+GROUP_SIZE = 12  # query heads per KV head
+NUM_KV_HEADS = (1, 2)  # 24 / 2 is the full model, 12 / 1 is one tensor-parallel rank of two
+HEAD_DIM = 256
+TOPK_WIDTHS = (2051, 2052)  # 512 blocks x 4 tokens + 3 tail tokens, or with a fourth, always empty tail slot
+SOFTMAX_SCALE = HEAD_DIM**-0.5
+_SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES = ((10, 0), (10, 3))
+
+
+def _dsl_cuda_version() -> tuple[int, int]:
+    from cutlass.base_dsl.version_info import CUDA_VERSION
+
+    return CUDA_VERSION.major, CUDA_VERSION.minor
+
+
+def _byte_span(tensor: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    # Exact for the contiguous layouts check_support admits.
+    return tensor.data_ptr(), tensor.data_ptr() + tensor.numel() * tensor.element_size()
+
+
+def _overlaps(lhs: tuple[int, int], rhs: tuple[int, int]) -> bool:
+    return lhs[0] < rhs[1] and rhs[0] < lhs[1]
+
+
+class _QsaTwoPassBackward(APIBase):
+    """QSA backward: dQ, dK and dV from Q, K, V, O, dO, the forward LSE and the selected token indices.
+
+    The geometry is 12 query heads per KV head with 2 KV heads (the model) or 1 (one of two tensor-parallel ranks),
+    read from the sample shapes. The T rows are one sequence, or with ``cu_seqlens`` (int32 ``[B + 1]`` prefix sums)
+    B packed sequences of at most ``max_seq_len`` tokens that attend within themselves. ``topk_idxs`` row ``i`` lists
+    the first token (its row in the packed buffer) of each of its ``min((p + 1) // 4, 512)`` complete 4-token blocks,
+    p the row's position in its sequence (the four ids of a block are consecutive and the blocks start at the
+    sequence's first token), then the ``(p + 1) % 4`` tail tokens, then ``-1``. Up to 2051 tokens every row is
+    therefore its whole causal prefix. The kernels read the block ids only and derive the tail block from the
+    position. Rows that break this layout are not checked. FP32 saved output pairs with head-major ``[Hq, T]`` LSE
+    and is read natively; BF16 saved output pairs with the earlier token-major ``[T, Hq]`` LSE contract.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        sample_q: torch.Tensor,  # (T, 12 * H_kv, 256) bf16
+        sample_k: torch.Tensor,  # (T, H_kv, 256) bf16, H_kv in (1, 2)
+        sample_v: torch.Tensor,  # (T, H_kv, 256) bf16
+        sample_out: torch.Tensor,  # (T, 12 * H_kv, 256) bf16 or fp32
+        sample_dout: torch.Tensor,  # (T, 12 * H_kv, 256) bf16
+        sample_lse: torch.Tensor,  # fp32 natural-log LSE: (Hq, T) with fp32 out, otherwise (T, Hq)
+        sample_topk_idxs: torch.Tensor,  # (T, 2051) or (T, 2052) int32
+        sample_dq: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        sample_dk: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        sample_dv: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        softmax_scale: Optional[float] = None,
+        sample_cu_seqlens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,  # (B + 1,) int32 sequence bounds of the packed rows
+        max_seq_len: Optional[int] = None,  # longest packed sequence, T when omitted
+    ):
+        """Capture the sample tensor contract. Missing output samples default to the input layouts."""
+        super().__init__()
+        self._warn_experimental_api()
+        self.descs = {
+            "q": self._make_tensor_desc(sample_q, name="sample_q"),
+            "k": self._make_tensor_desc(sample_k, name="sample_k"),
+            "v": self._make_tensor_desc(sample_v, name="sample_v"),
+            "out": self._make_tensor_desc(sample_out, name="sample_out"),
+            "dout": self._make_tensor_desc(sample_dout, name="sample_dout"),
+            "lse": self._make_tensor_desc(sample_lse, name="sample_lse"),
+            "topk_idxs": self._make_tensor_desc(sample_topk_idxs, name="sample_topk_idxs"),
+            "dq": self._make_tensor_desc(sample_q if sample_dq is None else sample_dq, name="sample_dq"),
+            "dk": self._make_tensor_desc(sample_k if sample_dk is None else sample_dk, name="sample_dk"),
+            "dv": self._make_tensor_desc(sample_v if sample_dv is None else sample_dv, name="sample_dv"),
+        }
+        if sample_cu_seqlens is not None:
+            self.descs["cu_seqlens"] = self._make_tensor_desc(sample_cu_seqlens, name="sample_cu_seqlens")
+        self.softmax_scale = softmax_scale
+        self.max_seq_len = max_seq_len
+        self._kernel_module = None
+        self._plan = None
+
+    def check_support(self) -> bool:
+        """Validate the DSL version, device, dtypes, shapes and layouts."""
+        error = cutedsl_requirement_error(self.__class__.__name__)
+        self._not_implemented_error_if(error is not None, error or "")
+
+        q_desc = self.descs["q"]
+        self._value_error_if(q_desc.device.type != "cuda" or q_desc.device.index is None, f"q must live on an indexed CUDA device, got {q_desc.device}")
+        capability = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(q_desc.device)
+        self._not_implemented_error_if(
+            capability not in _SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES,
+            f"{self.__class__.__name__} requires SM100 or SM103, found SM{capability[0]}{capability[1]}",
+        )
+        self._not_implemented_error_if(
+            self.softmax_scale not in (None, SOFTMAX_SCALE),
+            f"{self.__class__.__name__} supports only softmax_scale {SOFTMAX_SCALE}, got {self.softmax_scale}",
+        )
+        k_desc = self.descs["k"]
+        self._value_error_if(q_desc.ndim != 3 or k_desc.ndim != 3, f"q and k must be 3-D (T, heads, {HEAD_DIM}), got {q_desc.shape} and {k_desc.shape}")
+        seq_len = q_desc.shape[0]
+        num_kv_heads = k_desc.shape[1]
+        self._not_implemented_error_if(
+            num_kv_heads not in NUM_KV_HEADS,
+            f"{self.__class__.__name__} supports {NUM_KV_HEADS} KV heads with {GROUP_SIZE} query heads each, got k shape {k_desc.shape}",
+        )
+        num_q_heads = GROUP_SIZE * num_kv_heads
+        out_dtype = self.descs["out"].dtype
+        self._value_error_if(out_dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32), "out must be BF16 or FP32")
+        fp32_saved_state = out_dtype == torch.float32
+        idx_desc = self.descs["topk_idxs"]
+        topk_width = idx_desc.shape[1] if idx_desc.ndim == 2 and idx_desc.shape[1] in TOPK_WIDTHS else TOPK_WIDTHS[0]
+        expected = {
+            "q": ((seq_len, num_q_heads, HEAD_DIM), torch.bfloat16),
+            "k": ((seq_len, num_kv_heads, HEAD_DIM), torch.bfloat16),
+            "v": ((seq_len, num_kv_heads, HEAD_DIM), torch.bfloat16),
+            "out": ((seq_len, num_q_heads, HEAD_DIM), out_dtype),
+            "dout": ((seq_len, num_q_heads, HEAD_DIM), torch.bfloat16),
+            "lse": ((num_q_heads, seq_len) if fp32_saved_state else (seq_len, num_q_heads), torch.float32),
+            "topk_idxs": ((seq_len, topk_width), torch.int32),
+            "dq": ((seq_len, num_q_heads, HEAD_DIM), torch.bfloat16),
+            "dk": ((seq_len, num_kv_heads, HEAD_DIM), torch.bfloat16),
+            "dv": ((seq_len, num_kv_heads, HEAD_DIM), torch.bfloat16),
+        }
+        num_seqs = 0
+        if "cu_seqlens" in self.descs:
+            cu_desc = self.descs["cu_seqlens"]
+            self._value_error_if(cu_desc.ndim != 1 or cu_desc.shape[0] < 2, f"cu_seqlens must be 1-D with at least 2 entries, got {cu_desc.shape}")
+            num_seqs = cu_desc.shape[0] - 1
+            expected["cu_seqlens"] = ((num_seqs + 1,), torch.int32)
+        for name, (shape, dtype) in expected.items():
+            desc = self.descs[name]
+            self._value_error_if(desc.shape != shape, f"{name} must have shape {shape}, got {desc.shape}")
+            self._check_dtype(desc, dtype, name=name)
+            self._value_error_if(desc.device != q_desc.device, f"{name} must be on {q_desc.device}, got {desc.device}")

+            self._not_implemented_error_if(
+                not desc.is_contiguous(),
+                f"{self.__class__.__name__} addresses only contiguous {name}, got shape {desc.shape} strides {desc.stride}",
+            )
+        max_seq_len = seq_len if self.max_seq_len is None else int(self.max_seq_len)
+        self._value_error_if(not 1 <= max_seq_len <= seq_len, f"max_seq_len must be in [1, {seq_len}], got {max_seq_len}")
+
+        from . import qsa_bwd_sm100 as kernel
+
+        max_len = kernel.max_packed_len(num_kv_heads)
+        self._value_error_if(
+            not 1 <= seq_len <= max_len,
+            f"sequence length must be in [1, {max_len}], got {seq_len}",
+        )
+        self._kernel_module = kernel
+        self._plan = kernel.LaunchPlan(
+            seq_len, torch.cuda.get_device_properties(q_desc.device).multi_processor_count, num_kv_heads, num_seqs, max_seq_len, fp32_saved_state
+        )
+        if num_kv_heads == 1 and self._plan.has_sparse:
+            # The cu12 compiler crashes compiling the four-query key-major kernel
+            # in both DSL 4.7 and 4.8. Gate the actual compiler, not torch/CUDA_HOME.
+            compiler_cuda = _dsl_cuda_version()
+            self._not_implemented_error_if(
+                compiler_cuda[0] < 13,
+                f"QSA 12Q/1KV sparse backward requires the CUDA 13 build of CuTe DSL; found compiler CUDA {compiler_cuda[0]}.{compiler_cuda[1]}. "
+                "Install 'nvidia-cutlass-dsl[cu13]>=4.7.0' with a CUDA 13 compatible driver.",
+            )
+        self._is_supported = True
+        return True
+
+    def compile(self) -> None:
+        """Compile the launch sequence the plan's sequence length needs."""
+        self._ensure_support_checked()
+        if self._compiled_kernel is not None:
+            return
+        with torch.cuda.device(self.descs["q"].device):
+            self._compiled_kernel = self._kernel_module.compile_kernels(self._plan)
+
+    def scratch_workspace_bytes(self) -> int:
+        """Caller workspace bytes one execution needs."""
+        self._ensure_support_checked()
+        return self._plan.workspace_bytes()
+
+    def execute(
+        self,
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        k: torch.Tensor,
+        v: torch.Tensor,
+        out: torch.Tensor,
+        dout: torch.Tensor,
+        lse: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_idxs: torch.Tensor,
+        dq: torch.Tensor,
+        dk: torch.Tensor,
+        dv: torch.Tensor,
+        workspace: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        current_stream: Optional[cuda.CUstream] = None,
+        cu_seqlens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    ):
+        """Launch the backward on ``current_stream`` and return ``(dq, dk, dv)``."""
+        self._runtime_error_if(self._compiled_kernel is None, "plan not compiled; call compile() first")
+        tensors = {"q": q, "k": k, "v": v, "out": out, "dout": dout, "lse": lse, "topk_idxs": topk_idxs, "dq": dq, "dk": dk, "dv": dv}
+        if ("cu_seqlens" in self.descs) != (cu_seqlens is not None):
+            raise ValueError("cu_seqlens must be passed exactly when the plan was built with sample_cu_seqlens")
+        if cu_seqlens is not None:
+            tensors["cu_seqlens"] = cu_seqlens
+        for name, tensor in tensors.items():
+            desc = self.descs[name]
+            if not isinstance(tensor, torch.Tensor):
+                raise TypeError(f"{name} must be a torch.Tensor, got {type(tensor).__name__}")
+            if tuple(tensor.shape) != desc.shape or tuple(tensor.stride()) != desc.stride:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must match the compiled shape {desc.shape} and strides {desc.stride}")
+            if tensor.dtype != desc.dtype or tensor.device != desc.device:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must match the compiled dtype {desc.dtype} and device {desc.device}")
+            scalar_lse = name == "lse" and self.descs["out"].dtype == torch.float32
+            alignment = 4 if name in ("topk_idxs", "cu_seqlens") or scalar_lse else 16
+            if tensor.data_ptr() % alignment:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be {alignment}-byte aligned")
+        spans = {name: _byte_span(tensor) for name, tensor in tensors.items()}
+        for first, second in (("dq", "dk"), ("dq", "dv"), ("dk", "dv")):
+            if _overlaps(spans[first], spans[second]):
+                raise ValueError(f"{first} and {second} must not overlap")
+        if workspace is not None:
+            if workspace.device != q.device:
+                raise ValueError(f"workspace must be on {q.device}, got {workspace.device}")
+            carved = (workspace.data_ptr(), workspace.data_ptr() + self.scratch_workspace_bytes())
+            for name, span in spans.items():
+                if _overlaps(carved, span):

+            stream = self._get_default_stream(current_stream)
+            self._kernel_module.launch(self._plan, self._compiled_kernel, q, k, v, out, dout, lse, topk_idxs, dq, dk, dv, scratch, stream, cu_seqlens)
+        return dq, dk, dv
+
+
+_cache_of__QsaTwoPassBackwardObjects: dict = {}
+
+
+def _backward(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    dout: torch.Tensor,
+    lse: torch.Tensor,
+    topk_idxs: torch.Tensor,
+    dq: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    dk: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    dv: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    stream: Optional[cuda.CUstream] = None,
+    workspace: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    softmax_scale: Optional[float] = None,
+    cu_seqlens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    max_seq_len: Optional[int] = None,
+) -> TupleDict:
+    """High-level wrapper returning ``{'dq', 'dk', 'dv'}``."""
+    inputs = (q, k, v, out, dout, lse, topk_idxs)
+    key = (q.device, softmax_scale, max_seq_len) + tuple((tuple(t.shape), t.stride(), t.dtype) for t in inputs)
+    key += tuple(None if t is None else (tuple(t.shape), t.stride(), t.dtype) for t in (dq, dk, dv, cu_seqlens))
+    obj = _cache_of__QsaTwoPassBackwardObjects.get(key)
+    if obj is None:
+        obj = _QsaTwoPassBackward(
+            *inputs, sample_dq=dq, sample_dk=dk, sample_dv=dv, softmax_scale=softmax_scale, sample_cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens, max_seq_len=max_seq_len
+        )
+        obj.check_support()
+        obj.compile()
+        _cache_of__QsaTwoPassBackwardObjects[key] = obj
+
+    with torch.cuda.device(q.device), stream_context(stream, q.device):
+        dq = torch.empty_like(q) if dq is None else dq
+        dk = torch.empty_like(k) if dk is None else dk
+        dv = torch.empty_like(v) if dv is None else dv
+        if workspace is None:
+            workspace = torch.empty(obj.scratch_workspace_bytes(), dtype=torch.uint8, device=q.device)
+    obj.execute(*inputs, dq, dk, dv, workspace=workspace, current_stream=stream, cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens)
+    return TupleDict(dq=dq, dk=dk, dv=dv)

+def sdpa_capabilities() -> frozenset:
+    """Names of the SDPA binding capabilities this build of cudnn-frontend provides, as a frozenset of ``str``.

+"""Warp-level FP32 amax reductions that also assemble on SM110 (Jetson Thor).
+
+``redux.sync.max.f32`` (``cute.arch.warp_redux_sync`` with ``kind="fmax"``) is
+not available on ``sm_110a`` even though the block-scaled ``tcgen05`` MMA is, so
+a kernel that reaches it fails in ptxas (#1686).  Every FP32 amax reduction in
+the CuTeDSL GEMM kernels goes through :func:`warp_amax_with_nan`, which keeps
+the single-instruction path on other targets and unrolls a butterfly shuffle on
+SM110.  Both forms propagate NaN and reduce across the full warp.
+"""
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+
+
+def target_needs_shuffle_amax() -> bool:
+    """True when the current compile target cannot assemble ``redux.f32``."""
+    from cutlass.cutlass_dsl import CuTeDSL
+
+    arch = CuTeDSL._get_dsl().get_arch_enum()
+    return (int(arch.major), int(arch.minor)) == (11, 0)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def warp_amax_with_nan(value):
+    """Full-warp FP32 max with NaN propagation; ``redux.f32`` or an SM110 shuffle."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(target_needs_shuffle_amax()):
+        for shift in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+            value = cute.arch.fmax(value, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(value, offset=1 << shift), nan=True)
+    else:
+        value = cute.arch.warp_redux_sync(value=value, kind="fmax", mask_and_clamp=0xFFFFFFFF, nan=True)
+    return value

+The backend's blob is its execution plan. A python engine's plan is not a blob: it is a
+deterministic function of the graph and ``(engine_id, knobs)``, which is exactly what
+``create_execution_plan`` replays. So the blob carries that recipe and, optionally, the
+compiled kernels the plan was built from:
+
+    MAGIC | header length (u64 LE) | header (JSON, utf-8) | kernel objects
+
+- ``graph``: every node and tensor of the python IR, tensors referenced by uid. A value the
+  encoder cannot represent exactly (a score_mod callback, a framework object) refuses
+  serialization; nothing is dropped silently.
+- ``plan``: the selected plan's ``(engine_id, public knobs)``. Engine ids and knob values are
+  append-only, so the recipe stays valid on any frontend that still ships the engine.
+- ``kernels``: the ``compiled_cache`` entries the plan's build used, each with the environment
+  manifest it was compiled under. Deserialize installs one only when that manifest equals the
+  current process's exactly; otherwise the kernel is compiled again. A stale object is never
+  loaded.

+    if isinstance(data, (list, tuple)) and len(data) >= len(MAGIC):
+        try:
+            return bytes(data[: len(MAGIC)]) == MAGIC
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            return False
+    return False
+

+class _Unserializable(TypeError):
+    pass
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Values
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _type_path(t: type) -> str:
+    return f"{t.__module__}:{t.__qualname__}"
+
+
+def _resolve_type(path: str) -> type:
+    module, _, qualname = path.partition(":")
+    if module.split(".")[0] not in ("cudnn", "_compiled_module"):
+        raise ValueError(f"serialized plan names a type outside cudnn: {path!r}")
+    obj: Any = importlib.import_module(module)
+    for part in qualname.split("."):
+        obj = getattr(obj, part)
+    if not (isinstance(obj, type) and hasattr(obj, "__members__")):
+        raise ValueError(f"serialized plan names a type that is not an enum: {path!r}")
+    return obj
+
+
+def _encode(value: Any, where: str) -> Any:
+    if value is None or isinstance(value, (bool, int, float, str)):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, Tensor):
+        return {"$tensor": value.uid}
+    if isinstance(value, enum.Enum):
+        if isinstance(value, int):
+            return {"$enum": _type_path(type(value)), "value": int(value), "name": value.name}
+        return {"$enum": _type_path(type(value)), "name": value.name}
+    t = type(value)
+    if hasattr(t, "__members__") and hasattr(value, "name") and hasattr(value, "__int__"):  # pybind11 enum
+        return {"$enum": _type_path(t), "value": int(value), "name": value.name}
+    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
+        items = [_encode(v, f"{where}[{i}]") for i, v in enumerate(value)]
+        return items if isinstance(value, list) else {"$tuple": items}
+    if isinstance(value, dict) and all(isinstance(k, str) for k in value):
+        return {"$dict": {k: _encode(v, f"{where}.{k}") for k, v in value.items()}}
+    raise _Unserializable(f"{where} holds a {t.__module__}.{t.__qualname__}, which a serialized plan cannot represent")
+
+
+def _decode(value: Any, tensors: Dict[int, Tensor]) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return [_decode(v, tensors) for v in value]
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        return value
+    if "$tensor" in value:
+        return tensors[value["$tensor"]]
+    if "$tuple" in value:
+        return tuple(_decode(v, tensors) for v in value["$tuple"])
+    if "$dict" in value:
+        return {k: _decode(v, tensors) for k, v in value["$dict"].items()}
+    if "$enum" in value:
+        t = _resolve_type(value["$enum"])
+        # Values are the append-only contract for backend-mirrored enums (data_type, knob_type);
+        # python enums are looked up by name.
+        if "value" in value and (type(value["value"]) is not int):
+            raise ValueError(f"serialized enum value must be an integer: {value!r}")
+        return t(value["value"]) if "value" in value else t[value["name"]]
+    raise ValueError(f"serialized plan holds an unknown value encoding: {sorted(value)}")
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Graph
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _tensor_fields() -> List[str]:
+    return [f.name for f in dataclasses.fields(Tensor) if f.name != "owner"]
+
+
+def _encode_graph(graph: "pygraph") -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    ctx = graph._context
+    return {
+        "context": {
+            "io_data_type": _encode(ctx.io_data_type, "context.io_data_type"),
+            "intermediate_data_type": _encode(ctx.intermediate_data_type, "context.intermediate_data_type"),
+            "compute_data_type": _encode(ctx.compute_data_type, "context.compute_data_type"),
+        },
+        "graph_kwargs": {k: _encode(graph._cpp_graph_kwargs[k], f"graph.{k}") for k in _GRAPH_KWARGS if k in graph._cpp_graph_kwargs},
+        "is_cuda_graph_replay_expected": graph.is_cuda_graph_replay_expected,
+        "next_uid": graph._next_uid,
+        "reserved_uids": sorted(graph._reserved_uids),
+        "node_count": dict(graph._node_count),
+        "tensors": [{f: _encode(getattr(t, f), f"tensor {t.name!r}.{f}") for f in _tensor_fields()} for t in graph._tensor_by_uid.values()],
+        "nodes": [
+            {
+                "name": n.name,
+                "node_type": n.node_type.name,
+                "compute_data_type": _encode(n.compute_data_type, f"node {n.name!r}.compute_data_type"),
+                "inputs": {port: t.uid for port, t in n.inputs.items()},
+                "outputs": {port: t.uid for port, t in n.outputs.items()},
+                "params": {k: _encode(v, f"node {n.name!r} param {k!r}") for k, v in n.params.items()},
+            }
+            for n in graph._nodes
+        ],
+    }
+
+
+def _decode_graph(graph: "pygraph", data: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    from ._pygraph import GraphContext
+
+    ctx = data["context"]
+    graph._context = GraphContext(**{k: _decode(v, {}) for k, v in ctx.items()})
+    for k, v in data["graph_kwargs"].items():
+        graph._cpp_graph_kwargs[k] = _decode(v, {})
+    graph.is_cuda_graph_replay_expected = bool(data["is_cuda_graph_replay_expected"])

+    for record in data["tensors"]:

+        t = Tensor(**{k: _decode(v, {}) for k, v in attrs.items()})
+        for k in ("dim", "stride"):

+        tensors[t.uid] = t
+        pending.append((t, record.get("ragged_offset")))

+        t.ragged_offset = _decode(ragged, tensors)

+        node = Node(record["name"], NodeType[record["node_type"]], _decode(record["compute_data_type"], tensors))
+        node.inputs = {port: tensors[uid] for port, uid in record["inputs"].items()}
+        node.outputs = {port: tensors[uid] for port, uid in record["outputs"].items()}
+        node.params = {k: _decode(v, tensors) for k, v in record["params"].items()}
+        graph._nodes.append(node)

+    graph._reserved_uids = set(data["reserved_uids"])
+    graph._node_count = dict(data["node_count"])
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Blob
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def serialize(graph: "pygraph", include_kernels: bool) -> bytes:
+    """The blob for ``graph``'s selected, built python-engine plan."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    from .frost import compiled_cache
+
+    index = graph._plan_index
+    engine = graph.selected_engine
+    engine_id, knobs = graph.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(index)
+    try:
+        header: Dict[str, Any] = {
+            "format": FORMAT,
+            "frontend_version": str(getattr(cudnn, "__version__", "unknown")),
+            "graph": _encode_graph(graph),
+            "plan": {
+                "engine_id": int(engine_id),
+                "engine_name": engine.name,
+                "knobs": [[_encode(k, "knob type"), int(v)] for k, v in knobs.items()],
+            },
+            "kernels": [],
+        }
+    except _Unserializable as exc:
+        raise cudnn_graph_not_supported(f"serialize(): {exc}") from None
+    payload = bytearray()
+    if include_kernels:
+        for entry in graph._plan_kernel_entries.get(index, ()):
+            item = compiled_cache.read_entry(entry)
+            if item is None:
+                continue  # pruned since the build: the deserializing process compiles it
+            description, data = item
+            description.update(offset=len(payload), size=len(data))
+            header["kernels"].append(description)
+            payload += data
+    text = json.dumps(header, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
+    return MAGIC + _LEN.pack(len(text)) + text + bytes(payload)
+
+
+def deserialize(graph: "pygraph", data: Any, handle: Any = None, enforce_precompiled: bool = False) -> None:
+    """Rebuild a blob from :func:`serialize` into the empty ``graph`` and build its plan."""
+    from .frost import compiled_cache
+
+    blob = bytes(data)
+    if graph._nodes or graph._planning_done:
+        raise RuntimeError("deserialize() of a python-engine plan needs an empty pygraph (no nodes, no plans)")
+    start = len(MAGIC) + _LEN.size
+    if len(blob) < start:
+        raise ValueError("serialized python-engine plan is truncated")
+    (length,) = _LEN.unpack_from(blob, len(MAGIC))
+    if len(blob) < start + length:
+        raise ValueError("serialized python-engine plan is truncated")
+    header = json.loads(blob[start : start + length].decode("utf-8"))
+    payload = memoryview(blob)[start + length :]
+    if header.get("format") != FORMAT:
+        raise ValueError(f"serialized python-engine plan has format {header.get('format')!r}; this frontend reads format {FORMAT}")
+
+    device = getattr(getattr(handle if handle is not None else graph._handle, "device", None), "ordinal", None)
+    seeded = 0
+    for description in header["kernels"]:
+        offset, size = int(description.pop("offset")), int(description.pop("size"))
+        if offset < 0 or offset + size > len(payload):
+            raise ValueError("serialized python-engine plan is truncated")
+        if compiled_cache.seed_entry(description, bytes(payload[offset : offset + size]), device=device):
+            seeded += 1
+    seeded_note = f"{seeded} of the blob's {len(header['kernels'])} kernels match this environment (frontend, CuTe DSL, tvm-ffi, driver, device)"
+
+    # Any later failure restores the empty graph, so the caller can retry on it.
+    empty = {k: copy.copy(v) if isinstance(v, (list, dict, set)) else v for k, v in vars(graph).items()}
+    try:
+        _rebuild(graph, header, handle, enforce_precompiled, seeded_note)
+    except BaseException:
+        vars(graph).clear()
+        vars(graph).update(empty)
+        raise
+
+
+def _rebuild(graph: "pygraph", header: Dict[str, Any], handle: Any, enforce_precompiled: bool, seeded_note: str) -> None:
+    from .frost import compiled_cache
+
+    if handle is not None:
+        graph._handle = handle
+    _decode_graph(graph, header["graph"])
+    plan = header["plan"]
+    knobs = {_decode(k, {}): int(v) for k, v in plan["knobs"]}
+    graph.validate()
+    graph.create_execution_plan(int(plan["engine_id"]), knobs)
+    graph.select_plan(len(graph._plans) - 1)
+    engine = graph.selected_engine
+    if engine is None or engine.name != plan["engine_name"]:
+        raise ValueError(f"engine id {plan['engine_id']} is {getattr(engine, 'name', 'the backend')!r} here, not {plan['engine_name']!r}")
+    if not enforce_precompiled:
+        graph.build_plans()
+        return
+    try:
+        with compiled_cache.refuse_compiles():
+            graph.build_plans()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        cause: Any = exc
+        while cause is not None and not isinstance(cause, compiled_cache.CompileRefused):
+            cause = cause.__cause__ or cause.__context__
+        if cause is None:
+            raise
+        raise cudnn_graph_not_supported(
+            f"enforce_precompiled: a kernel of the plan is neither in the blob nor in the compiled cache ({seeded_note}); {cause}"
+        ) from exc
+

+def cudnn_graph_not_supported(message: str) -> Exception:
+    from ._pygraph import cudnn_graph_not_supported as make
+
+    return make(message)

+"""KPage entry points behind the ``kpage=`` argument of the BSA wrappers."""

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional, Tuple, Union
+
+import torch
+
+from .kpage._layout import KPageLayout
+
+KPAGE_MIN_CUTEDSL = (4, 6, 2)
+
+
+def _require_cutedsl() -> None:
+    from ._interface import _cutlass_dsl_version
+
+    version = _cutlass_dsl_version()
+    if version < KPAGE_MIN_CUTEDSL:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "KPage block-sparse attention requires nvidia-cutlass-dsl>="
+            + ".".join(map(str, KPAGE_MIN_CUTEDSL))
+            + "; found "
+            + ".".join(map(str, version))
+            + ". The other BSA paths remain available."
+        )
+
+
+def _normalize_metadata(
+    q2k_block_index: torch.Tensor,
+    block_sparse_num: Optional[int],
+    block_sizes: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    q2k_block_nums: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    q_block_sizes: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    num_kv_blocks: Optional[int],
+    sparse_block_size: int = 128,
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Expand the BSA metadata to the four tensors the layout builder consumes.
+
+    The batch is folded into the head dimension: the layout tables are per
+    (batch, head) and ``block_sizes`` is shared across the batch anyway.
+    """
+    if q2k_block_index.ndim != 4 or q2k_block_index.dtype != torch.int32 or not q2k_block_index.is_cuda:
+        raise ValueError("q2k_block_index must be a rank-4 int32 CUDA tensor")
+    if not q2k_block_index.is_contiguous() or (q2k_block_nums is not None and not q2k_block_nums.is_contiguous()):
+        raise NotImplementedError("kpage requires contiguous q2k_block_index and q2k_block_nums")
+    batch, heads, num_q_blocks, capacity = q2k_block_index.shape
+    q2k_block_index = q2k_block_index.view(1, batch * heads, num_q_blocks, capacity)
+    if q2k_block_nums is None:
+        if block_sparse_num is None:
+            block_sparse_num = capacity
+        if not 1 <= block_sparse_num <= capacity:
+            raise ValueError(f"block_sparse_num must be in [1, {capacity}], got {block_sparse_num}")

+        raise ValueError(f"block_sizes has {block_sizes.numel()} entries, seqlen_k spans {num_kv_blocks} KV blocks")

+        q_block_sizes = torch.full((num_q_blocks,), sparse_block_size, dtype=torch.int32, device=q2k_block_index.device)

+
+
+def _metadata_source(q2k_block_index, block_sparse_num, block_sizes, q2k_block_nums) -> tuple:
+    """Identity of the metadata arguments: storage, shape and strides of each tensor.
+
+    A layout remembers what it was built from so a call that passes it with
+    other metadata is rejected instead of silently running the wrong pattern.
+    The tensors themselves are kept alive by the layout, so storage addresses
+    cannot be recycled behind the check.
+    """
+
+    def ident(t):
+        return None if t is None else (t.data_ptr(), tuple(t.shape), tuple(t.stride()), t)
+
+    # block_sparse_num only matters with fixed counts, and None means "the whole row"
+    if q2k_block_nums is not None:
+        block_sparse_num = None
+    elif block_sparse_num is None:
+        block_sparse_num = int(q2k_block_index.shape[-1])
+    return (ident(q2k_block_index), block_sparse_num, ident(block_sizes), ident(q2k_block_nums))

+
+

+    q2k_block_index: torch.Tensor,
+    block_sparse_num: Optional[int],
+    block_sizes: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    q2k_block_nums: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    *,
+    q_block_sizes: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    seqlen_q: Optional[int] = None,
+    seqlen_k: Optional[int] = None,
+    validate: bool,
+    allow_empty_block_nums: bool = False,
+    bwd_kv_groups: Optional[int],
+    with_backward: bool = False,
+    sparse_block_size: int = 128,

+            seqlen_k=seqlen_k,
+            validate=validate,
+            allow_empty_block_nums=allow_empty_block_nums,
+            bwd_kv_groups=bwd_kv_groups,

+
+
+def resolve_layout(
+    kpage: Union[bool, KPageLayout],
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+    q2k_block_index: torch.Tensor,
+    block_sparse_num: Optional[int],
+    block_sizes: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    q2k_block_nums: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    *,
+    arch: int,
+    sparse_block_size: int,
+    allow_empty_block_nums: bool,
+    extra: Tuple[Optional[torch.Tensor], ...] = (),

+    _require_cutedsl()

+    if isinstance(kpage, KPageLayout):
+        if kpage.sparse_block_size != sparse_block_size:
+            raise ValueError(f"the KPageLayout was built for sparse_block_size={kpage.sparse_block_size}, the call uses {sparse_block_size}")
+        if kpage.device != q.device:
+            raise ValueError(f"the KPageLayout was built on {kpage.device}, q is on {q.device}")
+        if (kpage.num_heads, kpage.seqlen_q, kpage.seqlen_k) != (batch * heads, seqlen_q, seqlen_k):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"the KPageLayout describes {kpage.num_heads} (batch x heads) x {kpage.seqlen_q} query / {kpage.seqlen_k} key tokens, "
+                f"the call has {batch} x {heads} x {seqlen_q} / {seqlen_k}"
+            )
+        if not _same_source(kpage._source, _metadata_source(q2k_block_index, block_sparse_num, block_sizes, q2k_block_nums)):
+            raise ValueError("the KPageLayout was built from different sparse metadata; pass the same tensors, rebuild it, or use kpage=True")
+        return kpage
+    if kpage is not True:
+        raise TypeError(f"kpage must be False, True, or a KPageLayout, got {type(kpage).__name__}")
+    return prepare_layout(
+        q2k_block_index,
+        block_sparse_num,
+        block_sizes,
+        q2k_block_nums,
+        seqlen_q=seqlen_q,
+        seqlen_k=seqlen_k,
+        validate=True,
+        allow_empty_block_nums=allow_empty_block_nums,
+        bwd_kv_groups=None,
+        sparse_block_size=sparse_block_size,
+    )
+
+
+def _fold(t: Optional[torch.Tensor], name: str = "tensor") -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+    """[B, H, ...] -> [1, B * H, ...] view; the kernels run a batch as batch x heads."""
+    if t is None:
+        return None
+    try:
+        return t.view(1, t.shape[0] * t.shape[1], *t.shape[2:])
+    except RuntimeError:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"kpage runs a batch as batch x heads and needs {name} to be viewable as [1, batch * heads, ...]; a BSHD batch > 1 is not"
+        ) from None
+
+
+def forward(q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor, v: torch.Tensor, layout_obj: KPageLayout, softmax_scale: Optional[float]):
+    from .kpage import _interface

+    batch, heads = q.shape[:2]
+    out, lse = _interface.forward(_fold(q), _fold(k), _fold(v), layout_obj, softmax_scale)
+    return out.view(batch, heads, *out.shape[2:]), lse.view(batch, heads, lse.shape[2])
+
+
+def backward(
+    do: torch.Tensor,
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    v: torch.Tensor,
+    o: torch.Tensor,
+    lse: torch.Tensor,
+    layout_obj: KPageLayout,
+    softmax_scale: Optional[float],
+    dq: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    dk: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    dv: Optional[torch.Tensor],

+"""Match KV neighborhoods in groups of eight and partition common/residual edges.
+
+Duplicate edges disable pairing for their eight-KV group, preserving multiset
+semantics through the regular path. All metadata is rebuilt on every call.
+"""
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass import Int32
+from ..utils.kernel_utils import warp_prefix_sum
+
+
+class PairedKvNeighborhoods:
+    @cute.kernel
+    def clear(self, bits: cute.Tensor, duplicates: cute.Tensor):
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        block, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        i = block * 256 + tid
+        flat_bits = cute.make_tensor(bits.iterator, cute.make_layout(cute.size(bits)))
+        flat_duplicates = cute.make_tensor(duplicates.iterator, cute.make_layout(cute.size(duplicates)))
+        if i < cute.size(bits):
+            flat_bits[i] = Int32(0)
+        if i < cute.size(duplicates):
+            flat_duplicates[i] = Int32(0)
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def scatter(
+        self,
+        indices: cute.Tensor,
+        counts: cute.Tensor,
+        bits: cute.Tensor,
+        duplicates: cute.Tensor,
+    ):
+        tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        q, h, b = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        mask = Int32(1) << (q % 32)
+        count = counts[b, h, q]
+        for edge in cutlass.range(tid, count, 128):
+            k = indices[b, h, q, edge]
+            if k >= 0 and k < bits.shape[2]:
+                ptr = bits.iterator + cute.crd2idx((b, h, k, q // 32), bits.layout)
+                previous = Int32(cute.arch.atomic_or(ptr.llvm_ptr, mask, sem="relaxed", scope="gpu"))
+                if (previous & mask) != 0:
+                    dup_ptr = duplicates.iterator + cute.crd2idx((b, h, k // 2), duplicates.layout)
+                    cute.arch.atomic_or(dup_ptr.llvm_ptr, Int32(1), sem="relaxed", scope="gpu")
+
+
+def _matchings(vertices):
+    if not vertices:
+        yield ()
+    else:
+        first = vertices[0]
+        for other in vertices[1:]:
+            for rest in _matchings(tuple(x for x in vertices if x not in (first, other))):
+                yield ((first, other),) + rest
+
+
+class LocalPairMatch8:
+    def __init__(self):
+        edges = tuple((i, j) for i in range(8) for j in range(i + 1, 8))
+        patterns = tuple(_matchings(tuple(range(8))))
+        assert len(patterns) == 105
+        self.edges = edges
+        self.pair_ids = tuple(tuple(edges.index(edge) for edge in pattern) for pattern in patterns)
+        self.larger_nodes = tuple(tuple(j for i, j in pattern) for pattern in patterns)
+        encodings = []
+        for pattern in patterns:
+            partner = [0] * 8
+            for i, j in pattern:
+                partner[i], partner[j] = j, i
+            encodings.append(sum(p << (3 * i) for i, p in enumerate(partner)))
+        self.encodings = tuple(encodings)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        bits: cute.Tensor,
+        duplicates: cute.Tensor,
+        partners: cute.Tensor,
+        owners: cute.Tensor,
+        common: cute.Tensor,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        self.match(bits, duplicates, partners, owners, common).launch(
+            grid=(cute.ceil_div(bits.shape[2], 8), bits.shape[1], bits.shape[0]), block=(32, 1, 1), stream=stream
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def match(
+        self,
+        bits: cute.Tensor,
+        duplicates: cute.Tensor,
+        partners: cute.Tensor,
+        owners: cute.Tensor,
+        common: cute.Tensor,
+    ):
+        lane, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        group, head, batch = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        start = group * 8
+        weights = cute.make_rmem_tensor((28,), Int32)
+        weights.fill(0)
+        values = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), Int32)

+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):

+                    values[i] = bits[batch, head, start + i, word]

+                weights[e] += Int32(cute.arch.popc(values[self.edges[e][0]] & values[self.edges[e][1]]))
+        for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(28):
+            weights[e] = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(warp_prefix_sum(weights[e], lane), 31)
+        best_score, best_tie, encoding = Int32(-1), Int32(0), Int32(0)
+        for p in cutlass.range_constexpr(105):
+            if lane == p % 32:
+                score, real_pairs = Int32(0), Int32(0)
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    score += weights[self.pair_ids[p][j]]
+                    real_pairs += Int32(start + self.larger_nodes[p][j] < bits.shape[2])
+                # Prefer real-real pairs over multiple real-dummy ties at tails.
+                tie = real_pairs * 4096 + (104 - p) * 32 + lane

+                    best_score, best_tie, encoding = score, tie, Int32(self.encodings[p])
+        for step in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+            other_score = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(best_score, lane ^ (1 << step))
+            other_tie = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(best_tie, lane ^ (1 << step))
+            if other_score > best_score or (other_score == best_score and other_tie > best_tie):
+                best_score, best_tie = other_score, other_tie
+        encoding = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(encoding, best_tie & 31)
+        duplicate = Int32(0)
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            if start // 2 + i < duplicates.shape[2]:
+                duplicate |= duplicates[batch, head, start // 2 + i]
+        if duplicate != 0:
+            encoding = Int32(self.encodings[0])
+        relative_partner = (encoding >> (3 * (lane % 8))) & 7
+        partner = start + relative_partner
+        valid = lane < 8 and start + lane < bits.shape[2]
+        owner = valid and relative_partner > lane
+        rank = warp_prefix_sum(Int32(owner), lane)
+        if valid:
+            partners[batch, head, start + lane] = Int32(-1) if duplicate != 0 or partner >= bits.shape[2] else partner
+        if owner:
+            owners[batch, head, start // 2 + rank - 1] = start + lane
+        if lane == 0:
+            common[batch, head, group] = Int32(0) if duplicate != 0 else best_score
+

+class LocalPairPartition8:
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        bits: cute.Tensor,
+        partners: cute.Tensor,
+        offsets: cute.Tensor,
+        indices: cute.Tensor,
+        residuals: cute.Tensor,
+        bucket_size: cutlass.Constexpr,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        self.partition(bits, partners, offsets, indices, residuals, bucket_size).launch(
+            grid=(cute.ceil_div(bits.shape[2], 2) * offsets.shape[2], bits.shape[1], bits.shape[0]),
+            block=(32, 1, 1),
+            stream=stream,
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def partition(
+        self,
+        bits: cute.Tensor,
+        partners: cute.Tensor,
+        offsets: cute.Tensor,
+        indices: cute.Tensor,
+        residuals: cute.Tensor,
+        bucket_size: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ):
+        lane, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        task, h, b = cute.arch.block_idx()
+        tasks_per_group = cute.ceil_div(bits.shape[2], 2)
+        pair_slot = task % tasks_per_group
+        group = task // tasks_per_group
+        first_k = partners[b, h, bits.shape[2] + pair_slot]
+        start = (first_k // 8) * 8
+        partner0 = partners[b, h, start]
+        partner1 = Int32(-1)
+        if start + 1 < bits.shape[2]:
+            partner1 = partners[b, h, start + 1]
+        fallback = partner0 < 0 and partner1 < 0
+        if first_k < bits.shape[2]:
+            second_k = partners[b, h, first_k]
+            if fallback:
+                second_k = first_k + 1
+            has_second = second_k >= 0 and second_k < bits.shape[2]
+            begin0 = offsets[b, h, group, first_k]
+            end0 = offsets[b, h, group, first_k + 1]
+            begin1, end1 = Int32(0), Int32(0)
+            valid = has_second and not fallback
+            if has_second:
+                begin1 = offsets[b, h, group, second_k]
+                end1 = offsets[b, h, group, second_k + 1]
+            common_count = Int32(0)
+            q_begin = group * bucket_size
+            q_end = q_begin + bucket_size
+            word_begin = q_begin // 32
+            word_end = cute.min(cute.ceil_div(q_end, 32), bits.shape[3])
+            if valid:
+                for word in cutlass.range(word_begin + lane, word_end, 32):
+                    common = bits[b, h, first_k, word] & bits[b, h, second_k, word]
+                    if word * 32 < q_begin:
+                        common = common & (Int32(-1) << (q_begin % 32))
+                    if word * 32 + 32 > q_end and q_end % 32 != 0:
+                        common = common & ((Int32(1) << (q_end % 32)) - 1)
+                    common_count += Int32(cute.arch.popc(common))
+                common_count = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(warp_prefix_sum(common_count, lane), 31)
+            residual0 = end0 - begin0 - common_count
+            residual1 = end1 - begin1 - common_count

+                residuals[b, h, group, first_k] = residual0
+                if has_second:
+                    residuals[b, h, group, second_k] = residual1
+            if common_count > 0:
+                running0 = begin0
+                running1 = begin1
+                running_common = begin0 + residual0

+                    word = word_begin + tile * 32 + lane
+                    first = Int32(0)
+                    second = Int32(0)
+                    if word < word_end:
+                        first = bits[b, h, first_k, word]
+                        second = bits[b, h, second_k, word]
+                    keep = Int32(-1)
+                    if word * 32 < q_begin:
+                        keep = keep & (Int32(-1) << (q_begin % 32))
+                    if word * 32 + 32 > q_end and q_end % 32 != 0:
+                        keep = keep & ((Int32(1) << (q_end % 32)) - 1)
+                    for category in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+                        if cutlass.const_expr(category == 0):
+                            value = first & ~second & keep
+                            running = running0

+                            value = second & ~first & keep

+                            indices[b, h, position] = word * 32 + bit
+                            position += 1

+                        if cutlass.const_expr(category == 0):
+                            running0 = running
+                        elif cutlass.const_expr(category == 1):
+                            running1 = running
+                        else:
+                            running_common = running

+class LocalPairRefineBatchWide:
+    def __init__(self, width, iterations, word_capacity):
+        assert width in (16, 32, 64)
+        assert word_capacity > 0
+        self.width, self.iterations = width, iterations
+        self.word_capacity = word_capacity
+        self.threads = 512 if width == 64 else (256 if width == 32 else 128)

+    @cute.jit

+        self.refine(bits, duplicates, partners, owners, common).launch(
+            grid=(cute.ceil_div(bits.shape[2], self.width), bits.shape[1], bits.shape[0]), block=(self.threads, 1, 1), stream=stream
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def refine(self, bits: cute.Tensor, duplicates: cute.Tensor, partners: cute.Tensor, owners: cute.Tensor, common: cute.Tensor):
+        # Keep the historical cost limit, evaluated for every invocation.
+        # Above it, exact-eight matching remains untouched.
+        if bits.shape[3] <= 1024:
+            tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()

+            pairs = cute.ceil_div(real, 2)

+                    duplicate |= duplicates[b, h, start // 2 + i]

+                a = owners[b, h, start // 2 + tid] - start
+                second = partners[b, h, start + a] - start
+                if second < 0:
+                    second = real
+                if duplicate != 0:
+                    a, second = tid * 2, tid * 2 + 1
+                aa[tid], bb[tid] = a, second

+    @cute.jit
+    def load_pair(self, atom, tensor, shared, pair, head, batch, barrier):
+        layout = cute.make_layout((64, 64), stride=(64, 1))
+        source = tensor[None, None, (head, batch)]
+        for plane in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+            for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+                dest = cute.make_tensor(shared.iterator + plane * 8192 + half * 4096, layout)
+                tile = cute.local_tile(cute.domain_offset((pair[half] * 64, plane * 64), source), (64, 64), (0, 0))
+                dst, src = cpasync.tma_partition(atom, 0, cute.make_layout(1), cute.group_modes(dest, 0, 2), cute.group_modes(tile, 0, 2))
+                cute.copy(atom, src, dst, tma_bar_ptr=barrier)

+    @cute.jit

+        self,
+        tStS: cute.Tensor,
+        tdPtdP: cute.Tensor,
+        sLSE: cute.Tensor,

+        sP: cute.Tensor,

+        scale_softmax: Float32,
+        pipeline_args: tuple,
+    ):
+        tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        _, blk_coord_h, blk_coord_b = self.logical_block_coord(problem_shape[0])
+        seqlen_q, seqlen_k, head_dim, HB = problem_shape
+        num_heads, batch_size = HB
+        (
+            mma_compute_S_pipeline,
+            compute_mma_P_pipeline,
+            load_compute_LSE_pipeline,
+            load_compute_sum_OdO_pipeline,
+            mma_compute_dP_pipeline,
+            compute_mma_dS_pipeline,
+            mma_compute_dKdV_pipeline,

+
+        mma_compute_S_consumer_state = pipeline.make_pipeline_state(pipeline.PipelineUserType.Consumer, self.mma_compute_S_stage)
+        compute_mma_P_producer_state = pipeline.make_pipeline_state(pipeline.PipelineUserType.Producer, self.compute_mma_P_stage)
+        load_compute_LSE_consumer_state = pipeline.make_pipeline_state(pipeline.PipelineUserType.Consumer, self.load_compute_LSE_stage)
+        load_compute_sum_OdO_consumer_state = pipeline.make_pipeline_state(pipeline.PipelineUserType.Consumer, self.load_compute_sum_OdO_stage)
+        mma_compute_dP_consumer_state = pipeline.make_pipeline_state(pipeline.PipelineUserType.Consumer, self.mma_compute_dP_stage)
+        compute_mma_dS_producer_state = pipeline.make_pipeline_state(pipeline.PipelineUserType.Producer, self.compute_mma_dS_stage)
+        mma_compute_dKdV_consumer_state = pipeline.make_pipeline_state(pipeline.PipelineUserType.Consumer, self.mma_compute_dKdV_stage)

+        tmem_load_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(
+            tcgen05.copy.Ld32x32bOp(tcgen05.copy.Repetition(16)),
+            self.acc_dtype,
+        )
+
+        # (128, 64)
+        tStS = tStS[(None, None), 0, 0]
+        # (128, 64)
+        tdPtdP = tdPtdP[(None, None), 0, 0]
+
+        cS = cute.make_identity_tensor(cute.select(self.QK_mma_tiler, mode=[0, 1]))

+        block_size_k = Int32(self.sparse_block_size)

+            packed_p = cute.recast_tensor(tRS_rP, Float32)

+            cute.arch.fence_proxy(
+                "async.shared",
+                space="cta",
+            )

+            # Notify for P
+            compute_mma_P_pipeline.producer_commit(compute_mma_P_producer_state)
+            compute_mma_P_producer_state.advance()
+
+            # Release S
+            mma_compute_S_pipeline.consumer_release(mma_compute_S_consumer_state)
+            mma_compute_S_consumer_state.advance()
+
+            # Release LSE
+            load_compute_LSE_pipeline.consumer_release(load_compute_LSE_consumer_state)
+            load_compute_LSE_consumer_state.advance()
+
+            # Wait for OdO
+            load_compute_sum_OdO_pipeline.consumer_wait(load_compute_sum_OdO_consumer_state)
+            # Wait for dP
+            mma_compute_dP_pipeline.consumer_wait(mma_compute_dP_consumer_state)
+
+            # Wait for dS
+            compute_mma_dS_pipeline.producer_acquire(compute_mma_dS_producer_state)
+
+            # Compute dS = dsoftmax(P, dP, sum_OdO)
+            cute.copy(tiled_t2r, tTR_tdP, tTR_rdP)

+            for i in cutlass.range(0, cute.size(tTR_rdP), 2, unroll_full=True):

+                        sSum_OdO[

+                            load_compute_sum_OdO_consumer_state.index,
+                        ],
+                    ),

+                tTR_rdP[i], tTR_rdP[i + 1] = cute.arch.mul_packed_f32x2((tTR_rdP[i], tTR_rdP[i + 1]), (tTR_rS[i], tTR_rS[i + 1]))

+        tdKTtdKT: cute.Tensor,

+        pipeline_q: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_kv: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        block_info: "BlockInfo",
+        tile_scheduler: "TileSchedulerProtocol",
+        mBlockIndex: cute.Tensor,
+        block_sparse_num: Int32,
+        mBlockNums: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    ):
+        warp_idx = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.warp_idx())
+        q_producer_phase = Int32(1)
+        kv_producer_state = pipeline.make_pipeline_state(pipeline.PipelineUserType.Producer, self.kv_stage)
+        work_tile = tile_scheduler.initial_work_tile_info()
+        while work_tile.is_valid_tile:
+            m_block, head_idx, batch_idx, split_idx = work_tile.tile_idx
+            mQ_cur = mQ[None, None, None, batch_idx][None, None, head_idx]
+            tiler_gQ = ((self.mma_tiler_qk[0] * self.q_stage), self.head_dim_padded)
+            gQ = cute.local_tile(mQ_cur, tiler_gQ, (m_block, 0))  # (128, 128)
+            gQ = layout_utils.select(cute.flat_divide(gQ, (self.mma_tiler_qk[0],)), mode=[0, 2, 1])  # (128, 128, 1)
+
+            head_idx_kv = head_idx
+            mK_cur, mV_cur = [t[None, None, head_idx_kv, batch_idx] for t in (mK, mV)]
+            gK = cute.local_tile(mK_cur, cute.select(self.mma_tiler_qk, mode=[1, 2]), (None, 0))
+            gV = cute.local_tile(mV_cur, cute.select(self.mma_tiler_pv, mode=[1, 2]), (0, None))
+            tSgQ = thr_mma_qk.partition_A(gQ)
+            tSgK = thr_mma_qk.partition_B(gK)
+            tOgV = thr_mma_pv.partition_B(gV)
+            load_Q_fn, _, _ = copy_utils.tma_get_copy_fn(tma_atom_Q, 0, cute.make_layout(1), tSgQ, sQ)
+
+            tKsK, tKgK = cpasync.tma_partition(
+                tma_atom_K,
+                0,  # no multicast
+                cute.make_layout(1),
+                cute.group_modes(sK, 0, 3),
+                cute.group_modes(tSgK, 0, 3),
+            )
+            tVsV, tVgV = cpasync.tma_partition(
+                tma_atom_V,
+                0,  # no multicast
+                cute.make_layout(1),
+                cute.group_modes(sV, 0, 3),
+                cute.group_modes(tOgV, 0, 3),
+            )
+
+            load_K = partial(
+                self.load_KV,
+                tma_atom_K,
+                tKgK,
+                tKsK,
+                pipeline_kv=pipeline_kv,
+                K_or_V="K",
+            )
+            load_V = partial(
+                self.load_KV,
+                tma_atom_V,
+                tVgV,
+                tVsV,
+                pipeline_kv=pipeline_kv,
+                K_or_V="V",
+            )
+
+            # n_block(i): maps logical index i to actual KV block index via q2k_block_index
+            # When mBlockNums is provided, raw count may be odd; round up to even for kernel loops.
+            # max_i clamps phantom block indices to the last valid entry.
+            if const_expr(self.num_splits > 1):
+                split_begin, raw_block_count = self._split_block_range(mBlockNums, block_sparse_num, batch_idx, head_idx, m_block, split_idx)
+                process_tile = raw_block_count > Int32(0)
+                block_iter_count = (raw_block_count + 1) & ~1
+                mBlockIndex_split = cute.make_tensor(mBlockIndex.iterator + split_begin, mBlockIndex.layout)
+                n_block = partial(
+                    block_info.get_n_block_idx,
+                    mBlockIndex_split,
+                    batch_idx,
+                    head_idx,
+                    m_block,
+                    max_i=cutlass.max(raw_block_count - 1, Int32(0)),
+                )
+            elif const_expr(mBlockNums is not None):
+                raw_block_count = mBlockNums[batch_idx, head_idx, m_block]
+                process_tile = raw_block_count > Int32(0) if const_expr(self.allow_empty_block_nums) else True
+                block_iter_count = (raw_block_count + 1) & ~1
+                n_block = partial(
+                    block_info.get_n_block_idx,
+                    mBlockIndex,
+                    batch_idx,
+                    head_idx,
+                    m_block,
+                    max_i=cutlass.max(raw_block_count - 1, Int32(0)),
+                )
+            else:
+                process_tile = True
+                block_iter_count = (block_sparse_num + 1) & ~1
+                n_block = partial(
+                    block_info.get_n_block_idx,
+                    mBlockIndex,
+                    batch_idx,
+                    head_idx,
+                    m_block,
+                    max_i=cutlass.max(block_sparse_num - 1, Int32(0)),
+                )
+
+            if process_tile:
+                load_K(
+                    block=n_block(block_iter_count - 1),
+                    producer_state=kv_producer_state,
+                    page_idx=None,
+                )  # K0
+                if const_expr(len(self.load_warp_ids) == 1) or warp_idx == self.load_warp_ids[0]:
+                    pipeline_q.producer_acquire_w_index_phase(0, q_producer_phase)
+                    tma_bar_ptr = pipeline_q.sync_object_full.get_barrier(0)
+                    load_Q_fn(src_idx=0, dst_idx=0, tma_bar_ptr=tma_bar_ptr)
+                kv_producer_state.advance()
+
+                # q_stage=1 intra-warp overlap
+                # Load order: K[N-1], Q, K[N-2], {V[N-1-i], K[N-3-i]}x(N-2), V[1], V[0]
+                block_loop_count = block_iter_count - 2
+                q_producer_phase ^= 1
+
+                # Prologue: K[N-2]
+                load_K(
+                    block=n_block(block_iter_count - 2),
+                    producer_state=kv_producer_state,
+                    page_idx=None,
+                )
+                kv_producer_state.advance()
+
+                # Flat main loop: N-2 iterations, each loads V then K
+                for i in cutlass.range(block_loop_count, unroll=1):
+                    # V[N-1-i]: V for the block whose S was computed earlier
+                    load_V(
+                        block=n_block(block_iter_count - 1 - i),
+                        producer_state=kv_producer_state,
+                        page_idx=None,
+                    )
+                    kv_producer_state.advance()
+                    # K[N-3-i]: K for the next QK GEMM
+                    load_K(
+                        block=n_block(block_iter_count - 3 - i),
+                        producer_state=kv_producer_state,
+                        page_idx=None,
+                    )
+                    kv_producer_state.advance()
+
+                # Epilogue: last 2 V loads
+                load_V(block=n_block(1), producer_state=kv_producer_state, page_idx=None)
+                kv_producer_state.advance()
+                load_V(block=n_block(0), producer_state=kv_producer_state, page_idx=None)
+                kv_producer_state.advance()
+
+            tile_scheduler.prefetch_next_work()
+            work_tile = tile_scheduler.consumer_advance()
+            # End of persistent scheduler loop
+
+        pipeline_kv.producer_tail(kv_producer_state)
+        # This is equivalent to pipeline_q.producer_tail
+        if const_expr(len(self.load_warp_ids) == 1) or warp_idx == self.load_warp_ids[0]:
+            pipeline_q.producer_acquire_w_index_phase(self.q_stage - 1, q_producer_phase)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def load_k_scale(
+        self,
+        mKScale: cute.Tensor,
+        key_block: Int32,
+        batch_idx: Int32,
+        head_idx: Int32,
+    ) -> Float32:
+        lane = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % 32
+        value = Float32(0.0)
+        if lane < 8:
+            scale_idx = cutlass.min(key_block * 8 + lane, mKScale.shape[2] - 1)
+            value = mKScale[batch_idx, head_idx, scale_idx]
+        return value
+
+    # for both softmax0 and softmax1 warp group
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def valid_block_size(
+        self,
+        mBlockSizes: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        batch_idx: Int32,
+        head_idx: Int32,
+        key_block: Int32,
+        seqlen_k: Int32,
+    ) -> Int32:
+        size = cutlass.min(cutlass.max(seqlen_k - key_block * 128, Int32(0)), Int32(128))
+        if const_expr(self.has_block_sizes):
+            if const_expr(self.block_sizes_mode == 1):
+                size = cutlass.min(size, mBlockSizes[key_block])
+            elif const_expr(self.block_sizes_mode == 2):
+                size = cutlass.min(size, mBlockSizes[batch_idx, key_block])
+            else:
+                size = cutlass.min(size, mBlockSizes[batch_idx, head_idx, key_block])
+        return size

+    @cute.jit
+    def correction_rescale(
+        self,
+        thr_mma: cute.ThrMma,
+        tOtO: cute.Tensor,
+        tidx: Int32,
+        scale: Float32,
+    ):
+        """Rescale intermediate attention results based on softmax normalization factor.
+
+        This method performs a crucial correction step in the attention computation pipeline.
+        When processing attention in blocks, the softmax normalization factors may change
+        as new blocks are processed. This method rescales previously computed partial
+        output values to account for updated normalization factors.
+
+        The implementation uses efficient tensor memory operations to:
+        1. Load existing partial attention output from tensor memory
+        2. Apply the scaling factor to all elements
+        3. Store the rescaled results back to tensor memory
+        """
+        tOcO = thr_mma.partition_C(cute.make_identity_tensor(self.mma_tiler_pv[:2]))
+        corr_tile_size = self.correction_tile_size
+        tmem_load_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(tcgen05.copy.Ld32x32bOp(tcgen05.copy.Repetition(corr_tile_size)), self.pv_acc_dtype)
+        tmem_store_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(
+            tcgen05.copy.St32x32bOp(tcgen05.copy.Repetition(corr_tile_size)),
+            self.pv_acc_dtype,
+        )
+        tOtO_i = cute.composition(tOtO, cute.make_layout((self.m_block_size, corr_tile_size)))
+        tOcO_i = cute.composition(tOcO, cute.make_layout((self.m_block_size, corr_tile_size)))
+        thr_tmem_load = tcgen05.make_tmem_copy(tmem_load_atom, tOtO_i).get_slice(tidx)
+        thr_tmem_store = tcgen05.make_tmem_copy(tmem_store_atom, tOtO_i).get_slice(tidx)
+        tOtO_t2r = thr_tmem_load.partition_S(tOtO_i)
+        tOrO_t2r_shape = thr_tmem_load.partition_D(tOcO_i).shape
+        tOtO_r2t = thr_tmem_store.partition_D(tOtO_i)
+
+        frg_count = self.head_dim_v_padded // corr_tile_size
+        tOrO_frg = cute.make_rmem_tensor((tOrO_t2r_shape, frg_count), self.pv_acc_dtype)
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(frg_count):
+            tOrO_frg = cute.make_rmem_tensor(tOrO_t2r_shape, self.pv_acc_dtype)
+            tOtO_t2r_i = cute.make_tensor(tOtO_t2r.iterator + i * corr_tile_size, tOtO_t2r.layout)
+            cute.copy(thr_tmem_load, tOtO_t2r_i, tOrO_frg)
+            for j in cutlass.range(0, cute.size(tOrO_frg), 2, unroll_full=True):
+                tOrO_frg[j], tOrO_frg[j + 1] = cute.arch.mul_packed_f32x2((tOrO_frg[j], tOrO_frg[j + 1]), (scale, scale))
+            tOtO_r2t_i = cute.make_tensor(tOtO_r2t.iterator + i * corr_tile_size, tOtO_r2t.layout)
+            cute.copy(thr_tmem_store, tOrO_frg, tOtO_r2t_i)
+        cute.arch.fence_view_async_tmem_store()
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def correction_epilogue_combine(
+        self,
+        thr_mma: cute.ThrMma,
+        tOtO0: cute.Tensor,
+        tOtO1: cute.Tensor,
+        tidx: Int32,
+        scale0: Float32,
+        scale1: Float32,
+        sO: cute.Tensor,
+        mVScale: cute.Tensor,
+        head_idx: Int32,
+    ):
+        """Combine two partial O accumulators (O0, O1) from intra-warp overlap and write to smem/gmem.
+
+        For q_stage=1 intra-warp overlap, O0 and O1 accumulate results from even and odd
+        n_blocks respectively. This method reads both from TMEM, applies their respective
+        scales (derived from combined softmax stats), adds them, and writes the result.
+        """
+        corr_tile_size = self.epilogue_tile_size
+        tOsO = thr_mma.get_slice(0).partition_C(sO)
+        tOcO = thr_mma.partition_C(cute.make_identity_tensor(self.mma_tiler_pv[:2]))
+
+        tOtO0_i = cute.logical_divide(tOtO0, cute.make_layout((self.m_block_size, corr_tile_size)))
+        tOtO1_i = cute.logical_divide(tOtO1, cute.make_layout((self.m_block_size, corr_tile_size)))
+        tOcO_i = cute.logical_divide(tOcO, cute.make_layout((self.m_block_size, corr_tile_size)))
+        tOsO_i = cute.logical_divide(tOsO, cute.make_layout((self.m_block_size, corr_tile_size)))
+
+        epi_subtile = (self.epi_tile[0], corr_tile_size)
+        tmem_copy_atom = sm100_utils_basic.get_tmem_load_op(
+            self.mma_tiler_pv,
+            self.o_layout,
+            self.o_dtype,
+            self.pv_acc_dtype,
+            epi_subtile,
+            False,
+        )
+        tiled_tmem_load = tcgen05.make_tmem_copy(tmem_copy_atom, tOtO0_i[(None, None), 0])
+        thr_tmem_load = tiled_tmem_load.get_slice(tidx)
+        smem_copy_atom = sm100_utils_basic.get_smem_store_op(self.o_layout, self.o_dtype, self.pv_acc_dtype, tiled_tmem_load)
+        tiled_smem_store = cute.make_tiled_copy_D(smem_copy_atom, tiled_tmem_load)
+
+        tOtO0_t2r = thr_tmem_load.partition_S(tOtO0_i[(None, None), None])
+        tOtO1_t2r = thr_tmem_load.partition_S(tOtO1_i[(None, None), None])
+        tOsO_s2r = copy_utils.partition_D_position_independent(thr_tmem_load, tOsO_i[(None, None), None])
+        tOcO_t2r = thr_tmem_load.partition_D(tOcO_i[(None, None), None])
+        # Each warp shares the same channel scales. Coalesced loads followed
+        # by register shuffles avoid one scalar global load per output value.
+        # SM103's larger correction fragments leave less register headroom,
+        # so load its scales one output fragment at a time.
+        lane = tidx % 32
+        if const_expr(self.prefetch_all_v_scales):
+            tVScales = cute.make_rmem_tensor((4,), Float32)
+            for chunk in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                tVScales[chunk] = mVScale[head_idx, chunk * 32 + lane]
+        for i in cutlass.range(self.head_dim_v_padded // corr_tile_size, unroll_full=True):
+            if const_expr(not self.prefetch_all_v_scales):
+                v_scale = mVScale[head_idx, i * corr_tile_size + lane]
+            tOtO0_t2r_i = tOtO0_t2r[None, 0, 0, i]
+            tOtO1_t2r_i = tOtO1_t2r[None, 0, 0, i]
+            tOsO_r2s_i = tOsO_s2r[None, 0, 0, i]
+            frg_shape = tOcO_t2r[None, 0, 0, i].shape
+            tOrO0_frg = cute.make_rmem_tensor(frg_shape, self.pv_acc_dtype)
+            tOrO1_frg = cute.make_rmem_tensor(frg_shape, self.pv_acc_dtype)
+            # When both scales are 0 (empty tile), skip tmem reads to avoid 0*NaN=NaN.
+            is_zero_output = scale0 == Float32(0.0) and scale1 == Float32(0.0)
+            if not is_zero_output:
+                cute.copy(tiled_tmem_load, tOtO0_t2r_i, tOrO0_frg)
+                cute.copy(tiled_tmem_load, tOtO1_t2r_i, tOrO1_frg)
+                # Combined: O = O0 * scale0 + O1 * scale1
+                for j in cutlass.range(0, cute.size(tOrO0_frg), 2, unroll_full=True):
+                    o0_a, o0_b = cute.arch.mul_packed_f32x2((tOrO0_frg[j], tOrO0_frg[j + 1]), (scale0, scale0))
+                    o1_a, o1_b = cute.arch.mul_packed_f32x2((tOrO1_frg[j], tOrO1_frg[j + 1]), (scale1, scale1))
+                    tOrO0_frg[j], tOrO0_frg[j + 1] = cute.arch.add_packed_f32x2((o0_a, o0_b), (o1_a, o1_b))
+            else:
+                tOrO0_frg.fill(Float32(0.0))
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(cute.size(tOrO0_frg)):
+                channel = tOcO_t2r[None, 0, 0, i][j][1]
+                if const_expr(self.prefetch_all_v_scales):
+                    value_scale = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(tVScales[channel // 32], channel % 32)
+                else:
+                    value_scale = cute.arch.shuffle_sync(v_scale, channel % 32)
+                tOrO0_frg[j] *= value_scale
+            copy_utils.cvt_copy(tiled_smem_store, tOrO0_frg, tOsO_r2s_i)
+        cute.arch.fence_view_async_shared()
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def epilogue_s2g(
+        self,
+        mO: cute.Tensor,
+        sO: cute.Tensor,
+        tma_atom_O: cute.CopyAtom,
+        pipeline_o_epi: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        tile_scheduler: "TileSchedulerProtocol",
+    ):
+        epi_consumer_phase = Int32(0)
+        work_tile = tile_scheduler.initial_work_tile_info()
+        while work_tile.is_valid_tile:
+            m_block, head_idx, batch_idx, split_idx = work_tile.tile_idx
+
+            output_head = head_idx
+            if const_expr(self.num_splits > 1):
+                output_head += split_idx * (mO.shape[2] // self.num_splits)
+            mO_cur = mO[None, None, None, batch_idx][None, None, output_head]
+            tiler_gO = ((self.mma_tiler_pv[0] * self.q_stage), self.head_dim_v_padded)
+            gO = cute.local_tile(mO_cur, tiler_gO, (m_block, 0))  # (128, 128)
+            gO = layout_utils.select(cute.flat_divide(gO, (self.mma_tiler_pv[0],)), mode=[0, 2, 1])  # (128, 128, 1)
+            gO = cute.flat_divide(gO, (self.mma_tiler_pv[0],))[None, 0, None, None]
+
+            store_O, _, _ = copy_utils.tma_get_copy_fn(tma_atom_O, 0, cute.make_layout(1), sO, gO)
+            for stage in cutlass.range(self.q_stage, unroll_full=True):
+                # wait from corr, issue tma store on smem
+                # 1. wait for O0 final
+                pipeline_o_epi.consumer_wait_w_index_phase(stage, epi_consumer_phase)
+                # 2. copy O0 to gmem
+                store_O(src_idx=stage, dst_idx=stage)
+                cute.arch.cp_async_bulk_commit_group()
+            for stage in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.q_stage):
+                # Ensure O0 buffer is ready to be released
+                cute.arch.cp_async_bulk_wait_group(self.q_stage - 1 - stage, read=True)
+                pipeline_o_epi.consumer_release_w_index(stage)
+
+            epi_consumer_phase ^= 1
+
+            # Advance to next tile
+            work_tile = tile_scheduler.consumer_advance()
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def load_KV(
+        self,
+        tma_atom: cute.CopyAtom,
+        tXgX: cute.Tensor,
+        tXsX: cute.Tensor,
+        block: Int32,
+        pipeline_kv: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        producer_state: pipeline.PipelineState,
+        K_or_V: Literal["K", "V"],
+        page_idx: Optional[Int32] = None,
+        extra_tx_count: Optional[Int32] = None,
+    ):
+        assert K_or_V in ("K", "V")
+        stage = producer_state.index
+        extra_tx_count_kv = self.tma_copy_bytes[K_or_V] - self.tma_copy_bytes["K"]
+        extra_tx_count = extra_tx_count_kv + (extra_tx_count if extra_tx_count is not None else 0)
+        extra_kwargs = {"extra_tx_count": extra_tx_count}
+        pipeline_kv.producer_acquire(producer_state, **extra_kwargs)
+
+        tXsX_cur = tXsX[None, stage]
+        tXgX_cur = tXgX[None, block] if const_expr(page_idx is None) else tXgX[None, 0, page_idx]
+        cute.copy(
+            tma_atom,
+            tXgX_cur,
+            tXsX_cur,
+            tma_bar_ptr=pipeline_kv.producer_get_barrier(producer_state),
+        )

+@cute.jit
+def declare_ptx_smem_desc(
+    smem_desc_start_a: Int32,  # If TS, then this is the tmem start address for A
+    smem_desc_base_a: Optional[int],
+    tCrA_layout: cute.Layout,
+    var_name_prefix: str = "smem_desc",
+) -> None:
+    is_ts = const_expr(smem_desc_base_a is None)
+    num_k_tile = cute.size(tCrA_layout.shape[2])
+    smem_desc_base_a_lo, smem_desc_a_hi = None, None
+    if const_expr(not is_ts):
+        smem_desc_base_a_lo, smem_desc_a_hi = i64_to_i32x2(smem_desc_base_a)
+    tCrA_layout = (
+        tCrA_layout
+        if const_expr(not is_ts)
+        # currently hard-coding the width to 16
+        else cute.recast_layout(32, 16, tCrA_layout)
+    )

+MASK_R2P_CHUNK_SIZE: int = 32
+
+MaskGenFn: TypeAlias = Callable[[int], Uint32]

+@cute.jit
+def r2p_bitmask_below(limit: Int32, s: int) -> Uint32:
+    """32-bit R2P bitmask keeping positions < limit (exclusive upper bound)."""
+    m = max((s + 1) * MASK_R2P_CHUNK_SIZE - limit, 0)
+    return utils.shr_u32(Uint32(0xFFFFFFFF), Uint32(m))
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def mask_r2p_lambda(
+    X: cute.Tensor,
+    mask_gen_fn: cutlass.Constexpr[MaskGenFn],
+) -> None:
+    """Apply R2P masking with a custom bitmask generator to a rank-1 tensor."""
+    ncol = const_expr(cute.size(X.shape))
+    CHUNK_SIZE = MASK_R2P_CHUNK_SIZE
+    for s in cutlass.range_constexpr(cute.ceil_div(ncol, CHUNK_SIZE)):
+        mask = mask_gen_fn(s)
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(min(CHUNK_SIZE, ncol - s * CHUNK_SIZE)):
+            in_bound = cutlass.Boolean(mask & (Uint32(1) << i))
+            c = s * CHUNK_SIZE + i
+            X[c] = X[c] if in_bound else -Float32.inf
+

+@cute.jit
+def _max16_tree(values: cute.TensorSSA) -> Float32:
+    """Reduce one K-scale group with eight maxima and three dependent levels."""
+    tValues = cute.make_rmem_tensor((16,), Float32)
+    tValues.store(values)
+    max0 = utils.fmax(tValues[0], tValues[1], tValues[2])
+    max1 = utils.fmax(tValues[3], tValues[4], tValues[5])
+    max2 = utils.fmax(tValues[6], tValues[7], tValues[8])
+    max3 = utils.fmax(tValues[9], tValues[10], tValues[11])
+    max4 = utils.fmax(tValues[12], tValues[13], tValues[14])
+    return utils.fmax(utils.fmax(max0, max1, max2), utils.fmax(max3, max4, tValues[15]))

+    if block_size < n_block_size:

+    out = llvm.inline_asm(

+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+    )
+    values = tuple(Float32(llvm.extractvalue(T.f32(), out, [i])) for i in range(16))
