+        sQ_layout = sm100_utils_basic.make_smem_layout_a(tiled_mma_qk, self.mma_tiler_qk, self.q_dtype, self.q_stage)
+        sK_layout = sm100_utils_basic.make_smem_layout_b(tiled_mma_qk, self.mma_tiler_qk, self.k_dtype, self.kv_stage)
+        tP_layout = sm100_utils_basic.make_smem_layout_a(tiled_mma_pv, self.mma_tiler_pv, self.q_dtype, self.s_stage)
+        sV_layout = sm100_utils_basic.make_smem_layout_b(tiled_mma_pv, self.mma_tiler_pv, self.v_dtype, self.kv_stage)
+        sO_layout = sm100_utils_basic.make_smem_layout_epi(self.o_dtype, self.o_layout, self.epi_tile, self.s_stage)
+        self.tma_copy_bytes = {
+            name: cute.size_in_bytes(mX.element_type, cute.select(layout, mode=[0, 1, 2]))
+            for name, mX, layout in [
+                ("Q", mQ, sQ_layout),
+                ("K", mK, sK_layout),
+                ("V", mV, sV_layout),
+            ]
+        }
+        # TMA load for Q
+        tma_load_op = cpasync.CopyBulkTensorTileG2SOp(tcgen05.CtaGroup.ONE)
+        tma_store_op = cpasync.CopyBulkTensorTileS2GOp()
+
+        tma_atom_Q, mQ = cute.nvgpu.make_tiled_tma_atom_A(
+            tma_load_op,
+            mQ,
+            cute.select(sQ_layout, mode=[0, 1, 2]),
+            self.mma_tiler_qk,
+            tiled_mma_qk,
+        )
+
+        # TMA load for K
+        tma_atom_K, mK = cute.nvgpu.make_tiled_tma_atom_B(
+            tma_load_op,
+            mK,
+            cute.select(sK_layout, mode=[0, 1, 2]),
+            self.mma_tiler_qk,
+            tiled_mma_qk,
+        )
+        # TMA load for V
+        tma_atom_V, mV = cute.nvgpu.make_tiled_tma_atom_B(
+            tma_load_op,
+            mV,
+            cute.select(sV_layout, mode=[0, 1, 2]),
+            self.mma_tiler_pv,
+            tiled_mma_pv,
+        )
+
+        tma_atom_O, mO = cpasync.make_tiled_tma_atom(tma_store_op, mO, cute.select(sO_layout, mode=[0, 1]), self.epi_tile)
+
+        tile_sched_args = TileSchedulerArguments(
+            cute.ceil_div(cute.size(mQ.shape[0]), self.cta_tiler[0]),
+            cute.size(mQ.shape[2]),
+            cute.size(mQ.shape[3]),
+            num_splits,
+            cute.size(mK.shape[0]),
+            mQ.shape[1],
+            mV.shape[0],  # Note that this is different from Sm90 since we transpose mV in Sm100
+            total_q=cute.size(mQ.shape[0]) * cute.size(mQ.shape[3]),
+            tile_shape_mn=self.cta_tiler[:2],
+            element_size=self.k_dtype.width // 8,
+            is_persistent=True,
+            is_split_kv=self.num_splits > 1,
+        )
+        tile_sched_params = TileScheduler.to_underlying_arguments(tile_sched_args, scheduling_mode=SchedulingMode.CLC)
+        self.tile_scheduler_cls = TileScheduler
+        grid_dim = TileScheduler.get_grid_shape(tile_sched_params)
+
+        sO_size = cute.cosize(sO_layout)
+        sQ_size = cute.cosize(sQ_layout)
+
+        clc_response_size = self.sched_stages * 4
+        clc_mbar_size = self.sched_stages * 2
+
+        @cute.struct
+        class SharedStorage:
+            # m_barriers for pipelines
+            mbar_load_Q: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.q_stage * 2]
+            mbar_load_KV: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.kv_stage * 2]
+            mbar_S_full_P_full_O_rescaled: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.s_stage * 2]
+            mbar_P_ready: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.p_stage * 2]
+            mbar_O_full: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.s_stage * 2]
+            mbar_softmax_stats: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.s_stage * 2]
+            mbar_O_epi: cute.struct.MemRange[Int64, self.s_stage * 2]
+            # Tmem holding buffer
+            tmem_holding_buf: Int32
+            # Smem tensors
+            # store row max and row sum
+            sScale: cute.struct.MemRange[Float32, self.s_stage * self.m_block_size * 2]
+            # Keep independent 32-byte stages aligned for vectorized shared loads.
+            sKScale: cute.struct.Align[cute.struct.MemRange[Float32, self.s_stage * 2 * 8], 32]
+            # CLC buffers (mbarriers + response storage)
+            clc_mbar_ptr: cute.struct.MemRange[cutlass.Int64, clc_mbar_size]
+            clc_response: cute.struct.Align[cute.struct.MemRange[Int32, clc_response_size], 16]
+            sO: cute.struct.Align[cute.struct.MemRange[self.o_dtype, sO_size], self.buffer_align_bytes]
+            sQ: cute.struct.Align[cute.struct.MemRange[self.q_dtype, sQ_size], self.buffer_align_bytes]
+            sK: cute.struct.Align[
+                cute.struct.MemRange[self.k_dtype, cute.cosize(sK_layout)],
+                self.buffer_align_bytes,
+            ]
+
+            sOnes: cute.struct.Align[cute.struct.MemRange[Int32, 4096], 1024]
+
+        self.shared_storage = SharedStorage
+
+        softmax_scale_log2, softmax_scale = utils.compute_softmax_scale_log2(softmax_scale)
+
+        # Launch the kernel synchronously
+        self.kernel(
+            mQ,
+            mK,
+            mV,
+            mO,
+            mLSE,
+            mQScale,
+            mKScale,
+            mVScale,
+            tma_atom_Q,
+            tma_atom_K,
+            tma_atom_V,
+            tma_atom_O,
+            softmax_scale_log2,
+            softmax_scale,
+            sQ_layout,
+            sK_layout,
+            tP_layout,
+            sV_layout,
+            sO_layout,
+            tiled_mma_qk,
+            tiled_mma_pv,
+            tile_sched_params,
+            mBlockIndex,
+            mBlockSizes,
+            block_sparse_num,
+            mBlockNums,
+        ).launch(
+            grid=grid_dim,
+            block=[self.threads_per_cta, 1, 1],
+            stream=stream,
+            min_blocks_per_mp=1,
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        mQ: cute.Tensor,  # (s_q, d, h, b)
+        mK: cute.Tensor,  # (s_k, d, h_k, b_k)
+        mV: cute.Tensor,  # (d, s_k, h_k, b_k)
+        mO: cute.Tensor,
+        mLSE: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mQScale: cute.Tensor,
+        mKScale: cute.Tensor,
+        mVScale: cute.Tensor,
+        tma_atom_Q: cute.CopyAtom,
+        tma_atom_K: cute.CopyAtom,
+        tma_atom_V: cute.CopyAtom,
+        tma_atom_O: cute.CopyAtom,
+        softmax_scale_log2: Float32,
+        softmax_scale: Float32 | None,
+        sQ_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        sK_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        tP_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        sV_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        sO_layout: cute.ComposedLayout,
+        tiled_mma_qk: cute.TiledMma,
+        tiled_mma_pv: cute.TiledMma,
+        tile_sched_params: ParamsBase,
+        mBlockIndex: cute.Tensor,
+        mBlockSizes: cute.Tensor,
+        block_sparse_num: Int32,
+        mBlockNums: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    ):
+        """The device kernel implementation of the Fused Multi-Head Attention.
+
+        This kernel coordinates multiple specialized warps to perform different phases of the FMHA computation:
+        1. Load warp: Loads Q, K, V data from global memory to shared memory using TMA
+        2. MMA warp: Performs matrix multiplications (Q*K^T and P*V)
+        3. Softmax warps: Compute softmax normalization on attention scores
+        4. Correction warps: Apply adjustments to intermediate results
+        5. Epilogue warp: Handles final output transformation and storage
+
+        The kernel implements a complex pipeline with overlapping computation and memory operations,
+        using tensor memory access (TMA) for efficient data loading, warp specialization for different
+        computation phases, and optional attention masking.
+        """
+
+        warp_idx = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.warp_idx())
+
+        # Prefetch tma descriptor
+        if warp_idx == 0:
+            for tma_atom in (tma_atom_Q, tma_atom_K, tma_atom_V, tma_atom_O):
+                cpasync.prefetch_descriptor(tma_atom)
+
+        # Alloc
+        smem = SmemAllocator()
+        storage = smem.allocate(self.shared_storage)
+        sOnesPtr = storage.sOnes.data_ptr()
+        sOnes = storage.sOnes.get_tensor(cute.make_layout(4096))
+        thread = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+            sOnes[thread + i * self.threads_per_cta] = Int32(0x38383838)
+        cute.arch.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+        cute.arch.barrier()
+
+        tmem_alloc_barrier = _SubsetNamedBarrier(
+            barrier_id=int(NamedBarrierFwdSm100.TmemPtr),
+            num_threads=cute.arch.WARP_SIZE
+            * len(
+                (
+                    self.mma_warp_id,
+                    *self.softmax0_warp_ids,
+                    *self.softmax1_warp_ids,
+                    *self.correction_warp_ids,
+                )
+            ),
+        )
+        # Tensor memory dealloc barrier init
+        tmem = TmemAllocator(
+            storage.tmem_holding_buf.ptr,
+            barrier_for_retrieve=tmem_alloc_barrier,
+            allocator_warp_id=self.mma_warp_id,
+        )
+
+        ThreadCooperativeGroup = partial(pipeline.CooperativeGroup, pipeline.Agent.Thread)
+        mma_warp = ThreadCooperativeGroup(len([self.mma_warp_id]))
+        tma_warp = ThreadCooperativeGroup(1)
+        softmax_warps = ThreadCooperativeGroup(len(self.softmax0_warp_ids))
+        softmax_threads = ThreadCooperativeGroup(cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * len(self.softmax0_warp_ids))
+        correction_threads = ThreadCooperativeGroup(cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * len(self.correction_warp_ids))
+        softmax_correction_threads = ThreadCooperativeGroup(cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * len(self.softmax0_warp_ids + self.correction_warp_ids))
+        epilogue_threads = ThreadCooperativeGroup(cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * len(self.epilogue_warp_ids))
+        pipeline_q = pipeline_custom.PipelineTmaUmma.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_load_Q.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.q_stage,
+            producer_group=tma_warp,
+            consumer_group=mma_warp,
+            tx_count=self.tma_copy_bytes["Q"],
+            defer_sync=True,
+        )
+        pipeline_kv = pipeline_custom.PipelineTmaUmma.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_load_KV.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.kv_stage,
+            producer_group=tma_warp,
+            consumer_group=mma_warp,
+            tx_count=self.tma_copy_bytes["K"],
+            defer_sync=True,
+        )
+        # This pipeline is not the typical producer-consumer pipeline. The "producer" mma warp
+        # uses it to signal that S is ready, and the softmax threads wait for S to be ready.
+        # When softmax threads write P to tmem and the correction threads have rescaled O, they
+        # signal as "consumer". SM100 separates P-ready from correction-only O credits.
+        pipeline_s_p_o = pipeline_custom.PipelineUmmaAsync.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_S_full_P_full_O_rescaled.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.s_stage,
+            producer_group=mma_warp,
+            consumer_group=(correction_threads if self.triple_buffer_p else softmax_correction_threads),
+            defer_sync=True,
+        )
+        if const_expr(self.triple_buffer_p):
+            pipeline_p_ready = pipeline_custom.PipelineAsync.create(
+                barrier_storage=storage.mbar_P_ready.data_ptr(),
+                num_stages=self.p_stage,
+                producer_group=softmax_threads,
+                consumer_group=mma_warp,
+                defer_sync=True,
+            )
+        else:
+            pipeline_p_ready = pipeline_custom.PipelineAsyncUmma.create(
+                barrier_storage=storage.mbar_P_ready.data_ptr(),
+                num_stages=self.s_stage,
+                producer_group=softmax_warps,
+                consumer_group=mma_warp,
+                defer_sync=True,
+            )
+        # MMA warp uses this to signal to the correction warps that O is ready.
+        pipeline_o_acc = pipeline_custom.PipelineUmmaAsync.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_O_full.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.s_stage,
+            producer_group=mma_warp,
+            consumer_group=correction_threads,
+            defer_sync=True,
+        )
+        pipeline_sm_stats = pipeline_custom.PipelineAsync.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_softmax_stats.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.s_stage,
+            producer_group=softmax_threads,
+            consumer_group=correction_threads,
+            defer_sync=True,
+        )
+        # Should put the NamedBarrier inside the pipeline class so we'll just have pipeline_sm_stats
+        sm_stats_barrier = _SubsetNamedBarrier(barrier_id=int(NamedBarrierFwdSm100.SoftmaxStatsW0), num_threads=cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * 2)
+        pipeline_o_epi = pipeline_custom.PipelineAsync.create(
+            barrier_storage=storage.mbar_O_epi.data_ptr(),
+            num_stages=self.s_stage,
+            producer_group=correction_threads,
+            consumer_group=epilogue_threads,
+            defer_sync=True,
+        )
+
+        pipeline_init_arrive(is_relaxed=True)
+
+        #  Generate smem tensor Q/K/V/O
+        # (MMA, MMA_Q, MMA_D, PIPE)
+        sQ = storage.sQ.get_tensor(sQ_layout.outer, swizzle=sQ_layout.inner)
+        # (MMA, MMA_K, MMA_D, PIPE)
+        sK = storage.sK.get_tensor(sK_layout.outer, swizzle=sK_layout.inner)
+        # (MMA, MMA_K, MMA_D, PIPE)
+        # Strip swizzle info to reuse smem
+        sV = cute.make_tensor(cute.recast_ptr(sK.iterator, sV_layout.inner), sV_layout.outer)
+        sO = storage.sO.get_tensor(sO_layout.outer, swizzle=sO_layout.inner)
+
+        sScale = storage.sScale.get_tensor(cute.make_layout(self.s_stage * self.m_block_size * 2))
+        sKScale = storage.sKScale.get_tensor(cute.make_layout(self.s_stage * 2 * 8))
+
+        thr_mma_qk = tiled_mma_qk.get_slice(0)
+        thr_mma_pv = tiled_mma_pv.get_slice(0)
+
+        qk_acc_shape = thr_mma_qk.partition_shape_C(self.mma_tiler_qk[:2])
+        # This is a fake tensor, by right we need to retrieve tmem_ptr. But we know that we always
+        # request 512 columns of tmem, so we know that it starts at 0.
+        tStS = thr_mma_qk.make_fragment_C(cute.append(qk_acc_shape, self.s_stage))
+        pv_acc_shape = thr_mma_pv.partition_shape_C(self.mma_tiler_pv[:2])
+        tOtO = thr_mma_pv.make_fragment_C(cute.append(pv_acc_shape, self.s_stage))
+        tOtO = cute.make_tensor(
+            tOtO.iterator + self.tmem_o_offset[0],
+            cute.make_layout(tOtO.shape, stride=(*tOtO.layout.stride[:-1], 144)),
+        )
+        tP = cute.make_tensor(tStS.iterator, tP_layout.outer)
+        tOrP = thr_mma_pv.make_fragment_A(tP)[None, None, None, 0]
+        # Need to multiply by width ratio bc tP is in v_dtype but tmem offsets are in FP32
+        tP_width_ratio = Float32.width // self.v_dtype.width
+        # Need to adjust the stage stride manually since the two stages aren't contiguous in tmem
+        tP_stage_stride = (self.tmem_p_offset[1] - self.tmem_p_offset[0]) * tP_width_ratio
+        tOrP = cute.make_tensor(
+            tOrP.iterator + self.tmem_p_offset[0] * tP_width_ratio,
+            cute.append(tOrP.layout, cute.make_layout((self.s_stage,), stride=(tP_stage_stride,))),
+        )
+
+        block_info = BlockInfo(
+            # The scheduler advances in single-CTA output tiles.
+            self.cta_tiler[0],
+            self.cta_tiler[1],
+        )
+        SeqlenInfoCls = partial(
+            SeqlenInfoQK.create,
+            seqlen_q_static=mQ.shape[0],
+            seqlen_k_static=mK.shape[0],
+        )
+        # Create the tile scheduler and its CLC pipeline
+        clc_response_ptr = storage.clc_response.data_ptr()
+        clc_mbar_ptr = storage.clc_mbar_ptr.data_ptr()
+
+        clc_pipeline_producer_group = cutlass_pipeline.CooperativeGroup(cutlass_pipeline.Agent.Thread)
+        clc_pipeline_consumer_group = cutlass_pipeline.CooperativeGroup(cutlass_pipeline.Agent.Thread, self.threads_per_cta)
+        clc_pipeline = cutlass_pipeline.PipelineClcFetchAsync.create(
+            barrier_storage=clc_mbar_ptr,
+            num_stages=self.sched_stages,
+            producer_group=clc_pipeline_producer_group,
+            consumer_group=clc_pipeline_consumer_group,
+            tx_count=16,
+        )
+
+        tile_scheduler = self.tile_scheduler_cls.create(tile_sched_params, clc_response_ptr=clc_response_ptr)
+        clc_consumer_state = cutlass_pipeline.make_pipeline_state(cutlass_pipeline.PipelineUserType.Consumer, self.sched_stages)
+        tile_scheduler.set_clc_pipeline(clc_pipeline, clc_consumer_state)
+
+        pipeline_init_wait()
+
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        #  CLC SCHEDULER WARP
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        if warp_idx == self.clc_scheduler_warp_id:
+            cute.arch.setmaxregister_decrease(self.num_regs_other)
+            self.clc_scheduler_warp(clc_pipeline, tile_scheduler)
+
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        #  LOAD
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        if warp_idx >= self.load_warp_ids[0] and warp_idx <= self.load_warp_ids[-1]:
+            cute.arch.setmaxregister_decrease(self.num_regs_other)
+            self.load(
+                thr_mma_qk,
+                thr_mma_pv,
+                mQ,
+                mK,
+                mV,
+                sQ,
+                sK,
+                sV,
+                tma_atom_Q,
+                tma_atom_K,
+                tma_atom_V,
+                pipeline_q,
+                pipeline_kv,
+                block_info,
+                tile_scheduler,
+                mBlockIndex,
+                block_sparse_num,
+                mBlockNums,
+            )
+
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        #  MMA
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        if warp_idx == self.mma_warp_id:
+            cute.arch.setmaxregister_decrease(self.num_regs_other)
+            # Alloc tensor memory buffer
+            tmem.allocate(cute.arch.get_max_tmem_alloc_cols("sm_100"))
+            tmem_alloc_barrier.arrive_and_wait()  # not tmem.wait_for_alloc(): that rebuilds an aligned barrier
+            tmem_ptr = tmem.retrieve_ptr(self.qk_acc_dtype)
+            self.mma(
+                tiled_mma_qk,
+                tiled_mma_pv,
+                sQ,
+                sK,
+                sV,
+                tOrP,
+                pipeline_q,
+                pipeline_kv,
+                pipeline_s_p_o,
+                pipeline_p_ready,
+                pipeline_o_acc,
+                tile_scheduler,
+                block_sparse_num,
+                mBlockNums,
+                block_info,
+                mBlockIndex,
+                mKScale,
+                sKScale,
+                sOnesPtr,
+            )
+            # Dealloc the tensor memory buffer
+            tmem.relinquish_alloc_permit()
+            tmem_alloc_barrier.arrive_and_wait()
+            tmem.free(tmem_ptr)
+
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        #  Epilogue
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        if warp_idx >= self.epilogue_warp_ids[0] and warp_idx <= self.epilogue_warp_ids[-1]:
+            cute.arch.setmaxregister_decrease(self.num_regs_other)
+            self.epilogue_s2g(
+                mO,
+                sO,
+                tma_atom_O,
+                pipeline_o_epi,
+                tile_scheduler,
+            )
+
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        #  Softmax
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        if warp_idx <= self.softmax1_warp_ids[-1]:
+            # increase register after decreasing
+            cute.arch.setmaxregister_increase(self.num_regs_softmax)
+            # sync with mma warp before retrieving tmem ptr
+            tmem_alloc_barrier.arrive_and_wait()  # not tmem.wait_for_alloc(): that rebuilds an aligned barrier
+            tmem_ptr = tmem.retrieve_ptr(self.qk_acc_dtype)
+            softmax_loop = partial(
+                self.softmax_loop,
+                softmax_scale_log2=softmax_scale_log2,
+                softmax_scale=softmax_scale,
+                sScale=sScale,
+                mLSE=mLSE,
+                pipeline_s_p_o=pipeline_s_p_o,
+                pipeline_p_ready=pipeline_p_ready,
+                pipeline_o_acc=pipeline_o_acc,
+                pipeline_sm_stats=pipeline_sm_stats,
+                sm_stats_barrier=sm_stats_barrier,
+                block_info=block_info,
+                tile_scheduler=tile_scheduler,
+                mBlockIndex=mBlockIndex,
+                mBlockSizes=mBlockSizes,
+                block_sparse_num=block_sparse_num,
+                mBlockNums=mBlockNums,
+                mQScale=mQScale,
+                sKScale=sKScale,
+                seqlen_q=mQ.shape[0],
+                seqlen_k=mK.shape[0],
+            )
+
+            stage = Int32(0 if warp_idx < self.softmax1_warp_ids[0] else 1)
+            softmax_loop(stage=stage)
+
+            tmem_alloc_barrier.arrive()
+
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        #  Correction
+        # ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
+        if warp_idx >= self.correction_warp_ids[0] and warp_idx < self.mma_warp_id:
+            cute.arch.setmaxregister_decrease(self.num_regs_correction)
+            # sync with mma warp before retrieving tmem ptr
+            tmem_alloc_barrier.arrive_and_wait()  # not tmem.wait_for_alloc(): that rebuilds an aligned barrier
+            tmem_ptr = tmem.retrieve_ptr(self.qk_acc_dtype)
+            self.correction_loop(
+                thr_mma_pv,
+                tOtO,
+                sScale,
+                mLSE,
+                sO,
+                pipeline_s_p_o,
+                pipeline_o_acc,
+                pipeline_sm_stats,
+                sm_stats_barrier,
+                pipeline_o_epi,
+                Float32(1.0),
+                SeqlenInfoCls,
+                tile_scheduler,
+                block_sparse_num,
+                mBlockNums,
+                mVScale,
+            )
+            tmem_alloc_barrier.arrive()
+
+        return
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def mma(
+        self,
+        tiled_mma_qk: cute.ThrMma,

+    @cute.jit
+    def gemm_fused_pv(
+        self,
+        tmem_out: Int32,
+        tmem_probability: Int32,
+        sOnesPtr: cutlass.Pointer,
+        tCrB: cute.Tensor,
+        sB: cute.Tensor,
+        zero_init: bool | Boolean,
+        mbar_ptr: Optional[cutlass.Pointer] = None,
+        mbar_phase: Int32 = 0,
+    ):
+        assert self.split_P_arrive == 0
+        _fused_pv_issue(
+            tmem_out,
+            Int32(sB.iterator.toint()),
+            Int32(sOnesPtr.toint()),
+            Int32(not zero_init),
+            tmem_probability,
+            144,
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def publish_k_scales(
+        self,
+        mKScale: cute.Tensor,
+        sKScale: cute.Tensor,
+        key_block: Int32,
+        stage: Int32,
+        batch_idx: Int32,
+        head_idx: Int32,
+    ):
+        value = self.load_k_scale(mKScale, key_block, batch_idx, head_idx)
+        self.publish_prefetched_k_scale(sKScale, value, stage)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def publish_prefetched_k_scale(
+        self,
+        sKScale: cute.Tensor,
+        value: Float32,
+        stage: Int32,
+    ):
+        lane = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % 32
+        if lane < 8:
+            sKScale[stage * 8 + lane] = value
+        cute.arch.sync_warp()
+        cute.arch.fence_view_async_shared()
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def softmax_loop(
+        self,
+        stage: int | Int32,
+        softmax_scale_log2: Float32,
+        softmax_scale: Float32,
+        sScale: cute.Tensor,
+        mLSE: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        pipeline_s_p_o: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_p_ready: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_o_acc: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_sm_stats: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        sm_stats_barrier: pipeline.NamedBarrier,
+        block_info: "BlockInfo",
+        tile_scheduler: "TileSchedulerProtocol",
+        mBlockIndex: cute.Tensor,
+        mBlockSizes: cute.Tensor,
+        block_sparse_num: Int32,
+        mBlockNums: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mQScale: cute.Tensor,
+        sKScale: cute.Tensor,
+        seqlen_q: Int32,
+        seqlen_k: Int32,
+    ):
+        """Compute softmax on attention scores from QK matrix multiplication.
+
+        This method handles the softmax computation for either the first or second half of the
+        attention matrix, depending on the 'stage' parameter. It calculates row-wise maximum
+        and sum values needed for stable softmax computation, applies optional masking, and
+        transforms raw attention scores into probability distributions.
+
+        The implementation uses specialized memory access patterns and efficient math operations
+        for computing exp(x) using exp2 functions. It also coordinates pipeline
+        synchronization between MMA, correction, and sequence processing stages.
+        """
+        tidx = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % (cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * (len(self.softmax0_warp_ids)))
+        warp_idx = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.warp_idx()) % 4
+
+        mma_si_consumer_phase = Int32(0)
+        sm_stats_producer_phase = Int32(1)
+        p_write_counter = Int32(stage)
+
+        work_tile = tile_scheduler.initial_work_tile_info()
+        while work_tile.is_valid_tile:
+            m_block, head_idx, batch_idx, split_idx = work_tile.tile_idx
+
+            # n_block(i): maps logical index i to actual KV block index via q2k_block_index
+            if const_expr(self.num_splits > 1):
+                split_begin, raw_block_count = self._split_block_range(mBlockNums, block_sparse_num, batch_idx, head_idx, m_block, split_idx)

+                    m_block,
+                    max_i=cutlass.max(raw_block_count - 1, Int32(0)),

+                n_block = partial(
+                    block_info.get_n_block_idx,
+                    mBlockIndex,
+                    batch_idx,
+                    head_idx,
+                    m_block,
+                    max_i=cutlass.max(raw_block_count - 1, Int32(0)),
+                )
+            else:
+                raw_block_count = block_sparse_num
+                has_work = True
+                n_block = partial(
+                    block_info.get_n_block_idx,
+                    mBlockIndex,
+                    batch_idx,
+                    head_idx,
+                    m_block,
+                    max_i=cutlass.max(block_sparse_num - 1, Int32(0)),
+                )
+
+            softmax = SoftmaxSm100.create(
+                Float32(1.0),
+                rescale_threshold=math.log2(448.0 / 128.0),
+                softmax_scale=None,
+            )
+            softmax.reset()
+
+            softmax_step = partial(
+                self.softmax_step,
+                softmax=softmax,
+                pipeline_s_p_o=pipeline_s_p_o,
+                pipeline_p_ready=pipeline_p_ready,
+                pipeline_o_acc=pipeline_o_acc,
+                pipeline_sm_stats=pipeline_sm_stats,
+                sm_stats_barrier=sm_stats_barrier,
+                sScale=sScale,
+                stage=stage,
+                q_log2_scale=mQScale[batch_idx, head_idx, cutlass.min(m_block * 128 + tidx, seqlen_q - 1)] * softmax_scale_log2,
+                sKScale=sKScale,
+                tmem_s_addr=Int32(warp_idx * 32 << 16),
+                tmem_p_addr=self.tmem_p_offset[0] + stage * (self.tmem_p_offset[1] - self.tmem_p_offset[0]) + (warp_idx * 32 << 16),
+            )
+
+            # Always acquire pipeline_sm_stats to stay in sync with correction
+            pipeline_sm_stats.producer_acquire_w_index_phase(stage, sm_stats_producer_phase)
+            sm_stats_producer_phase ^= 1
+
+            if has_work:
+                # block_iter_count is even: each WG processes exactly half the blocks
+                # WG0 (stage=0): logical indices N-1, N-3, ... (stride 2)
+                # WG1 (stage=1): logical indices N-2, N-4, ... (stride 2)
+                if const_expr(mBlockNums is not None or self.num_splits > 1):
+                    block_iter_count = (raw_block_count + 1) & ~1
+                else:
+                    block_iter_count = (block_sparse_num + 1) & ~1
+                wg_count = block_iter_count // 2
+                # logical_first is the first logical index for this WG
+                logical_first = block_iter_count - 1 - stage
+

+                n_block_first = n_block(logical_first)
+                first_block_size = self.valid_block_size(mBlockSizes, batch_idx, head_idx, n_block_first, seqlen_k)
+                if logical_first >= raw_block_count:
+                    first_block_size = Int32(0)
+                first_mask_fn = partial(apply_block_size_mask, block_size=first_block_size, n_block_size=128)
+                mma_si_consumer_phase, sm_stats_producer_phase, p_write_counter = softmax_step(
+                    mma_si_consumer_phase,
+                    sm_stats_producer_phase,
+                    p_write_counter,
+                    valid_tokens=first_block_size,
+                    mask_fn=first_mask_fn,
+                    is_first=True,
+                )
+                # Remaining blocks with stride 2 — always valid (logical_n < raw_block_count)
+                for n_tile in cutlass.range(wg_count - 1, unroll=1):
+                    logical_n = logical_first - self.s_stage * (n_tile + 1)
+                    n_block_cur = n_block(logical_n)
+                    remaining_mask_fn = partial(
+                        apply_block_size_mask,
+                        block_size=self.valid_block_size(mBlockSizes, batch_idx, head_idx, n_block_cur, seqlen_k),
+                        n_block_size=128,
+                    )
+                    mma_si_consumer_phase, sm_stats_producer_phase, p_write_counter = softmax_step(
+                        mma_si_consumer_phase,
+                        sm_stats_producer_phase,
+                        p_write_counter,
+                        valid_tokens=self.valid_block_size(mBlockSizes, batch_idx, head_idx, n_block_cur, seqlen_k),
+                        mask_fn=remaining_mask_fn,
+                    )
+
+                if const_expr(self.double_buffer_stats):
+                    # Drain the last scale readers before reusing both slots for
+                    # the final payload. Terminal and steady ready IDs are distinct.
+                    _SubsetNamedBarrier(barrier_id=11, num_threads=256).arrive_and_wait_w_index(index=stage * 2)
+                else:
+                    # Final statistics have no next-QK ownership edge. Wait for
+                    # the last scale reader before reusing its shared slot.
+                    pipeline_sm_stats.producer_acquire_w_index_phase(stage, sm_stats_producer_phase)
+                    sm_stats_producer_phase ^= 1
+                sScale[tidx + stage * self.m_block_size] = softmax.row_sum[0]
+                if const_expr(mLSE is not None or self.q_stage == 1):
+                    sScale[tidx + stage * self.m_block_size + self.s_stage * self.m_block_size] = softmax.row_max[0]
+                if const_expr(self.double_buffer_stats):
+                    _SubsetNamedBarrier(barrier_id=11, num_threads=256).arrive_w_index(index=stage * 2)
+                else:
+                    sm_stats_barrier.arrive_w_index(index=stage * 4 + warp_idx)
+            else:
+                # Empty tiles publish only their terminal notification.
+                if const_expr(self.double_buffer_stats):
+                    _SubsetNamedBarrier(barrier_id=11, num_threads=256).arrive_w_index(index=stage * 2)
+                else:
+                    sm_stats_barrier.arrive_w_index(index=stage * 4 + warp_idx)
+
+            # Advance to next tile
+            work_tile = tile_scheduler.consumer_advance()
+        # End of persistent scheduler loop
+
+        # This is equivalent to pipeline_sm_stats.producer_tail
+        pipeline_sm_stats.producer_acquire_w_index_phase(stage, sm_stats_producer_phase)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def softmax_step(
+        self,
+        mma_si_consumer_phase: Int32,
+        sm_stats_producer_phase: Int32,
+        p_write_counter: Int32,
+        softmax: "SoftmaxSm100",
+        pipeline_s_p_o: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_p_ready: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_o_acc: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_sm_stats: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        sm_stats_barrier: pipeline.NamedBarrier,
+        sScale: cute.Tensor,
+        stage: int | Int32,
+        q_log2_scale: Float32,
+        sKScale: cute.Tensor,
+        tmem_s_addr: Int32,
+        tmem_p_addr: Int32,
+        valid_tokens: Int32,
+        mask_fn: Optional[Callable] = None,
+        is_first: bool = False,
+    ) -> Tuple[cute.Int32, cute.Int32, cute.Int32]:
+        """Perform a single step of the softmax computation on a block of attention scores.
+
+        This method processes one block of the attention matrix, computing numerically stable
+        softmax by first finding the row maximum, subtracting it from all elements, applying
+        exponential function, and then normalizing by the sum of exponentials. It also handles
+        optional masking of attention scores.
+
+        The method involves several key operations:
+        1. Loading attention scores from tensor memory
+        2. Applying optional masking based on position
+        3. Computing row-wise maximum values for numerical stability
+        4. Transforming scores using exp2(x*scale - max*scale)
+        5. Computing row sums for normalization
+        6. Coordinating pipeline synchronization between different processing stages
+        """
+        warp_idx = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.warp_idx()) % 4
+        if const_expr(self.triple_buffer_p):
+            p_slot = p_write_counter
+            if p_slot >= 3:
+                p_slot -= 3
+            tmem_p_addr = Int32(416) + p_slot * 32 + (warp_idx * 32 << 16)
+        # S_i completion covers the previous owner of P[i % 3].
+        pipeline_s_p_o.consumer_wait_w_index_phase(stage, mma_si_consumer_phase)
+        tSrS_t2r = cute.make_rmem_tensor((128,), Float32)
+        qk_scales = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), Float32)
+        group_maxima = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), Float32)
+        for group in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+            qk_scales[group] = q_log2_scale * sKScale[(mma_si_consumer_phase * 2 + stage) * 8 + group]
+        if const_expr(self.arch >= Arch.sm_103 and self.arch <= Arch.sm_103f):
+            for group in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                vals, group_max = tmem_load_red_max_32dp32b16x(tmem_s_addr + group * 16)
+                group_maxima[group] = group_max
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+                    tSrS_t2r[group * 16 + j] = vals[j]
+        else:
+            for group in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                vals = fp8_helpers.tmem_load_32dp32b32x(tmem_s_addr + group * 32)
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(32):
+                    tSrS_t2r[group * 32 + j] = vals[j]
+        # Retire every raw S load before another QK may overwrite its tile.
+        cute.arch.fence_view_async_tmem_load()
+        fp8_helpers.tcgen05_fence_before_thread_sync()
+        _SubsetNamedBarrier(barrier_id=12, num_threads=160).arrive_w_index(index=0)
+        if const_expr(mask_fn is not None):
+            mask_fn(tSrS_t2r)
+        tSrS_groups = cute.logical_divide(tSrS_t2r, cute.make_layout(16))
+        if const_expr(self.arch >= Arch.sm_103 and self.arch <= Arch.sm_103f):
+            if valid_tokens < 128:
+                for group in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                    group_maxima[group] = _max16_tree(tSrS_groups[None, group].load())
+        else:
+            for group in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+                group_maxima[group] = _max16_tree(tSrS_groups[None, group].load())
+        for group in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+            group_maxima[group] *= qk_scales[group]
+        row_max, acc_scale = softmax.update_row_max(group_maxima.load(), is_first)
+
+        if const_expr(self.double_buffer_stats):
+            # Correction reconstructs alpha from consecutive selected maxima.
+            # Keep the P bias in registers while publishing its shared payload.
+            thread_idx = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % self.m_block_size
+            scale_index = thread_idx + (mma_si_consumer_phase * 2 + stage) * self.m_block_size
+            selected_max = _publish_row_max(
+                Int32((sScale.iterator + scale_index).toint()),
+                softmax.row_max[0],
+                Int32(3 + stage * 2 + mma_si_consumer_phase),
+            )
+            row_max = selected_max if selected_max != -Float32.inf else Float32(0.0)
+        else:
+            if const_expr(not is_first):
+                # Delay this wait until the next score load/reduction has finished.
+                # Correction can consume the previous scale while that work runs.
+                pipeline_sm_stats.producer_acquire_w_index_phase(stage, sm_stats_producer_phase)
+                sm_stats_producer_phase ^= 1
+                thread_idx = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % self.m_block_size
+                sScale[thread_idx + stage * self.m_block_size] = acc_scale
+            # Publish scale ownership for every block, including the first.
+            sm_stats_barrier.arrive_w_index(index=stage * 4 + warp_idx)
+
+        # Fold input dequantization, attention scale and P*128 into one FMA.
+        # Store rounded P in 32-token chunks. The widened PV accumulates
+        # the same rounded probabilities into its appended denominator.
+        bias = Float32(7.0) - row_max
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            p_frag = cute.make_rmem_tensor((8,), Int32)
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(0, 32, 4):
+                offset = i * 32 + j
+                score_scale = qk_scales[offset // 16]
+                x0, x1 = cute.arch.fma_packed_f32x2(
+                    (tSrS_t2r[offset], tSrS_t2r[offset + 1]),
+                    (score_scale, score_scale),
+                    (bias, bias),
+                )
+                x2, x3 = cute.arch.fma_packed_f32x2(
+                    (tSrS_t2r[offset + 2], tSrS_t2r[offset + 3]),
+                    (score_scale, score_scale),
+                    (bias, bias),
+                )
+                e0, e1 = cute.math.exp2(x0, fastmath=True), cute.math.exp2(x1, fastmath=True)
+                if const_expr(self.enable_ex2_emu and i < 3 and j % 12 < 8):
+                    e2, e3 = utils.ex2_emulation_2(x2, x3)
+                else:
+                    e2, e3 = cute.math.exp2(x2, fastmath=True), cute.math.exp2(x3, fastmath=True)
+                p_frag[j // 4] = fp8_helpers.cvt_f32x4_to_e4m3x4(e0, e1, e2, e3)
+            # The third P slot is free at S readiness on SM100. SM103
+            # retains its previous-PV ownership wait before reusing P.
+            if const_expr(not self.triple_buffer_p and not is_first and i == 0):
+                pipeline_o_acc.consumer_wait_w_index_phase(stage, mma_si_consumer_phase ^ 1)
+            fp8_helpers.tmem_store_e4m3x8(tmem_p_addr + i * 8, p_frag)
+            if const_expr(i + 1 == self.split_P_arrive // 32):
+                cute.arch.fence_view_async_tmem_store()
+                fp8_helpers.tcgen05_fence_before_thread_sync()
+                pipeline_s_p_o.consumer_release_w_index(stage)
+        cute.arch.fence_view_async_tmem_store()
+        fp8_helpers.tcgen05_fence_before_thread_sync()
+        if const_expr(self.triple_buffer_p):
+            pipeline_p_ready.producer_commit_w_index(p_slot)
+            p_write_counter += 2
+            if p_write_counter >= 6:
+                p_write_counter -= 6
+        else:
+            if const_expr(self.split_P_arrive > 0):
+                cute.arch.sync_warp()
+                with cute.arch.elect_one():
+                    pipeline_p_ready.producer_commit_w_index(stage)
+            else:
+                # The single P credit now orders every probability store before PV.
+                pipeline_s_p_o.consumer_release_w_index(stage)
+        return mma_si_consumer_phase ^ 1, sm_stats_producer_phase, p_write_counter
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def correction_loop(
+        self,
+        thr_mma_pv: cute.ThrMma,
+        tOtO: cute.Tensor,
+        sScale: cute.Tensor,
+        mLSE: cute.Tensor,
+        sO: cute.Tensor,
+        pipeline_s_p_o: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_o_acc: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        pipeline_sm_stats: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        sm_stats_barrier: pipeline.NamedBarrier,
+        pipeline_o_epi: pipeline.PipelineAsync,
+        softmax_scale_log2: Float32,
+        SeqlenInfoCls: Callable,
+        tile_scheduler: "TileSchedulerProtocol",
+        block_sparse_num: Int32,
+        mBlockNums: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        mVScale: cute.Tensor,
+    ):
+        tidx = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % (cute.arch.WARP_SIZE * len(self.correction_warp_ids))
+        warp_idx = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.warp_idx()) % 4
+
+        # SM100 protects the first selected-max reader with its initial O credit.
+        # SM103 retains the scale-payload protocol and initial credits.
+        if const_expr(not self.double_buffer_stats):
+            for stage in cutlass.range(self.s_stage):
+                pipeline_s_p_o.consumer_release_w_index(stage)
+
+        sm_stats_consumer_phase = Int32(0)
+        o_corr_consumer_phase = Int32(0)
+        corr_epi_producer_phase = Int32(1)
+
+        work_tile = tile_scheduler.initial_work_tile_info()
+        while work_tile.is_valid_tile:
+            m_block, head_idx, batch_idx, split_idx = work_tile.tile_idx
+            seqlen = SeqlenInfoCls()
+
+            # For q_stage=1, always need row_max for combine; use -inf as default
+            stats = [
+                (
+                    Float32(0.0),
+                    -Float32.inf if const_expr(mLSE is not None or self.q_stage == 1) else None,
+                    True,
+                )
+            ] * self.s_stage
+
+            if const_expr(self.num_splits > 1):
+                _, split_block_count = self._split_block_range(mBlockNums, block_sparse_num, batch_idx, head_idx, m_block, split_idx)
+                has_work = split_block_count > Int32(0)
+            elif const_expr(mBlockNums is not None):
+                has_work = mBlockNums[batch_idx, head_idx, m_block] > Int32(0) if const_expr(self.allow_empty_block_nums) else True
+            else:
+                has_work = True
+
+            if has_work:
+                if const_expr(not self.double_buffer_stats):
+                    # The first dummy credit starts explicit scale ownership.
+                    sm_stats_barrier.arrive_and_wait_w_index(index=0 * 4 + warp_idx)
+                    pipeline_sm_stats.consumer_release_w_index(0)
+                    sm_stats_barrier.arrive_and_wait_w_index(index=1 * 4 + warp_idx)
+                    pipeline_sm_stats.consumer_release_w_index(1)
+                    sm_stats_consumer_phase ^= 1
+
+                if const_expr(self.double_buffer_stats):
+                    previous_row_max = cute.make_rmem_tensor((2,), Float32)
+                    for stage in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.s_stage):
+                        _SubsetNamedBarrier(barrier_id=3, num_threads=256).arrive_and_wait_w_index(index=stage * 2 + o_corr_consumer_phase)
+                        previous_row_max[stage] = sScale[tidx + (o_corr_consumer_phase * 2 + stage) * self.m_block_size]
+                        # The first PV cannot retire until this first reader is done.
+                        pipeline_s_p_o.consumer_release_w_index(stage)
+                # q_stage=1 correction loop
+                if const_expr(self.num_splits > 1):
+                    block_iter_count = (split_block_count + 1) & ~1
+                elif const_expr(mBlockNums is not None):
+                    block_iter_count = (mBlockNums[batch_idx, head_idx, m_block] + 1) & ~1
+                else:
+                    block_iter_count = (block_sparse_num + 1) & ~1
+                corr_pair_count = (block_iter_count - 2) // 2
+                # Rescale the two alternating stages as a pair.
+                for i in cutlass.range(corr_pair_count, unroll=1):
+                    for stage in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.s_stage):
+                        if const_expr(self.double_buffer_stats):
+                            scale_slot = o_corr_consumer_phase ^ 1
+                            _SubsetNamedBarrier(barrier_id=3, num_threads=256).arrive_and_wait_w_index(index=stage * 2 + scale_slot)
+                            selected_max = sScale[tidx + (scale_slot * 2 + stage) * self.m_block_size]
+                            safe_max = selected_max if selected_max != -Float32.inf else Float32(0.0)
+                            scale = cute.math.exp2(previous_row_max[stage] - safe_max, fastmath=True)
+                            previous_row_max[stage] = selected_max
+                            # Correction retains O credits and the previous-PV
+                            # wait, bounding both scale and arrival generations.
+                        else:
+                            sm_stats_barrier.arrive_and_wait_w_index(index=stage * 4 + warp_idx)
+                            scale = sScale[tidx + stage * self.m_block_size]
+                            # Lookahead QK bypasses O ownership. Release the scale
+                            # slot after every reader before the next writer.
+                            pipeline_sm_stats.consumer_release_w_index(stage)
+                        # An early S publication no longer proves previous PV completion.
+                        pipeline_o_acc.consumer_wait_w_index_phase(stage, o_corr_consumer_phase)
+                        should_rescale = cute.arch.vote_ballot_sync(scale < 1.0) != 0
+                        if should_rescale:
+                            self.correction_rescale(thr_mma_pv, tOtO[None, None, None, stage], tidx, scale)
+                            _fused_denominator_rescale(
+                                Int32(self.tmem_o_offset[stage] + 128 + ((warp_idx * 32) << 16)),
+                                scale,
+                            )
+                        pipeline_s_p_o.consumer_release_w_index(stage)
+                    sm_stats_consumer_phase ^= 1
+                    o_corr_consumer_phase ^= 1
+                # Read final softmax stats for both stages
+                for stage in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.s_stage):
+                    if const_expr(self.double_buffer_stats):
+                        # Drain scale readers, then wait for the final payload.
+                        _SubsetNamedBarrier(barrier_id=11, num_threads=256).arrive_and_wait_w_index(index=stage * 2)
+                        _SubsetNamedBarrier(barrier_id=11, num_threads=256).arrive_and_wait_w_index(index=stage * 2)
+                    else:
+                        sm_stats_barrier.arrive_and_wait_w_index(index=stage * 4 + warp_idx)
+                    # The final PV owns both O and its appended denominator.
+                    pipeline_o_acc.consumer_wait_w_index_phase(stage, o_corr_consumer_phase)
+                    fp8_helpers.tcgen05_fence_after_thread_sync()
+                    row_sum = _fused_denominator_load(Int32(self.tmem_o_offset[stage] + 128 + ((warp_idx * 32) << 16)))
+                    if const_expr(mLSE is not None or self.q_stage == 1):
+                        row_max = sScale[tidx + stage * self.m_block_size + self.s_stage * self.m_block_size]
+                    else:
+                        row_max = None
+                    pipeline_sm_stats.consumer_release_w_index(stage)
+                    acc_O_mn_row_is_zero_or_nan = row_sum == 0.0 or row_sum != row_sum
+                    stats[stage] = (row_sum, row_max, acc_O_mn_row_is_zero_or_nan)
+
+                # q_stage=1: combine O0 and O1, then write single output
+                row_sum0, row_max0, zero_or_nan0 = stats[0]
+                row_sum1, row_max1, zero_or_nan1 = stats[1]
+
+                # Compute combined scales for the two partial O accumulators
+                # FP8 row maxima already include dequantization and log2 scale;
+                # softmax_scale_log2 is 1 here when combining the two streams.
+                # For empty/padding stages (zero_or_nan=True), row_max may be 0.0 instead of -inf
+                # due to softmax's safe_max clamping. Use -inf for those to avoid polluting max_combined.
+                rm0 = row_max0 if not zero_or_nan0 else -Float32.inf
+                rm1 = row_max1 if not zero_or_nan1 else -Float32.inf
+                max_combined = cutlass.max(rm0, rm1)
+                max_safe = max_combined if max_combined != -Float32.inf else Float32(0.0)
+                scale0 = cute.math.exp2((rm0 - max_safe) * softmax_scale_log2, fastmath=True) if not zero_or_nan0 else Float32(0.0)
+                scale1 = cute.math.exp2((rm1 - max_safe) * softmax_scale_log2, fastmath=True) if not zero_or_nan1 else Float32(0.0)
+                sum_combined = row_sum0 * scale0 + row_sum1 * scale1
+                combined_zero_or_nan = sum_combined == 0.0 or sum_combined != sum_combined
+                inv_sum = cute.arch.rcp_approx(sum_combined if not combined_zero_or_nan else 1.0)
+                final_scale0 = scale0 * inv_sum
+                final_scale1 = scale1 * inv_sum
+
+                # Both O completions were consumed before their denominator reads.
+                pipeline_o_epi.producer_acquire_w_index_phase(0, corr_epi_producer_phase)
+                self.correction_epilogue_combine(
+                    thr_mma_pv,
+                    tOtO[None, None, None, 0],
+                    tOtO[None, None, None, 1],
+                    tidx,
+                    final_scale0,
+                    final_scale1,
+                    sO[None, None, 0],
+                    mVScale,
+                    head_idx,
+                )
+                # The next SM100 tile releases O after reading its first maxima.
+                if const_expr(not self.double_buffer_stats):
+                    for stage in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.s_stage):
+                        pipeline_s_p_o.consumer_release_w_index(stage)
+                pipeline_o_epi.producer_commit_w_index(0)
+
+                o_corr_consumer_phase ^= 1
+                sm_stats_consumer_phase ^= 1
+                corr_epi_producer_phase ^= 1
+            else:
+                # Empty tile (block_count == 0): sync pipelines and write O=0.
+                # Match softmax's 1 barrier arrive per stage.
+                for stage_idx in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.s_stage):
+                    if const_expr(self.double_buffer_stats):
+                        _SubsetNamedBarrier(barrier_id=11, num_threads=256).arrive_and_wait_w_index(index=stage_idx * 2)
+                    else:
+                        sm_stats_barrier.arrive_and_wait_w_index(index=stage_idx * 4 + warp_idx)
+                    pipeline_sm_stats.consumer_release_w_index(stage_idx)
+                sm_stats_consumer_phase ^= 1
+                # Write O=0 via correction_epilogue_combine with scale=0.
+                # Both scales are zero, so the epilogue skips stale TMEM reads.
+                pipeline_o_epi.producer_acquire_w_index_phase(0, corr_epi_producer_phase)
+                self.correction_epilogue_combine(
+                    thr_mma_pv,
+                    tOtO[None, None, None, 0],
+                    tOtO[None, None, None, 1],
+                    tidx,
+                    Float32(0.0),
+                    Float32(0.0),
+                    sO[None, None, 0],
+                    mVScale,
+                    head_idx,
+                )
+                # Do NOT release pipeline_s_p_o (MMA didn't commit)
+                pipeline_o_epi.producer_commit_w_index(0)
+                # o_corr_consumer_phase NOT toggled (pipeline_o_acc not touched)
+                corr_epi_producer_phase ^= 1
+
+            if const_expr(mLSE is not None):
+                output_head = head_idx + split_idx * (mLSE.shape[1] // self.num_splits)
+                mLSE_cur = mLSE[None, output_head, batch_idx]
+                # q_stage=1: compute combined LSE from two partial softmax stats
+                m_tile_idx = m_block
+                gLSE = cute.local_tile(mLSE_cur, (self.m_block_size,), (m_tile_idx,))
+                row_sum0, row_max0, zero_or_nan0 = stats[0]
+                row_sum1, row_max1, zero_or_nan1 = stats[1]
+                rm0_lse = row_max0 if not zero_or_nan0 else -Float32.inf
+                rm1_lse = row_max1 if not zero_or_nan1 else -Float32.inf
+                max_combined = cutlass.max(rm0_lse, rm1_lse)
+                max_safe = max_combined if max_combined != -Float32.inf else Float32(0.0)
+                s0 = cute.math.exp2((rm0_lse - max_safe) * softmax_scale_log2, fastmath=True) if not zero_or_nan0 else Float32(0.0)
+                s1 = cute.math.exp2((rm1_lse - max_safe) * softmax_scale_log2, fastmath=True) if not zero_or_nan1 else Float32(0.0)
+                sum_comb = row_sum0 * s0 + row_sum1 * s1
+                comb_zero_or_nan = sum_comb == 0.0 or sum_comb != sum_comb
+                LN2 = math.log(2.0)
+                lse = (max_safe * softmax_scale_log2 + cute.math.log2(sum_comb, fastmath=True) - Float32(7.0)) * LN2 if not comb_zero_or_nan else -Float32.inf
+                seqlen_q = seqlen.seqlen_q
+                if tidx < seqlen_q - m_tile_idx * self.m_block_size:
+                    gLSE[tidx] = lse
+
+            # Advance to next tile
+            work_tile = tile_scheduler.consumer_advance()
+        # End of persistent scheduler loop
+
+        # This is equivalent to pipeline_o_epi.consumer_tail() for the correction warps
+        pipeline_o_epi.producer_acquire_w_index_phase(self.q_stage - 1, corr_epi_producer_phase)
+

+@cute.jit
+def _fused_pv_issue(tmem: Int32, v_address: Int32, ones_address: Int32, accumulate: Int32, probability: Int32, columns: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    # Original SW128 V tile, plus a separate immutable SW128 ones tile.
+    # The relative leading offset is different for each current V stage.
+    descriptor: cutlass.Constexpr = (64 << 32) | (1 << 46) | (2 << 61)
+    instruction: cutlass.Constexpr = sm100_desc.make_instr_desc(
+        cutlass.Float8E4M3FN, cutlass.Float8E4M3FN, Float32, 128, columns, sm100_desc.Major.K, sm100_desc.Major.MN
+    )
+    llvm.inline_asm(
+        None,
+        [tmem.ir_value(), v_address.ir_value(), ones_address.ir_value(), accumulate.ir_value(), probability.ir_value()],
+        "{ .reg .pred elected, use_previous; .reg .b32 p, start, low, high, ins, leading; "

+"""Block-scaled Q/K precisions of the SM100 indexer kernels.
+
+``BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS`` maps each precision to its Q/K and scale dtypes, its
+scale vector size along head_dim and its kernel class. The indexer forward
+(dense and compressed-logits) and the dense indexer score recompute validate
+against it; the MXFP8 dense attention score reuses the MXFP8 entry.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from cudnn.deepseek_sparse_attention.utils.runtime import ceil_div
+from .indexer_score_unified_sm100 import IndexerScoreUnifiedSm100
+from .indexer_score_unified_sm100_mxfp4 import IndexerScoreUnifiedSm100Mxfp4
+from .indexer_score_unified_sm100_mxfp8 import IndexerScoreUnifiedSm100Mxfp8
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class BlockScaledFormat:
+    """Q/K storage contract of a block-scaled indexer precision.
+
+    ``data_dtype`` / ``scale_dtype`` resolve the named torch dtypes of Q/K and
+    their scales, or are ``None`` when the installed torch lacks them
+    (``validate_indexer_precision`` reports that). One stored element holds
+    ``elems_per_storage`` logical head_dim values (2 for packed FP4, whose last
+    dim is ``head_dim // 2``); each scale covers ``sf_vec_size`` of them.
+    """
+
+    data_dtype_name: str
+    scale_dtype_name: str
+    sf_vec_size: int
+    elems_per_storage: int
+    kernel_cls: type[IndexerScoreUnifiedSm100]
+
+    @property
+    def data_dtype(self) -> Optional[torch.dtype]:
+        return getattr(torch, self.data_dtype_name, None)
+
+    @property
+    def scale_dtype(self) -> Optional[torch.dtype]:
+        return getattr(torch, self.scale_dtype_name, None)
+
+
+BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS = {
+    "mxfp8": BlockScaledFormat(
+        data_dtype_name="float8_e4m3fn",
+        scale_dtype_name="float8_e8m0fnu",
+        sf_vec_size=32,
+        elems_per_storage=1,
+        kernel_cls=IndexerScoreUnifiedSm100Mxfp8,
+    ),
+    "mxfp4": BlockScaledFormat(
+        data_dtype_name="float4_e2m1fn_x2",
+        scale_dtype_name="float8_e8m0fnu",
+        sf_vec_size=32,
+        elems_per_storage=2,
+        kernel_cls=IndexerScoreUnifiedSm100Mxfp4,
+    ),
+}
+SM100_INDEXER_PRECISIONS = ("bf16", *BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS)
+# Block-scaled precision names for error messages: "'mxfp8' or 'mxfp4'".
+BLOCK_SCALED_PRECISION_NAMES = " or ".join(repr(name) for name in BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS)
+# The only logical head dim the block-scaled indexer kernels support.
+BLOCK_SCALED_HEAD_DIM = 128
+
+
+def validate_indexer_precision(precision: str) -> str:
+    """Lowercase ``precision`` and reject one the SM100 indexer or the installed torch does not support."""
+    precision = precision.lower()
+    if precision not in SM100_INDEXER_PRECISIONS:
+        raise ValueError(f"precision must be one of {SM100_INDEXER_PRECISIONS}, got {precision!r}")
+    fmt = BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS.get(precision)
+    if fmt is not None:
+        missing = [name for name in (fmt.data_dtype_name, fmt.scale_dtype_name) if getattr(torch, name, None) is None]
+        if missing:
+            raise NotImplementedError(f"precision={precision!r} requires a torch build with " + " and ".join(f"torch.{name}" for name in missing))
+    return precision
+
+
+def validate_sf_vec_size(precision: str, sf_vec_size: int) -> None:
+    """A block-scaled ``precision`` requires its format's scale vector size (``ValueError`` otherwise)."""
+    fmt = BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS.get(precision)
+    if fmt is not None and sf_vec_size != fmt.sf_vec_size:
+        raise ValueError(f"precision={precision!r} currently requires sf_vec_size={fmt.sf_vec_size}")
+
+
+def validate_block_scaled_inputs(
+    precision: str,
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    w: torch.Tensor,
+    q_scale: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    k_scale: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+) -> None:
+    """Check the dtype and device contract of a block-scaled precision's Q/K/W and scales."""
+    fmt = BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS[precision]
+    if q.dtype != fmt.data_dtype or k.dtype != fmt.data_dtype:
+        raise TypeError(f"precision={precision!r} requires q and k to be {fmt.data_dtype}")
+    if w.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+        raise TypeError(f"precision={precision!r} requires w to be torch.bfloat16")
+    if q_scale is None or k_scale is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"precision={precision!r} requires q_scale and k_scale")
+    if q_scale.dtype != fmt.scale_dtype or k_scale.dtype != fmt.scale_dtype:
+        raise TypeError(f"precision={precision!r} requires q_scale and k_scale to be {fmt.scale_dtype}")
+    if q_scale.device != q.device or k_scale.device != k.device:
+        raise ValueError("q_scale/k_scale must be on the same device as q/k")
+
+
+def logical_head_dim(precision: str, storage_head_dim: int) -> int:
+    """Logical head dim of Q/K whose last dim is ``storage_head_dim``.
+
+    A block-scaled precision must hold ``BLOCK_SCALED_HEAD_DIM`` logical values;
+    otherwise this raises ``ValueError`` naming the stored last dim it needs.
+    """
+    fmt = BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS.get(precision)
+    if fmt is None:
+        return storage_head_dim
+    head_dim = storage_head_dim * fmt.elems_per_storage
+    if head_dim != BLOCK_SCALED_HEAD_DIM:
+        stored = BLOCK_SCALED_HEAD_DIM // fmt.elems_per_storage
+        packing = f" ({fmt.elems_per_storage} values per torch.{fmt.data_dtype_name} element)" if fmt.elems_per_storage > 1 else ""
+        raise ValueError(f"precision={precision!r} requires head_dim={BLOCK_SCALED_HEAD_DIM}, stored as q/k last dim {stored}{packing}; got {storage_head_dim}")
+    return head_dim
+
+
+def kernel_qk_view(precision: str, t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Q or K as the ``precision`` kernel is compiled and launched with.
+
+    A packed format (more than one value per stored element) passes its raw bytes
+    as a ``torch.uint8`` view, which the kernel recasts to its element type: CuTe
+    DSL before 4.8 binds a ``torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2`` tensor with its packed shape
+    and strides, not the E2M1 ones the kernel is compiled for. Other precisions
+    pass ``t`` unchanged.
+    """
+    fmt = BLOCK_SCALED_FORMATS.get(precision)
+    if fmt is None or fmt.elems_per_storage == 1:
+        return t
+    return t.view(torch.uint8)
+
+
+def bshd_packed_scale_shape(
+    *,
+    bs: int,
+    seqlen: int,
+    n_heads_kv: int,
+    sf_groups: int,
+    pack_q_heads: int = 1,
+) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
+    """Shape ``(L, padded_MN, padded_sf_groups)`` of BSHD blockscaled-packed scales.
+
+    ``MN = seqlen * pack_q_heads`` rounds up to 128 rows and the scale groups
+    to 4 columns.
+    """
+    mn = seqlen * pack_q_heads
+    return (
+        bs * n_heads_kv,
+        ceil_div(mn, 128) * 128,
+        ceil_div(sf_groups, 4) * 4,
+    )
+
+
+def validate_thd_scale_contract(
+    q_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    k_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens_q_scale_padded: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    cu_seqlens_k_scale_padded: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    *,
+    precision: str,
+    bs: int,
+    n_heads_kv: int,
+    sf_groups: int,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> None:
+    """Check the THD scale padded prefixes and the packed ``(n_heads_kv, multiple_of_128, padded_sf_groups)`` scales."""
+    if cu_seqlens_q_scale_padded is None or cu_seqlens_k_scale_padded is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"THD {precision.upper()} requires Q/K scale padded cu_seqlens")
+
+    for prefix, name in (
+        (cu_seqlens_q_scale_padded, "cu_seqlens_q_scale_padded"),
+        (cu_seqlens_k_scale_padded, "cu_seqlens_k_scale_padded"),
+    ):
+        if prefix.dtype != torch.int32 or prefix.ndim != 1 or prefix.shape[0] != bs + 1 or not prefix.is_contiguous() or prefix.device != device:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be contiguous int32 shape ({bs + 1},) on {device}")
+
+    sf_padded = ceil_div(sf_groups, 4) * 4
+    for scale, name in ((q_scale, "q_scale"), (k_scale, "k_scale")):

+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 3D packed scale tensor")
+        if scale.shape[0] != n_heads_kv or scale.shape[1] % 128 != 0 or scale.shape[2] != sf_padded:

+        if scale.device != device:
+            raise ValueError("q_scale/k_scale must be on the same device as q/k")

+    """Round a workspace segment size up to the shared alignment boundary."""
+    return -(-int(num_bytes) // _WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT) * _WORKSPACE_ALIGNMENT

+def _workspace_shapes_sm100(
+    total_s_q: int,
+    total_s_kv: int,

+    num_heads: int,

+    backend retains the conservative 128-plane capacity.

+    total_s_kv: int,

+    head_dim_v: int,
+    num_heads: int,
+    max_topk: int,
+    deterministic: bool,
+    backend: Optional[str],
+    *,
+    include_workspace: bool,

+    """Return whether a compact plan tensor can exceed signed Int32 offsets.
+
+    All public SM100 DSA backward tensors are contiguous. Their largest
+    element offset is therefore ``numel - 1``. The generic compiler also
+    describes byte-shaped workspaces with compact layouts, while the D576
+    compiler already gives those workspace extents an Int64 ABI independently.

+        total_s_kv * head_dim,

+                backend,

+def flash_attn_bwd_sm100_workspace_size(
+    total_s_q: int,
+    total_s_kv: int,
+    head_dim: int,
+    num_heads: int,

+    backend: Optional[str] = None,

+    """Return the reusable caller scratch required by one SM100 launch.

+    H96/H128 D576 two-CTA backends use a compact 96-plane layout; unspecified
+    backends use the conservative fixed 128-plane layout. The result includes
+    alignment padding and is the minimum byte count for a contiguous
+    ``torch.uint8`` workspace.
+    """
+    workspace_lse_odo_shape, workspace_dkv_shape = _workspace_shapes_sm100(
+        total_s_q,
+        total_s_kv,
+        head_dim,
+        num_heads,
+        deterministic,
+        backend,
+    )
+    return _align_workspace_bytes(math.prod(workspace_lse_odo_shape)) + _align_workspace_bytes(math.prod(workspace_dkv_shape))

+def _layout(max_topk: int, heads: int) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
+    """Return tile, shared capacity, packed stride, and threshold divisor."""
+    if heads not in (16, 32):
+        raise ValueError(f"adaptive q-cluster requires H16 or H32, got H{heads}")
+    if not 0 < max_topk <= 2048:
+        raise ValueError(f"adaptive q-cluster requires 1 <= topk <= 2048, got {max_topk}")
+    tile = 128 if heads == 16 else 64
+    if max_topk <= 2 * tile:
+        return tile, 0, max_topk, 0
+    shared_capacity = ((max_topk - 1) // tile) * tile
+    packed_stride = -(-(max_topk + shared_capacity) // 32) * 32
+    # H16 merges into the tuned H32 kernel; H32 merges into generic H64 and
+    # needs a slightly larger segment to amortize that path.
+    threshold_divisor = 8 if heads == 16 else 6
+    return tile, shared_capacity, packed_stride, threshold_divisor
+

+def workspace_size(total_q: int, total_kv: int, dim: int, heads: int, max_topk: int) -> int:
+    """Return base scratch plus graph-stable q-cluster metadata storage."""
+    lse_shape, dkv_shape = _workspace_shapes_sm100(total_q, total_kv, dim, heads, False)
+    size = _align_workspace_bytes(math.prod(lse_shape)) + _align_workspace_bytes(math.prod(dkv_shape))
+    _, shared_capacity, packed_stride, _ = _layout(max_topk, heads)
+    if shared_capacity:
+        size += _align_workspace_bytes(total_q * packed_stride * 4)
+        size += _align_workspace_bytes((total_q + (total_q + 1) // 2) * 4)
+        size += _align_workspace_bytes(2 * heads * 4)
+    return size

+from cutlass.cute.typing import Int32

+class QPairTopKTransformSm100:
+    """Partition adjacent top-k rows into shared and per-query segments.
+
+    The hash table is sized from ``topk_capacity`` and never from the KV
+    sequence length. Invalid or duplicate rows retain the ordinary path.
+    """
+
+    THREADS = 256
+
+    def __init__(self, topk_capacity: int, shared_capacity: int, tile: int, threshold_divisor: int):
+        """Configure a bounded hash table and tile-aligned sharing policy."""
+        if not 0 < topk_capacity <= 2048:
+            raise ValueError("topk_capacity must be in [1, 2048]")
+        if not 0 < shared_capacity < topk_capacity or shared_capacity % tile:
+            raise ValueError("shared_capacity must be tile-aligned and below topk_capacity")
+        if threshold_divisor <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("threshold_divisor must be positive")
+
+        self.topk_capacity = topk_capacity
+        self.shared_capacity = shared_capacity
+        self.tile = tile
+        self.threshold_divisor = threshold_divisor
+        # The union contains at most 2K entries. Keep the table at or below
+        # 50% occupancy so bounded linear probing remains cheap.
+        self.table_capacity = 1 << (4 * topk_capacity - 1).bit_length()
+        self.items_per_thread = (topk_capacity + self.THREADS - 1) // self.THREADS
+        self.slots_per_thread = (self.table_capacity + self.THREADS - 1) // self.THREADS
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        mInput: cute.Tensor,
+        mOutput: cute.Tensor,
+        mUniqueLengths: cute.Tensor,
+        mSharedLengths: cute.Tensor,
+        mDSink: cute.Tensor,
+        mTopkLength: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        max_seqlen_kv: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        """Launch one independent CTA per adjacent query pair."""

+        )

+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        mInput: cute.Tensor,
+        mOutput: cute.Tensor,
+        mUniqueLengths: cute.Tensor,
+        mSharedLengths: cute.Tensor,
+        mDSink: cute.Tensor,
+        mTopkLength: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+        max_seqlen_kv: Int32,

+                shared = Int32(0)

+            mUniqueLengths[row0] = meta[0] - shared
+            mUniqueLengths[row1] = meta[1] - shared

+        if meta[5] == Int32(0):
+            for rank in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):

+            cute.arch.nvvm.exit()
+
+        # Select common keys while walking row 0, then let row 1 observe the
+        # selection bit. This visits O(K) inputs instead of O(table_capacity)
+        # slots and preserves every unselected common key in both tails.
+        for item in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.items_per_thread):

+                    if shared_pos < meta[5]:

+                        cute.arch.atomic_or((flags.iterator + slot).llvm_ptr, Int32(4), sem="relaxed", scope="cta")
+                        selected = Int32(1)
+                if selected == Int32(0):
+                    unique_pos = cute.arch.atomic_add((meta.iterator + Int32(7)).llvm_ptr, Int32(1), sem="relaxed", scope="cta")
+                    mOutput[row0, Int32(self.shared_capacity) + unique_pos] = index
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+
+        for item in cutlass.range_constexpr(self.items_per_thread):
+            pos = tidx + Int32(item * self.THREADS)
+            if pos < meta[1]:
+                index = mInput[row1, pos]
+                slot = Int32((cutlass.Uint32(index) * cutlass.Uint32(2654435761)) & cutlass.Uint32(self.table_capacity - 1))
+                while keys[slot] != index:
+                    slot = (slot + Int32(1)) & Int32(self.table_capacity - 1)
+                if (flags[slot] & Int32(4)) == Int32(0):
+                    unique_pos = cute.arch.atomic_add((meta.iterator + Int32(8)).llvm_ptr, Int32(1), sem="relaxed", scope="cta")
+                    mOutput[row1, Int32(self.shared_capacity) + unique_pos] = index
+

+    target_i64 = target.toint(loc=loc, ip=ip).ir_value()

+            Float32(value_0).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+            Float32(value_1).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+            Float32(value_2).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+            Float32(value_3).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),

+### Row-block tiling and tile order
+
+A pair processes 256 rows. The host chooses power-of-two `kb` and `r_i` with
+`r_i * kb == 256`. For scheduler row-block index `tile_m` and pair row `r`:

+```text

+kb_idx = tile_m % n_kb
+bi = ib * r_i + (r >> lkb)
+k = kb_idx * kb + (r & (kb - 1))

+mask/statistics accesses and stores must also honor those bounds and `n_pad`.
+The descriptor layout, swizzled LayerNorm accesses and MMA operand layout must
+agree. The accumulator-pairing arm has two independently normalized operands
+and its own output layout.

+Every CLC consumer must use the same decode. Reordering work must preserve the
+operation's arithmetic and output addressing.

+

+|---|---|---|

+| `a_norm_full` | One elected lane per LayerNorm warp in both CTAs | Leader MMA waits for normalized A |
+| `ab_full` | Elected TMA lane, counting both CTAs' B traffic | Leader MMA waits for B loads |
+| `ab_empty` | Leader MMA commit with the pair multicast mask | TMA producers wait before reusing an operand stage |
+| `acc_full` / `acc_empty` | MMA / epilogue warps | Protect accumulator production, drain and reuse |
+| `clc_full` / `clc_empty` | Scheduler / consumer warps | Protect each scheduler response until every consumer finishes |

+lane issues the release arrival. Preserve the leader/follower arrival counts
+and the corresponding waits. Fully masked work still commits completion so
+the epilogue cannot wait forever. Accumulator loads must complete before TMEM
+release or deallocation.

+The A region holds `_A_SLOTS * _NK` immutable stages; LayerNorm runs once per
+item, while the B ring, accumulator ring and epilogue remain per tile.
+`_item_tile` decodes the item's subtile into N tile and pass. CLC is consumed
+once per item. After the last K step of the last subtile, the MMA commits
+`a_empty` to release the A slot; both CTAs drain all outstanding slots before
+exit. A-region phases advance for each item and slot, rather than with the
+B ring's per-tile cadence. Use `ln_once_a_slots` and `ln_once_b_stages_effective` for
+the architecture-specific capacity decision.

+### Register allocation and LayerNorm forms
+
+The bodies assign epilogue, MMA, TMA, scheduler and LayerNorm warp roles.
+Set `min_blocks_per_mp=1` on the launch for their `setmaxregister` requests to
+take effect. The adapter defaults to zero; without the hint, ptxas can drop
+the register split. Check the generated binary before claiming that a
+toolchain honored the requests; do not infer effective register allocation
+from source-level requests alone.

+register-resident LayerNorm with K at least `4 * K_STAGE` and a packed epilogue,
+for every accumulator-pairing case, or a columns-pairing statistics writer
+using `packed_hoist` / `packed_biasfold`. This gate does not apply to SM107.
+Keep it a typed host rejection rather than allowing a later compilation error.
+
+The register form retains row words between statistics passes. Shared-memory
+forms re-read their unchanged stages; the accumulator-pairing re-read forms
+require the MN-major prologue because transpose writes can overwrite another
+lane's unread input. The `smem_rolled_tree` form changes the FP32 summation
+order and requires its numerical checks; the other forms retain the existing
+association. Packed epilogue variants keep the final mask select and their
+declared rounding points. These choices do not justify changing barrier
+counts, stage ownership or output layout.

+## SM100 block-scale descriptor roots
+
+The SM100 block-scale templates declare the scale-factor rings before the
+data rings. Their non-versioned `Tcgen05SmemDesc.build` encoding has a 14-bit
+start-address field in 16-byte units. A ring root at or above `262144` bytes
+wraps into earlier shared memory. `advance_start_address` advances an encoded
+descriptor without that root mask, so the restriction applies to the build
+roots rather than every stage offset.

+`sm100/compiler.py::_block_scale_smem_desc_roots` models each complete ring
+in declaration order, with 1024-byte ring alignment and the template's actual
+output-staging placement. Dense templates place output staging after the
+rings; grouped templates place it before them. The compiler trims stage depth
+until every build root fits, and rejects a configuration when even one stage
+cannot fit. This check is separate from the target GPU's shared-memory budget.
+More shared memory does not make a wrapped descriptor valid.

+changing ring depth or adding distinct operands. The regression in
+`test_block_scale_smem_layout_sm107.py` checks the source order and the
+independent root model; source comments link this section instead of repeating

+"""The additive attention bias as a RESIDENT SMEM row-block of a persistent SDPA forward.
+
+One work item of the classic (d128-family) pipeline owns ``BLOCK_ROWS = TILES_Q x TILE_M`` query rows and a KV
+range of ``n_tiles`` ``TILE_N``-column tiles.  The bias slice it needs, ``[BLOCK_ROWS x n_tiles * TILE_N]`` of
+the io dtype, is loaded ONCE per item by the TMA-LDG warp (:func:`issue_bias_block_load`) into a block the
+softmax warps read for the item's lifetime -- one lane = one query row, a 128-byte row slice of a 64-column
+sub-tile per 16-byte-granule swizzled load (:func:`load_bias_row_chunk`) -- and add pre-scale to the raw
+scores as one packed FFMA per pair (:func:`bias_fma_chunk`): ``s_raw + bias * inv_scale`` keeps the kernel's
+raw-S + scale-at-the-exp2 convention (``(s_raw + bias / scale) * scale == s_raw * scale + bias``).
+
+The block's swizzle does BOTH jobs (frost-kernels s5): the TMA descriptor writes it under the 128-byte atom (a
+descriptor reads it: job D), and the softmax lanes address it one 128-byte row each (lanes read it: job L --
+a per-lane stride that is a multiple of the 128-byte bank cycle is a 32-way conflict unswizzled; the 16-byte
+chunk index XOR (row % 8) spreads eight consecutive rows over eight bank groups, so a warp-wide 16-byte load
+costs the ideal 4 wavefronts).  ``cutlass.Swizzle(3, 4, 3)``: ``MBase + SShift = 7 = log2(128 B)``.
+
+Geometry is derived from the kernel's Cfg (:func:`bias_block_geometry`), never spelled per call site; the
+expect_tx of the item's fill is the sum of the FULL boxes (an overshooting box past S_q / S_kv is zero-filled
+AND counted), so a tail tile needs no special case.
+
+Above the resident budget the SAME block geometry becomes a STREAMED RING (``CFG.BIAS_MODE == 2``): the TMA-LDG
+warp issues ONE tile per kv tile into a ``STAGES_BIAS``-deep ring (:func:`issue_bias_ring_tile`), the softmax
+warps read the stage exactly as they read a resident tile (the tile index is the ring stage) and release it per
+kv tile.  Same swizzle, same boxes, same lane loads; only the SMEM extent and the two mbarrier rings differ.
+
+The ADDITIVE per-key vector (the ``kv_mask`` input in its bf16 / fp16 / fp32 form: one value per key, broadcast
+over every query row, the models' finite ``-1e9`` fold) takes the SAME pre-scale FFMA (:func:`additive_vec_fma_chunk`)
+from a warp-uniform GMEM load (:func:`additive_vec_granules`): nothing is staged in SMEM and no barrier row is added
+-- the slice is ``n`` elements per kv tile, read as 16-byte granules every lane of the warp fetches at the same
+address, so the LSU broadcasts one sector per instruction.  A granule past the vector's end is CLAMPED to the last
+in-bounds one (the band / padding mask masks those columns anyway), which is why the vector's extent must be
+whole granules (``S_kv % 8 == 0``) and its base / batch stride 16-byte aligned -- typed declines on the row.

+from typing import NamedTuple

+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass.base_dsl.typing import Pointer
+from cutlass.experimental import primitives as nvvm
+
+from cutlass.cute.arch.nvvm_wrappers import inline_ptx

+from .pointwise import f16x2_to_f32, ffma2, fmax_f32, opaque_i32
+from .tma import tma_load_tile, tma_load_tile_multicast
