+    @property
+    def k_stages(self) -> int:
+        return self.k // K_STAGE
+
+    @property
+    def n_tiles(self) -> int:
+        """GEMM N tiles per row block: ``c_out / 128`` in BOTH arms (the columns arm's 256-wide tile holds one value block + one gate block; the
+        accumulators arm's two GEMMs each run a 128-wide tile)."""
+        return self.c_out // CHANNEL_BLOCK
+
+
+def ln_once_n_tiles_per_item(p: LnDualGemmParams) -> int:
+    """N tiles one work item spans under the lever: every one (``"block"``), one (``"passes"``); 1 when the lever is off."""
+    return p.n_tiles if p.ln_once == "block" else 1
+
+
+def ln_once_tiles_per_item(p: LnDualGemmParams) -> int:
+    """GEMM tiles per work item: ``passes x n_tiles_per_item`` under the lever (the LayerNorm multiplicity it removes), 1 when off."""
+    return p.passes * ln_once_n_tiles_per_item(p) if p.ln_once else 1
+
+
+def _ln_once_a_slots_at(p: LnDualGemmParams, arch: str, b_stages: int) -> int:
+    """The slot count the self-referential predicate gives with a B ring of ``b_stages`` stages (the shipped ring's bytes are the budget)."""
+    ring = ring_stages(arch, p.pairing)
+    off_bytes = ring * (p.num_a_operands * A_STAGE_BYTES + p.num_b_operands * B_STAGE_BYTES[p.pairing])
+    b_ring_bytes = b_stages * p.num_b_operands * B_STAGE_BYTES[p.pairing]
+    region_bytes = p.num_a_operands * p.k_stages * A_STAGE_BYTES
+    return 2 if 2 * region_bytes + b_ring_bytes <= off_bytes else 1
+
+
+def ln_once_b_stages_effective(p: LnDualGemmParams, arch: str = "sm107") -> int:
+    """Return the effective B-ring depth for LayerNorm reuse."""
+    ring = ring_stages(arch, p.pairing)
+    want = int(p.ln_once_b_stages or 0)
+    if not p.ln_once or want <= 0 or want >= ring:
+        return ring
+    if _ln_once_a_slots_at(p, arch, ring) == 2 or _ln_once_a_slots_at(p, arch, want) != 2:
+        return ring
+    return want
+
+
+def ln_once_a_slots(p: LnDualGemmParams, arch: str = "sm107") -> int:
+    """Return the resident A-slot count for LayerNorm reuse."""
+    if not p.ln_once:
+        return 0
+    return _ln_once_a_slots_at(p, arch, ln_once_b_stages_effective(p, arch))
+
+
+_SM100_UNALLOCATABLE_MIN_K = 4 * K_STAGE
+
+
+def sm100_register_form_unallocatable(p: LnDualGemmParams, arch: str) -> bool:
+    """Reject SM100 register forms that ptxas cannot allocate."""
+    if arch != "sm100" or p.ln_pass_form != "registers" or p.epi_math == "scalar" or p.k < _SM100_UNALLOCATABLE_MIN_K:
+        return False
+    if p.dual:
+        return True
+    return bool(p.want_stats) and p.epi_math in ("packed_hoist", "packed_biasfold")
+
+
+def validate_ln_dual_gemm_params(p: LnDualGemmParams, arch: str = "sm107") -> None:
+    """Typed declines for every value a caller can trip (never a module-level assert -- engine contract S 7); ``arch`` names the body whose
+    ring bounds K (:func:`max_k`): the same record can be valid for the Rubin body and a decline for the Blackwell one."""
+    if not isinstance(p, LnDualGemmParams):
+        raise TypeError(f"expected LnDualGemmParams, got {type(p).__name__}")
+    if arch not in BODIES:
+        raise ValueError(f"the LayerNorm-prologue dual GEMM has a rendered body for {sorted(BODIES)} only, not {arch!r}")
+    if p.k <= 0 or p.k % K_STAGE != 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"the LayerNorm width K must be a positive multiple of {K_STAGE} (one TMA / MMA stage), got {p.k}")
+    if p.c_out <= 0 or p.c_out % CHANNEL_BLOCK != 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"c_out must be a positive multiple of {CHANNEL_BLOCK} (one value block + one gate block per 256-wide N tile), got {p.c_out}")
+    if p.passes < 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"passes must be >= 1, got {p.passes}")
+    if not (p.eps > 0.0):
+        raise ValueError(f"eps must be > 0, got {p.eps}")
+    if not (1 <= p.clc_stages <= 8):
+        raise ValueError(f"clc_stages must be in [1, 8], got {p.clc_stages}")
+    if p.diag not in DIAG_ARMS:
+        raise ValueError(f"diag must be one of {DIAG_ARMS}, got {p.diag!r}")
+    if p.pass_order not in PASS_ORDERS:
+        raise ValueError(f"pass_order must be one of {PASS_ORDERS}, got {p.pass_order!r}")
+    if p.pass_order == "interleaved" and (p.passes & (p.passes - 1)):
+        raise ValueError(f"pass_order='interleaved' folds the pass into the tile index with a shift and a mask: passes must be a power of two, got {p.passes}")
+    if p.pairing not in PAIRINGS:
+        raise ValueError(f"pairing must be one of {PAIRINGS}, got {p.pairing!r}")
+    if p.a0_major not in A0_MAJORS:
+        raise ValueError(f"a0_major must be one of {A0_MAJORS}, got {p.a0_major!r}")
+    if p.a0_prologue not in A0_PROLOGUES:
+        raise ValueError(f"a0_prologue must be one of {A0_PROLOGUES}, got {p.a0_prologue!r}")
+    if p.ln_pass_form not in LN_PASS_FORMS:
+        raise ValueError(f"ln_pass_form must be one of {LN_PASS_FORMS}, got {p.ln_pass_form!r}")
+    if p.epi_math not in EPI_MATHS:
+        raise ValueError(f"epi_math must be one of {EPI_MATHS}, got {p.epi_math!r}")
+    if isinstance(p.min_blocks_per_mp, bool) or p.min_blocks_per_mp not in MIN_BLOCKS_PER_MP_DOMAIN:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"min_blocks_per_mp must be 0 (no .minnctapersm directive: the rendering as shipped, the register split dropped by ptxas) or 1 (the hint "
+            f"under which ptxas honours the body's setmaxnreg split); 2 or more would cap the allocation at 65536 / (2 x 384) = 80 registers with the "
+            f"split impossible -- got {p.min_blocks_per_mp!r}"
+        )
+    if p.ln_once not in LN_ONCE_FORMS:
+        raise ValueError(f"ln_once must be one of {LN_ONCE_FORMS}, got {p.ln_once!r}")
+    if isinstance(p.ln_once_b_stages, bool) or not isinstance(p.ln_once_b_stages, int) or p.ln_once_b_stages < 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"ln_once_b_stages must be a non-negative integer (0 = the body's shipped B ring), got {p.ln_once_b_stages!r}")
+    if p.ln_once_b_stages and not p.ln_once:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"ln_once_b_stages={p.ln_once_b_stages} shallows the B ring under the LayerNorm-once item only (the item's resident A region is what the freed "
+            "bytes buy); with ln_once='' the ring is the shipped one -- leave the field 0"
+        )
+    if p.ln_once_b_stages and p.pairing in PAIRINGS and arch in BODIES and p.ln_once_b_stages > ring_stages(arch, p.pairing):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"ln_once_b_stages={p.ln_once_b_stages} is deeper than the {arch} body's shipped {ring_stages(arch, p.pairing)}-deep ring (pairing {p.pairing!r}): "
+            "the field can only shallow the ring"
+        )
+    if p.pairing in PAIRINGS and p.k > max_k(arch, p.pairing):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"the {arch} body keeps every K stage of a tile resident in its {ring_stages(arch, p.pairing)}-deep operand ring (pairing {p.pairing!r}): "
+            f"K must be <= {max_k(arch, p.pairing)}, got {p.k}"
+        )
+    if sm100_register_form_unallocatable(p, arch):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"the sm100 body cannot render K={p.k} with ln_pass_form='registers' and epi_math={p.epi_math!r}"
+            f"{' (want_stats=True)' if not p.dual else ''} for pairing {p.pairing!r}: ptxas fails to allocate the LayerNorm row held in registers plus the "
+            "packed epilogue at the flat 168-register entry count (C7600 'Register allocation failed with register count of 168' on sm_100a; the sm107 body "
+            "renders the same record with hundreds of spilled words).  Use a re-read LayerNorm form (ln_pass_form='smem_rolled' / 'smem_rolled_pf': the "
+            "measured picks at this width on both architectures) or the scalar epilogue"
+        )
+    if p.ln_once:
+        if ln_once_tiles_per_item(p) < 2:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"ln_once={p.ln_once!r} makes a work item of ONE GEMM tile here (passes {p.passes} x {ln_once_n_tiles_per_item(p)} N tile(s) at c_out {p.c_out}, "
+                f"pairing {p.pairing!r}): the LayerNorm already runs once per row block and the resident A region would be dead weight -- leave the lever off"
+            )
+        if p.pass_order != "major":
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"ln_once={p.ln_once!r} folds the pass into the work item's sub-tile loop; pass_order={p.pass_order!r} would fold it a second time into "
+                "the scheduler's M axis and every tile of pass 1 would read pass 0's rows -- use pass_order='major'"
+            )
+        if p.prefetch_a_l2:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"ln_once={p.ln_once!r} loads a row block's A operand(s) once per item; the per-tile L2 prefetch (prefetch_a_l2) has no tile to prefetch for"
+            )
+        if (p.passes & (p.passes - 1)) or (p.n_tiles & (p.n_tiles - 1)):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"ln_once={p.ln_once!r} decodes the item's sub-tile with a shift and a mask: passes ({p.passes}) and the N tiles per row block "
+                f"({p.n_tiles} = c_out / {CHANNEL_BLOCK}) must be powers of two"
+            )
+        if p.diag == "ln_first_tile_only":
+            raise ValueError(
+                "diag='ln_first_tile_only' bounds the LayerNorm-once lever from the per-tile body; under ln_once the LayerNorm already runs once per item -- nothing to relieve"
+            )
+    if p.dual:
+        if p.has_mask or p.skip_masked_tiles:
+            raise ValueError("pairing='accumulators' has no output mask: has_mask and skip_masked_tiles must be False")
+        if p.passes != 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"pairing='accumulators' has one output: passes must be 1, got {p.passes}")
+        if p.a0_major != "mn":
+            raise ValueError("pairing='accumulators' is written for an MN-major operand 0 (the channel-major y rows); a0_major must be 'mn'")
+        if p.ln_pass_form != "registers" and p.a0_prologue != "mn_major":
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"ln_pass_form={p.ln_pass_form!r} re-reads operand 0's MN-major stage in every LayerNorm pass; a0_prologue='transpose' overwrites the "
+                "channel rows other lanes still read (the register form reads everything before its LN_SYNC barrier) -- use a0_prologue='mn_major'"
+            )
+    else:
+        if p.a0_major != "k":
+            raise ValueError("pairing='columns' (the single K-major operand) takes a0_major='k'")
+        if p.affine_fold or p.fuse_residual:
+            raise ValueError("affine_fold / fuse_residual belong to the accumulators arm (pairing='accumulators')")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RowBlockGeometry:
+    """The pair-tile decomposition of ``(bn, n_res)`` rows -- every number the kernel's host call needs."""
+
+    n_res: int
+    bn: int
+    n_pad: int  #: output k extent (a multiple of 8)
+    kb: int  #: k's per 256-row pair tile (power of two)
+    lkb: int  #: log2(kb)
+    r_i: int  #: bi's per pair tile (= 256 // kb)
+    n_kb: int  #: k blocks per bi row
+    n_ib: int  #: bi blocks (ceil(bn / r_i))
+    kbc: int  #: k's per CTA box (min(kb, 128))
+    rc: int  #: bi's per CTA box (128 // kbc)
+
+    @property
+    def pair_tiles(self) -> int:
+        return self.n_ib * self.n_kb
+
+    @property
+    def m_sched(self) -> int:
+        """The flat M the template's scheduler walks: one 256-row pair tile per (bi block, k block)."""
+        return self.pair_tiles * PAIR_TILE_ROWS
+
+    @property
+    def rows_computed(self) -> int:
+        return self.m_sched
+
+    @property
+    def rows_valid(self) -> int:
+        return self.bn * self.n_res
+
+
+def default_k_block(n_res: int) -> int:
+    """The rule: ``kb = 256`` for ``n_res >= 256`` (one bi per pair tile), else the next power of two >= max(n_res, 8)."""
+    n_res = int(n_res)
+    if n_res >= PAIR_TILE_ROWS:
+        return PAIR_TILE_ROWS
+    kb = MIN_K_BLOCK
+    while kb < n_res:
+        kb *= 2
+    return kb
+
+
+def validate_k_block(k_block) -> int:
+    """A caller's ``k_block``: a power of two in ``[MIN_K_BLOCK, PAIR_TILE_ROWS]`` (ValueError names the domain -- a malformed declaration)."""
+    if isinstance(k_block, bool) or not isinstance(k_block, int):
+        raise ValueError(f"k_block must be an int power of two in [{MIN_K_BLOCK}, {PAIR_TILE_ROWS}], got {k_block!r}")
+    if k_block < MIN_K_BLOCK or k_block > PAIR_TILE_ROWS or k_block & (k_block - 1):
+        raise ValueError(f"k_block must be a power of two in [{MIN_K_BLOCK}, {PAIR_TILE_ROWS}] (k's per 256-row pair tile), got {k_block}")
+    return k_block
+
+
+def row_block_geometry(n_res: int, bn: int, k_block: Optional[int] = None) -> RowBlockGeometry:
+    """The pair-tile decomposition: ``kb`` = :func:`default_k_block` (``None``) or the caller's :func:`validate_k_block`-checked ``k_block``
+    (a performance knob -- the same bits under every admitted value; the accumulators arm additionally needs ``kb >= MIN_K_BLOCK_MN_MAJOR``)."""
+    n_res, bn = int(n_res), int(bn)
+    if n_res < 1 or bn < 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"n_res and bn must be >= 1, got n_res={n_res}, bn={bn}")
+    kb = default_k_block(n_res) if k_block is None else validate_k_block(k_block)
+    lkb = kb.bit_length() - 1
+    r_i = PAIR_TILE_ROWS // kb
+    n_kb = -(-n_res // kb)
+    n_ib = -(-bn // r_i)
+    kbc = min(kb, PAIR_TILE_ROWS // 2)
+    rc = (PAIR_TILE_ROWS // 2) // kbc
+    n_pad = -(-n_res // K_PAD_MULTIPLE) * K_PAD_MULTIPLE
+    return RowBlockGeometry(n_res=n_res, bn=bn, n_pad=n_pad, kb=kb, lkb=lkb, r_i=r_i, n_kb=n_kb, n_ib=n_ib, kbc=kbc, rc=rc)
+
+
+def interleave_value_gate(w_value, w_gate):
+    """Interleave 128-channel value and gate weight blocks."""
+    import torch
+
+    if w_value.shape != w_gate.shape or w_value.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError(f"value / gate weights must both be [c_out, K], got {tuple(w_value.shape)} and {tuple(w_gate.shape)}")
+    c_out, k = w_value.shape
+    if c_out % CHANNEL_BLOCK != 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"c_out must be a multiple of {CHANNEL_BLOCK}, got {c_out}")
+    v = w_value.reshape(c_out // CHANNEL_BLOCK, CHANNEL_BLOCK, k)
+    g = w_gate.reshape(c_out // CHANNEL_BLOCK, CHANNEL_BLOCK, k)
+    return torch.cat([v, g], dim=1).reshape(2 * c_out, k)
+
+
+def interleave_value_gate_bias(b_value, b_gate):
+    """The ``[c_out]`` value and gate biases in the interleaved ``[2 * c_out]`` order of :func:`interleave_value_gate`."""
+    return interleave_value_gate(b_value.reshape(-1, 1), b_gate.reshape(-1, 1)).reshape(-1)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class LnDualGemmPlan:
+    """One compiled artifact.  Plan-time only; :func:`run_ln_dual_gemm` launches."""
+
+    params: LnDualGemmParams
+    module: Any
+    launch: Any  # the cute-compiled ``_host``
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=None)
+def build_ln_dual_gemm(params: LnDualGemmParams, arch: str = "sm107") -> LnDualGemmPlan:
+    """Load the ``arch`` body (:data:`BODIES`; :func:`body_arch_for_cc` names it from the device) specialized for ``params`` and cute-compile it."""
+    from cudnn.frost.buffers import cutedsl_arch_requirement_error, cutedsl_requirement_error
+    from cudnn.frost.template_loader import load_template
+
+    if arch not in BODIES:
+        raise ValueError(f"the LayerNorm-prologue dual GEMM has a rendered body for {sorted(BODIES)} only, not {arch!r}")
+    msg = (
+        cutedsl_requirement_error("the LayerNorm-prologue dual GEMM")
+        or cutedsl_arch_requirement_error(ARCH_GATE_CC[arch])
+        or tcgen05_smem_desc_requirement_error(arch)
+    )
+    if msg:
+        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
+    validate_ln_dual_gemm_params(params, arch)
+    mod = load_template(body_path(arch), params, tag="ln_prologue_dual_gemm")
+    return LnDualGemmPlan(params=params, module=mod, launch=mod.compile())
+
+
+def _check(cond: bool, msg: str) -> None:
+    if not cond:
+        raise ValueError(msg)
+
+
+def run_ln_dual_gemm(
+    plan: LnDualGemmPlan,
+    z,  # [bn * n_res, K] bf16 contiguous (pair-major rows)
+    w,  # [passes, 2 * c_out, K] bf16 contiguous, rows interleaved per pass (interleave_value_gate)
+    out,  # [passes, c_out, bn, n_pad] bf16 contiguous (channel-major planes; k padded to n_pad)
+    ln_weight,  # [K] bf16
+    ln_bias,  # [K] bf16
+    *,
+    n_res: int,
+    bn: int,
+    bias=None,  # [passes, 2 * c_out] bf16 interleaved, required iff params.has_bias
+    mask=None,  # [bn * n_res] bf16 per-row mask, required iff params.has_mask
+    stats=None,  # [bn * n_res, 2] fp32 (mean, rstd), required iff params.want_stats
+    stream,
+    k_block: Optional[int] = None,  # k's per 256-row pair tile (row_block_geometry's rule when None; performance only, bitwise the same)
+) -> RowBlockGeometry:
+    """Launch.  No allocation, no conversion; every check is cheap host arithmetic.  Returns the geometry used."""
+    import torch
+    from cuda.bindings import driver as cuda
+
+    p = plan.params
+    _check(not p.dual, "this artifact was compiled with pairing='accumulators'; launch it through run_ln_dual_gemm_tail")
+    g = row_block_geometry(n_res, bn, k_block)
+    rows = g.rows_valid
+    bf16 = torch.bfloat16
+    _check(
+        z.dtype == bf16 and z.is_contiguous() and tuple(z.shape) == (rows, p.k),
+        f"z must be a contiguous bf16 [{rows}, {p.k}] tensor, got {tuple(z.shape)} {z.dtype}",
+    )
+    _check(
+        w.dtype == bf16 and w.is_contiguous() and tuple(w.shape) == (p.passes, p.n_out, p.k),
+        f"w must be a contiguous bf16 [{p.passes}, {p.n_out}, {p.k}] tensor (rows interleaved per 128-channel block), got {tuple(w.shape)} {w.dtype}",
+    )
+    _check(
+        out.dtype == bf16 and out.is_contiguous() and tuple(out.shape) == (p.passes, p.c_out, bn, g.n_pad),
+        f"out must be a contiguous bf16 [{p.passes}, {p.c_out}, {bn}, {g.n_pad}] tensor (channel-major, k padded to {g.n_pad}), got {tuple(out.shape)} {out.dtype}",
+    )
+    for name, t_ in (("ln_weight", ln_weight), ("ln_bias", ln_bias)):
+        _check(
+            t_.dtype == bf16 and t_.is_contiguous() and tuple(t_.shape) == (p.k,),
+            f"{name} must be a contiguous bf16 [{p.k}] tensor, got {tuple(t_.shape)} {t_.dtype}",
+        )
+    if p.has_bias:
+        _check(bias is not None, "this artifact was compiled with has_bias=True; bias must be bound (no silent fallback)")
+        _check(
+            bias.dtype == bf16 and bias.is_contiguous() and tuple(bias.shape) == (p.passes, p.n_out),
+            f"bias must be a contiguous bf16 [{p.passes}, {p.n_out}] tensor (interleaved like the weight rows), got {tuple(bias.shape)} {bias.dtype}",
+        )
+    else:
+        _check(bias is None, "this artifact was compiled with has_bias=False; bias must be None")
+    if p.has_mask:
+        _check(mask is not None, "this artifact was compiled with has_mask=True; mask must be bound")
+        _check(
+            mask.dtype == bf16 and mask.is_contiguous() and tuple(mask.shape) == (rows,),
+            f"mask must be a contiguous bf16 [{rows}] tensor, got {tuple(mask.shape)} {mask.dtype}",
+        )
+    else:
+        _check(mask is None, "this artifact was compiled with has_mask=False; mask must be None")
+    if p.want_stats:
+        _check(stats is not None, "this artifact was compiled with want_stats=True; stats must be bound")
+        _check(
+            stats.dtype == torch.float32 and stats.is_contiguous() and tuple(stats.shape) == (rows, 2),
+            f"stats must be a contiguous fp32 [{rows}, 2] tensor, got {tuple(stats.shape)} {stats.dtype}",
+        )
+    else:
+        _check(stats is None, "this artifact was compiled with want_stats=False; stats must be None")
+    for name, t_ in (("z", z), ("w", w), ("out", out)):
+        _check(t_.data_ptr() % 16 == 0, f"{name} must be 16-byte aligned (a TMA operand)")
+    for name, t_ in (("ln_weight", ln_weight), ("ln_bias", ln_bias), ("bias", bias)):
+        _check(t_ is None or t_.data_ptr() % 16 == 0, f"{name} must be 16-byte aligned (read with 16-byte vector loads)")
+    _check(mask is None or mask.data_ptr() % 4 == 0, "mask must be 4-byte aligned (read as aligned 32-bit words)")
+    _check(stats is None or stats.data_ptr() % 8 == 0, "stats must be 8-byte aligned (written as 8-byte (mean, rstd) pairs)")
+    geom = (g.m_sched, p.n_out, p.k, p.passes, g.n_res, g.bn, g.n_pad, g.lkb, g.n_kb, g.kbc, g.rc)
+    plan.launch(
+        geom,
+        z.view(-1),
+        None,
+        w.view(-1),
+        None,
+        out.view(-1),
+        ln_weight,
+        ln_bias,
+        None,
+        None,
+        bias.view(-1) if bias is not None else None,
+        mask if mask is not None else None,
+        stats.view(-1) if stats is not None else None,
+        None,
+        cuda.CUstream(int(stream)),
+    )
+    return g
+

+def fold_output_affine(w_value, b_value, ln_weight, ln_bias):
+    """Fold LayerNorm affine parameters into projection weights and bias."""
+    import torch
+
+    w64 = w_value.double()
+    g64 = ln_weight.double()

+def _sf_kblk_words(words):

+    if _SF_DUP == 1:

+_FP4_IN_BYTE = 0x3C3C3C3C  # bits [5:2] of every byte: where kind::mxf8f6f4 reads e2m1

+def _fp4_frag_regs(words, sel):
+    """Unpack an E2M1 operand fragment into MMA registers."""
+    # Bytes (2t, 2t+1, 8+2t, 9+2t) of the chunk: the nibbles of K 4t..4t+3 and 16+4t..16+4t+3.
+    z = nvvm.prmt(words.load(), sel, nvvm.PermuteMode.DEFAULT, hi=(words + 2).load())
+    even = (z << 2) & _FP4_IN_BYTE  # low nibbles (K 4t, 4t+2, 16+4t, 18+4t) to bits [5:2]
+    odd = (z >> 2) & _FP4_IN_BYTE  # high nibbles (K 4t+1, 4t+3, 17+4t, 19+4t) to bits [5:2]
+    return (
+        nvvm.prmt(even, 0x5140, nvvm.PermuteMode.DEFAULT, hi=odd),
+        nvvm.prmt(even, 0x7362, nvvm.PermuteMode.DEFAULT, hi=odd),
+    )

+def _ldm_frags(ptr, num, padded):
+    """Load byte-operand fragments with ldmatrix."""
+    if padded:
+        regs = nvvm.ldmatrix(ptr, num, nvvm.MMALayout.ROW, shape=nvvm.LoadShape.M8N16, src_format=nvvm.LoadSrcFormat.B4X16_P64)
+        return tuple(regs[i] << 2 for i in range(num))
+    regs = nvvm.ldmatrix(ptr, num, nvvm.MMALayout.ROW)
+    return tuple(regs[i] for i in range(num))

+    if cutlass.const_expr(tile_swizzle_n > 0):

+    """N-super-block width for one routed group, resolved per group."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(tile_swizzle_n > 0):
+        return tile_swizzle_n
+    budget = cutlass.Int64(swizzle_l2_budget_bytes)
+    row_bytes = (cutlass.Int64(ab_dtype.width) * k) // 8
+    cap = cutlass.max(budget // (row_bytes * cgrp_tile_mnk[1]), cutlass.Int64(1))

+@cute.jit
+def l2_swizzle_tile(raw_m, raw_n, nt_m, nt_n, swizzle_w, identity=False):
+    """N-direction super-block rasterization of the (m, n) cgrp-tile coord, for L2 reuse."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(identity):
+        return raw_m, raw_n
+    log_m, log_n = raw_m, raw_n
+    if swizzle_w != 1:
+        t = raw_n * nt_m + raw_m
+        blk = nt_m * swizzle_w
+        sb = t // blk
+        off = t - sb * blk
+        base_n = sb * swizzle_w
+        cur_S = cutlass.min(cutlass.Int32(swizzle_w), nt_n - base_n)
+        log_m = off // cur_S
+        log_n = base_n + off - log_m * cur_S
+    return log_m, log_n

+def epi_subtile_spans(cols, epi_n=32):
+    """Power-of-two column spans the epilogue drains a tile in (host-side)."""
+    spans = []
+    off = 0
+    while off < cols:
+        w = epi_n
+        while w > cols - off:
+            w //= 2
+        spans.append((off, w))
+        off += w
+    return spans

+@cute.jit
+def cluster_split_k_reduce(
+    partial, mailbox, ready, free, iteration, k_rank, root_rank, plane_ctas: cutlass.Constexpr, slices: cutlass.Constexpr, epilogue_threads: cutlass.Constexpr
+):
+    """Bulk-copy one fragment per peer to reusable slots on its K-rank-zero CTA."""
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    warp = cute.arch.warp_idx()
+    elected = nvvm.elect_sync()
+    values = partial.to_elements()
+    chunk_elems = epilogue_threads * len(values)
+    phase = iteration & 1
+    result = partial
+    if k_rank != 0:
+        staging = mailbox.subview((slices - 1) * chunk_elems)
+        for q in cutlass.range_constexpr(len(values) // 4):
+            staging.data_ptr(tid * len(values) + q * 4).store(partial[q * 4 : q * 4 + 4], alignment=16)
+        cute.arch.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+        nvvm.barrier_cta_sync(barrier_id=CLUSTER_K_REDUCE_BARRIER_ID, thread_count=epilogue_threads)
+        if warp == 0:
+            remote_ready = nvvm.mapa(ready, root_rank)
+            if elected:
+                nvvm.mbarrier_arrive_expect_tx(remote_ready, chunk_elems * 4, scope=nvvm.MemScope.CLUSTER)
+            if elected:
+                nvvm.cp_async_bulk_shared_cluster_shared_cta(
+                    nvvm.mapa(mailbox.subview((k_rank - 1) * chunk_elems), root_rank), staging, remote_ready, chunk_elems * 4
+                )
+        while not nvvm.mbarrier_try_wait_parity(free, phase, time_limit=10_000_000, scope=nvvm.MBarrierScope.CLUSTER):
+            pass
+    else:
+        while not nvvm.mbarrier_try_wait_parity(ready, phase, time_limit=10_000_000, scope=nvvm.MBarrierScope.CLUSTER):
+            pass
+        summed = list(values)
+        for peer in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, slices):
+            for q in cutlass.range_constexpr(len(values) // 4):
+                incoming = mailbox.load((peer - 1) * chunk_elems + tid * len(values) + q * 4, vector_size=4, alignment=16)
+                for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    summed[q * 4 + e] = summed[q * 4 + e] + incoming[e]
+        result = _cvec.Vector.from_elements(tuple(summed), cutlass.Float32)
+        nvvm.barrier_cta_sync(barrier_id=CLUSTER_K_REDUCE_BARRIER_ID, thread_count=epilogue_threads)
+        if warp == 0:
+            for peer in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, slices):
+                if elected:
+                    nvvm.mbarrier_arrive(nvvm.mapa(free, root_rank + peer * plane_ctas), scope=nvvm.MemScope.CLUSTER)
+    return result

+def extract_block_scale_sfb(stage, n_start, tile_n: cutlass.Constexpr, k_atoms: cutlass.Constexpr, stage_bytes: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    """Extract a tcgen05 N sub-tile in place from one or two F8_128x4 blocks."""
+    words = cutlass.Array(base=stage.data_ptr(), shape=stage_bytes // 4, dtype=cutlass.Uint32)
+    lane = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+    for atom in cutlass.range_constexpr(k_atoms):
+        values = []
+        for col in cutlass.range_constexpr((tile_n + 31) // 32):
+            row = n_start + cutlass.min(lane + col * 32, tile_n - 1)
+            src = (row // 128) * (128 * k_atoms) + atom * 128 + (row % 32) * 4 + (row % 128) // 32
+            values.append(words.data_ptr(src).load())
+        nvvm.bar_warp_sync(0xFFFFFFFF)
+        for col in cutlass.range_constexpr((tile_n + 31) // 32):
+            words.data_ptr(atom * 128 + lane * 4 + col).store(values[col])
+    cute.arch.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+    nvvm.bar_warp_sync(0xFFFFFFFF)

+def moe_swizzle_tile(t, nt_m, nt_n, swizzle_w):
+    """Group-local linear tile index -> (m, n) under an N-super-block walk."""
+    blk = cutlass.max(nt_m * swizzle_w, cutlass.Int32(1))
+    sb = t // blk
+    off = t - sb * blk
+    base_n = sb * swizzle_w
+    cur_S = cutlass.min(cutlass.Int32(swizzle_w), nt_n - base_n)
+    tile_m = off // cur_S
+    tile_n = base_n + off - tile_m * cur_S
+    return tile_m, tile_n

+        llvm.inline_asm(

+def moe_combine_add_vector(ptr, values, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr, count: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    """At most 16 bytes of adjacent output elements, with scalar alignment ABI."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(count == 1):
+        moe_combine_add(ptr, values[0], dtype)
+    else:
+        if ptr.toint() % (count * dtype.width // 8) == 0:
+            if cutlass.const_expr(dtype == cutlass.Float32):
+                words = values
+                nwords = count
+                instruction = f"red.global.add.v{count}.f32"
+                constraint = "f"
+            else:
+                words = values.to(dtype).bitcast(cutlass.Uint32)
+                nwords = count // 2
+                scalar_type = "bf16x2" if cutlass.const_expr(dtype == cutlass.BFloat16) else "f16x2"
+                vector_type = "" if cutlass.const_expr(count == 2) else f"v{count // 2}."
+                instruction = f"red.global.add.noftz.{vector_type}{scalar_type}"
+                constraint = "r"
+            operands = ", ".join(f"${i + 1}" for i in range(nwords))
+            operands = operands if cutlass.const_expr(nwords == 1) else "{" + operands + "}"
+            llvm.inline_asm(
+                None,
+                [ptr.toint().ir_value()] + [words[i].ir_value() for i in range(nwords)],
+                instruction + " [$0], " + operands + ";",
+                "l," + ",".join([constraint] * nwords) + ",~{memory}",
+                has_side_effects=True,
+            )
+        else:
+            moe_combine_add_vector(ptr, values[: count // 2], dtype, count // 2)

+    one) and ``X[j + 1] = gamma[j] X[j] + H[j]``, every slot's incoming state.  ``reverse`` (the backward chain):

+class CompiledScalarStateChain(NamedTuple):
+    """Build-time facts of one scalar-transition chain launch, produced by :func:`build_scalar_state_chain`."""

+    compiled: object
+    heads_out: int
+    dim_v: int
+    dim_k: int
+    rows_per_cta: int
+    has_seed: bool

+def build_scalar_state_chain(
+    *, heads_out, dim_v, dim_k, rows_per_cta, has_seed, reverse=False, seed_dtype="float32", device, opt_level, has_seed_indices=False

+    """Compile (cached per state geometry, flags, seed dtype, device and ``opt_level``) the scalar-transition chain;
+    ``heads_out`` and ``num_seqs`` are launch arguments and every tensor's layout is dynamic."""

+    rows = int(rows_per_cta)

+            from_dlpack(DeviceView(256, (1, HO, V, K), "float32", int(device)), assumed_align=16).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=3),
+            from_dlpack(DeviceView(256, (1, HO, V, K), seed_name, int(device)), assumed_align=4).mark_layout_dynamic(leading_dim=3) if has_seed else None,
+            from_dlpack(DeviceView(256, (1,), "int32", int(device)), assumed_align=4).mark_layout_dynamic(),
+            from_dlpack(DeviceView(256, (1,), "int32", int(device)), assumed_align=4).mark_layout_dynamic() if has_seed_indices else None,

+def run_scalar_state_chain(compiled: CompiledScalarStateChain, num_seqs, H, transition, X, seed, main_rows, stream, seed_indices=None) -> None:
+    """Chain ``num_seqs`` sequences over the piece table's filled slots: ``H`` / ``X`` fp32 ``[slots, HO, V, K]``,

+    when not built), ``main_rows`` int32 ``[num_seqs + 1]``, ``seed_indices`` int32 ``[num_seqs]`` when built with them."""

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.

+
+"""Copy the states an aliased launch reads into scratch, so its exact twin can redo it.
+
+A ``STEEP_FAST`` launch writes its final state before its ``STEEP_EXACT`` twin runs (common/steep_decay.py).  When that
+output aliases the state the launch reads (``overwrite_initial_state``, a ``state_indices`` pool, or the backward's
+``d_initial_state`` over ``d_final_state``), the plan first copies the read state into a dense workspace snapshot and
+both launches read the copy.  ``indices`` gathers pool rows in sequence order; sequences that name the same pool row all
+read its value from before the call.  The source may have any strides with a unit innermost stride and 16-byte aligned
+``[.., v, :]`` rows, the layout the kernels' own state loads require."""
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.barrier import wait_on_dependent_grids
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.tma import ld_global_v4, st_global_v4
+
+USE_PDL = True
+
+BLOCK = 256
+
+
+@cute.kernel
+def frost_state_snapshot(mSrc: cute.Tensor, mDst: cute.Tensor, mIdx: Optional[cute.Tensor], line_chunks: cutlass.Int64) -> None:
+    if cutlass.const_expr(USE_PDL):
+        wait_on_dependent_grids()
+    tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    bidx = cute.arch.block_idx()[0]
+    chunk = cutlass.Int64(cutlass.Int32(bidx)) * cutlass.Int64(BLOCK) + cutlass.Int64(cutlass.Int32(tidx))
+    lines = cutlass.Int64(mDst.shape[0]) * cutlass.Int64(mDst.shape[1]) * cutlass.Int64(mDst.shape[2])
+    if chunk < lines * line_chunks:
+        line = chunk // line_chunks
+        word = chunk - line * line_chunks
+        rows_per_seq = cutlass.Int64(mDst.shape[1]) * cutlass.Int64(mDst.shape[2])
+        seq = line // rows_per_seq
+        rem = line - seq * rows_per_seq
+        head_wide = rem // cutlass.Int64(mDst.shape[2])
+        head = head_wide.to(cutlass.Int32)
+        v_row = (rem - head_wide * cutlass.Int64(mDst.shape[2])).to(cutlass.Int32)
+        slot = seq.to(cutlass.Int32)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(mIdx is not None):
+            slot = cutlass.Int32(mIdx[slot])
+        elem_bytes = cutlass.const_expr(mSrc.element_type.width // 8)
+        offset = cutlass.Int64(mSrc.layout((slot, head, v_row, 0)))
+        src = mSrc.iterator.toint() + offset * cutlass.Int64(elem_bytes) + word * cutlass.Int64(16)
+        dst = mDst.iterator.toint() + chunk * cutlass.Int64(16)
+        w0, w1, w2, w3 = ld_global_v4(src, cutlass.Int32)
+        st_global_v4(dst, (w0, w1, w2, w3), cutlass.Int32)
+
+
+frost_state_snapshot.set_name_prefix("cudnn", remove_cutlass_symbol=True)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def snapshot_states(mSrc: cute.Tensor, mDst: cute.Tensor, mIdx: Optional[cute.Tensor], stream: cuda.CUstream) -> None:
+    """``mDst[i] = mSrc[mIdx[i] if mIdx else i]`` for every row of the dense ``mDst``; issued from another kernel's host."""
+    elem_bytes = cutlass.const_expr(mSrc.element_type.width // 8)
+    line_chunks = cutlass.Int64(mDst.shape[3]) * cutlass.Int64(elem_bytes) // cutlass.Int64(16)
+    total = cutlass.Int64(mDst.shape[0]) * cutlass.Int64(mDst.shape[1]) * cutlass.Int64(mDst.shape[2]) * line_chunks
+    grid_x = ((total + cutlass.Int64(BLOCK - 1)) // cutlass.Int64(BLOCK)).to(cutlass.Int32)
+    frost_state_snapshot(mSrc, mDst, mIdx, line_chunks).launch(grid=(grid_x, 1, 1), block=(BLOCK, 1, 1), stream=stream, use_pdl=USE_PDL)

+"""Exact intra-tile decay for steep key channels in the GDN-2 and KDA BT = 16 kernels.
+
+The chunk kernels split the intra-tile decay of key channel d between tokens t >= s,
+``2^(g[t, d] - g[s, d])`` with ``g`` the inclusive log2 gate prefix inside the 16-token
+tile, across the two operands of one register MMA: K decay / Q decay carry
+``exp2(+g[t, d])`` and K inv carries ``rcp(exp2(g[s, d]))``.  Once a prefix falls below
+-126, ``exp2(+g)`` leaves the fp32 normal range, the approximate reciprocal returns inf,
+and ``0 * inf`` turns KK, A and the state update NaN for the rest of the sequence.
+
+A channel needs exact decay when its prefix falls below the dtype threshold (``-120`` for bf16, ``-14`` for fp16),
+or its raw key magnitude makes the inverse operand unsafe. Normalized keys have magnitude at most one;
+``channel_needs_exact_decay`` also bounds unnormalized keys before selecting the path.
+
+Dispatch.  The steep path costs registers and code even where it never runs, so a ``STEEP_FAST`` kernel's ``host``
+launches it twice (``cfg.steep_mode``):
+
+- ``STEEP_FAST``: the original arithmetic plus a range check and one ballot per scan warp; a warp that finds a steep channel stores 1 into
+  the second int32 of the kernel's scheduler slot, which the prologue zeroes every call.  A steep tile's outputs are
+  garbage at this point.
+- ``STEEP_EXACT``: launched right after, from the same host, with the steep path compiled in.  Every thread exits on
+  entry while the flag is 0, so a call without a steep tile pays one empty launch; otherwise the kernel redoes the whole
+  launch exactly (pulling tiles off the flag int, past its 1), overwriting every output before the next kernel reads it.
+  No host synchronisation is involved, so the pair is safe under CUDA graphs and ``torch.compile``.
+- ``STEEP_OFF``: chosen by ``steep_mode_for`` when no tile can be steep.  Under the safe gate with normalized keys a tile's
+  log2 prefix stays above ``BT * gate_scale_log2``; when that floor is above the dtype's steep threshold the kernel runs
+  once, without the vote or the scratch, and no exact twin is compiled.
+A launch whose output aliases a state it reads (``overwrite_initial_state``, a ``state_indices`` pool, the backward's
+``d_initial_state`` over ``d_final_state``) reads that state from a workspace snapshot (common/state_snapshot.py), so
+the exact launch never reads the fast launch's garbage.
+
+The steep path (``STEEP_EXACT``):
+
+- the gate scan retains individual token decay factors ``exp2(g)`` (at most 1) for steep channels on exchange rows
+  ``0 .. BT - 2``; the final token's factor goes to a per-channel array. The last exchange row retains ``exp2(prefix)``
+  for state decay. Ballot bits select this representation, including zero gates and padding;
+- exact decay multiplies only the intervening token factors: one FMUL per step, no ``exp2``. Subtracting inclusive fp32
+  prefixes would lose small gates after a large negative spike; a product of factors at most 1 can only underflow.
+  Interval walks run all ``BT`` tokens, multiplying by 1 / adding 0 outside the interval, so loads issue ahead of the chain;
+- the row stage selects valid scales before constructing operands (``row_operand_scales``): K decay / Q decay use
+  ``exp2(g[t])``, which may underflow to zero harmlessly; K inv and K restore use
+  ``k[t] * exp2(g[BT - 1] - g[t])``, whose exponent is never positive;
+- ``steep_row_corrections`` adds the steep channels' exact KK and A entries, every
+  exponent ``g[t] - g[s] <= 0``, minus the products the register MMAs formed with
+  their K inv column; the register-MMA warps add the corrections to their
+  accumulators;
+- the backward picks bounded per-channel scales before it assembles gradients (``gradient_operand_scales``), so it
+  never reads token factors as prefix exponentials and repairs those lanes afterwards; ``steep_grad_corrections`` adds the
+  exact intra-tile terms. Where one lane owns a channel at every token (``d_k = 128``), ``steep_grad_corrections_warp``
+  and ``steep_dk_restore_warp`` hand a steep channel's tokens to one lane each instead of walking them in series;
+- per-element steep work runs in zero- or one-trip loops, and row corrections visit only set ballot bits: ptxas
+  predicates a branch-free ``if`` body, which then issues on every mild lane;
+- ``common/gdn2_state_grad.py`` retains the steep channels' original state gradients in FP32 scratch. Their tensor-core
+  operand is zero; bounded FP32 projections supply dU, restored dK and dGate. Decay is applied before the gate dot
+  product. This avoids overflowing a finite FP32 seed or carry when it is packed into FP16.
+
+Synchronisation invariants of the steep path:
+
+- per-group scan ballots alternate between two slots where a mild tile skips the exact path's final group barrier, so
+  its next iteration can publish before every warp has read the previous ballots; the next scan's publication barrier
+  keeps a group from running two iterations ahead. Last-token and norm scratch stay behind that final barrier. The
+  ``alternating`` gate pattern covers mild/steep transitions in every scan group;
+- correction rows come from single-lane stores, and the async-proxy fence orders only the issuing thread's accesses:
+  every lane fences, the warp joins (``bar.warp.sync``), then one elected lane arrives on the K/Q-ready barriers, so
+  both modes keep warp-sized counts. Readers join before an elected lane releases a correction stage;
+- on a mild tile the exact backward keeps the fast schedule: compute group 2 releases the FP32 dstate, U and raw stages
+  where the fast kernel does, and compute group 1 skips the waits that only feed the steep dU term (the tile's steep
+  words are visible since its decay-scale wait);
+- the exact backward's dA and dM writers both arrive on the existing diagonal-ready barrier after waiting for its slot,
+  counted directly. ``STEEP_FAST`` keeps the single-producer count because it does not consume the dM copy;
+- the public summary ops have no overwrite attribute, so their state outputs never alias and their wrappers launch
+  ``STEEP_FAST``.
+"""
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import cutlass.experimental.primitives as nvvm
+
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.pointwise import sigmoid
+from cudnn.frost.tile_dsl.swizzle import swizzle_xor_128b
+
+STEEP_LOG2_PREFIX: float = -120.0
+"""bf16 operands: a key channel whose inclusive log2 gate prefix inside a tile falls below this is steep for the tile.
+``exp2`` of the prefix reaches the fp32 (and bf16) normal floor, ``2^-126``, six binades further down."""
+
+STEEP_LOG2_PREFIX_FP16: float = -14.0
+"""fp16 operands: K inv = k * 2^-g reaches the fp16 maximum, ``65504 ~ 2^16``, two binades further down."""
+
+
+STEEP_OFF: int = -1
+"""Kernel ``cfg.steep_mode``: no tile of this configuration can be steep; the original arithmetic alone, one launch."""
+
+STEEP_FAST: int = 0
+"""Kernel ``cfg.steep_mode``: the original arithmetic plus the steep vote; a steep tile raises the call's steep flag.
+``host`` follows the launch with a ``STEEP_EXACT`` launch of the same kernel."""
+
+STEEP_EXACT: int = 1
+"""The exact kernel of a ``STEEP_FAST`` launch: every thread exits on entry unless the flag is raised, else it redoes
+the whole launch with the steep path, pulling tiles from its own ticket."""
+
+STEEP_COOP_MAX: int = 16
+"""The most steep channels a warp's exact backward hands out one token per lane (``steep_grad_corrections_warp``,
+``steep_dk_restore_warp``). Past this every lane walks its own tokens: with most lanes steep, the gathers and per-pass
+state reloads cost more than the parallelism saves."""
+
+STEEP_FLAG_SLOT: int = 1
+"""The steep flag and the exact launch's ticket share the second int32 of the kernel's scheduler slot, which the
+prologue zeroes with the first: 0 means no steep tile, and the exact launch's tickets start at the 1 the fast launch
+stored."""
+
+
+def steep_mode_for(io_dtype, l2norm: bool, safe_gate: bool, gate_scale_log2: float, b_t: int) -> int:
+    """The steep mode of a configuration: ``STEEP_OFF`` when no BT-token tile can hold a steep key channel, else ``STEEP_FAST``.
+
+    Under the safe gate every token's log2 gate lies in ``(gate_scale_log2, 0)``, so a tile's prefix never falls below
+    ``b_t * gate_scale_log2``, and normalized keys leave the prefix as the only bound on the inverse operand."""
+    if not (safe_gate and l2norm):
+        return STEEP_FAST
+    threshold = STEEP_LOG2_PREFIX_FP16 if io_dtype == cutlass.Float16 else STEEP_LOG2_PREFIX
+    return STEEP_FAST if b_t * abs(float(gate_scale_log2)) >= -threshold else STEEP_OFF
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def steep_exit_unless_flagged(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, flag_slot):
+    """``STEEP_EXACT`` kernel entry, after the grid-dependency wait: leave unless the fast launch raised the flag.
+
+    Do not trigger dependents here. An early trigger lets the next persistent kernel's CTAs be dispatched while this
+    grid's CTAs are still being placed, and that kernel then ran about 12% slower (B300, mild gates). Its dependents
+    launch when this grid completes, which they wait for anyway."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.steep_mode == STEEP_EXACT):
+        if flag_slot[STEEP_FLAG_SLOT] == cutlass.Int32(0):
+            nvvm.exit()
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def steep_raise_flag(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, flag_slot, steep_word, lane_idx):
+    """``STEEP_FAST`` scan: a warp whose ballot found a steep channel raises the flag (idempotent, never read back)."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.steep_mode == STEEP_FAST):
+        if steep_word != 0:
+            if lane_idx == 0:
+                flag_slot[STEEP_FLAG_SLOT] = cutlass.Int32(1)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def steep_ticket(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, mScheduler):
+    """The next ticket off the scheduler slot: the first int32, or under ``STEEP_EXACT`` the flag slot past its 1."""
+    fetched = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.steep_mode == STEEP_EXACT):
+        fetched = cutlass.Int32(nvvm.atomicrmw("add", mScheduler.iterator + STEEP_FLAG_SLOT, cutlass.Int32(1), mem_order="relaxed", syncscope="gpu")) - 1
+    else:
+        fetched = cutlass.Int32(nvvm.atomicrmw("add", mScheduler.iterator, cutlass.Int32(1), mem_order="relaxed", syncscope="gpu"))
+    return fetched
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def exchange_offset(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, row, channel):
+    """Element offset of ``(row, channel)`` in one ``[BT, DK]`` fp32 gate-exchange stage."""
+    seg = channel // 32
+    return seg * (cfg.b_t * 32) + row * 32 + swizzle_xor_128b(row ^ seg, channel - seg * 32, elem_bytes=4)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def raw_offset(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, row, channel):
+    """Element offset of ``(row, channel)`` in one ``[BT, DK]`` 16-bit row-major operand tile."""
+    seg = channel // 64
+    return seg * (cfg.b_t * 64) + row * 64 + swizzle_xor_128b(row, channel - seg * 64, elem_bytes=2)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def channel_needs_exact_decay(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, prefix, raw_k_ptr, channel):
+    """Bound the inverse operand over a channel before selecting its decay path.
+
+    Normalized keys have magnitude at most one. Otherwise scan the raw tile
+    and reserve one binade below the operand maximum for reciprocal rounding.
+    The last prefix is the minimum, so this bounds every row's inverse.
+    """
+    threshold = cutlass.Float32(STEEP_LOG2_PREFIX_FP16 if cfg.io_dtype == cutlass.Float16 else STEEP_LOG2_PREFIX)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(not cfg.l2norm):
+        max_key = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+        for row in cutlass.range(cfg.b_t, unroll=1):
+            key = (raw_k_ptr + raw_offset(cfg, row, channel)).load().to(cutlass.Float32)
+            max_key = cute.math.max(max_key, cute.math.abs(key))
+        limit = cutlass.Float32(15.0 if cfg.io_dtype == cutlass.Float16 else 127.0)
+        threshold = cute.math.max(threshold, cute.math.log2(max_key) - limit)
+    return prefix < threshold
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def classify_steep_channel(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, prefix, raw_k_ptr, channel, channel_rows: cutlass.Constexpr, flag_slot, lane_idx):
+    """Classify a scan lane, mask duplicate lanes, and flag a FAST relaunch.
+
+    Callers retain ownership of stage offsets, scratch stores and barriers.
+    """
+    channel_steep = cutlass.Boolean(False)
+    word = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.steep_mode != STEEP_OFF):
+        channel_steep = channel_needs_exact_decay(cfg, prefix, raw_k_ptr, channel)
+        word = cutlass.Int32(nvvm.vote_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, channel_steep, nvvm.VoteSync.BALLOT))
+        if cutlass.const_expr(channel_rows < cfg.threads_per_warp):
+            word = word & cutlass.Int32((1 << channel_rows) - 1)
+        steep_raise_flag(cfg, flag_slot, word, lane_idx)
+    return channel_steep, word
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def encode_gate_exchange(
+    cfg: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    prefix,
+    raw_k_ptr,
+    channel,
+    channel_rows: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    flag_slot,
+    lane_idx,
+    scan_warp,
+    token_logs,
+    values,
+    words_ptr,
+    log_last_ptr,
+    channel_active=True,
+):
+    """Classify a channel and encode its exchange registers and scan metadata.
+
+    ``values`` always holds inclusive log2 prefixes on entry. Exact steep
+    channels retain token decay factors ``exp2(g)`` except in the last row,
+    which always holds the state-decay exponential. Callers own exchange stores,
+    stage selection and publication barriers; this helper never synchronizes.
+    """
+    channel_steep, word = classify_steep_channel(cfg, prefix, raw_k_ptr, channel, channel_rows, flag_slot, lane_idx)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.steep_mode == STEEP_EXACT):
+        if lane_idx == 0:
+            (words_ptr + scan_warp).store(word)
+        if word != 0:
+            if channel_steep:
+                if channel_active:
+                    (log_last_ptr + channel).store(cute.math.exp2(token_logs[cfg.b_t - 1], fastmath=True))
+    for row in cutlass.range_constexpr(cfg.b_t):
+        values[row] = cute.math.exp2(values[row], fastmath=True)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.steep_mode == STEEP_EXACT):
+        for _ in cutlass.range(cutlass.Int32(channel_steep), unroll=1):
+            for row in cutlass.range_constexpr(cfg.b_t - 1):
+                values[row] = cute.math.exp2(token_logs[row], fastmath=True)
+    return word
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def steep_tile_mask(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, words_ptr):
+    """Read the tile's four scan-warp ballots; FAST never reads exact-path scratch."""
+    mask = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.steep_mode == STEEP_EXACT):
+        mask = (words_ptr.load() | (words_ptr + 1).load()) | ((words_ptr + 2).load() | (words_ptr + 3).load())
+    return mask
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def lane_steep_bits(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, words_ptr, lane_in_row_group, channel_rows: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    """The steep channels a row-stage lane owns: bit ``h * 8 + j`` is channel ``h * 64 + lane_in_row_group * 8 + j``.
+
+    ``words_ptr`` holds one ballot word per scan warp; channel ``c`` is bit ``c % channel_rows`` of word
+    ``c // channel_rows``."""
+    bits = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    for dim_half in cutlass.range_constexpr(cfg.d_k // 64):
+        first = dim_half * 64 + lane_in_row_group * 8
+        word = (words_ptr + first // channel_rows).load()
+        bits = bits | (((word >> (first % channel_rows)) & 0xFF) << (dim_half * 8))
+    return bits
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def steep_channel_bit(words_ptr, channel, channel_rows: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    """1 if ``channel`` is steep in the ballot words at ``words_ptr`` (one word per scan warp of ``channel_rows`` channels), else 0."""
+    return ((words_ptr + channel // channel_rows).load() >> (channel % channel_rows)) & 1
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def steep_beta(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, beta_ptr, row, channel):
+    """The erase gate the operands used, from the chunk's raw beta tile (beta_eff under the guard, written back).
+
+    KDA passes ``None``: its scalar beta is applied outside the K decay operand and the strict dM tile, so 1."""
+    beta = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(beta_ptr is not None):
+        beta = (beta_ptr + raw_offset(cfg, row, channel)).load().to(cutlass.Float32)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.beta_sigmoid and not cfg.beta_guard):
+            beta = (sigmoid(beta) * (2.0 if cfg.allow_neg_eigval else 1.0)).to(cfg.io_dtype).to(cutlass.Float32)
+    return beta
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def steep_token_factor(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, row, channel):
+    """Read a steep channel's per-token decay factor ``exp2(g)``, 1 on padding."""
+    value = (log_last_ptr + channel).load()
+    if row < cfg.b_t - 1:
+        value = (exchange_ptr + exchange_offset(cfg, row, channel)).load()
+    return value
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def steep_interval_factor(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, start, end, channel):
+    """Multiply [start, end) directly: prefix subtraction loses mild gates after large spikes."""
+    total = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+    for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(cfg.b_t):
+        factor = steep_token_factor(cfg, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, token, channel)
+        if token < start:
+            factor = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+        if token >= end:
+            factor = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+        total = total * factor
+    return total
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def steep_decay_scale(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, row, channel):
+    """A steep channel's K decay / Q decay scale on ``row``, ``exp2(g[row])``, at most 1 (may underflow to zero)."""
+    return steep_interval_factor(cfg, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, 0, row + 1, channel)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def steep_restore_scale(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, row, channel):
+    """A steep channel's K inv / K restore scale on ``row``, ``exp2(g[BT - 1] - g[row])``, at most 1."""
+    return steep_interval_factor(cfg, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, row + 1, cfg.b_t, channel)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def steep_row_scales(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, row, channel):
+    """:func:`steep_decay_scale` and :func:`steep_restore_scale` of ``row`` from one pass over the tile's factors (same products, same order)."""
+    decay = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+    restore = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+    for token in cutlass.range_constexpr(cfg.b_t):
+        factor = steep_token_factor(cfg, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, token, channel)
+        decay_factor = factor
+        restore_factor = factor
+        if token > row:
+            decay_factor = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+        if token <= row:
+            restore_factor = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+        decay = decay * decay_factor
+        restore = restore * restore_factor
+    return decay, restore
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def gradient_operand_scales(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, channel_steep, row, channel, value, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr):
+    """Return decay, inverse-gradient and restore scales before gradient assembly.
+
+    Steep channels use bounded prefix/suffix factors. Their inverse-gradient
+    contribution comes from the exact intra-tile correction, so its scale is zero.
+    """
+    decay = value
+    inverse = cute.math.rcp(value, approx=True, ftz=True)
+    restore = inverse
+    for _ in cutlass.range(channel_steep, unroll=1):
+        decay, restore = steep_row_scales(cfg, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, row, channel)
+        inverse = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    return decay, inverse, restore
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def row_operand_scales(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, bits, reg_idx, row, channel, value, last_value, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr):
+    """Return decay, inverse and restore-multiplier scales before operand construction.
+
+    The fast specialization retains the original factorization. Exact channels
+    put the bounded restore scale in K inv; K restore then uses multiplier one.
+    All other channels retain the original operation order and rounding.
+    """
+    decay = value
+    inverse = cute.math.rcp(value, approx=True, ftz=True)
+    restore_multiplier = last_value
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.steep_mode == STEEP_EXACT):
+        for _ in cutlass.range((bits >> reg_idx) & 1, unroll=1):
+            decay, inverse = steep_row_scales(cfg, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, row, channel)
+            restore_multiplier = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+    return decay, inverse, restore_multiplier
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def steep_row_corrections(
+    cfg: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    bits,
+    row,
+    lane_in_row_group,
+    k_norm,
+    q_scale,
+    exchange_ptr,
+    log_last_ptr,
+    raw_k_ptr,
+    raw_q_ptr,
+    beta_ptr,
+    k_norm_ptr,
+    k_inv_ptr,
+    k_decay_ptr,
+    q_decay_ptr,
+    corr_ptr,
+):
+    """Add the steep channels' KK and A entries of tile row ``row`` to ``corr_ptr``.
+
+    Called by all lanes of the row stage after its K inv / K decay stores.  ``bits`` is the lane's
+    :func:`lane_steep_bits`; ``k_norm`` / ``q_scale`` the row's K inverse norm and Q factor (the inverse norm, times
+    the attention scale where the A tile carries it); ``raw_q_ptr`` is ``None`` without an A tile.  Every operand is
+    read from the raw and operand tiles. ``corr_ptr`` is ``[2, BT, BT]`` fp32, the KK rows then the A rows.
+    Each row group reduces in a fixed order and one lane stores each entry, for
+    ``s <= row`` and each steep channel,
+
+        A[row, s]  += q_n[row] k_n[s] 2^(g[row] - g[s]) - Q decay[row] K inv[s]
+        KK[row, s] += beta[row] k_n[row] k_n[s] 2^(g[row] - g[s]) - K decay[row] K inv[s]   (s < row)
+
+    using the stored K decay / Q decay / K inv values for the second terms. The correction does not duplicate
+    operand rounding. The row-stage barrier must make all operand rows visible before this call."""
+    with_a = cutlass.const_expr(raw_q_ptr is not None)
+    kk_regs = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Float32, cfg.b_t)
+    attn_regs = cutlass.Array(cutlass.Float32, cfg.b_t)
+    for source_row in cutlass.range_constexpr(cfg.b_t):
+        kk_regs[source_row] = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+        attn_regs[source_row] = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    remaining = bits.to(cutlass.Uint32)
+    while remaining != 0:
+        j = cutlass.Int32(31) - cute.arch.bfind(cute.arch.brev(remaining)).to(cutlass.Int32)
+        remaining = remaining & (remaining - cutlass.Uint32(1))
+        channel = (j // 8) * 64 + lane_in_row_group * 8 + (j % 8)
+        x = ((raw_k_ptr + raw_offset(cfg, row, channel)).load().to(cutlass.Float32) * k_norm) * steep_beta(cfg, beta_ptr, row, channel)
+        x_decay = (k_decay_ptr + raw_offset(cfg, row, channel)).load().to(cutlass.Float32)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(with_a):
+            z = (raw_q_ptr + raw_offset(cfg, row, channel)).load().to(cutlass.Float32) * q_scale
+            z_decay = (q_decay_ptr + raw_offset(cfg, row, channel)).load().to(cutlass.Float32)
+        decay = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+        # Grow an interval backward from its destination. Never subtract prefixes.
+        for step in cutlass.range_constexpr(cfg.b_t):
+            source_row = cfg.b_t - 1 - step
+            if cutlass.const_expr(source_row < cfg.b_t - 1):
+                factor = steep_token_factor(cfg, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, source_row + 1, channel)
+                if source_row >= row:
+                    factor = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+                decay = decay * factor
+            k_s = (raw_k_ptr + raw_offset(cfg, source_row, channel)).load().to(cutlass.Float32)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(k_norm_ptr is not None):
+                k_s = k_s * (k_norm_ptr + source_row).load()
+            k_inv_s = (k_inv_ptr + raw_offset(cfg, source_row, channel)).load().to(cutlass.Float32)
+            k_decayed = k_s * decay
+            kk_term = x * k_decayed - x_decay * k_inv_s
+            if source_row >= row:
+                kk_term = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+            kk_regs[source_row] = kk_regs[source_row] + kk_term
+            if cutlass.const_expr(with_a):
+                attn_term = z * k_decayed - z_decay * k_inv_s
+                if source_row > row:
+                    attn_term = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+                attn_regs[source_row] = attn_regs[source_row] + attn_term
+    for source_row in cutlass.range_constexpr(cfg.b_t):
+        kk = kk_regs[source_row]
+        attn = attn_regs[source_row]
+        for step in cutlass.range_constexpr(3):
+            distance = 4 >> step
+            kk = kk + cutlass.Float32(nvvm.shfl_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, kk, distance, 31, kind=nvvm.Shfl.BFLY))
+            if cutlass.const_expr(with_a):
+                attn = attn + cutlass.Float32(nvvm.shfl_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, attn, distance, 31, kind=nvvm.Shfl.BFLY))
+        if lane_in_row_group == 0:
+            (corr_ptr + row * cfg.b_t + source_row).store(kk)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(with_a):
+                (corr_ptr + cfg.b_t * cfg.b_t + row * cfg.b_t + source_row).store(attn)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def add_steep_corrections(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, acc, corr_ptr, lane_idx):
+    """Add a ``[BT, BT]`` fp32 correction tile to an m16n16 register-MMA accumulator fragment (8 values per lane)."""
+    for accum_idx in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+        row = lane_idx // 4
+        if cutlass.const_expr(accum_idx % 4 >= 2):
+            row = row + cutlass.Int32(8)
+        col = (accum_idx // 4) * 8 + 2 * (lane_idx % 4)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(accum_idx % 2 == 1):
+            col = col + cutlass.Int32(1)
+        acc[accum_idx] = acc[accum_idx] + (corr_ptr + row * cfg.b_t + col).load()
+    # Callers release this stage through an elected lane. Join every reader
+    # before that lane can let the producer overwrite the correction tile.
+    nvvm.bar_warp_sync(cute.arch.FULL_MASK)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def steep_grad_corrections(
+    cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, channel, t, scale, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, raw_q_ptr, raw_k_ptr, beta_ptr, q_norm_ptr, k_norm_ptr, dadm_ptr
+):
+    """The backward's intra-tile terms of steep channel ``channel`` at token ``t`` (bprop compute group 2).
+
+    ``dadm_ptr`` holds the chunk's strict-lower dA and dM tiles, ``[2, BT, BT]`` in the io dtype, exactly as the
+    tcgen05 GEMMs read them.  With ``F(t, s) = 2^(g[t] - g[s])`` and ``K inv[s] = k_n[s] * 2^(g[BT - 1] - g[s])``
+    rounded to the io dtype (the steep column of the K inv operand), forms
+
+        dq_attn  = sum_{s<t} dA[t, s] k_n[s] F(t, s)          dq_mma  = sum_{s<t} dA[t, s] K inv[s]
+        dkd_attn = sum_{s<t} dM[t, s] k_n[s] F(t, s)          dkd_mma = sum_{s<t} dM[t, s] K inv[s]
+        dk_inv   = sum_{s>t} (scale q_n[s] dA[s, t] - beta[s] k_n[s] dM[s, t]) F(s, t)
+
+    Every exponent of F is at most 0. ``dq_mma`` and ``dkd_mma`` contain products for the steep column.
+    The dQ attn and dK decay GEMMs have already accumulated these products.
+    Return the dQ correction, the inverse-side dK term, the beta correction and the
+    decay-side dK correction (also used for dgate). Callers only map these onto their register layouts;
+    they add the two dK terms in their original accumulation order."""
+    dq_attn = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    dq_mma = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    dkd_attn = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    dkd_mma = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    dk_inv = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    tile = cutlass.const_expr(cfg.b_t * cfg.b_t)
+    # Grow bounded intervals directly. Never subtract cumulative prefixes: a
+    # large negative spike can erase later mild gates in FP32.
+    decay = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+    restore = steep_interval_factor(cfg, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, t + 1, cfg.b_t, channel)
+    for distance in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, cfg.b_t):
+        s = t - distance
+        source = s
+        if s < 0:
+            source = cutlass.Int32(0)
+        gate = steep_token_factor(cfg, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, source + 1, channel)
+        da = (dadm_ptr + t * cfg.b_t + source).load().to(cutlass.Float32)
+        dm = (dadm_ptr + tile + t * cfg.b_t + source).load().to(cutlass.Float32)
+        if s < 0:
+            gate = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+            da = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+            dm = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+        decay = decay * gate
+        restore = restore * gate
+        k_s = (raw_k_ptr + raw_offset(cfg, source, channel)).load().to(cutlass.Float32)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.l2norm):
+            k_s = k_s * (k_norm_ptr + source).load()
+        k_inv_s = (k_s * restore).to(cfg.io_dtype).to(cutlass.Float32)
+        dq_attn = dq_attn + da * (k_s * decay)
+        dq_mma = dq_mma + da * k_inv_s
+        dkd_attn = dkd_attn + dm * (k_s * decay)
+        dkd_mma = dkd_mma + dm * k_inv_s
+    decay = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+    for s in cutlass.range_constexpr(1, cfg.b_t):
+        gate = steep_token_factor(cfg, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, s, channel)
+        da = (dadm_ptr + s * cfg.b_t + t).load().to(cutlass.Float32)
+        dm = (dadm_ptr + tile + s * cfg.b_t + t).load().to(cutlass.Float32)
+        if s <= t:
+            gate = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+            da = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+            dm = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+        decay = decay * gate
+        k_s = (raw_k_ptr + raw_offset(cfg, s, channel)).load().to(cutlass.Float32)
+        q_s = (raw_q_ptr + raw_offset(cfg, s, channel)).load().to(cutlass.Float32)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.l2norm):
+            k_s = k_s * (k_norm_ptr + s).load()
+            q_s = q_s * (q_norm_ptr + s).load()
+        dk_inv = dk_inv + ((q_s * scale) * da - (k_s * steep_beta(cfg, beta_ptr, s, channel)) * dm) * decay
+    exp_t = steep_decay_scale(cfg, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, t, channel)
+    k_t = (raw_k_ptr + raw_offset(cfg, t, channel)).load().to(cutlass.Float32)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(cfg.l2norm):
+        k_t = k_t * (k_norm_ptr + t).load()
+    beta_t = steep_beta(cfg, beta_ptr, t, channel)
+    dq_delta = scale * (dq_attn - exp_t * dq_mma)
+    dkd_delta = exp_t * dkd_mma - dkd_attn
+    return dq_delta, dk_inv, k_t * dkd_delta, beta_t * dkd_delta
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def steep_warp_pass(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, pending, lane_idx):
+    """Hand the lowest pending steep owner lanes of a warp to its ``BT``-lane slots, one owner per slot.
+
+    In a warp whose lane ``l`` owns one channel at every token, lane ``l`` of slot ``l // BT`` works on token
+    ``l % BT`` of its slot's channel. Returns the owners still pending, the owner lane this lane works for (-1 for an
+    empty slot) and the slot an owner lane gathers its tokens from (-1 for every other lane)."""
+    owner = cutlass.Int32(-1)
+    slot = cutlass.Int32(-1)
+    for s in cutlass.range_constexpr(cfg.threads_per_warp // cfg.b_t):
+        if pending != 0:
+            lowest = cutlass.Int32(31) - cute.arch.bfind(cute.arch.brev(pending)).to(cutlass.Int32)
+            pending = pending & (pending - cutlass.Uint32(1))
+            if lane_idx // cfg.b_t == s:
+                owner = lowest
+            if lane_idx == lowest:
+                slot = cutlass.Int32(s)
+    return pending, owner, slot
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def steep_slot_gather(cfg: cutlass.Constexpr, value, slot, token):
+    """Token ``token``'s ``value`` from the lanes of ``slot`` (any lane when ``slot`` is -1; the caller discards it)."""
+    source = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    if slot >= 0:
+        source = slot * cfg.b_t
+    return cutlass.Float32(nvvm.shfl_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, value, source + token, 31, kind=nvvm.Shfl.IDX))
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def steep_grad_corrections_warp(
+    cfg: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    steep,
+    lane_idx,
+    warp_channel,
+    scale,
+    exchange_ptr,
+    log_last_ptr,
+    raw_q_ptr,
+    raw_k_ptr,
+    beta_ptr,
+    q_norm_ptr,
+    k_norm_ptr,
+    dadm_ptr,
+    dq,
+    db,
+    dgate,
+    dk,
+):
+    """Add :func:`steep_grad_corrections` to ``[BT]`` register rows of a warp whose lane ``l`` owns channel
+    ``warp_channel + l`` at every token (``db`` may be ``None``). Called by every lane of the warp.
+
+    Each pass of :func:`steep_warp_pass` computes one token per lane, and each owner gathers its tokens."""
+    pending = cutlass.Int32(nvvm.vote_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, steep != 0, nvvm.VoteSync.BALLOT)).to(cutlass.Uint32)
+    if cute.arch.popc(pending) > STEEP_COOP_MAX:
+        if steep != 0:
+            for t in cutlass.range(cfg.b_t, unroll=1):
+                dq_delta, dk_inv, db_delta, dgate_delta = steep_grad_corrections(
+                    cfg, warp_channel + lane_idx, t, scale, exchange_ptr, log_last_ptr, raw_q_ptr, raw_k_ptr, beta_ptr, q_norm_ptr, k_norm_ptr, dadm_ptr
+                )
+                dk_delta = dk_inv + dgate_delta
+                for u in cutlass.range_constexpr(cfg.b_t):

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""
+PyTorch custom operator for the Mamba-2 state space duality (SSD) layer.
+
+Mamba-2 is the gated delta rule without the erase term, with one per-token scalar dt
+playing both the decay and the write strength:
+
+    dt_t  = clamp(softplus(dt_raw_t + dt_bias_h), dt_min, dt_max),
+    S_t   = exp(A_h dt_t) S_{t-1} + dt_t B_t^T x_t,
+    y_t   = C_t S_t + D_h x_t              (* z_t sigmoid(z_t) when the z gate is fused),
+
+where ``S_t`` is the recurrent state ``[N, P]`` (``N`` the state dimension, ``P`` the
+head dimension), ``A_h < 0`` a per-head decay rate, ``D`` a per-head or per-channel skip,
+and ``B`` / ``C`` grouped over ``G`` groups of the ``H`` heads.
+
+Layout follows the graph-API MAMBA2 node (THD), token-packed ``[total_tokens, heads, dim]``
+tensors plus ``cu_seqlens`` sequence boundaries.  In the node's vocabulary ``C`` is ``q``,
+``B`` is ``k``, ``x`` is ``v``, ``dt`` is ``g`` and ``A`` is ``a``.
+
+The op is a thin adapter over the graph API; forward and backward execute cached
+single-node ``MAMBA2`` / ``MAMBA2_BWD`` pygraphs.  Engine selection happens at graph
+planning time over the manifest's python engines (``Mamba2FrostEngine`` on
+SM100 / SM103 / SM107).  Registered through ``torch.library.custom_op`` so it composes
+with autograd, ``torch.compile``, and DDP.
+
+Graph caching ensures cuDNN graphs are built once per unique configuration and reused
+across calls.
+"""
+
+from typing import Dict, Optional, Tuple
+
+import torch
+import cudnn
+
+from .common import execute_graph, make_execution_resources, select_plan, torch_dtype_to_cudnn
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Module-level state
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+fprop_cache: Dict[tuple, tuple] = {}
+bprop_cache: Dict[tuple, tuple] = {}
+summary_cache: Dict[tuple, tuple] = {}
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Helpers
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def check_dtype(name, t, want) -> None:
+    wants = want if isinstance(want, tuple) else (want,)
+    if t.dtype not in wants:
+        names = " or ".join(str(w) for w in wants)
+        raise TypeError(f"mamba2: {name} must be {names} (kernel-native; callers convert), got {t.dtype}")
+
+
+def make_fprop_cache_key(
+    total,
+    N,
+    H,
+    G,
+    K,
+    V,
+    io_dtype,
+    cu_dtype,
+    g_dtype,
+    a_dtype,
+    dt_bias_dtype,
+    d_dtype,
+    d_per_channel,
+    z_dtype,
+    state_dtype,
+    output_final_state,
+    output_pre_gate,
+    batch_invariant,
+    checkpoint,
+    dt_softplus,
+    dt_min,
+    dt_max,
+    device,
+    plan_name,
+    overwrite_initial_state,
+    state_pool_rows=None,
+    checkpoint_dtype=None,
+):
+    return (
+        "fprop",
+        total,
+        N,
+        H,
+        G,
+        K,
+        V,
+        io_dtype,
+        cu_dtype,
+        g_dtype,
+        a_dtype,
+        dt_bias_dtype,
+        d_dtype,
+        bool(d_per_channel),
+        z_dtype,
+        state_dtype,
+        bool(output_final_state),
+        bool(output_pre_gate),
+        bool(batch_invariant),
+        checkpoint,
+        bool(dt_softplus),
+        float(dt_min),
+        float(dt_max),
+        device,
+        plan_name,
+        bool(overwrite_initial_state),
+        state_pool_rows,
+        checkpoint_dtype,
+    )
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Forward graph builder
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def build_fprop_graph(
+    total,
+    N,
+    H,
+    G,
+    K,
+    V,
+    io_dtype,
+    g_dtype,
+    a_dtype,
+    dt_bias_dtype,
+    d_dtype,
+    d_per_channel,
+    z_dtype,
+    state_dtype,
+    cu_dtype,
+    output_final_state,
+    output_pre_gate,
+    batch_invariant,
+    checkpoint,
+    dt_softplus,
+    dt_min,
+    dt_max,
+    overwrite_initial_state=False,
+    state_indices_dtype=None,
+    state_pool_rows=None,
+    checkpoint_dtype=None,
+):
+    graph = cudnn.pygraph()
+    q_t = graph.tensor([total, G, K], data_type=io_dtype, name="q")
+    k_t = graph.tensor([total, G, K], data_type=io_dtype, name="k")
+    v_t = graph.tensor([total, H, V], data_type=io_dtype, name="v")
+    g_t = graph.tensor([total, H], data_type=g_dtype, name="g")
+    a_t = graph.tensor([H], data_type=a_dtype, name="a")
+    cu_t = graph.tensor([N + 1], data_type=cu_dtype, name="cu_seqlens")
+    state0_t = None
+    if state_dtype is not None:
+        state_rows = N if state_pool_rows is None else state_pool_rows
+        state0_t = graph.tensor([state_rows, H, V, K], data_type=state_dtype, name="initial_state")
+    state_indices_t = None
+    if state_indices_dtype is not None:
+        state_indices_t = graph.tensor([N], data_type=state_indices_dtype, name="state_indices")
+    pool_ports = {"state_indices": state_indices_t} if state_indices_t is not None else {}
+    dt_bias_t = None
+    if dt_bias_dtype is not None:
+        dt_bias_t = graph.tensor([H], data_type=dt_bias_dtype, name="dt_bias")
+    d_t = None
+    if d_dtype is not None:
+        d_t = graph.tensor([H, V] if d_per_channel else [H], data_type=d_dtype, name="d")
+    z_t = None
+    if z_dtype is not None:
+        z_t = graph.tensor([total, H, V], data_type=z_dtype, name="z")
+    O_t, fs_t, state_checkpoints_t, o_pre_t = graph.mamba2(
+        q=q_t,
+        k=k_t,
+        v=v_t,
+        g=g_t,
+        a=a_t,
+        cu_seqlens=cu_t,
+        initial_state=state0_t,
+        **pool_ports,
+        dt_bias=dt_bias_t,
+        d=d_t,
+        z=z_t,
+        output_final_state=output_final_state,
+        checkpoint_every_n_tokens=checkpoint,
+        dt_softplus=dt_softplus,
+        dt_min=dt_min,
+        dt_max=None if dt_max == float("inf") else dt_max,
+        output_pre_gate=output_pre_gate or None,
+        batch_invariant=batch_invariant,
+        overwrite_initial_state=overwrite_initial_state or None,
+        name="mamba2",
+    )
+    if state_checkpoints_t is not None:
+        state_checkpoints_t.set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT if checkpoint_dtype == torch.float32 else io_dtype)
+    return graph, dict(
+        q=q_t,
+        k=k_t,
+        v=v_t,
+        g=g_t,
+        a=a_t,
+        cu=cu_t,
+        state0=state0_t,
+        state_indices=state_indices_t,
+        dt_bias=dt_bias_t,
+        d=d_t,
+        z=z_t,
+        O=O_t,
+        fs=fs_t,
+        state_checkpoints=state_checkpoints_t,
+        O_pre=o_pre_t,
+    )
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Forward custom op
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def run_mamba2_fwd(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    dt: torch.Tensor,
+    A: torch.Tensor,
+    B: torch.Tensor,
+    C: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+    D: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    dt_bias: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    z: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    initial_state: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    output_final_state: bool = False,
+    output_pre_gate: bool = False,
+    checkpoint_every_n_tokens: int = 0,
+    dt_softplus: bool = True,
+    dt_min: float = 0.0,
+    dt_max: Optional[float] = None,
+    batch_invariant: bool = False,
+    plan_name: Optional[str] = None,
+    final_state_out: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    state_indices: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    checkpoint_dtype: Optional[torch.dtype] = None,
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Internal Mamba-2 forward over a cached single-node MAMBA2 pygraph in THD layout.
+
+    Returns ``(y, final_state, state_checkpoints, y_pre)``; ``final_state`` / ``state_checkpoints`` / ``y_pre`` are
+    zero-size tensors when ``output_final_state`` is ``False`` / ``checkpoint_every_n_tokens`` is ``0`` /
+    ``output_pre_gate`` is ``False`` or ``z`` is absent.  ``final_state_out`` binds the final_state output to a caller
+    buffer (the in-place op passes ``initial_state``); ``state_indices`` (int32 ``[N]``) makes ``initial_state`` a
+    pool whose row ``state_indices[i]`` seeds sequence ``i`` and receives its final state.  ``checkpoint_dtype`` is the
+    checkpoint row dtype: ``None`` (the io dtype) or ``torch.float32``.
+    """
+    total, H, V = x.shape
+    G, K = C.shape[1], C.shape[2]
+    if B.shape != C.shape:
+        raise ValueError(f"mamba2: B and C must share one head count and shape; got {tuple(B.shape)} and {tuple(C.shape)}")
+    if H % G != 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"mamba2: the head count ({H}) must be a multiple of the B / C group count ({G})")
+    if dt.shape != (total, H):
+        raise ValueError(f"mamba2: dt must be [total_tokens, H] = [{total}, {H}]; got {tuple(dt.shape)}")
+    if A.shape != (H,):
+        raise ValueError(f"mamba2: A must be [H] = [{H}]; got {tuple(A.shape)}")
+    N = cu_seqlens.shape[0] - 1
+    device = x.device
+    if cu_seqlens.dtype not in (torch.int32, torch.int64):
+        raise ValueError(f"mamba2: cu_seqlens must be int32 or int64; got {cu_seqlens.dtype}")
+    check_dtype("x", x, (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16))
+    check_dtype("B", B, x.dtype)
+    check_dtype("C", C, x.dtype)
+    check_dtype("dt", dt, (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16, torch.float16))
+    check_dtype("A", A, (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16, torch.float16))
+    if dt_bias is not None:
+        check_dtype("dt_bias", dt_bias, (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16, torch.float16))
+        if dt_bias.shape != (H,):
+            raise ValueError(f"mamba2: dt_bias must be [H] = [{H}]; got {tuple(dt_bias.shape)}")
+    if D is not None:
+        check_dtype("D", D, (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16, torch.float16))
+        if D.shape not in ((H,), (H, V)):
+            raise ValueError(f"mamba2: D must be [H] or [H, P] = [{H}] / [{H}, {V}]; got {tuple(D.shape)}")
+    if z is not None:
+        check_dtype("z", z, x.dtype)
+        if z.shape != x.shape:
+            raise ValueError(f"mamba2: z must match x's shape {tuple(x.shape)}; got {tuple(z.shape)}")
+    dt_max_value = float("inf") if dt_max is None else float(dt_max)
+    if float(dt_min) > dt_max_value:
+        raise ValueError(f"mamba2: dt_min ({dt_min}) must not exceed dt_max ({dt_max_value})")
+    state_pool_rows = None
+    if state_indices is not None:
+        if initial_state is None:
+            raise ValueError("mamba2: state_indices selects rows of the initial_state pool, so initial_state is required")
+        check_dtype("state_indices", state_indices, torch.int32)
+        if state_indices.dim() != 1 or state_indices.shape[0] != N:

+            tuple(initial_state.stride()[1:]) != (V * K, K, 1)
+            or initial_state.stride(0) < H * V * K
+            or initial_state.stride(0) % (16 // initial_state.element_size())
+        ):
