+@cute.jit
+def _softmax_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    lse,
+    delta,
+    origins,
+    stats_origin: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    meta,
+    n_batch,
+    scale,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(CFG.SOFTMAX_REGS, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.INCREASE)
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    row = tid % CFG.M
+    group = tid // CFG.M
+    state = PipelineState.start()
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        if cutlass.const_expr(not causal):
+            _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        lo, hi, seq_q, seq_k, q_start = _bounds(block, meta, batch, n_batch, causal)
+        if lo < hi:
+            _stats(slab, lse, delta, row, group, lo * CFG.N, batch, head, scale, q_start, seq_q, origins, stats_origin)
+        for qtile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.s_done, state.phase)
+            p = _p_values(slab, tmem_base, row, group, block, qtile, seq_q, seq_k, scale, causal, dtype)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.STORE)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+            bars.p_ready.arrive()
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.dp_done, state.phase)
+            _ds_values(slab, tmem_base, group, p, scale, dtype)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.STORE)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+            bars.ds_ready.arrive()
+            if qtile + 1 < hi:
+                _stats(slab, lse, delta, row, group, (qtile + 1) * CFG.N, batch, head, scale, q_start, seq_q, origins, stats_origin)
+            state = advance(state, 1)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+            _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        block, head, batch, valid, sched_state = _next_tile(sched, bars, sched_state)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _store_words(slab, byte_offset, row, words):
+    for vec in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+        off = byte_offset + row * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES + ((row % 8) ^ vec) * 16
+        values = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(words[vec * 4 + k] for k in range(4)), cutlass.Int32)
+        Pointer(slab.data_ptr() + off, dtype=cutlass.Int32).store(values, alignment=16)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _store_dq_slice(slab, row, values, index: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    for vec in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):
+        off = CFG.ALIAS + index * CFG.SLICE_BYTES + row * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES + ((row % 8) ^ vec) * 16
+        v = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(values[index * 32 + vec * 4 + k] for k in range(4)), cutlass.Float32)
+        Pointer(slab.data_ptr() + off, dtype=cutlass.Float32).store(v, alignment=16)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _native_epilogue(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, live, empty_phase, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr, dk: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]):
+    plane = 384 if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else 256
+    base = CFG.ALIAS + (CFG.OPERAND_BYTES if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else 0)
+    last_slice = 3 if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else 1
+    for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+        vals = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(cutlass.Float32(0.0) for _ in range(64)), cutlass.Float32)
+        if live:
+            vals = _tmem_load(tmem_base + plane + half * 64, 64)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+        words = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(fp32_to_fp16(vals[2 * i], vals[2 * i + 1], dtype=dtype) for i in range(32)), cutlass.Int32)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(half == 0):
+            _wait(bars.dq_empty[last_slice], empty_phase)
+        _store_words(slab, base + half * CFG.SLICE_BYTES, row, words)
+    nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(dk):
+        bars.dk_full.arrive()
+    else:
+        bars.dv_full.arrive()
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _native_epilogue_fp32(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, live, empty_phase, dk: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]):
+    """dkv_accum = fp32_reduce (the grouped THD kernel only): the lane's kv row of the fp32 dV (TMEM plane CFG.DV_COL) or dK (CFG.DK_COL)
+    accumulator as the FOUR [M x DQ_BOX] fp32 SW128 slices of the ALIAS slab (the dQ staging image, `_store_dq_slice`), published through
+    dv_full / dk_full for the store warp's reduce-adds.  The dV round's WAR (the last dQ slice reads) is the caller's terminal dq_empty waits;
+    the dK round waits dq_empty[i] (the store warp's credit after its dV slice i source read) before overwriting slice i -- the SAME ring
+    object, one more completion per item on both sides.  A zero-trip owner stages zeros (its reduce-adds are skipped by the store warp)."""
+    # ALIAS 64 KiB = one fp32 tensor (4 dQ-slice boxes): dV round, dK round; dq_empty x4
+    plane = CFG.DK_COL if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else CFG.DV_COL
+    lo_vals = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(cutlass.Float32(0.0) for _ in range(CFG.D_HALF)), cutlass.Float32)
+    hi_vals = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(cutlass.Float32(0.0) for _ in range(CFG.D_HALF)), cutlass.Float32)
+    if live:
+        lo_vals = _tmem_load(tmem_base + plane, CFG.D_HALF)
+        hi_vals = _tmem_load(tmem_base + plane + CFG.D_HALF, CFG.D_HALF)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    vals = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(lo_vals[i] for i in range(CFG.D_HALF)) + tuple(hi_vals[i] for i in range(CFG.D_HALF)), cutlass.Float32)
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(CFG.DKV_ACC_SLICES):
+        if cutlass.const_expr(dk):
+            _wait(bars.dq_empty[i], empty_phase)  # WAR: the store warp read the dV slice out of these bytes (its post-read credit)
+        _store_dq_slice(slab, row, vals, i)
+    nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(dk):
+        bars.dk_full.arrive()
+    else:
+        bars.dv_full.arrive()
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _epilogue_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    meta,
+    n_batch,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    dkv_fp32: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+):
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(CFG.EPILOGUE_REGS, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.INCREASE)
+    row = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.M
+    ds_state = PipelineState.start()
+    dq_state = PipelineState.start()
+    empty_state = PipelineState.start()
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        lo, hi, seq_q, seq_k, q_start = _bounds(block, meta, batch, n_batch, causal)
+        for qtile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.ds_ready, ds_state.phase)
+            ds0 = _tmem_load(tmem_base + 128, 32, cutlass.Int32)
+            ds1 = _tmem_load(tmem_base + 192, 32, cutlass.Int32)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+            _wait(bars.dq_empty[0], empty_state.phase)
+            _store_words(slab, CFG.ALIAS, row, ds0)
+            _wait(bars.dq_empty[1], empty_state.phase)
+            _store_words(slab, CFG.ALIAS + CFG.SLICE_BYTES, row, ds1)
+            nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+            bars.ds_smem.arrive()
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.dq_done, dq_state.phase)
+            dq0 = _tmem_load(tmem_base + 128, 64)
+            dq1 = _tmem_load(tmem_base + 192, 64)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+            bars.dp_empty.arrive()
+            vals = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(dq0[i] for i in range(64)) + tuple(dq1[i] for i in range(64)), cutlass.Float32)
+            for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                _wait(bars.dq_empty[i], empty_state.phase)
+                _store_dq_slice(slab, row, vals, i)
+                nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+                bars.dq_full[i].arrive()
+            ds_state = advance(ds_state, 1)
+            dq_state = advance(dq_state, 1)
+            empty_state = advance(empty_state, 1)
+        if lo >= hi:
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.dq_done, dq_state.phase)
+            dq_state = advance(dq_state, 1)
+        # Observe every terminal source-credit phase before the next CLC
+        # owner bootstraps these barriers again. Native dV/dK alone wait on
+        # slices 1/3, leaving slices 0/2 unobserved after the final dQ or a
+        # zero-trip owner. Each completed mbarrier phase needs a successful
+        # wait before an arrival in its next phase.
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+            _wait(bars.dq_empty[i], empty_state.phase)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(dkv_fp32):
+            # dkv_accum = fp32_reduce: dV then dK as fp32 slices over the ALIAS slab -- two ring rounds per item (the store warp credits dq_empty
+            # after the dV slices' source reads; the dK round waits them at the advanced phase)
+            _native_epilogue_fp32(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, lo < hi, empty_state.phase, False)
+            empty_state = advance(empty_state, 1)
+            _native_epilogue_fp32(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, lo < hi, empty_state.phase, True)
+        else:
+            _native_epilogue(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, lo < hi, empty_state.phase, dtype, False)
+            _native_epilogue(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, lo < hi, empty_state.phase, dtype, True)
+        empty_state = advance(empty_state, 1)
+        block, head, batch, valid, sched_state = _next_tile(sched, bars, sched_state)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _ts(desc, plane, bdesc, dst, accum):
+    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(CFG.D // CFG.K_HW):
+        mma_ts_step(
+            desc, nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(plane + (k // 4) * 32, cutlass.Int8), bdesc, dst, k_idx=k, accumulate=accum if cutlass.const_expr(k == 0) else True
+        )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _mma_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    meta,
+    n_batch,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(CFG.SERVICE_REGS, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.DECREASE)
+    score = _mma_desc(dtype)
+    grad = _mma_desc(dtype, btranspose=True)
+    dqdesc = _mma_desc(dtype, atranspose=True, btranspose=True)
+    kd = _operand(slab, CFG.K, dtype).desc()
+    vd = _operand(slab, CFG.V, dtype).desc()
+    dod = _operand(slab, CFG.DO, dtype).desc()
+    dot = _operand(slab, CFG.DO, dtype, transpose=True).desc()
+    dst = _operand(slab, CFG.ALIAS, dtype, transpose=True).desc()
+    kt = _operand(slab, CFG.K, dtype, transpose=True).desc()
+    s = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base, cutlass.Float32)
+    dp = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + 128, cutlass.Float32)
+    dv = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + 256, cutlass.Float32)
+    dk = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + 384, cutlass.Float32)
+    q_state = PipelineState.start()
+    do_state = PipelineState.start()
+    kv_state = PipelineState.start()
+    ready_state = PipelineState.start()
+    dp_empty = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+    out_empty = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        lo, hi, seq_q, seq_k, q_start = _bounds(block, meta, batch, n_batch, causal)
+        if lo < hi:
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.k_full, kv_state.phase)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.q_full[q_state.idx], q_state.phase)
+            qd = _operand(slab, CFG.Q + q_state.idx * CFG.OPERAND_BYTES, dtype).desc()
+            mma_ss(score, kd, qd, s)
+            _commit(bars.s_done)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.v_full, kv_state.phase)
+        _wait_tcgen(bars.dvk_empty, out_empty.phase)
+        out_empty = advance(out_empty, 1)
+        for qtile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.dp_empty, dp_empty.phase)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.do_full[0], do_state.phase)
+            mma_ss(score, vd, dod, dp, k_start=0, k_count=4)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.do_full[1], do_state.phase)
+            mma_ss(score, vd, dod, dp, k_start=4, k_count=4, accumulate=True)
+            _commit(bars.dp_done)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.p_ready, ready_state.phase)
+            _ts(grad, tmem_base, dot, dv, qtile > lo)
+            _commit(bars.do_empty)
+            q_next = advance(q_state, CFG.Q_STAGES)
+            if qtile + 1 < hi:
+                _wait_tcgen(bars.q_full[q_next.idx], q_next.phase)
+                qd_next = _operand(slab, CFG.Q + q_next.idx * CFG.OPERAND_BYTES, dtype).desc()
+                mma_ss(score, kd, qd_next, s)
+                _commit(bars.s_done)
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.ds_ready, ready_state.phase)
+            qt = _operand(slab, CFG.Q + q_state.idx * CFG.OPERAND_BYTES, dtype, transpose=True).desc()
+            _ts(grad, tmem_base + 128, qt, dk, qtile > lo)
+            _commit(bars.q_empty[q_state.idx])
+            _wait_tcgen(bars.ds_smem, ready_state.phase)
+            mma_ss(dqdesc, dst, kt, dp)
+            _commit(bars.dq_done)

+        hi = cutlass.Int32(arith.select((key < skv).ir_value(), hi.ir_value(), stream_base.ir_value()))
+        ds_lo = cute.math.max(lo, cutlass.Int32(1)) if cutlass.const_expr(causal) else lo
+        ds_hi = cutlass.Int32(arith.select((skv > 1).ir_value(), hi.ir_value(), stream_base.ir_value()))
+        if cutlass.const_expr(window_left > 0):
+            # At query skv + W - 2 only the last key remains; its dS is zero.
+            ds_hi = cute.math.min(ds_hi, skv + window_left - 2)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(causal and window_left == 1):
+                ds_hi = stream_base
+    return band_mask_words(lo, hi, stream_base + col, CFG.POINTWISE_COLS), band_mask_words(ds_lo, ds_hi, stream_base + col, CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _probability_masked(
+    s,
+    dp,
+    stats,
+    owner_base,
+    stream_base,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    scale,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    q_owner: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    col: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0,
+):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+    if cutlass.const_expr(q_owner):
+        lse = stats.subview(tid).load()
+        delta = stats.subview(CFG.Q_STATS_DELTA + tid).load()
+    else:
+        lse = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+        delta = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(CFG.KV_STATS_DELTA + col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+    words, ds_words = _probability_words(stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, causal, q_owner, col, window_left)
+    p = cute.math.exp2((s * scale - lse) * _LOG2E, fastmath=True)
+    p = apply_mask_words(p, words, mask_value=0.0, n_cols=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+    # A row with exactly one legal key has softmax derivative exactly zero.
+    # Select zero rather than retaining dP-versus-delta reduction roundoff;
+    # P remains unchanged because that key still contributes to dV.
+    ds = apply_mask_words((dp - delta) * p * scale, ds_words, mask_value=0.0, n_cols=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+    return p, ds
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _probability_full(s, dp, stats, scale, q_owner: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], col: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+    if cutlass.const_expr(q_owner):
+        lse = stats.subview(tid).load()
+        delta = stats.subview(CFG.Q_STATS_DELTA + tid).load()
+    else:
+        lse = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+        delta = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(CFG.KV_STATS_DELTA + col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+    # Full rectangles exclude SKV1 and causal query0, so both original
+    # masks are all-one. KV keeps its original nonfinite-LSE behavior.
+    p = cute.math.exp2((s * scale - lse) * _LOG2E, fastmath=True)
+    ds = (dp - delta) * p * scale
+    return p, ds
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _probability(
+    s,
+    dp,
+    stats,
+    owner_base,
+    stream_base,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    scale,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    q_owner: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    col: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0,
+):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+    if cutlass.const_expr(q_owner):
+        full = (owner_base + CFG.TILE_M <= sq) & (stream_base + CFG.TILE_N <= skv)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+            full = full & (stream_base + CFG.TILE_N - 1 <= owner_base)
+        lse = stats.subview(tid).load()
+        # All32 lanes participate even on geometric tails. A sentinel in any
+        # lane sends that whole warp through the original zero-masking path.
+        lse_live = nvvm.vote_sync(cute.arch.FULL_MASK, lse != cutlass.Float32(float("-inf")), nvvm.VoteSync.ALL)
+        full = full & lse_live
+    else:
+        full = (owner_base + CFG.TILE_M <= skv) & (stream_base + CFG.TILE_N <= sq)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+            full = full & (stream_base >= owner_base + CFG.TILE_M - 1)
+    # Seed staged-control-flow result types; both branches overwrite them.
+    p, ds = s, dp
+    if full & (window_left == 0):
+        p, ds = _probability_full(s, dp, stats, scale, q_owner, col)
+    else:
+        p, ds = _probability_masked(s, dp, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal, q_owner, col, window_left)
+    return p, ds
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _kv_full(owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0):
+    full = (owner_base + CFG.TILE_M <= skv) & (stream_base + CFG.TILE_N <= sq)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+        full = full & (stream_base >= owner_base + CFG.TILE_M - 1)
+    return full & (window_left == 0)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _kv_probability_p(
+    s, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], col: cutlass.Constexpr[int], window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0
+):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+    lse = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+    p = s
+    if _kv_full(owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, causal, window_left):
+        p = cute.math.exp2((s * scale - lse) * _LOG2E, fastmath=True)
+    else:
+        words, _ = _probability_words(stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, causal, False, col, window_left)
+        p = cute.math.exp2((s * scale - lse) * _LOG2E, fastmath=True)
+        p = apply_mask_words(p, words, mask_value=0.0, n_cols=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+    return p
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _kv_probability_ds(
+    dp, p, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], col: cutlass.Constexpr[int], window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0
+):
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+    delta = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(stats.subview(CFG.KV_STATS_DELTA + col + i).load() for i in range(CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+    ds = dp
+    if _kv_full(owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, causal, window_left):
+        ds = (dp - delta) * p * scale
+    else:
+        _, ds_words = _probability_words(stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, causal, False, col, window_left)
+        ds = apply_mask_words((dp - delta) * p * scale, ds_words, mask_value=0.0, n_cols=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS)
+    return ds
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _kv_p_chunk(
+    score_base,
+    stats,
+    owner_base,
+    stream_base,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    scale,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    col: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0,
+):
+    s = tmem_load_tile(score_base + CFG.TMEM_S + col, num_elems=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS, ld_num=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS).vec
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    p = _kv_probability_p(s, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal, col, window_left)
+    packed_col = (col // CFG.GROUP_COLS) * CFG.GROUP_COLS + (col % CFG.GROUP_COLS) * CFG.BPE // CFG.TMEM_WORD_BYTES
+    nvvm.tcgen05_st("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(score_base + CFG.TMEM_S + packed_col, cutlass.Float32), p.to(dtype))
+    return p  # The original FP32 vector remains live; native conversion is a copy.
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _kv_ds_chunk(
+    score_base,
+    p,
+    stats,
+    owner_base,
+    stream_base,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    scale,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    col: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0,
+):
+    dp = tmem_load_tile(score_base + CFG.TMEM_DP + col, num_elems=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS, ld_num=CFG.POINTWISE_COLS).vec
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    ds = _kv_probability_ds(dp, p, stats, owner_base, stream_base, sq, skv, scale, causal, col, window_left)
+    packed_col = (col // CFG.GROUP_COLS) * CFG.GROUP_COLS + (col % CFG.GROUP_COLS) * CFG.BPE // CFG.TMEM_WORD_BYTES
+    nvvm.tcgen05_st("32x32b", nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(score_base + CFG.TMEM_DP + packed_col, cutlass.Float32), ds.to(dtype))
+
+
+class Bars(NamedTuple):

+    q_stats_ready: MBarrier

+    input_empty: MBarrier
+    o_full: MBarrier
+    o_empty: MBarrier
+    stats_full: MBarrier
+    stats_empty: MBarrier
+    s_full: MBarrier
+    dp_full: MBarrier
+    p_full: MBarrier
+    ds_full: MBarrier
+    q_score_empty: MBarrier
+    q_ds_empty: MBarrier

+    out_ready: MBarrier

+
+    return Bars(

+        make(1, CFG.STATS_ARRIVERS, Producer.THREAD),
+        make(1, CFG.COMPUTE_ARRIVERS, Producer.THREAD),
+        make(1, CFG.ONE_LANE, Producer.MMA_COMMIT),
+        make(1, CFG.ONE_LANE, Producer.MMA_COMMIT),
+        make(1, CFG.COMPUTE_ARRIVERS, Producer.THREAD),
+        make(1, CFG.COMPUTE_ARRIVERS, Producer.THREAD),
+        make(1, CFG.COMPUTE_ARRIVERS, Producer.THREAD),
+        make(1, CFG.ONE_LANE, Producer.MMA_COMMIT),
+        make(1, CFG.ONE_LANE, Producer.MMA_COMMIT),
+        make(1, CFG.COMPUTE_ARRIVERS, Producer.THREAD),
+    )

+
+def _q_ds(slab):
+    return _operand(slab, CFG.AUX, CFG.TILE_M, cols=CFG.TILE_N)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _mma_ts_gapped(desc, plane, desc_b, dest, accumulate):
+    for k in cutlass.range_constexpr(CFG.TILE_N // CFG.TILE_K_HW):
+        # mma_ts_step adds the packed K16 stride. Shift the origin past each
+        # group gap: logical group width minus its native packed width.
+        mma_ts_step(
+            desc,
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(
+                plane + (k // (CFG.GROUP_COLS // CFG.TILE_K_HW)) * (CFG.GROUP_COLS - CFG.GROUP_COLS * CFG.BPE // CFG.TMEM_WORD_BYTES), cutlass.Int8
+            ),
+            desc_b,
+            dest,
+            k_idx=k,
+            accumulate=accumulate if cutlass.const_expr(k == 0) else True,
+        )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _issue_kv_s(slab, bars, tmem_base, input_state, full_state, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    _wait_service(bars.input_full, input_state)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+    mma_ss(
+        _mma_desc(dtype),
+        _operand(slab, CFG.RESIDENT0, CFG.TILE_M).desc(),
+        _input(slab, input_state.idx, 0).desc(),
+        nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_S, cutlass.Float32),
+    )
+    bars.s_full[full_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+    return advance(input_state, CFG.INPUT_STAGES), advance(full_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _mma_kv(slab, bars, tmem_base, lo, hi, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    input_state = PipelineState.start()
+    input_empty_state = PipelineState.start()
+    s_state = PipelineState.start()
+    dp_state = PipelineState.start()
+    p_state = PipelineState.start()
+    ds_state = PipelineState.start()
+    score = _mma_desc(dtype)
+    grad = _mma_desc(dtype, gradient=True)
+    if hi > lo:
+        input_state, s_state = _issue_kv_s(slab, bars, tmem_base, input_state, s_state, dtype)
+    for tile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+        mma_ss(
+            score,
+            _operand(slab, CFG.RESIDENT1, CFG.TILE_M).desc(),
+            _input(slab, input_empty_state.idx, 1).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_DP, cutlass.Float32),
+        )
+        bars.dp_full[dp_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        dp_state = advance(dp_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        _wait_service(bars.p_full, p_state)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        p_state = advance(p_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        _mma_ts_gapped(
+            grad,
+            tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_S,
+            _input(slab, input_empty_state.idx, 1, transposed=True).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_G1, cutlass.Float32),
+            tile > lo,
+        )
+        if tile + 1 < hi:
+            input_state, s_state = _issue_kv_s(slab, bars, tmem_base, input_state, s_state, dtype)
+        _wait_service(bars.ds_full, ds_state)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        ds_state = advance(ds_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        _mma_ts_gapped(
+            grad,
+            tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_DP,
+            _input(slab, input_empty_state.idx, 0, transposed=True).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_G0, cutlass.Float32),
+            tile > lo,
+        )
+        bars.input_empty[input_empty_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        input_empty_state = advance(input_empty_state, CFG.INPUT_STAGES)
+    if hi > lo:
+        bars.final_grad.arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _mma_q(slab, bars, tmem_base, lo, hi, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    input_state = PipelineState.start()
+    input_empty_state = PipelineState.start()
+    empty_state = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+    s_state = PipelineState.start()
+    ds_state = PipelineState.start()
+    ds_empty_state = PipelineState.start()
+    score = _mma_desc(dtype)
+    grad = _mma_desc(dtype, gradient=True)
+    for tile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+        _wait_service(bars.input_full, input_state)
+        _wait_service(bars.q_score_empty, empty_state)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        mma_ss(
+            score,
+            _operand(slab, CFG.RESIDENT0, CFG.TILE_M).desc(),
+            _input(slab, input_state.idx, 0).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_S, cutlass.Float32),
+        )
+        mma_ss(
+            score,
+            _operand(slab, CFG.RESIDENT1, CFG.TILE_M).desc(),
+            _input(slab, input_state.idx, 1).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_DP, cutlass.Float32),
+        )
+        bars.s_full[s_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        input_state = advance(input_state, CFG.INPUT_STAGES)
+        empty_state = advance(empty_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        s_state = advance(s_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        _wait_service(bars.ds_full, ds_state)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        mma_ss(
+            grad,
+            _q_ds(slab).desc(),
+            _input(slab, input_empty_state.idx, 0, transposed=True).desc(),
+            nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_G0, cutlass.Float32),
+            accumulate=tile > lo,
+        )
+        bars.input_empty[input_empty_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        bars.q_ds_empty[ds_empty_state.idx].arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        ds_state = advance(ds_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        input_empty_state = advance(input_empty_state, CFG.INPUT_STAGES)
+        ds_empty_state = advance(ds_empty_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+    if hi > lo:
+        bars.final_grad.arrive(cta_group=CFG.CTA_MMA, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+    _wait_service(bars.q_score_empty, empty_state)
+    empty_state = advance(empty_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _stage_gradient(tmem_base, tmem_offset: cutlass.Constexpr[int], smem, live, dtype: cutlass.Constexpr, group: cutlass.Constexpr[int]):
+    # The second score group still participates in every readiness barrier,
+    # but D64 has no second 64-column gradient slab to read or store.
+    if cutlass.const_expr(group * CFG.GROUP_COLS < CFG.HEAD_DIM):
+        row = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.TILE_M
+        values = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(cutlass.Float32(0.0) for _ in range(CFG.GROUP_COLS)), cutlass.Float32)
+        if live:
+            values = tmem_load_tile(tmem_base + tmem_offset + group * CFG.GROUP_COLS, num_elems=CFG.GROUP_COLS).vec
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+        smem.base.subview(group * CFG.TILE_M * CFG.GROUP_COLS + row * CFG.GROUP_COLS).data_ptr().store_swizzled(
+            values.to(dtype), alignment=128, swizzle=_SWIZZLE
+        )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _compute_kv(
+    slab,
+    stats,
+    bars,
+    tmem_base,
+    owner_base,
+    lo,
+    hi,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    scale,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    group: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    window_left: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0,
+):
+    s_state = PipelineState.start()
+    dp_state = PipelineState.start()
+    stats_full_state = PipelineState.start()
+    stats_empty_state = PipelineState.start()
+    p_state = PipelineState.start()
+    ds_state = PipelineState.start()
+    for tile in cutlass.range(lo, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+        bars.s_full[s_state.idx].wait(s_state.phase)
+        bars.stats_full[stats_full_state.idx].wait(stats_full_state.phase)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        p0 = _kv_p_chunk(tmem_base, stats, owner_base, tile * CFG.TILE_N, sq, skv, scale, causal, dtype, group * CFG.GROUP_COLS, window_left)
+        p1 = _kv_p_chunk(
+            tmem_base, stats, owner_base, tile * CFG.TILE_N, sq, skv, scale, causal, dtype, group * CFG.GROUP_COLS + CFG.POINTWISE_COLS, window_left
+        )
+        nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.STORE)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+        bars.p_full[p_state.idx].arrive()
+        bars.dp_full[dp_state.idx].wait(dp_state.phase)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        _kv_ds_chunk(tmem_base, p0, stats, owner_base, tile * CFG.TILE_N, sq, skv, scale, causal, dtype, group * CFG.GROUP_COLS, window_left)
+        _kv_ds_chunk(
+            tmem_base, p1, stats, owner_base, tile * CFG.TILE_N, sq, skv, scale, causal, dtype, group * CFG.GROUP_COLS + CFG.POINTWISE_COLS, window_left
+        )
+        nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.STORE)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+        bars.stats_empty[stats_empty_state.idx].arrive()
+        bars.ds_full[ds_state.idx].arrive()
+        s_state = advance(s_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        dp_state = advance(dp_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        stats_full_state = advance(stats_full_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        stats_empty_state = advance(stats_empty_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        p_state = advance(p_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+        ds_state = advance(ds_state, CFG.SINGLE_STAGE)
+    if hi > lo:
+        bars.final_grad.wait(PipelineState.start().phase)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+    _stage_gradient(tmem_base, CFG.TMEM_G0, _operand(slab, CFG.RESIDENT0, CFG.TILE_M), hi > lo, dtype, group)
+    _stage_gradient(tmem_base, CFG.TMEM_G1, _operand(slab, CFG.RESIDENT1, CFG.TILE_M), hi > lo, dtype, group)
+    nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")

+            v64,

+            dv,

+    (dq_accum.iterator.raw_ptr() + dq_offset + 4).store(zero4, alignment=16)
+    do_values = (do.iterator.raw_ptr() + do_offset).load(count=ELEMENTS_PER_LANE, alignment=16)
+    o_values = (o.iterator.raw_ptr() + o_offset).load(count=ELEMENTS_PER_LANE, alignment=16)
+    pairs = []

+    return amax, _pack_fp8(ds), cutlass.Int32(0)
+

+@cute.jit
+def _st16(slab, off, values, i: cutlass.Constexpr[int], dtype: cutlass.Constexpr):
+    st_shared_v4(_view(slab, off, dtype, 4).data_ptr(), (values[i], values[i + 1], values[i + 2], values[i + 3]), dtype)
+

+@cute.jit
+def _store_chunks(slab, byte_offset, row, words, first: cutlass.Constexpr[int], count: cutlass.Constexpr[int], swz: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES):
+    for vec in cutlass.range_constexpr(count):
+        chunk = first + vec
+        if cutlass.const_expr(swz == CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES):
+            off = byte_offset + row * swz + ((row % 8) ^ chunk) * 16
+        else:
+            off = byte_offset + row * swz + (((row // 2) % 4) ^ chunk) * 16
+        _st16(slab, off, words, vec * 4, cutlass.Int32)

+@cute.jit
+def _softmax_tile(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    tmem_base,
+    lse,
+    delta,
+    row,
+    group,
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    hi,
+    qtile,
+    s_scale,
+    dp_scale,
+    delta_scale,
+    lse_shift,
+    phase,
+    ring_idx,
+    ring_phase,
+    stats,
+    amax,
+    fold: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    causal_mask: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    key_mask: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    window_mask: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+):
+    stat_next = _stat_load(lse, delta, row, group, (qtile + 1) * CFG.N, sq, batch, head)
+    _wait_tcgen(bars.s_done, phase)
+    address = tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_S + group * 64
+    a = _tmem_load(address, 32)
+    b = _tmem_load(address + 32, 32)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+    bars.s_free.arrive()
+    scores = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(a[i] for i in range(32)) + tuple(b[i] for i in range(32)), cutlass.Float32)
+    _wait(bars.stats_full[stats.idx], stats.phase)
+    p, p_words = _p_values(slab, scores, row, group, block, qtile, skv, stats.idx, s_scale, causal_mask, key_mask, window_mask)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(P_SMEM):
+        _wait(bars.p_empty[ring_idx], ring_phase ^ 1)
+        _store_chunks(slab, CFG.P + ring_idx * CFG.RING_BYTES, row, p_words, group * 4, 4)
+        nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+        bars.p_full[ring_idx].arrive()
+    else:
+        _wait_tcgen(bars.p_empty[ring_idx], ring_phase ^ 1)
+        _tmem_store(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_P + ring_idx * CFG.P_COLS + group * (CFG.P_COLS // 2), p_words)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.STORE)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+        bars.p_full[ring_idx].arrive()
+    _wait_tcgen(bars.dp_done, phase)
+    a = _tmem_load(address, 32)
+    b = _tmem_load(address + 32, 32)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+    bars.dp_empty.arrive()
+    dp = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(a[i] for i in range(32)) + tuple(b[i] for i in range(32)), cutlass.Float32)
+    amax, ds_words, ds_sf = _ds_values(slab, dp, group, stats.idx, p, dp_scale, amax, fold)
+    _wait(bars.ds_empty[ring_idx], ring_phase ^ 1)
+    _store_chunks(slab, CFG.DS + ring_idx * CFG.RING_BYTES, row, ds_words, group * 4, 4)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(MX):
+        _view(slab, CFG.SF_DS + ring_idx * 512 + (row % 32) * 16 + (row // 32) * 4 + group * 2, cutlass.Uint16, 1, alignment=2).subview(0).store(
+            cutlass.Uint16(ds_sf)
+        )
+    nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+    bars.ds_full[ring_idx].arrive()
+    stats = advance(stats, 2)
+    if qtile + 1 < hi:
+        _stat_publish(slab, bars, row, group, stats.idx, (qtile + 1) * CFG.N, sq, delta_scale, lse_shift, stat_next)
+    next_idx = ring_idx + 1
+    wrap = next_idx == CFG.P_STAGES
+    ring_idx = cutlass.Int32(arith.select(wrap.ir_value(), cutlass.Int32(0).ir_value(), next_idx.ir_value()))
+    ring_phase = cutlass.Int32(arith.select(wrap.ir_value(), (ring_phase ^ 1).ir_value(), ring_phase.ir_value()))
+    return phase ^ 1, ring_idx, ring_phase, stats, amax
+

+@cute.jit

+    for qtile in cutlass.range(diag_end, edge_start, 1, unroll=1):

+            ring_idx,
+            ring_phase,
+            stats,
+            amax,
+            fold,
+            False,
+            key_mask,
+        )
+    if cutlass.const_expr(WINDOW > 0):
+        for qtile in cutlass.range(edge_start, hi, 1, unroll=1):
+            phase, ring_idx, ring_phase, stats, amax = _softmax_tile(
+                slab,
+                bars,
+                tmem_base,
+                lse,
+                delta,
+                row,
+                group,
+                block,
+                head,
+                batch,

+    return phase, ring_idx, ring_phase, stats, amax

+@cute.jit
+def _softmax_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    lse,
+    delta,
+    descale_q,
+    descale_k,
+    descale_v,
+    descale_s,
+    descale_do,
+    scale_s_t,
+    scale_dp_t,
+    amax_dp: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    nk,
+    nheads,
+    batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    scale,
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    ratio: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 1,
+):
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(CFG.SOFTMAX_REGS, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.INCREASE)
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    row = tid % CFG.M
+    group = tid // CFG.M
+    if cutlass.const_expr(MX):
+        s_scale = scale
+        lse_shift = cutlass.Float32(8.0)
+        delta_scale = scale * cutlass.Float32(1.0 / 256.0)
+        dp_scale = delta_scale
+    else:
+        s_scale = scale * _scalar(descale_q) * _scalar(descale_k)
+        scale_s = _scalar(scale_s_t)
+        scale_dp = _scalar(scale_dp_t)
+        lse_shift = cute.math.log2(scale_s)
+        delta_scale = scale * _scalar(descale_s) * scale_dp
+        dp_scale = delta_scale * _scalar(descale_v) * _scalar(descale_do)
+    fold = cutlass.const_expr(amax_dp is not None)
+    amax = opaque_f32_zero()
+    phase = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    ring_idx = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    ring_phase = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    stats = PipelineState.start()
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        if cutlass.const_expr(not causal):
+            _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        lo, hi = _bounds(block, sq, causal)
+        for r in cutlass.range(0, ratio, 1, unroll=1):
+            hq = head * ratio + r
+            if lo < hi:
+                _stat_publish(
+                    slab, bars, row, group, stats.idx, lo * CFG.N, sq, delta_scale, lse_shift, _stat_load(lse, delta, row, group, lo * CFG.N, sq, batch, hq)
+                )
+            if (block + 1) * CFG.M > skv:
+                phase, ring_idx, ring_phase, stats, amax = _softmax_tiles(
+                    slab,
+                    bars,
+                    tmem_base,
+                    lse,
+                    delta,
+                    row,
+                    group,
+                    block,
+                    hq,
+                    batch,
+                    sq,
+                    skv,
+                    lo,
+                    hi,
+                    s_scale,
+                    dp_scale,
+                    delta_scale,
+                    lse_shift,
+                    phase,
+                    ring_idx,
+                    ring_phase,
+                    stats,
+                    amax,
+                    fold,
+                    causal,
+                    True,
+                )
+            else:
+                phase, ring_idx, ring_phase, stats, amax = _softmax_tiles(
+                    slab,
+                    bars,
+                    tmem_base,
+                    lse,
+                    delta,
+                    row,
+                    group,
+                    block,
+                    hq,
+                    batch,
+                    sq,
+                    skv,
+                    lo,
+                    hi,
+                    s_scale,
+                    dp_scale,
+                    delta_scale,
+                    lse_shift,
+                    phase,
+                    ring_idx,
+                    ring_phase,
+                    stats,
+                    amax,
+                    fold,
+                    causal,
+                    False,
+                )
+        if cutlass.const_expr(causal):
+            _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        block, head, batch, valid, sched_state = _next_tile(sched, bars, sched_state, nheads, nk, causal, swizzle, batch_heads)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(fold):
+        _fold_amax(amax * (cutlass.Float32(1.0) / scale_dp), amax_dp)

+@cute.jit
+def _native_epilogue(
+    slab, tmem_base, bars, row, live, grad_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr, dk: cutlass.Constexpr[bool], factor, out_scale, amax, fold: cutlass.Constexpr[bool]
+):
+    plane = CFG.TMEM_DK if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else CFG.TMEM_DV
+    cols = CFG.DQK if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else CFG.DV
+    fp8_out = cutlass.const_expr(grad_dtype == FP8)
+    base = CFG.OUT + (CFG.M * CFG.DV * _bpe(grad_dtype) if cutlass.const_expr(dk) else 0)
+    for half in cutlass.range_constexpr(cols // 64):
+        vals = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(cutlass.Float32(0.0) for _ in range(64)), cutlass.Float32)
+        if live:
+            vals = _tmem_load(tmem_base + plane + half * 64, 64)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+        scaled = _scale_pairs([vals[i] for i in range(64)], factor)
+        if cutlass.const_expr(fold):
+            amax = fmax_f32(amax, abs_max_tree(scaled))
+        if cutlass.const_expr(fp8_out):
+            words = _pack_fp8(_scale_pairs(scaled, out_scale))
+            if cutlass.const_expr(dk and CFG.QK_SWZ == CFG.NARROW_SWIZZLE_BYTES):
+                _store_chunks(slab, base + half * CFG.M * CFG.NARROW_SWIZZLE_BYTES, row, words, 0, 4, CFG.NARROW_SWIZZLE_BYTES)
+            else:
+                _store_chunks(slab, base + (half // 2) * CFG.M * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES, row, words, (half % 2) * 4, 4)
+        else:
+            words = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(fp32_to_fp16(scaled[2 * i], scaled[2 * i + 1], dtype=grad_dtype) for i in range(32)), cutlass.Int32)
+            _store_chunks(slab, base + half * CFG.M * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES, row, words, 0, 8)
+    nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+    nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(dk):
+        bars.dk_full.arrive()
+    else:
+        bars.dv_full.arrive()
+    return amax
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _epilogue_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    descale_q,
+    descale_s,
+    descale_do,
+    descale_dp,
+    scale_dk_t,
+    scale_dv_t,
+    amax_dk: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    amax_dv: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    nk,
+    nheads,
+    batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    grad_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(CFG.EPILOGUE_REGS, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.DECREASE)
+    tid = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0]
+    row = tid % CFG.M
+    if cutlass.const_expr(MX):
+        dk_factor = opaque_f32_zero() + cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+        dv_factor = opaque_f32_zero() + cutlass.Float32(1.0 / 256.0)
+    else:
+        dk_factor = _scalar(descale_dp) * _scalar(descale_q)
+        dv_factor = _scalar(descale_s) * _scalar(descale_do)
+    dk_out = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+    dv_out = cutlass.Float32(1.0)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(grad_dtype == FP8):
+        dk_out = _scalar(scale_dk_t)
+        dv_out = _scalar(scale_dv_t)
+    fold_k = cutlass.const_expr(amax_dk is not None)
+    fold_v = cutlass.const_expr(amax_dv is not None)
+    amax_k = opaque_f32_zero()
+    amax_v = opaque_f32_zero()
+    done_phase = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    out_empty = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        lo, hi = _bounds(block, sq, causal)
+        _wait_tcgen(bars.dvk_done, done_phase)
+        done_phase = done_phase ^ 1
+        _wait(bars.dvk_empty, out_empty.phase)
+        out_empty = advance(out_empty, 1)
+        amax_v = _native_epilogue(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, lo < hi, grad_dtype, False, dv_factor, dv_out, amax_v, fold_v)
+        amax_k = _native_epilogue(slab, tmem_base, bars, row, lo < hi, grad_dtype, True, dk_factor, dk_out, amax_k, fold_k)
+        block, head, batch, valid, sched_state = _next_tile(sched, bars, sched_state, nheads, nk, causal, swizzle, batch_heads)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(fold_v):
+        _fold_amax(amax_v, amax_dv)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(fold_k):
+        _fold_amax(amax_k, amax_dk)
+

+@cute.jit
+def _load_t(slab, bars, qt_desc, dot_desc, sf_qt_desc, sf_dot_desc, q_idx, q_phase, do_idx, do_phase, qtile, plane, hq, batch):
+    _wait(bars.q_used[q_idx], q_phase ^ 1)
+    bars.qt_full[q_idx].arrive(n_bytes=CFG.QT_TX, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+    tma_load_tile(
+        _operand(slab, CFG.Q + q_idx * CFG.Q_STAGE_BYTES, FP8, CFG.N, CFG.DQK, swz=CFG.QK_SWZ),
+        GmemTileTma(qt_desc)(0, qtile * CFG.N, hq, batch),
+        bars.qt_full[q_idx].smem_ptr,
+    )
+    _load_sf_t(slab, CFG.SF_QT + q_idx * CFG.SF_QT_BYTES, sf_qt_desc, qtile, plane, bars.qt_full[q_idx].smem_ptr)
+    _wait(bars.do_used[do_idx], do_phase ^ 1)
+    bars.dot_full[do_idx].arrive(n_bytes=CFG.DOT_TX, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+    tma_load_tile(
+        _operand(slab, CFG.DO + do_idx * CFG.DO_STAGE_BYTES, FP8, CFG.N, CFG.DV, swz=CFG.V_SWZ),
+        GmemTileTma(dot_desc)(0, qtile * CFG.N, hq, batch),
+        bars.dot_full[do_idx].smem_ptr,
+    )
+    tma_load_tile(
+        _sf_tile(slab, CFG.SF_DOT + do_idx * CFG.SF_V_BYTES, CFG.SF_V_BYTES), GmemTileTma(sf_dot_desc)(0, 0, qtile, plane, 0), bars.dot_full[do_idx].smem_ptr
+    )

+@cute.jit
+def _grad_products(slab, bars, tmem_base, do_state, q_state, qt_state, ring, dvdesc, dkdesc, dv, dk, accumulate):
+    _wait_tcgen(bars.p_full[ring.idx], ring.phase)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(TS):
+        _wait_tcgen(bars.dot_full[do_state.idx], do_state.phase)

+def _store_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    dk_desc,
+    dv_desc,
+    block,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    nk,
+    nheads,
+    batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    grad_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    dk_swz = CFG.QK_SWZ if cutlass.const_expr(grad_dtype == FP8) else CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES
+    out_state = PipelineState.start()
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        _wait(bars.dv_full, out_state.phase)
+        tma_store_tile(_operand(slab, CFG.OUT, grad_dtype, CFG.M, CFG.DV), GmemTileTma(dv_desc)(0, block * CFG.M, head, batch))
+        _wait(bars.dk_full, out_state.phase)

+            _operand(slab, CFG.OUT + CFG.M * CFG.DV * _bpe(grad_dtype), grad_dtype, CFG.M, CFG.DQK, swz=dk_swz),
+            GmemTileTma(dk_desc)(0, block * CFG.M, head, batch),
+        )
+        out_state = advance(out_state, 1)
+        tma_store_commit()
+        tma_store_wait(0)
+        bars.dvk_empty.arrive()
+        bars.k_empty.arrive()
+        block, head, batch, valid, sched_state = _next_tile(sched, bars, sched_state, nheads, nk, causal, swizzle, batch_heads)

+def _scheduler_loop(bars, sched):
+    state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        _wait(bars.sched_empty[state.idx], state.phase)
+        if nvvm.elect_sync():
+            bars.sched_full[state.idx].arrive(n_bytes=16)
+            nvvm.clusterlaunchcontrol_try_cancel(sched.tile_id_smem.subview(state.idx * 8), bars.sched_full[state.idx].smem_ptr, multicast=1)
+        nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+        nvvm.bar_warp_sync(cute.arch.FULL_MASK)

+        _, _, valid = read_clc_payload(sched, state.idx * 8, warp_broadcast=True)
+        state = advance(state, CFG.SCHED_STAGES)

+@cute.jit
+def _epilogue_loop(
+    slab,
+    bars,
+    sched,
+    tmem_base,
+    descale_k,
+    descale_dp,
+    scale_dq_t,
+    amax_dq: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    qtile,
+    head,
+    batch,
+    sq,
+    skv,
+    nq,
+    nheads,
+    batch_heads: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    swizzle: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    causal: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    grad_dtype: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    nvvm.setmaxregister(CFG.EPILOGUE_REGS, nvvm.SetMaxRegisterAction.DECREASE)
+    row = cute.arch.thread_idx()[0] % CFG.M
+    fp8_out = cutlass.const_expr(grad_dtype == FP8)
+    split = cutlass.const_expr(OUT_SPLIT and not fp8_out)
+    factor = opaque_f32_zero() + cutlass.Float32(1.0) if MX else _scalar(descale_dp) * _scalar(descale_k)

+    if cutlass.const_expr(fp8_out):

+    fold = cutlass.const_expr(amax_dq is not None)
+    amax = opaque_f32_zero()
+    done_phase = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    empty_phase = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    sched_state = PipelineState.start()
+    valid = cutlass.Int32(1)
+    while valid != 0:
+        _credit(bars.sched_empty[sched_state.idx])
+        _wait_tcgen(bars.dq_done, done_phase)
+        done_phase = done_phase ^ 1
+        _wait(bars.out_empty, empty_phase)
+        empty_phase = empty_phase ^ 1
+        for third in cutlass.range_constexpr(CFG.DQK // 64):
+            vals = _tmem_load(tmem_base + CFG.TMEM_DQ + third * 64, 64)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_wait(kind=nvvm.Tcgen05Wait.LOAD)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(third == CFG.DQK // 64 - 1):
+                nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.BEFORE_THREAD_SYNC)
+                bars.dq_read.arrive()
+            if cutlass.const_expr(split and third == 2):
+                nvvm.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+                bars.out_full.arrive()
+                _wait(bars.out_empty, empty_phase)
+                empty_phase = empty_phase ^ 1
+            scaled = _scale_pairs([vals[i] for i in range(64)], factor)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(fold):

+                    slab, CFG.OUT + third * CFG.M * CFG.NARROW_SWIZZLE_BYTES, row, _pack_fp8(_scale_pairs(scaled, out_scale)), 0, 4, CFG.NARROW_SWIZZLE_BYTES

+            elif cutlass.const_expr(fp8_out):
+                _store_chunks(slab, CFG.OUT + (third // 2) * CFG.M * CFG.SWIZZLE_BYTES, row, _pack_fp8(_scale_pairs(scaled, out_scale)), (third % 2) * 4, 4)

+                words = cutlass.Vector.from_elements(tuple(fp32_to_fp16(scaled[2 * i], scaled[2 * i + 1], dtype=grad_dtype) for i in range(32)), cutlass.Int32)

+        bars.out_full.arrive()
+        qtile, head, batch, valid, sched_state = _next_tile(sched, bars, sched_state, nheads, nq, causal, swizzle, batch_heads)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(fold):
+        _fold_amax(amax, amax_dq)

+from typing import Optional

+@cute.jit
+def _scalar(tensor):
+    return cutlass.Float32(cutlass.make_array_view(tensor)[0])

+@cute.jit
+def _reset(tensor: Optional[cute.Tensor]):
+    if cutlass.const_expr(tensor is not None):

+@cute.kernel
+def dot_do_o_d192_fp8_kernel(
+    o: cute.Tensor,
+    do: cute.Tensor,
+    delta: cute.Tensor,
+    descale_o: cute.Tensor,
+    descale_do: cute.Tensor,
+    amax_dq: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    amax_dk: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    amax_dv: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+    amax_dp: Optional[cute.Tensor],
+):
+    """Eight rows per CTA: the true-unit O ."""
+    block, batch, head = cute.arch.block_idx()
+    tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    if block == 0 and batch == 0 and head == 0 and tid == 0:
+        _reset(amax_dq)
+        _reset(amax_dk)
+        _reset(amax_dv)
+        _reset(amax_dp)
+    row = cutlass.Int64(block) * ROWS_PER_CTA + cutlass.Int64(tid // LANES_PER_ROW)
+    lane = tid % LANES_PER_ROW
+    column = cutlass.Int64(lane) * ELEMENTS_PER_LANE
+    valid = row < cutlass.Int64(o.shape[1])
+    io_row = cutlass.Int64(arith.select(valid.ir_value(), row.ir_value(), cutlass.Int64(o.shape[1] - 1).ir_value()))
+    o_offset = (
+        cutlass.Int64(batch) * cutlass.Int64(o.stride[0]) + io_row * cutlass.Int64(o.stride[1]) + cutlass.Int64(head) * cutlass.Int64(o.stride[2]) + column
+    )
+    do_offset = (
+        cutlass.Int64(batch) * cutlass.Int64(do.stride[0]) + io_row * cutlass.Int64(do.stride[1]) + cutlass.Int64(head) * cutlass.Int64(do.stride[2]) + column
+    )
+    delta_offset = (
+        cutlass.Int64(batch) * cutlass.Int64(delta.stride[0]) + cutlass.Int64(head) * cutlass.Int64(delta.stride[1]) + row * cutlass.Int64(delta.stride[2])
+    )
+    do_values = (do.iterator.raw_ptr() + do_offset).load(count=ELEMENTS_PER_LANE, alignment=8)
+    o_values = (o.iterator.raw_ptr() + o_offset).load(count=ELEMENTS_PER_LANE, alignment=8)
+    pairs = []
+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(ELEMENTS_PER_LANE // 2):
+        high = cute.math.mul(do_values[2 * j + 1].to(cutlass.Float32), o_values[2 * j + 1].to(cutlass.Float32), rounding=RN, ftz=True)

+    dot = cute.math.add(pairs[0], pairs[1], rounding=RN, ftz=True)
+    dot = cute.math.add(dot, pairs[2], rounding=RN, ftz=True)
+    dot = cute.math.add(dot, pairs[3], rounding=RN, ftz=True)
+    for step in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        peer = nvvm.shfl_sync(thread_mask=0xFFFFFFFF, val=dot, offset=1 << (3 - step), mask_and_clamp=0x1F, kind=nvvm.Shfl.BFLY)

+    )

+"""SDPA backward stage 2, d_qk = d_v = 512, bf16/fp16, SM100 (Blackwell) -- the 2x2-datapath twin.
+
+Produces the ``S`` and ``dS`` workspaces that stage 3's three GEMMs reduce into
+dV / dK / dQ.  Computes no gradient itself::
+
+    S  = exp2(attn_scale_log2e * S_acc  - lse * log2e)      then masked to 0.0
+    dS = (attn_scale_for_dS * dS_acc - do_dot * attn_scale_in) * S
+
+Same ABI, workspace format, LSE / do_dot contract and mask-after-exp2 rule as
+the cga4x1 role-split sibling ``bprop_d512_f16.py``; what differs is the
+datapath:
+
+**One FUSED pipeline per ``cta_group::2`` pair** (CGA_M=4 -> pairs {0,1}, {2,3}):
+
+    every CTA   64 q rows; BMM1  mma_ss(Q  from SMEM, K from SMEM) -> S_acc  (collective M = 128)
+                           BMM2  mma_ss(dO from SMEM, V from SMEM) -> dS_acc
+                softmax -> S in registers ; dS = f(S) in the SAME lane ; bf16 S, dS -> workspace
+
+The 2x2 D image of ``tcgen05.mma.cta_group::2`` at M = 128: D row m, column n
+lands in TMEM lane ``(m % 64) + 64 * (n // 64)``, column ``n % 64`` -- a 64 x 128
+fp32 accumulator is 64 columns over all 128 lanes, so compute warp w holds rows
+``32 * (w % 2) ..+31`` of kv-column half ``w // 2`` of BOTH accumulators at the
+same lane, and the dS product never leaves the lane.  No fp32 S ship, no DSMEM,
+no UTCCP, no alias seam, no named barrier 8.
+
+**The cluster stays (4,1,1) and covers 256 q rows** (``CLUSTER_Q_ROWS``), so
+stage 3's ``causal_gran``, the THD unit and ``READ_TILE_ARRIVERS`` are what the
+4x1 kernel has.  The two pairs share K / V by TMA multicast: d is streamed in
+``D_CHUNK = 64`` column chunks and chunk ``c`` of a kv tile is issued by the
+pair with ``pair_id == c & 1`` to CTAs ``{c, c ^ 2}`` (mask ``5 << cta_in_pair``,
+``group = cta_2``); every byte that lands in a CTA completes on ITS pair
+leader's ``mb_tma_ring_full`` (destination-pair-leader routing, probe
+``mcast_twin`` 2026-10-01), so ONLY pair leaders arm ``expect_tx`` and ONLY the
+leader's MMA warp waits it.  A ring slot is refilled only after BOTH pairs'
+MMAs have read it: ``mb_tma_ring_empty`` has init 2 and both pair leaders'
+``tcgen05.commit`` carry mask 0xF.  Each shared ``ring_full`` has init 4:
+its leader's ``expect_tx`` arrival plus one ACK from each other CTA, sent only
+after that CTA observes its local ``ring_empty`` phase.  This gates both MMAs
+and therefore the next empty release on all four observations.  Without ACKs,
+a passive follower can miss a phase while its slot is recycled (parity ABA).
+
+**There is no online softmax.**  LSE arrives as a kernel input, so there is no
+running max, no rescale, no alpha/stats ship, no correction warp -- and no
+exchange between the two warps that share a row.
+
+**The mask is applied to S AFTER exp2, with 0.0 (not -inf before).**  dS is a
+product with S, so zeroing S zeroes dS for free.  Do not move it.
+
+**Every mbarrier init count is a named ``CFG`` constant, and the comment beside
+it names the ARRIVE SITES it counts and the guard each one fires under.**  Keep
+that pairing when changing either side: a mismatch is an intermittent hang whose
+output is correct on every launch that completes.
+
+**Measured (2026-10-01, B200 sm_100a at 1155 MHz, DSL 4.7.0, CUPTI medians of 30
+trials per slot, L2 flushed, one process per slot, every slot started AND ended
+with an empty ``nvidia-smi`` compute-apps list, A/B/A against the 4x1 role split;
+MEDIANS over 3 slots per arm, ``lane_d512_bprop/fix/ab_table_fix_medians.md``).**
+The October 1 polling version, before the observer ACK fix (``POLL_TIGHT_ITERS``
+128 / ``POLL_SLEEP_NS`` 128), B=1 H=128 d=512 bf16:
+
+    dense  S=8192  stage 2  42049 -> 40861 us  (+2.9 %;  6855 -> 6661 clk per SM per kv tile, floor 2304)
+                   whole bwd 72525 -> 73191 us (-0.9 %)
+    causal S=8192  stage 2  19092 -> 18222 us  (+4.8 %;  6036 -> 5761 clk/tile)   whole 36042 -> 35326 (+2.0 %)
+    dense  S=2048  stage 2   2073 ->  2264 us  (-8.4 %;  5408 -> 5904 clk/tile)   whole  3873 ->  4065 (-4.7 %)
+
+The pre-fix kernel (every wait parked, the one that hangs under GPU sharing)
+measured 42097 -> 39166 (+7.5 %) dense 8K, 18565 -> 17817 (+4.2 %) causal 8K and
+2072 -> 2111 (-1.9 %) dense 2K on the lane's slots (``fix/ab_table_medians.md``;
+its first dense8k 4x1 slot, 45063 us, and three non-exclusive slots are flagged
+there -- the lane's earlier MEANS +9.3 / +5.9 % absorbed them).  So the poll costs
+~3-4 % at S=8192 and ~7 % at S=2048 against the parked twin: the two polling
+warps share their SMSPs with compute warps 0 / 1 (a tight poll cost 2.2x, see
+``_poll_wait``).  Slot-to-slot noise is +-3 %, so the S=8192 gate (>= +3 % on
+both masks) is NOT met by this kernel (dense +2.9 %), and S=2048 regresses
+further (the per-tile Q + dO prologue, 128 KiB per CTA and not double-buffered,
+is paid over only 16 kv tiles, now plus the poll).  Stage 2 runs at ~2.9x its
+MMA floor: the fused datapath removed ~200-300 of the ~4500 clk/tile of
+overhead, so the role split's S ship was NOT what held the 4x1 at ~6900
+clk/tile; the remaining gap is not attributed here (levers to A/B: ``d_chunk``
+128 x 2 stages, ``stages_acc`` 4, a deeper ring on Rubin).  Numerics: bitwise
+identical to the role split (S / dS workspace and dQ / dK / dV, ``torch.equal``
+on int16 views) on dense, causal, SWA, bottom-right, GQA, fp16.
+
+**The GPU-sharing hang: historical polling experiment and observer fix.**
+The October 1 heartbeat dump (``lane_d512_bprop/fix/HANDOFF2.md``,
+``fix/e2_heartbeat_wf0.log``) found a passive follower at ``ring_empty[0]``
+while the other CTAs had advanced five chunks.  Sleeping and hint-less
+``try_wait`` forms hung within 2-74 launches; polling completed 200/200 and
+300/300.  Those finite passes did not establish correctness or prove a lost
+hardware wake-up.  Polling also leaves the observer lifecycle unordered:
+a local empty barrier can advance twice before the passive CTA observes it.
+
+The shared-ring ACK protocol above preserves every CTA's empty wait and
+prevents that phase overrun.  Removing the passive wait is not sufficient:
+the multicast still advances that CTA's barrier object, whose phase must be
+observed before reuse.  Keep polling and the existing diagnostics; the ACKs
+supply the missing ordering.  ``KV_SHARE = 1`` keeps its existing pair-local
+protocol.  Runnable detectors:
+``test_sdpa_bwd_dsl_sm100.py::test_stage2_2x2_waits_for_delayed_empty_observer``
+and ``test_sdpa_bwd_d512_sm107.py::test_chain_waits_for_delayed_empty_observer``
+delay a passive observer at a reused slot, then check gradients and capture /
+replay.  The natural GPU-sharing positive tests remain.  The old must-hang
+``wait_form = 4`` negative control was probabilistic and is replaced by the
+delayed-observer regression.  ``debug_heartbeat`` / ``debug_dump_addr`` and
+all wait-form levers remain available for diagnosis.  Performance and a
+default-dispatch change are separate decisions.

+@cute.jit
+def _poll_wait(mb, phase):
+    """A wait that NEVER parks the warp on the barrier: ``mbarrier.test_wait.parity`` until the phase flips, with a timer
+    back-off after ``POLL_TIGHT_ITERS`` tests.
+
+    The form every barrier whose completing event is issued from OUTSIDE the pair must take (``ring_empty``: the partner
+    leader's ``tcgen05.commit`` multicast; ``ring_full``: the partner's TMA ``complete_tx``).  Measured 2026-10-01 under
+    GPU time-slicing: a warp parked in NANOSLEEP.SYNCS (the ``try_wait`` retry of tile_dsl ``wait()``, with the 1 ns or
+    the 10 ms hint, and the hint-less spin alike) on such a barrier can miss the wake-up and the cluster hangs; this
+    poll never does (``lane_d512_bprop/fix/HANDOFF2.md``).
+
+    The kernel's ONE call of the shared ``tile_dsl.barrier.wait_poll`` (an inline-PTX ``mbarrier.test_wait.parity`` loop
+    with the timer back-off; the DSL's ``nvvm.mbarrier_test_wait`` wrapper raises a TypeError on 4.7.0) in THIS kernel's shape
+    (``POLL_TIGHT_ITERS`` / ``POLL_SLEEP_NS``); ``_wait_plain`` WAIT_FORM 0 and 2 call it."""
+    wait_poll(mb, phase, tight_iters=POLL_TIGHT_ITERS, sleep_ns=POLL_SLEEP_NS)

+@cute.jit
+def _wait_plain(mb, phase, poll: bool = False):
+    """The kernel's mbarrier wait: ``poll`` (a Python constant) marks a barrier released from outside the pair, which
+    under the shipped ``WAIT_FORM`` 0 takes :func:`_poll_wait` while every pair-local barrier takes tile_dsl ``wait()``.
+    ``WAIT_FORM`` 1-4 are diagnostic arms applied to every wait (see the config comment)."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(CFG.WAIT_FORM == 0):
+        if cutlass.const_expr(poll):
+            _poll_wait(mb, phase)
+        else:
+            wait(mb, phase)
+    elif cutlass.const_expr(CFG.WAIT_FORM == 1):
+        wait(mb, phase, spin=True)
+    elif cutlass.const_expr(CFG.WAIT_FORM == 2):
+        _poll_wait(mb, phase)
+    elif cutlass.const_expr(CFG.WAIT_FORM == 3):
+        while not nvvm.mbarrier_try_wait_parity(mb, phase, time_limit=10_000_000):
+            pass
+    else:
+        # 4: the pre-fix kernel -- the sleeping wait on the ring barriers too (the negative control of the contention test).
+        wait(mb, phase)

+@cute.jit
+def _wait_b(mb, phase, dbg, bar_id: int, idx, aux0, aux1, aux2, aux3, aux4, poll: bool = False):
+    """``_wait_plain(mb, phase, poll)``; with the bounded-wait lever armed, bounded by ``_DBG_WAIT_NS`` of %globaltimer ->
+    record -> wait on; with the heartbeat armed, the record (status WAITING) goes out BEFORE the unmodified wait and the
+    status flips to RUNNING after it; with the attribution lever (``_DBG_CLK``) armed, the UNMODIFIED wait is bracketed by
+    two %clock64 reads and the elected lane adds the delta to this warp's bucket for ``bar_id`` (plus one to its blocked
+    count when the wait took more than DBG_CLK_BLOCKED_THRESH clk)."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(not _DBG):
+        _wait_plain(mb, phase, poll)
+    elif cutlass.const_expr(_DBG_HEARTBEAT):
+        _dbg_record(dbg, DBG_STATUS_WAITING, bar_id, idx, phase, aux0, aux1, aux2, aux3, aux4, cutlass.Int64(0))
+        _wait_plain(mb, phase, poll)
+        if nvvm.elect_sync():
+            dbg.arr[dbg.slot + cutlass.Int32(DBG_W_STATUS)] = cutlass.Int32(DBG_STATUS_RUNNING)
+    elif cutlass.const_expr(_DBG_CLK):
+        # The production wait, bracketed by two clock reads; the elected lane accumulates into this warp's SMEM slice.
+        t0 = cute.arch.clock64()
+        _wait_plain(mb, phase, poll)
+        dt = cute.arch.clock64() - t0
+        if nvvm.elect_sync():
+            i = dbg.cslot + cutlass.Int32(DBG_CLK_WAIT_BASE + bar_id)
+            dbg.clk[i] = dbg.clk[i] + dt
+            if dt > cutlass.Int64(DBG_CLK_BLOCKED_THRESH):
+                j = dbg.cslot + cutlass.Int32(DBG_CLK_BLOCKED_BASE + bar_id)
+                dbg.clk[j] = dbg.clk[j] + cutlass.Int64(1)
+    else:
+        t0 = cute.arch.globaltimer()
+        done = cutlass.Int32(0)
+        timed_out = cutlass.Int32(0)
+        while done == cutlass.Int32(0):
+            if nvvm.mbarrier_try_wait_parity(mb, phase, time_limit=WAIT_TIMEOUT):
+                done = cutlass.Int32(1)
+            elif cute.arch.globaltimer() - t0 > cutlass.Int64(_DBG_WAIT_NS):
+                done = cutlass.Int32(1)
+                timed_out = cutlass.Int32(1)

+@cute.jit
+def _clk_add(dbg, word: int, dt):
+    """Attribution lever: the elected lane adds ``dt`` clk to this warp's SMEM slot ``word`` (its own slice: no atomics)."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(_DBG_CLK):
+        if nvvm.elect_sync():
+            i = dbg.cslot + cutlass.Int32(word)
+            dbg.clk[i] = dbg.clk[i] + dt
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _dbg_exit(dbg, tile_no, kv_total):
+    """This warp left its persistent loop and every drain.  Under the attribution lever (the primary branch): close the body
+    clock and its %globaltimer span, record the tile counts and write the warp's 32 x Int64 slice out.  Under the bounded /
+    heartbeat levers: status EXITED (a warp that timed out never gets here)."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(_DBG_CLK):
+        if nvvm.elect_sync():
+            i0 = dbg.cslot
+            dbg.clk[i0] = cute.arch.clock64() - dbg.clk[i0]
+            dbg.clk[i0 + cutlass.Int32(DBG_CLK_BODY_NS)] = cute.arch.globaltimer() - dbg.clk[i0 + cutlass.Int32(DBG_CLK_BODY_NS)]
+            dbg.clk[i0 + cutlass.Int32(DBG_CLK_TILES)] = cutlass.Int64(tile_no)
+            dbg.clk[i0 + cutlass.Int32(DBG_CLK_KV_TOTAL)] = cutlass.Int64(kv_total)
+            for _w in cutlass.range_constexpr(DBG_CLK_WORDS):
+                dbg.arr[dbg.slot + cutlass.Int32(_w)] = dbg.clk[i0 + cutlass.Int32(_w)]
+    elif cutlass.const_expr(_DBG):
+        if nvvm.elect_sync():
+            dbg.arr[dbg.slot + cutlass.Int32(DBG_W_STATUS)] = cutlass.Int32(DBG_STATUS_EXITED)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _dbg_store64(dbg, word: int, raw):
+    dbg.arr[dbg.slot + cutlass.Int32(word)] = cutlass.Int32(raw & cutlass.Int64(0xFFFFFFFF))
+    dbg.arr[dbg.slot + cutlass.Int32(word + 1)] = cutlass.Int32(raw >> cutlass.Int64(32))
+

+@cute.jit
+def _wait_stg(bars, smem_state, dbg, kv_loop, q_block, tile_no, stg_total):
+    """The TMA-STG warp's ``smem_full`` wait.  Plain ``_wait_b`` unless heartbeat AND a wait budget are both armed: then
+    this one wait is bounded and, on timeout, snapshots the CTA's barrier words (see DBG_STATUS_SNAPSHOT) -- the
+    evidence that tells a lost arrive (pending count still owed) from a sleeping waiter that missed a completed phase."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(not (_DBG_HEARTBEAT and _DBG_BOUNDED)):
+        _wait_b(
+            bars.mb_smem_full[smem_state.idx].smem_ptr,
+            smem_state.phase,
+            dbg,
+            DBG_BAR_SMEM_FULL,
+            smem_state.idx,
+            kv_loop,
+            cutlass.Int32(DBG_NONE),
+            q_block,
+            tile_no,
+            stg_total,
+        )
+    else:
+        mb = bars.mb_smem_full[smem_state.idx].smem_ptr
+        _dbg_record(
+            dbg,
+            DBG_STATUS_WAITING,
+            DBG_BAR_SMEM_FULL,
+            smem_state.idx,
+            smem_state.phase,
+            kv_loop,
+            cutlass.Int32(DBG_NONE),
+            q_block,
+            tile_no,
+            stg_total,
+            cutlass.Int64(0),
+        )
+        t0 = cute.arch.globaltimer()
+        done = cutlass.Int32(0)
+        timed_out = cutlass.Int32(0)
+        while done == cutlass.Int32(0):
+            if nvvm.mbarrier_try_wait_parity(mb, smem_state.phase, time_limit=WAIT_TIMEOUT):
+                done = cutlass.Int32(1)
+            elif cute.arch.globaltimer() - t0 > cutlass.Int64(_DBG_WAIT_NS):
+                done = cutlass.Int32(1)
+                timed_out = cutlass.Int32(1)
+        if timed_out == cutlass.Int32(1):
+            if nvvm.elect_sync():
+                for _s in cutlass.range_constexpr(min(CFG.STAGES_KV, 4)):
+                    _dbg_store64(dbg, 2 + 2 * _s, bars.mb_tma_ring_empty[_s].smem_ptr.load())
+                _dbg_store64(dbg, 10, bars.mb_tmem_dealloc.smem_ptr.load())
+                dbg.arr[dbg.slot + cutlass.Int32(12)] = cutlass.Int32(bars.mb_acc_empty[0].smem_ptr.load() & cutlass.Int64(0xFFFFFFFF))
+                dbg.arr[dbg.slot + cutlass.Int32(13)] = cutlass.Int32(bars.mb_smem_full[0].smem_ptr.load() & cutlass.Int64(0xFFFFFFFF))
+                dbg.arr[dbg.slot + cutlass.Int32(14)] = kv_loop
+                dbg.arr[dbg.slot + cutlass.Int32(15)] = cutlass.Int32(dbg.cta_id_x)
+                dbg.arr[dbg.slot + cutlass.Int32(DBG_W_STATUS)] = cutlass.Int32(DBG_STATUS_SNAPSHOT)
+            _wait_plain(mb, smem_state.phase)
+        if nvvm.elect_sync():
+            dbg.arr[dbg.slot + cutlass.Int32(DBG_W_STATUS)] = cutlass.Int32(DBG_STATUS_RUNNING)

+@cute.jit
+def _rt_desc(desc_words, slot):
+    """Pointer to one 128-byte runtime TMA descriptor in the setup array (the packed-total clamp, issue #624)."""
+    return (desc_words.iterator.raw_ptr() + slot * cutlass.Int32(_TENSOR_MAP_QWORDS)).tospace(cutlass.AddressSpace.generic)

+@cute.jit
+def _kv_tile_bounds(q_block, cta_id_x, seqlen_q, seqlen_kv, n_kv):
+    """The kv TILE range this cluster visits, plus where the mask starts biting.
+
+    Keyed on the CLUSTER's q span (``CLUSTER_Q_ROWS`` rows from ``(q_block - cta_id_x) * TILE_M``), not the
+    CTA's: every barrier here is a cross-CTA protocol whose trip count must match on all four CTAs -- and
+    the cross-pair K / V ring makes the two PAIRS lock-step too, so all four must agree.  The CTA holding
+    the earlier rows then computes a few fully-masked tiles; the per-cell mask zeroes them.
+
+    Dense folds to the whole range at trace time.  Returns ``(left, unmasked_lo, unmasked_hi, right)``;
+    only ``[unmasked_lo, unmasked_hi)`` is guaranteed free of masked cells.
+    """
+    if cutlass.const_expr(not _MASKED):
+        return cutlass.Int32(0), cutlass.Int32(0), n_kv, n_kv
+    cluster_q_row = (q_block - cta_id_x) * cutlass.Int32(CFG.TILE_M)
+    b = compute_kv_loop_bounds(
+        cluster_q_row,
+        seqlen_q,
+        seqlen_kv,
+        CFG.WINDOW_LEFT,
+        CFG.MASK_FLAGS,
+        CFG.TILE_N,
+        CFG.CLUSTER_Q_ROWS,
+        bottom_right=CFG.BOTTOM_RIGHT,
+        window_right=CFG.WINDOW_RIGHT,
+    )
+    return b.left, b.unmasked_lo, b.unmasked_hi, b.right

+def _require(cond, msg):
+    """Geometry sanity check; raises instead of assert (asserts vanish under -O)."""
+    if not cond:
+        raise ValueError(f"bprop_d512_f16_2x2_sm100: {msg}")

+# dtype
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+if CFG.DTYPE_QKV == 2:
+    STORAGE_DTYPE = cutlass.BFloat16
+elif CFG.DTYPE_QKV == 3:
+    STORAGE_DTYPE = cutlass.Float16
+else:  # pragma: no cover - make_cfg_d512_2x2 rejects everything else
+    raise ValueError(f"bprop_d512_f16_2x2_sm100: DTYPE_QKV={CFG.DTYPE_QKV} not supported (expected 2=BF16 or 3=FP16)")
+# The workspace dtype IS the io dtype: stage 3 reads S/dS at input precision.
+WORKSPACE_DTYPE = STORAGE_DTYPE
+MMA_KIND = nvvm.Tcgen05MMAKind.F16
+
+CGA_SIZE = CFG.CGA_M * CFG.CGA_N
+# The scheduler payload barrier is completed by the CLUSTER LEAD's DSMEM st.async + complete_tx (scheduler_warp_loop_persistent):
+# for the second pair of a 4-CTA cluster that is an event from outside its cta_group::2 pair, so every wait on it polls
+# (the ring barriers' rule; the CI GB200 lane's time-slicing detector hung once with the parked form, 2026-10-06).
+_SCHED_POLL = CGA_SIZE > CFG.CTA_MMA
+CTA_GROUP_KIND = nvvm.CTAGroup.CTA_2
+LOG2E = 1.4426950408889634

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Buffer geometry -- all of it derived from the config's own functions so the
+# validator and the kernel can never disagree.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+qBytes, doBytes, kBytesPerStage, vBytesPerStage = operand_bytes_2x2(CFG)
+qBufferElems = qBytes // CFG.BPE
+doBufferElems = doBytes // CFG.BPE
+kBufferElems = kBytesPerStage // CFG.BPE
+vBufferElems = vBytesPerStage // CFG.BPE
+castElems = cast_bytes_2x2(CFG) // CFG.BPE
+
+_require(CFG.CTA_MMA == 2 and CFG.CGA_M == 4, "the 2x2 datapath needs cluster (4,1,1) of two cta_group::2 pairs")
+_require(CFG.TILE_K == CFG.TILE_O, "d_qk must equal d_v (Q and dO share one SMEM geometry, K and V one ring geometry)")
+
+# cta_group::2 tensor TMA: ALL bytes landing in the pair route to the pair leader's mbar, so a transaction
+# counts BOTH CTAs' buffers.  Q + dO per tile; one K chunk + one V chunk per ring stage.
+opTmaTransactionBytes = op_tx_bytes_2x2(CFG)
+ringTmaTransactionBytes = ring_tx_bytes_2x2(CFG)
+_require(opTmaTransactionBytes == CFG.CTA_MMA * (qBytes + doBytes), "op expect_tx disagrees with the Q + dO slabs")
+_require(ringTmaTransactionBytes == CFG.CTA_MMA * (kBytesPerStage + vBytesPerStage), "ring expect_tx disagrees with the K + V chunk slabs")
+
+# TMA subtiling: inner byte extent / swizzle atom.  Q / dO: d = 512 as 8 boxes of 64 columns; a ring stage:
+# D_CHUNK columns as D_CHUNK / 64 boxes.  All boxes are TILE_M (Q, dO) or TILE_N / CTA_MMA (K, V) rows = 64.
+TMA_GRANU_ELEMS = CFG.Q_SWZ_BYTES // CFG.BPE  # 64
+TMA_OP_ITERS = CFG.TILE_K // TMA_GRANU_ELEMS  # 8
+TMA_RING_ITERS = CFG.D_CHUNK // TMA_GRANU_ELEMS  # 1 at D_CHUNK = 64
+_require(TMA_OP_ITERS == CFG.N_CHUNKS * TMA_RING_ITERS, "Q / dO subtiles must tile exactly into the ring chunks")
+# One Q / dO chunk (TILE_M rows x D_CHUNK columns) in BYTES = what the MMA descriptor advances per chunk.
+A_CHUNK_BYTES = CFG.TILE_M * CFG.D_CHUNK * CFG.BPE
+A_CHUNK_DESC_ADVANCE = A_CHUNK_BYTES >> 4
+_require(A_CHUNK_BYTES % 1024 == 0, "a Q / dO chunk must be a whole number of 1024-B swizzle atoms")
+
+_SWZ_ENUM = {128: 2, 64: 4, 32: 6}
+_SWZ_B = {128: 3, 64: 2, 32: 1}
+SMEM_LAYOUT_QK = _SWZ_ENUM[CFG.Q_SWZ_BYTES]
+SMEM_LAYOUT_S = _SWZ_ENUM[CFG.S_SWZ_BYTES]
+S_SMEM_SWIZZLE = cutlass.Swizzle(_SWZ_B[CFG.S_SWZ_BYTES], 4, 3)
+
+_CORE_MATRIX_ROWS = 8
+LEADING_BYTE_OFFSET_QK = 0
+STRIDE_BYTE_OFFSET_QK = _CORE_MATRIX_ROWS * CFG.Q_SWZ_BYTES
+
+# Workspace store: the 64 x 128 tile as two 64 x 64 subtiles (one per TMEM lane half), 128 B per row = one atom.
+S_TMA_ITERS = cast_subtiles_2x2(CFG)
+S_D_BLOCK = CFG.TILE_N // S_TMA_ITERS
+S_SUBTILE_SLAB = CFG.TILE_M * S_D_BLOCK
+_require(S_TMA_ITERS == 2 and S_D_BLOCK == acc_cols_2x2(CFG), "one stored subtile must be exactly one accumulator column half")
+_require(castElems == S_TMA_ITERS * S_SUBTILE_SLAB, "cast element count disagrees with config cast_bytes_2x2()")
+
+# tcgen05 SMEM-descriptor version, bound ONCE for every SmemTile (handles.py: a root at or past 256 KiB
+# needs the extended format or the address wraps to an untouched buffer -- exactly-zero accumulator).
+DESC_VERSION: int = desc_version_2x2(CFG)

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# TMEM: 256 columns, no operand columns (fact: a 2SM M=128 TS operand is duplicated across the lane halves).
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class KernelTmemLayout(NamedTuple):
+    """[S_acc p0 | S_acc p1 | dS_acc p0 | dS_acc p1], ACC_COLS = TILE_N / 2 each under the 2x2 D image."""
+
+    ACC_COLS: int = acc_cols_2x2(CFG)
+    S_OFF: int = 0
+    DS_OFF: int = CFG.STAGES_ACC * acc_cols_2x2(CFG)
+    TOTAL_COLS: int = tmem_cols_2x2(CFG)
+
+
+LAYOUT = KernelTmemLayout()
+_require(LAYOUT.DS_OFF + CFG.STAGES_ACC * LAYOUT.ACC_COLS == LAYOUT.TOTAL_COLS, "TMEM carve must be exactly the two accumulator rings")
+_require(LAYOUT.TOTAL_COLS == tmem_cols_2x2(CFG), "kernel TMEM carve disagrees with config tmem_cols_2x2()")
+_require(LAYOUT.TOTAL_COLS & (LAYOUT.TOTAL_COLS - 1) == 0 and LAYOUT.TOTAL_COLS >= 32, "tcgen05.alloc needs a power-of-two column count >= 32")
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# SMEM budget -- assert the COMPUTED total, never an inherited constant.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_SLABS = smem_layout_2x2(CFG)
+_require(tuple(s.name for s in _SLABS) == ("sQ", "sdO", "sRingK", "sRingV", "sCastS", "sCastDS"), "slab order must be Q, dO, ring K, ring V, cast S, cast dS")
+_require(
+    qBytes + doBytes + CFG.STAGES_KV * (kBytesPerStage + vBytesPerStage) + 2 * CFG.CAST_STAGES * cast_bytes_2x2(CFG) == smem_bytes_2x2(CFG),
+    "kernel slab sizing disagrees with config smem_bytes_2x2()",
