+def _quad_stage_and_merge_stats(sMerge, quad_buf, tid_in_wg, tmem_base, m_w, l_w, bars, bounds, lane_live):
+    """Quadrant softmax (QUAD), the correction warps' first half of a unit's epilogue.  Every lane stages its (max, sum) and its O row -- this quadrant's
+    partial over its own keys -- in SMEM, hands the TMEM accumulators back to the softmax (``mb_o_empty``: the next unit's first PV overwrites them), and once
+    all four quadrants' rows are staged merges the four (max, sum) of its row.  Returns the merged (max, sum) in the base epilogue's terms -- the log2-unit
+    max, 0-substituted when no quadrant saw a live key -- and the four O weights 2 ** (m_w - M), zero for a quadrant without one."""
+    lane = tid_in_wg % cutlass.Int32(QUAD_ROWS)
+    warp_c = tid_in_wg // cutlass.Int32(QUAD_ROWS)
+    row_base = ((quad_buf * cutlass.Int32(4) + warp_c) * cutlass.Int32(QUAD_ROWS) + lane) * cutlass.Int32(QUAD_STRIDE)
+    if lane_live:
+        st_shared_v2(sMerge.subview(row_base + cutlass.Int32(QUAD_O_COLS)).data_ptr(), (m_w, l_w), cutlass.Float32)
+    # An empty unit never wrote the accumulator (its sum is 0 in every quadrant, so the merge never reads the staged O).
+    if cutlass.const_expr(not MAY_BE_EMPTY) or (bounds.right > bounds.left):
+        quad_loaded = load_o_chunks_grouped(tmem_base, LAYOUT.O0_OFF, QUAD_O_COLS, 16, 4)
+        for blk in cutlass.range_constexpr(QUAD_O_COLS // 16):
+            vals = quad_loaded[blk]
+            if lane_live:
+                for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+                    st_shared_v4(
+                        sMerge.subview(row_base + cutlass.Int32(blk * 16 + 4 * j)).data_ptr(),
+                        (vals[4 * j], vals[4 * j + 1], vals[4 * j + 2], vals[4 * j + 3]),
+                        cutlass.Float32,
+                    )
+    bars.mb_o_empty[0].arrive()
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_sync(barrier_id=3, thread_count=32 * CFG.CORRECTION_WARPS)
+
+    neg_inf = cutlass.Float32(float("-inf"))
+    zero = cutlass.Float32(0.0)
+    ms = []
+    ls = []
+    alive = []
+    for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        sv = ld_shared_v2(
+            sMerge.subview(
+                ((quad_buf * cutlass.Int32(4) + cutlass.Int32(w)) * cutlass.Int32(QUAD_ROWS) + lane) * cutlass.Int32(QUAD_STRIDE) + cutlass.Int32(QUAD_O_COLS)
+            ).data_ptr(),
+            cutlass.Float32,
+        )
+        ms.append(cutlass.Float32(sv[0]))
+        ls.append(cutlass.Float32(sv[1]))
+        alive.append(ls[w] > zero)
+    m_max = neg_inf
+    for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        m_max = cute.math.max(m_max, cutlass.Float32(arith.select(alive[w].ir_value(), ms[w].ir_value(), neg_inf.ir_value())))
+    any_alive = m_max > neg_inf
+    wgt = []
+    total = zero
+    for w in cutlass.range_constexpr(4):
+        e = cute.math.exp2(ms[w] - m_max, fastmath=True)
+        wgt.append(cutlass.Float32(arith.select(alive[w].ir_value(), e.ir_value(), zero.ir_value())))
+        total = total + cutlass.Float32(arith.select(alive[w].ir_value(), (wgt[w] * ls[w]).ir_value(), zero.ir_value()))
+    merged_max = cutlass.Float32(arith.select(any_alive.ir_value(), m_max.ir_value(), zero.ir_value()))
+    return merged_max, total, wgt[0], wgt[1], wgt[2], wgt[3]

+"""The ONE visible-set helper of the SM107 index-list sparse forwards -- shared by the tcgen05 tile (``sparse_d256_f16.py``) and the
+lean ``mma.sync`` decode tile (``sparse_lean_d256_f16.py``).
+
+Not a template: nothing here reads ``FROST_TEMPLATE_PARAMS``.  Every config knob the arithmetic depends on is a ``cutlass.Constexpr``
+parameter the calling template passes from ITS ``CFG`` (a constexpr parameter folds exactly like a module-global constant: the tcgen05
+module's cubins are byte-identical before and after this lift, the md5 record in ``test_sdpa_fwd_sparse_lean_sm107.py``), so the two
+kernel bodies cannot drift apart on what a row may see (sdpa-invariants: "one helper for the visible set").
+
+WHAT A ROW SEES (the sparse tile's header, ``sparse_d256_f16.py``): for query row ``tok`` of sequence ``batch`` at key-space position
+``pos`` with ``n_vis = clamp(min(pos + 1, L_b), 0)`` visible tokens and the list row ``item_row`` (``[.., block_topk]`` int32, a valid prefix
+then -1, blocks of ``block_size`` tokens):
+
+    pos           = tok  (top-left)  |  tok + (L_b - S_q_b)  (bottom_right: the row sits at the END of the sequence)
+    anchor        = pos  |  L_b - S_q_b = pos_0, the step-0 position  (list_per_sequence: ONE list per sequence)
+    n_sel_default = min(block_topk, floor(clamp(anchor + 1, 0) / block_size))
+    count         = clamp(block_lens[item_row], 0, n_sel_default)  when given, else n_sel_default      (device values, never a host read)
+    tail_lo       = floor(n_anchor / block_size)                   the first block NOT complete at the anchor
+    n_tail        = max(0, ceil(n_vis / block_size) - tail_lo)     0 / 1 (anchor = pos), 0..2 under the shared list at S_q <= 4;
+                                                                   0 when include_open_block = 0 (the pure-list test arm)

+TMALDG_WARP_ID = CFG.TMALDG_WARP_ID
+# Named barriers: 1 = TMEM base hand-off (softmax warps + MMA warp), 2 = the
+# softmax warps' own cross-warp reductions (all groups, they run in lockstep).
+_BAR_TMEM = 1
+_BAR_SOFTMAX = 2
+# Cross-warp reduction scratch.  The per-KV-tile column MAXIMA meet in ONE 16-word Int32 slot per group: each of the
+# group's four warps publishes its 16 butterfly maxima with red.shared.max on order-preserving keys (_max_key), and
+# after the tile's named barrier every lane reads the 16 group maxima back -- no fold, nothing retained across the
+# exchange.  MAX_RED_SLOTS slots rotate per tile and the group's first warp re-arms the slot two tiles ahead, so the
+# one barrier per tile also orders every reuse.  The epilogue's column SUMS keep the per-warp fp32 form ([softmax
+# warp][COLS], each warp's partial read back by its group).  (Holding the 16 maxima in registers and folding 64
+# loaded values was what put the 18-warp N_Q = 64 tile over ptxas's 96-register cap.)
+MAX_RED_SLOTS = 3
+MAX_RED_WORDS = MAX_RED_SLOTS * COL_GROUPS * COLS  # <= SOFTMAX_LANES by construction (48 per group against 128 lanes), so one lane arms one word
+RED_WORDS = SOFTMAX_WARPS * COLS
+INT32_MIN = -2147483648  # below every max key: the slot's armed value
+
+LOG2E = 1.4426950408889634
+LN2 = 0.6931471805599453
+

+class DecodeBars(NamedTuple):
+    mb_q_full: object
+    mb_kv_full: object
+    mb_kv_empty: object
+    mb_s_full: object
+    mb_s_empty: object
+    mb_p_full: object
+    mb_bmm2_done: object
+    mb_tmem_dealloc: object
+
+
+def make_decode_bars() -> DecodeBars:
+    def _alloc(n):
+        return cutlass.Array(cutlass.Int64, n, alignment=16, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem)
+
+    return DecodeBars(
+        mb_q_full=MBarrier(_alloc(1), stages=1, init_count=1, producer=Producer.TMA_LOAD),
+        mb_kv_full=MBarrier(_alloc(STAGES), stages=STAGES, init_count=1, producer=Producer.TMA_LOAD),
+        mb_kv_empty=MBarrier(_alloc(STAGES), stages=STAGES, init_count=1, producer=Producer.MMA_COMMIT),
+        mb_s_full=MBarrier(_alloc(2), stages=2, init_count=1, producer=Producer.MMA_COMMIT),
+        mb_s_empty=MBarrier(_alloc(2), stages=2, init_count=SOFTMAX_LANES, producer=Producer.THREAD),
+        mb_p_full=MBarrier(_alloc(2), stages=2, init_count=SOFTMAX_LANES, producer=Producer.THREAD),
+        mb_bmm2_done=MBarrier(_alloc(2), stages=2, init_count=1, producer=Producer.MMA_COMMIT),
+        mb_tmem_dealloc=MBarrier(_alloc(1), stages=1, init_count=SOFTMAX_LANES, producer=Producer.THREAD),
+    )

+@cute.jit
+def _select_i32(cond, a, b):
+    return cutlass.Int32(arith.select(cond.ir_value(), cutlass.Int32(a).ir_value(), cutlass.Int32(b).ir_value()))
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _select_f32(cond, a, b):
+    return cutlass.Float32(arith.select(cond.ir_value(), a.ir_value(), b.ir_value()))
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _max_key(x):
+    """Order-preserving Int32 key of a non-NaN fp32 (the softmax maxima: finite or -inf): the bit pattern, with the
+    magnitude bits inverted for a negative value, so signed-integer order is the float order (-inf -> 0x807FFFFF, the
+    smallest key a column can hold, above INT32_MIN).  Its own inverse on the keys it produces (_key_max)."""
+    b = x.bitcast(cutlass.Int32)
+    return _select_i32(b < cutlass.Int32(0), b ^ cutlass.Int32(0x7FFFFFFF), b)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _key_max(k):
+    """The fp32 a _max_key key encodes."""
+    return _select_i32(k < cutlass.Int32(0), k ^ cutlass.Int32(0x7FFFFFFF), k).bitcast(cutlass.Float32)
+

+@cute.jit
+def _unit_bounds(seq_kv_lens_tensor, seq_q_lens_addr, batch_idx, split_idx, seqlen_q, seqlen_kv, tok0):
+    """This unit's KV-tile range ``[lo, hi)`` plus the per-batch lengths.
+
+    Every role computes it identically (pure function of the same inputs), so
+    the barrier handshakes stay in lockstep.  The masks narrow the range the
+    way the prefill tile does (compute_kv_loop_bounds over the unit's token
+    span, which starts at ``tok0`` = the token unit's first Q token), the dense
+    padded-Q trim collapses a dead batch to an empty range, and the split
+    chunking mirrors _common_blackwell's _split_chunk.
+    """
+    eff_seqlen_kv = seqlen_kv
+    if cutlass.const_expr(CFG.SEQ_KV_LENS_PRESENT == 1):
+        eff_seqlen_kv = cutlass.Int32(cutlass.make_array_view(seq_kv_lens_tensor)[batch_idx])
+    q_len_b = seqlen_q
+    if cutlass.const_expr(CFG.SEQ_Q_LENS_PRESENT == 1):
+        _sq_arr = cute.make_tensor(cute.make_ptr(cutlass.Int32, seq_q_lens_addr, cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=4), cute.make_layout(1 << 24))
+        q_len_b = cutlass.Int32(_sq_arr[batch_idx])
+    eff_seqlen_q = seqlen_q
+    if cutlass.const_expr(CFG.SEQ_Q_LENS_PRESENT == 1 and CFG.BOTTOM_RIGHT == 1):
+        eff_seqlen_q = cute.math.max(cutlass.Int32(0), cute.math.min(q_len_b, seqlen_q))
+    bounds = compute_kv_loop_bounds(
+        tok0,
+        eff_seqlen_q,
+        eff_seqlen_kv,
+        CFG.WINDOW_LEFT,
+        CFG.MASK_FLAGS,
+        TILE_N,
+        Q_BOX_TOKENS,
+        bottom_right=bool(CFG.BOTTOM_RIGHT),
+        window_right=int(CFG.WINDOW_RIGHT),
+    )
+    left = bounds.left
+    right = cute.math.max(bounds.right, left)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(CFG.SEQ_Q_LENS_PRESENT == 1):
+        right = _select_i32(q_len_b <= cutlass.Int32(0), left, right)
+    n_tiles = right - left
+    per = n_tiles // cutlass.Int32(SPLIT_KV)
+    rem = n_tiles % cutlass.Int32(SPLIT_KV)
+    lo = left + split_idx * per + cute.math.min(split_idx, rem)
+    hi = lo + per + _select_i32(split_idx < rem, 1, 0)
+    return lo, hi, eff_seqlen_kv, eff_seqlen_q, q_len_b
+

+@cute.jit
+def _paged_load_tile(
+    smem_tile,
+    tma,
+    block_table_tensor,
+    batch_idx,
+    kv_head_idx,
+    n_pages_b,
+    kv_tile,
+    mbar,
+    box_rows: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    n_boxes: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+    granu_elems: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+):
+    """One paged K or V tile as ``n_boxes`` row boxes through the block table
+    (same contract as prefill_d256_f16._paged_load_tile: boxes past the batch's
+    live pages take page -1 = TMA-OOB zeros, bytes still credited)."""
+    bt = cutlass.make_array_view(block_table_tensor)
+    last_live = cute.math.max(n_pages_b - cutlass.Int32(1), cutlass.Int32(0))
+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(n_boxes):
+        g = kv_tile * cutlass.Int32(TILE_N) + cutlass.Int32(j * box_rows)
+        slot = g // cutlass.Int32(PAGE_SIZE)
+        row_in_page = g % cutlass.Int32(PAGE_SIZE)
+        page_live = cutlass.Int32(bt[batch_idx, cute.math.min(slot, last_live)])
+        in_range = slot < n_pages_b
+        page = _select_i32(in_range, page_live, cutlass.Int32(-1))
+        tma_load_tile(
+            smem_tile.shifted(j * box_rows * granu_elems),
+            tma(cutlass.Int32(0), kv_head_idx, row_in_page, page),
+            mbar,
+            cta_group=1,
+        )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _load_kv(smem_tile, tma, block_table_tensor, batch_idx, kv_head_idx, n_pages_b, kv_tile, mbar):
+    """One K or V tile (TILE_N keys x TILE_K) into ``smem_tile``: dense TMA box or
+    the paged block-table walk."""
+    if cutlass.const_expr(PAGED_KV):
+        _paged_load_tile(smem_tile, tma, block_table_tensor, batch_idx, kv_head_idx, n_pages_b, kv_tile, mbar, KV_BOX_ROWS, KV_BOXES, GRANU_ELEMS)
+    else:
+        tma_load_tile(smem_tile, tma(cutlass.Int32(0), kv_head_idx, kv_tile * cutlass.Int32(TILE_N), batch_idx), mbar, cta_group=1)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _kv_slot(seq, n_tiles):
+    """Ring slot and full-barrier parity of the ``seq``-th load of the unit's
+    K(0), K(1), V(0), K(2), V(1), ... sequence (V(n-1) is the 2n-1-th load: no
+    K(n) precedes it)."""
+    slot = seq % cutlass.Int32(STAGES)
+    phase = (seq // cutlass.Int32(STAGES)) & cutlass.Int32(1)
+    return slot, phase
+

+@cute.jit
+def _tmaldg_warp_group(
+    tma_q_desc,
+    tma_k_desc,
+    tma_v_desc,
+    sQ,
+    sKV,
+    bars,
+    seq_kv_lens_tensor,
+    seq_q_lens_addr,
+    seqlen_q,
+    seqlen_kv,
+    head_idx,
+    batch_idx,
+    split_idx,
+    tok0,
+    block_table_tensor=None,
+    block_table_v_tensor=None,
+    paged_hnd: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+    use_pdl: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+):
+    tma_q = GmemTileTma(tma_q_desc)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(PAGED_KV and paged_hnd):
+        # HND page pools: descriptor dims are (D, row, H_kv, page); every load
+        # site keeps the (d, head, row, page) vocabulary, the swap lives here.
+        _tk, _tv = GmemTileTma(tma_k_desc), GmemTileTma(tma_v_desc)
+        tma_k = lambda d, h, r, p: _tk(d, r, h, p)  # noqa: E731
+        tma_v = lambda d, h, r, p: _tv(d, r, h, p)  # noqa: E731
+    else:
+        tma_k = GmemTileTma(tma_k_desc)
+        tma_v = GmemTileTma(tma_v_desc)
+
+    if cutlass.const_expr(use_pdl):
+        # Programmatic dependent launch: every global read of this role -- the lengths and the table (a serving stack's own
+        # earlier kernels write them), the Q box (the slab a projection / norm-RoPE launch wrote), the K / V pages (the
+        # write-through filled them) -- sits BELOW this wait; the descriptor prefetches above it are the prologue it overlaps.
+        wait_on_dependent_grids()
+        # The prologue is behind this CTA: release the dependent grid so it stages its own while the mainloop runs (its wait
+        # still blocks on this grid's completion and memory flush, wherever this trigger sits).
+        launch_dependent_grids()
+
+    lo, hi, eff_seqlen_kv, _eq, _ql = _unit_bounds(seq_kv_lens_tensor, seq_q_lens_addr, batch_idx, split_idx, seqlen_q, seqlen_kv, tok0)
+    n_tiles = hi - lo
+    q_head_base = head_idx * cutlass.Int32(HEADS_PER_TILE)
+    kv_head_idx = head_idx if cutlass.const_expr(CFG.PACK_GQA) else head_idx // cutlass.Int32(CFG.QH_PER_KH)
+    n_pages_b = cutlass.Int32(0)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(PAGED_KV):
+        n_pages_b = (eff_seqlen_kv + cutlass.Int32(PAGE_SIZE - 1)) // cutlass.Int32(PAGE_SIZE)
+
+    if n_tiles > cutlass.Int32(0):
+        bars.mb_q_full.arrive(n_bytes=Q_TX_BYTES, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        tma_load_tile(sQ[0], tma_q(cutlass.Int32(0), q_head_base, tok0, batch_idx), bars.mb_q_full.smem_ptr, cta_group=1)
+
+        # Ring order K(0), K(1), V(0), K(2), V(1), ...: K runs one tile ahead of V, so
+        # K(t+2) is issued when V(t-1)'s slot frees (end of iteration t-1) and lands
+        # a whole iteration before BMM1(t+2) needs it, while V(t+1) is issued when
+        # K(t+1)'s slot frees (start of iteration t).  The MMA warp consumes in the
+        # same order, so one 3-slot ring serves both operands (see _kv_slot).
+        kv_state = PipelineState.start(phase=1)
+        bars.mb_kv_empty[kv_state.idx].wait(kv_state.phase, spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS)
+        bars.mb_kv_full[kv_state.idx].arrive(n_bytes=KV_TX_BYTES, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+        _load_kv(sKV[kv_state.idx], tma_k, block_table_tensor, batch_idx, kv_head_idx, n_pages_b, lo, bars.mb_kv_full[kv_state.idx].smem_ptr)
+        kv_state = advance(kv_state, STAGES)
+        for i in cutlass.range(0, n_tiles, 1, unroll=1):
+            kv_tile = lo + i
+            if i + cutlass.Int32(1) < n_tiles:
+                bars.mb_kv_empty[kv_state.idx].wait(kv_state.phase, spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS)
+                bars.mb_kv_full[kv_state.idx].arrive(n_bytes=KV_TX_BYTES, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+                _load_kv(
+                    sKV[kv_state.idx],
+                    tma_k,
+                    block_table_tensor,
+                    batch_idx,
+                    kv_head_idx,
+                    n_pages_b,
+                    kv_tile + cutlass.Int32(1),
+                    bars.mb_kv_full[kv_state.idx].smem_ptr,
+                )
+                kv_state = advance(kv_state, STAGES)
+            bars.mb_kv_empty[kv_state.idx].wait(kv_state.phase, spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS)
+            bars.mb_kv_full[kv_state.idx].arrive(n_bytes=KV_TX_BYTES, pred=nvvm.elect_sync())
+            _load_kv(sKV[kv_state.idx], tma_v, block_table_v_tensor, batch_idx, kv_head_idx, n_pages_b, kv_tile, bars.mb_kv_full[kv_state.idx].smem_ptr)
+            kv_state = advance(kv_state, STAGES)
+

+@cute.jit
+def _mma_warp_group(
+    sQ,
+    sK,
+    sVt,
+    sP,
+    tmem_ptr_i32,
+    bars,
+    seq_kv_lens_tensor,
+    seq_q_lens_addr,
+    seqlen_q,
+    seqlen_kv,
+    batch_idx,
+    split_idx,
+    tok0,
+    use_pdl: cutlass.Constexpr[bool] = False,
+):
+    tmem_alloc(tmem_ptr_i32, TMEM_COLS, CTA_GROUP_KIND)
+    nvvm.barrier_cta_arrive(_BAR_TMEM, 32 * (SOFTMAX_WARPS + 1))
+
+    tmem_raw = nvvm.make_tmem_ptr(tmem_ptr_i32.load(), cutlass.Int8)
+
+    idesc_qk = prims.Tcgen05InstrDesc.build(
+        c_dtype=cutlass.Float32,
+        a_dtype=STORAGE_DTYPE,
+        b_dtype=STORAGE_DTYPE,
+        n_dim=N_Q,
+        m_dim=TILE_N,
+        k_dim=0,
+        a_negate=int(PARAMS.negate_scores),
+    )
+    idesc_pv = prims.Tcgen05InstrDesc.build(
+        c_dtype=cutlass.Float32,
+        a_dtype=STORAGE_DTYPE,
+        b_dtype=STORAGE_DTYPE,
+        n_dim=N_Q,
+        m_dim=128,
+        a_major=1,
+        b_major=1,
+        k_dim=0,
+    )
+    # BMM1: S^T = K . Q^T -- K [128 keys x TILE_K] K-major, Q^T [N_Q x TILE_K] K-major.
+    bmm1_desc = MmaDesc(
+        M=TILE_N,
+        N=N_Q,
+        K=TILE_K,
+        bpe_a=BPE,
+        bpe_b=BPE,
+        tile_k_hw=CFG.TILE_K_HW,
+        btranspose=False,
+        cta_group=1,
+        idesc=idesc_qk,
+        kind=MMA_KIND,
+    )
+    # BMM2: O^T = V^T . P^T -- V^T [128 d x 128 keys] MN-major (d contiguous),
+    # P^T [N_Q x 128 keys] MN-major (the N_Q values of one key contiguous).
+    bmm2_desc = MmaDesc(
+        M=128,
+        N=N_Q,
+        K=TILE_N,
+        bpe_a=BPE,
+        bpe_b=BPE,
+        tile_k_hw=CFG.TILE_K_HW,
+        atranspose=True,
+        btranspose=True,
+        cta_group=1,
+        idesc=idesc_pv,
+        kind=MMA_KIND,
+    )
+
+    if cutlass.const_expr(use_pdl):
+        # PDL: the TMEM allocation and the descriptor builds above are this role's prologue; its first global read (the lengths) is below.
+        wait_on_dependent_grids()
+    lo, hi, _ek, _eq, _ql = _unit_bounds(seq_kv_lens_tensor, seq_q_lens_addr, batch_idx, split_idx, seqlen_q, seqlen_kv, tok0)
+    n_tiles = hi - lo
+
+    # Barrier bookkeeping is arithmetic in the tile index (no loop-carried
+    # pipeline state inside a data-dependent branch):
+    #   ring load seq (K(0), K(1), V(0), K(2), V(1), ...): slot seq % STAGES, phase (seq // STAGES) & 1;
+    #   S slot t % 2: the softmax releases it once per tile that used it, so
+    #   BMM1(t) waits completion #(t // 2) of s_empty[t % 2], i.e. parity
+    #   ((t // 2) - 1) & 1 -- which is 1 for t < 2 and passes a fresh barrier;
+    #   p_full[t % 2] / bmm2_done[t % 2]: parity (t // 2) & 1.
+    if n_tiles > cutlass.Int32(0):
+        bars.mb_q_full.wait(cutlass.Int32(0))
+        desc_Q = sQ[0].desc()
+
+        # Prologue: BMM1(0).
+        slot0, phase0 = _kv_slot(cutlass.Int32(0), n_tiles)
+        bars.mb_kv_full[slot0].wait(phase0, spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS)
+        bars.mb_s_empty[0].wait(cutlass.Int32(1), spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS)
+        nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+        mma_ss(bmm1_desc, sK[slot0].desc(), desc_Q, tmem_raw.subview(cutlass.Int32(S_ACC_OFF[0])))
+        elect_p = nvvm.elect_sync()
+        bars.mb_s_full[0].arrive(cta_group=1, pred=elect_p)
+        bars.mb_kv_empty[slot0].arrive(cta_group=1, pred=elect_p)
+
+        for i in cutlass.range(0, n_tiles, 1, unroll=1):
+            # BMM1(i + 1) ahead of BMM2(i): the softmax of tile i overlaps the next
+            # score tile, and the K slot is released as early as possible.
+            if i + cutlass.Int32(1) < n_tiles:
+                t_next = i + cutlass.Int32(1)
+                slot_k, phase_k = _kv_slot(cutlass.Int32(2) * t_next - cutlass.Int32(1), n_tiles)
+                par_next = t_next & cutlass.Int32(1)
+                phase_s_empty = ((t_next // cutlass.Int32(2)) - cutlass.Int32(1)) & cutlass.Int32(1)
+                bars.mb_kv_full[slot_k].wait(phase_k, spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS)
+                bars.mb_s_empty[par_next].wait(phase_s_empty, spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS)
+                nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+                s_off_next = _select_i32(par_next == cutlass.Int32(0), S_ACC_OFF[0], S_ACC_OFF[1])
+                mma_ss(bmm1_desc, sK[slot_k].desc(), desc_Q, tmem_raw.subview(s_off_next))
+                elect_p1 = nvvm.elect_sync()
+                bars.mb_s_full[par_next].arrive(cta_group=1, pred=elect_p1)
+                bars.mb_kv_empty[slot_k].arrive(cta_group=1, pred=elect_p1)
+
+            seq_v = _select_i32(i + cutlass.Int32(1) < n_tiles, cutlass.Int32(2) * i + cutlass.Int32(2), cutlass.Int32(2) * n_tiles - cutlass.Int32(1))
+            slot_v, phase_v = _kv_slot(seq_v, n_tiles)
+            par_cur = i & cutlass.Int32(1)
+            phase_p = (i // cutlass.Int32(2)) & cutlass.Int32(1)
+            bars.mb_kv_full[slot_v].wait(phase_v, spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS)
+            bars.mb_p_full[par_cur].wait(phase_p, spin=SPIN_RING_WAITS)
+            nvvm.tcgen05_fence(nvvm.Tcgen05Fence.AFTER_THREAD_SYNC)
+            desc_P = sP[par_cur].desc()
+            accum = cutlass.Boolean(i > cutlass.Int32(0))
+            for blk in cutlass.range_constexpr(O_BLOCKS):
+                mma_ss(
+                    bmm2_desc,
+                    sVt[slot_v].shifted(blk * 2 * TILE_N * GRANU_ELEMS).desc(),
+                    desc_P,
+                    tmem_raw.subview(cutlass.Int32(O_OFF[blk])),
+                    accumulate=accum,
+                )
+            elect_p2 = nvvm.elect_sync()
+            bars.mb_bmm2_done[par_cur].arrive(cta_group=1, pred=elect_p2)
+            bars.mb_kv_empty[slot_v].arrive(cta_group=1, pred=elect_p2)
+
+    bars.mb_tmem_dealloc.wait(cutlass.Int32(0))
+    tmem_dealloc(tmem_ptr_i32, TMEM_COLS, CTA_GROUP_KIND)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _warp_reduce_max(x):
+    # ftz=True (the FMNMX intrinsic, as tile_dsl's row_max_reduction and the sparse sibling spell it): the bare
+    # cute.math.max lowers to compare + select -- FSETP.NAN + FSETP.GTU + two FSEL per max, every predicate register busy
+    # -- which tipped the 18-warp (N_Q = 64) tile's KV loop over ptxas's 96-register cap; the inline-asm max.f32 form
+    # pins its operands around each asm block and spilled more.  Softmax maxima are finite or -inf, so only a score below
+    # the fp32 normal range (|s| < 2^-126) could read differently (flushed to 0).
+    for off in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+        x = cute.math.max(x, cutlass.Float32(nvvm.shfl_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, x, 16 >> off, 31, kind=nvvm.Shfl.BFLY)), ftz=True)
+    return x
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _warp_reduce_sum(x):
+    for off in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+        x = x + cutlass.Float32(nvvm.shfl_sync(0xFFFFFFFF, x, 16 >> off, 31, kind=nvvm.Shfl.BFLY))
+    return x
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _softmax_warp_group(
+    tmem_ptr_i32,

+
+"""Example 00: gated attention block, TRAINING forward (``save_for_backward=True``).
+
+One ``GatedAttentionBlockFwd`` runs the whole sub-layer -- QKV + GATE projection,
+QK-RMSNorm + partial RoPE, causal GQA SDPA, sigmoid gate, out projection -- and,
+declared with ``save_for_backward=True``, writes every tensor the backward needs
+into a caller-owned ``SavedForBackward`` record instead of its workspace: the
+projection GEMM writes ``saved.proj_slab``, the SDPA writes the PRE-gate
+``saved.o`` and ``saved.lse``, norm + RoPE writes ``saved.rstd_q`` / ``rstd_k``.
+``saved_slab_views`` spells the slab's four column bands (``q_pre``, ``gate``,
+``k_pre``, ``v``) as zero-copy ``[B, S, heads, D]`` views.  This is the
+``proj_slab`` save mode (the declaration default); ``saved_gate_copy=True``
+keeps the slab in the workspace and copies the GATE band into a compact
+``saved.gate`` instead.
+
+Self-checks, torch fp32 math on the record alone: ``proj_slab`` is ``h @ W_qkvg^T``;
+``rstd_q`` / ``rstd_k`` are the RMSNorm statistics of the PRE-norm ``q_pre`` /
+``k_pre`` bands; ``out`` is ``(o * sigmoid(gate)) @ W_o^T``, i.e. ``saved.o`` is
+the pre-gate attention output and ``gate`` the GATE band the block gated with.
+
+Rubin (compute capability 10.7) only; prints SKIP on any other device.  The
+block's two projections ride the opt-in FROST GEMM engine, so
+``CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1`` must be in the environment before
+``import cudnn`` (set below if unset).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+
+os.environ.setdefault("CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES", "1")  # opt-in FROST engines; read at `import cudnn`
+
+import torch  # noqa: E402
+
+from cudnn.gated_attention_block import GatedAttentionBlockFwd, GatedAttentionBlockGeometry, SavedForBackward, saved_slab_views  # noqa: E402
+
+_RUBIN = (10, 7)
+

+def _rope_tables(batch: int, seq_len: int, rope_dim: int, *, base: float = 1_000_000.0, device, dtype):
+    """``cos, sin`` of shape ``[B, S, rope_dim]`` in the rotate-half convention (the two halves duplicated) --
+    what HF ``apply_rotary_pos_emb`` and vLLM's ``RotaryEmbedding`` hand a RoPE kernel."""
+    inv_freq = 1.0 / (base ** (torch.arange(0, rope_dim, 2, device=device, dtype=torch.float32) / rope_dim))
+    freqs = torch.outer(torch.arange(seq_len, device=device, dtype=torch.float32), inv_freq)  # [S, rope_dim // 2]
+    emb = torch.cat((freqs, freqs), dim=-1).expand(batch, seq_len, rope_dim)
+    return emb.cos().to(dtype).contiguous(), emb.sin().to(dtype).contiguous()
+
+
+def _rel_err(got: torch.Tensor, ref: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    got, ref = got.float().flatten(), ref.float().flatten()
+    return ((got - ref).norm() / ref.norm().clamp_min(1e-12)).item()
+

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Example 07: parameterized LeakyReLU on GEMM operands (pure frontend API).
+
+Run on a data-center Blackwell GPU:
+  CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1 python samples/frost/gemm/07_matmul_leaky_relu_mainloop.py --benchmark
+
+Both paths use FROST GEMM and preserve BF16 activation outputs. Timings use
+CUDA-graph replay, exclude preparation/JIT, and include the baseline's separate
+PyTorch activation kernels. They are shape-specific, not a speedup guarantee.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import math
+import warnings
+from collections.abc import Callable
+
+import cudnn
+import torch
+
+
+def _build_plans(g: cudnn.pygraph) -> None:
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+    candidates = [i for i, name in enumerate(names) if name.split("[")[0] == "frost_gemm"]
+    if not candidates:
+        raise RuntimeError("No FROST GEMM plan; set CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1 and check GPU/DSL support")
+    g.select_plan(candidates[0])  # Pin FROST for the matched-provider comparison.
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+
+
+def _build_graph(M: int, N: int, K: int, side: str, negative_slope: float, fuse: bool):
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(
+        io_data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16,
+        intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+        compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+    )
+    A = g.tensor(name="A", dim=[1, M, K], stride=[M * K, K, 1])
+    B = g.tensor(name="B", dim=[1, K, N], stride=[K * N, 1, K])
+    Ai, Bi = A, B
+    if fuse and side in ("a", "ab"):
+        Ai = g.leaky_relu(input=A, negative_slope=negative_slope, name="leakyA").set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16)
+    if fuse and side in ("b", "ab"):
+        Bi = g.leaky_relu(input=B, negative_slope=negative_slope, name="leakyB").set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16)
+    C = g.matmul(A=Ai, B=Bi, name="mm").set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT).set_output(True)
+    return g, A, B, C
+
+
+def _replay_us(call: Callable[[cudnn.Handle], None], check_replay: Callable[[Callable[[], None]], None], iterations: int = 100) -> float:
+    """Validate capture before timing warm replays with CUDA Events."""
+    stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    handle = cudnn.create_handle()
+    captured = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    try:
+        # Torch's stream context does not change a cuDNN handle's stream.
+        # Retain the explicit handle and capture pool through validation/timing.
+        cudnn.set_stream(handle, stream.cuda_stream)
+        with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+            for _ in range(5):
+                call(handle)
+        torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+        with warnings.catch_warnings():
+            warnings.filterwarnings("error", message="The CUDA Graph is empty.*")
+            with torch.cuda.graph(captured, stream=stream):
+                call(handle)
+        check_replay(captured.replay)
+        for _ in range(5):
+            captured.replay()
+        begin, end = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True), torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+        begin.record()
+        for _ in range(iterations):
+            captured.replay()
+        end.record()
+        end.synchronize()
+        return begin.elapsed_time(end) * 1000 / iterations
+    finally:
+        # Also wait on validation/capture failure before releasing resources.
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        captured.reset()
+        cudnn.destroy_handle(handle)
+
+
+def main(M: int = 512, N: int = 512, K: int = 264, side: str = "ab", negative_slope: float = 0.1, benchmark: bool = False) -> None:
+    if min(M, N, K) <= 0 or not math.isfinite(negative_slope):
+        raise ValueError("dimensions must be positive and negative_slope must be finite")
+    if side not in ("a", "b", "ab"):
+        raise ValueError("side must be 'a', 'b', or 'ab'")
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        print("[07] SKIP  needs a CUDA GPU")
+        return
+    major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability()
+    if not 100 <= major * 10 + minor < 120:
+        print("[07] SKIP  needs a data-center Blackwell-family GPU (100 <= SM < 120)")
+        return
+
+    # Graph description and plan construction precede all execution/timing.
+    g, A, B, C = _build_graph(M, N, K, side, negative_slope, fuse=True)
+    _build_plans(g)
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    a = torch.randn((1, M, K), device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    b = torch.randn((1, N, K), device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16).transpose(1, 2)
+    c = torch.empty((1, M, N), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    workspace = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+    def fused(handle: cudnn.Handle | None = None) -> None:
+        g.execute({A: a, B: b, C: c}, workspace, handle=handle)
+
+    def reference() -> torch.Tensor:
+        a_ref = torch.nn.functional.leaky_relu(a.float(), negative_slope).to(a.dtype) if side in ("a", "ab") else a
+        b_ref = torch.nn.functional.leaky_relu(b.float(), negative_slope).to(b.dtype) if side in ("b", "ab") else b
+        return a_ref.float() @ b_ref.float()
+
+    ref = reference()
+    fused()
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(c, ref, atol=1e-2, rtol=1e-2)
+    print(f"[07] PASS  leaky_relu operands  side={side} slope={negative_slope} M={M} N={N} K={K}")
+
+    if benchmark:
+        base, A_base, B_base, C_base = _build_graph(M, N, K, side, negative_slope, fuse=False)
+        _build_plans(base)
+        c_base = torch.empty_like(c)
+        base_workspace = torch.empty(max(base.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+        def separate(handle: cudnn.Handle | None = None) -> None:
+            a_activated = torch.nn.functional.leaky_relu(a, negative_slope) if side in ("a", "ab") else a
+            b_activated = torch.nn.functional.leaky_relu(b, negative_slope) if side in ("b", "ab") else b
+            base.execute({A_base: a_activated, B_base: b_activated, C_base: c_base}, base_workspace, handle=handle)
+
+        def check_replay(replay: Callable[[], None], output: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+            # Keep storage addresses stable but change BOTH operands after capture.
+            # Poison the output so an empty or partial capture cannot reuse old work.
+            a.neg_()
+            b.mul_(0.5)
+            expected = reference()
+            output.fill_(float("nan"))
+            replay()
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()

+
+        separate()

+        fused_us = _replay_us(fused, lambda replay: check_replay(replay, c))
+        # Restore capture inputs so both paths validate/time the same data.
+        a.neg_()
+        b.mul_(2)
+        separate_us = _replay_us(separate, lambda replay: check_replay(replay, c_base))
+        torch.testing.assert_close(c, c_base, atol=1e-2, rtol=1e-2)
+        print(f"[07] CUDA-graph replay: fused={fused_us:.2f} us, separate={separate_us:.2f} us, ratio={separate_us / fused_us:.3f}x")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--m", type=int, default=512)
+    parser.add_argument("--n", type=int, default=512)
+    parser.add_argument("--k", type=int, default=264)
+    parser.add_argument("--side", choices=("a", "b", "ab"), default="ab")
+    parser.add_argument("--slope", type=float, default=0.1)
+    parser.add_argument("--benchmark", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if min(args.m, args.n, args.k) <= 0 or not math.isfinite(args.slope):
+        parser.error("dimensions must be positive and slope must be finite")

+"""Per-K input scaling on A, B, or both, fused into the SM100 GEMM mainloop.
+
+Graph: (A[1,M,K] * scale_a[1,1,K]) @ (B[1,K,N] * scale_b[1,K,1]).
+Each FP32 multiply rounds to the operand dtype before MMA, just like a
+materialized graph. Scale loads use logical K after undoing the SMEM swizzle;
+loads are bounded by K, and the transformed padded K lanes are zeroed.
+
+The template supports K-major BF16/FP16 scaled operands, contiguous per-K
+BF16/FP16/FP32 scales, broadcast across the batch, dynamic M/N/K, and swap-AB.
+K must satisfy the existing TMA alignment (divisible by 8 for 16-bit inputs).
+Scaled A needs M>1; scaled B needs N>1 to distinguish the scale from its input.
+MoE, block scaling and parallel multi-GEMM are not mainloop template routes.
+
+Run on Blackwell: python samples/frost/gemm/07_matmul_per_k_input_scale.py --side ab
+The baseline uses separate torch.mul calls (preallocated outputs) and a plain
+FROST GEMM. Both paths include launches and exclude compilation. These timings
+are an experiment, not a speedup claim. Try --side a or --side b separately.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import cudnn
+import torch
+
+from cudnn.gemm.frost.compiler import jit_from_cudnn_graph
+from cudnn.gemm.frost.tile_config import by_name
+
+
+def _plan(M, N, K, side):
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    a = g.tensor(name="A", dim=[1, M, K], stride=[M * K, K, 1])
+    b = g.tensor(name="B", dim=[1, K, N], stride=[K * N, 1, K])
+    sa = g.tensor(name="scale_a", dim=[1, 1, K], stride=[K, K, 1]) if "a" in side else None
+    sb = g.tensor(name="scale_b", dim=[1, K, 1], stride=[K, 1, K]) if "b" in side else None
+    aa = g.mul(a=a, b=sa).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16) if sa is not None else a
+    bb = g.mul(a=b, b=sb).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16) if sb is not None else b
+    y = g.matmul(A=aa, B=bb).set_output(True)
+    cfg = by_name("CONFIG_sm100_128x128x64_128x128x32_cluster1x1_1ctamma")
+    return jit_from_cudnn_graph(g, cfg), (a, b, sa, sb, y)
+
+
+def _time_ms(fn, repeats):
+    for _ in range(10):
+        fn()
+    start, end = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True), torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
+    start.record()
+    for _ in range(repeats):
+        fn()
+    end.record()
+    end.synchronize()
+    return start.elapsed_time(end) / repeats
+
+
+def main(M=512, N=512, K=264, repeats=100, side="ab"):
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        raise SystemExit("This sample requires a Blackwell-family GPU (100 <= SM < 120).")
+    major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability()
+    if not 100 <= major * 10 + minor < 120:
+        raise SystemExit("This sample requires a Blackwell-family GPU (100 <= SM < 120).")
+    fused, (a, b, sa, sb, y) = _plan(M, N, K, side)
+    plain, (pa, pb, _, _, py) = _plan(M, N, K, "")
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    av = torch.randn(1, M, K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    bv = torch.randn(1, N, K, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    sav = ((torch.arange(K, device="cuda") % 17 - 8).float() / 7).reshape(1, 1, K).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    sbv = torch.linspace(0.7, 1.3, K, device="cuda").reshape(1, K, 1).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    out, baseline = torch.empty(1, M, N, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16), torch.empty(1, M, N, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    materialized_a, materialized_b = torch.empty_like(av), torch.empty_like(bv)
+    fused_pack = {a: av, b: bv, y: out}
+    if sa is not None:
+        fused_pack[sa] = sav
+    if sb is not None:
+        fused_pack[sb] = sbv
+    plain_pack = {pa: materialized_a if sa is not None else av, pb: materialized_b if sb is not None else bv, py: baseline}
+
+    def fused_run():
+        fused(fused_pack)
+
+    def separate_run():
+        if sa is not None:
+            torch.mul(av, sav, out=materialized_a)
+        if sb is not None:
+            torch.mul(bv, sbv.transpose(1, 2), out=materialized_b)
+        plain(plain_pack)
+
+    fused_run()
+    separate_run()
+    aa = (av.float() * sav.float()).to(torch.bfloat16) if sa is not None else av
+    bb = (bv.float() * sbv.transpose(1, 2).float()).to(torch.bfloat16) if sb is not None else bv
+    ref = (aa.float() @ bb.float().transpose(-1, -2)).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out, ref, atol=0.25, rtol=0.02)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(baseline, ref, atol=0.25, rtol=0.02)
+    assert torch.isfinite(out).all()
+    print(f"PASS side={side} M={M} N={N} K={K}; fused={_time_ms(fused_run, repeats):.4f} ms, separate={_time_ms(separate_run, repeats):.4f} ms")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    p.add_argument("--m", type=int, default=512)
+    p.add_argument("--n", type=int, default=512)
+    p.add_argument("--k", type=int, default=264)
+    p.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, default=100)
+    p.add_argument("--side", choices=("a", "b", "ab"), default="ab")
+    args = p.parse_args()
+    main(args.m, args.n, args.k, args.repeats, args.side)

+
+"""Example 08: transpose-aware operand fusion, without a transpose kernel.
+
+Graph: transpose(leaky_relu(X[1,K,M])) @ leaky_relu(transpose(W[1,N,K])).
+FROST absorbs last-two-axis transposes into input views and retains each activation's
+BF16 rounding. Runtime storage stays in the graph-input coordinates; no caller
+transpose, contiguous conversion or intermediate allocation is required.
+
+Run on data-center Blackwell:
+    CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1 python samples/frost/gemm/08_matmul_transpose_mainloop.py
+Use --batch-shape with no extents for rank-2, or --batch-shape 2 3 for rank-4.
+Leading batch axes are folded only when their addresses follow one affine pitch.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+from math import prod
+import warnings
+
+import cudnn
+import torch
+
+
+def _build_graph(M, N, K, batch_shape=(1,)):
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    prefix = tuple(batch_shape)
+    x_stride = [K * M * prod(prefix[i + 1 :]) for i in range(len(prefix))] + [1, K]
+    w_stride = [N * K * prod(prefix[i + 1 :]) for i in range(len(prefix))] + [K, 1]
+    permutation = [*range(len(prefix)), len(prefix) + 1, len(prefix)]
+    x = g.tensor(name="X", dim=[*prefix, K, M], stride=x_stride)
+    w = g.tensor(name="W", dim=[*prefix, N, K], stride=w_stride)
+    a = g.leaky_relu(input=x, negative_slope=0.125).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16)
+    a = g.transpose(input=a, permutation=permutation)
+    b = g.transpose(input=w, permutation=permutation)
+    b = g.leaky_relu(input=b, negative_slope=0.125).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16)
+    y = g.matmul(A=a, B=b).set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    return g, x, w, y
+
+
+def _build_plans(g):
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    frost = [i for i in range(len(g.plans)) if g.get_plan_name_at_index(i).split("[")[0] == "frost_gemm"]
+    if not frost:
+        raise RuntimeError("No FROST GEMM plan; set CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1 and check GPU/DSL support")
+    g.select_plan(frost[0])
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+
+
+def main(M=128, N=192, K=136, batch_shape=(1,)):
+    batch_shape = tuple(batch_shape)
+    if min(M, N, K, *batch_shape) <= 0 or K % 8:
+        raise ValueError("M/N/K must be positive and K must be divisible by 8 (BF16 TMA alignment)")
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        print("[08] SKIP  needs a CUDA GPU")
+        return
+    major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability()
+    if not 100 <= major * 10 + minor < 120:
+        print("[08] SKIP  needs a data-center Blackwell-family GPU (100 <= SM < 120)")
+        return
+    g, x, w, y = _build_graph(M, N, K, batch_shape)
+    _build_plans(g)
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    # X's strided layout is declared by the graph; create that storage once, not during execute.
+    xv = torch.empty_strided((*batch_shape, K, M), tuple(x.get_stride()), device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    xv.copy_(torch.randint(-3, 4, xv.shape, device="cuda"))
+    wv = torch.randint(-3, 4, (*batch_shape, N, K), device="cuda").to(torch.bfloat16)
+    out = torch.empty(*batch_shape, M, N, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    workspace = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    pack = {x: xv, w: wv, y: out}
+    stream, captured, handle = torch.cuda.Stream(), torch.cuda.CUDAGraph(), cudnn.create_handle()
+    try:
+        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        cudnn.set_stream(handle, stream.cuda_stream)
+        with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+            g.execute(pack, workspace, handle=handle)
+        stream.synchronize()
+        with warnings.catch_warnings():
+            warnings.filterwarnings("error", message="The CUDA Graph is empty.*")
+            with torch.cuda.graph(captured, stream=stream):
+                g.execute(pack, workspace, handle=handle)
+        for _ in range(2):
+            xv.neg_()
+            out.fill_(float("nan"))
+            captured.replay()
+            a = torch.nn.functional.leaky_relu(xv.float(), 0.125).bfloat16().transpose(-1, -2)
+            b = torch.nn.functional.leaky_relu(wv.float().transpose(-1, -2), 0.125).bfloat16()
+            torch.testing.assert_close(out, a.float() @ b.float(), atol=0, rtol=0)
+    finally:
+        captured.reset()
+        cudnn.destroy_handle(handle)
+    print(f"[08] PASS  transpose-aware mainloop  batch={batch_shape} M={M} N={N} K={K}; changed-input capture replay")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--m", type=int, default=128)
+    parser.add_argument("--n", type=int, default=192)
+    parser.add_argument("--k", type=int, default=136)
+    parser.add_argument("--batch-shape", nargs="*", type=int, default=[1], help="leading batch extents; pass no extents for rank-2")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    main(args.m, args.n, args.k, args.batch_shape)

+
+Run with CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1. The reshape source dimensions
+are fixed by the prepared graph; fresh storage can be rebound without copying.
+No performance claim is made by this correctness example.
+"""
+
+import warnings
+import cudnn
+import torch
+
+
+def build_graph():
+    """Build [B,H,S,K] -> activation -> [B,H*S,K] -> GEMM."""
+    graph = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    x = graph.tensor(name="X", dim=[2, 2, 64, 64], stride=[8192, 4096, 64, 1])
+    w = graph.tensor(name="W", dim=[2, 64, 128], stride=[8192, 128, 1])

+    value = graph.reshape(input=value, reshape_mode=cudnn.reshape_mode.LOGICAL).set_dim([2, 128, 64]).set_stride([8192, 64, 1])
+    y = graph.matmul(A=value, B=w).set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    return graph, x, w, y
+
+

+    """Execute the public graph API and verify changed-input capture replay."""

+        print("[09] SKIP: CUDA is required")
+        return

+    if not 100 <= major * 10 + minor < 120:
+        print("[09] SKIP: full GEMM requires data-center Blackwell")
+        return

+    graph.build_operation_graph()
+    graph.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    candidates = [i for i in range(len(graph.plans)) if graph.get_plan_name_at_index(i).split("[")[0] == "frost_gemm"]
+    if not candidates:
+        print("[09] SKIP: enable FROST engines and check GPU/DSL support")
+        return
+    graph.select_plan(candidates[0])
+    graph.check_support()
+    graph.build_plans()

+    wv = torch.randint(-3, 4, (2, 64, 128), device="cuda").bfloat16()
+    out = torch.empty((2, 128, 128), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+    workspace = torch.empty(max(graph.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    pack = {x: xv, w: wv, y: out}
+    stream, captured, handle = torch.cuda.Stream(), torch.cuda.CUDAGraph(), cudnn.create_handle()
+    try:
+        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        cudnn.set_stream(handle, stream.cuda_stream)
+        with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+            graph.execute(pack, workspace, handle=handle)
+        stream.synchronize()
+        with warnings.catch_warnings():
+            warnings.filterwarnings("error", message="The CUDA Graph is empty.*")
+            with torch.cuda.graph(captured, stream=stream):

+                out.fill_(float("nan"))
+                captured.replay()

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Example 17: Mamba-2 SSD prefill (pure cuDNN frontend API).
+
+Mamba-2 is the gated delta rule without the erase term: one per-token scalar ``dt`` is both the
+decay exponent and the write strength::
+
+    dt_t = softplus(dt_t + dt_bias)            (clamped to [dt_min, dt_max] when given)
+    S_t  = exp(A dt_t) S_{t-1} + dt_t k_t^T v_t
+    o_t  = q_t S_t  (+ D x_t) (* z_t sigmoid(z_t))
+
+In the graph API's delta-rule vocabulary ``q`` = C, ``k`` = B, ``v`` = x and ``g`` = the raw
+``dt``; the node takes the decay rate ``a`` (A) itself.
+THD layout: ``[total, heads, dim]`` with ``cu_seqlens`` sequence boundaries; B / C may be
+grouped over the x heads.  The final state comes back V-major ``[N, H, P, N_state]``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import cudnn
+import torch
+
+
+def _build_plans(g) -> None:
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+    g.select_plan(names.index("mamba2_frost"))
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+
+
+def _rms_ratio(out, ref):
+    out, ref = out.detach().double(), ref.detach().double()
+    return ((out - ref).pow(2).mean().sqrt() / ref.pow(2).mean().sqrt().clamp_min(1e-12)).item()
+
+
+def _reference(q, k, v, dt_raw, A, dt_bias, cu):
+    """fp64 per-token recurrence over the packed batch. Returns (o, final_state) with a V-major state."""
+    total, H, P = v.shape
+    N_state = q.shape[2]
+    q, k, v, dt_raw, A, dt_bias = (x.double() for x in (q, k, v, dt_raw, A, dt_bias))
+    dt = torch.nn.functional.softplus(dt_raw + dt_bias)
+    alpha = torch.exp(A * dt)
+    o = torch.zeros(total, H, P, dtype=torch.float64, device=q.device)
+    fs = torch.zeros(cu.numel() - 1, H, P, N_state, dtype=torch.float64, device=q.device)
+    for i in range(cu.numel() - 1):
+        S = torch.zeros(H, N_state, P, dtype=torch.float64, device=q.device)
+        for t in range(int(cu[i]), int(cu[i + 1])):
+            S = alpha[t][:, None, None] * S + dt[t][:, None, None] * torch.einsum("hn,hp->hnp", k[t], v[t])
+            o[t] = torch.einsum("hn,hnp->hp", q[t], S)
+        fs[i] = S.transpose(-2, -1)
+    return o, fs
+
+
+def main(seq_lens=(192, 320), H: int = 2, N_state: int = 128, P: int = 64) -> None:
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    device = "cuda"
+    total, num_seqs = sum(seq_lens), len(seq_lens)
+
+    q = (torch.randn(total, H, N_state, device=device) * 0.1).bfloat16()  # C
+    k = torch.nn.functional.normalize(torch.randn(total, H, N_state, device=device), dim=-1).bfloat16()  # B
+    v = torch.randn(total, H, P, device=device).bfloat16()  # x
+    A = -(torch.rand(H, device=device) * 7.0 + 1.0)
+    dt_bias = torch.rand(H, device=device) * 0.5
+    dt_raw = (torch.rand(total, H, device=device) * 4.0 - 4.0).contiguous()
+    cu = torch.tensor([0, *torch.tensor(seq_lens).cumsum(0).tolist()], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+
+    g = cudnn.pygraph()
+    q_t = g.tensor([total, H, N_state], data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, name="q")
+    k_t = g.tensor([total, H, N_state], data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, name="k")

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Example 18: Mamba-2 SSD backward (pure cuDNN frontend API).
+
+The MAMBA2_BWD node takes the forward inputs plus ``dO`` and returns ``(dQ, dK, dV, dG, dA,
+d_initial_state, d_dt_bias, dD, dZ)``: ``dG`` is the gradient of the raw ``dt`` and ``dA``
+that of ``log(-A)``.  Without the optional per-chunk ``state_checkpoints`` input the engine
+regenerates the state series internally.  The tensor gradients are checked against fp64 autograd
+through the per-token recurrence; ``d_dt_bias`` against its identity ``sum_t dG_t`` (the per-head
+parameter sums cancel heavily across tokens, so the fp64 comparison of ``dA`` is loose).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import cudnn
+import torch
+
+
+def _build_plans(g) -> None:
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+    g.select_plan(names.index("mamba2_frost"))
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+
+
+def _rms_ratio(out, ref):
+    out, ref = out.detach().double(), ref.detach().double()
+    return ((out - ref).pow(2).mean().sqrt() / ref.pow(2).mean().sqrt().clamp_min(1e-12)).item()
+
+
+def _reference_o(q, k, v, dt_raw, a, dt_bias, cu):
+    """Differentiable fp64 per-token recurrence; returns o."""
+    H, P = v.shape[1], v.shape[2]
+    N_state = q.shape[2]
+    dt = torch.nn.functional.softplus(dt_raw + dt_bias)
+    alpha = torch.exp(a * dt)
+    outs = []
+    for i in range(cu.numel() - 1):
+        S = torch.zeros(H, N_state, P, dtype=torch.float64, device=q.device)
+        for t in range(int(cu[i]), int(cu[i + 1])):
+            S = alpha[t][:, None, None] * S + dt[t][:, None, None] * torch.einsum("hn,hp->hnp", k[t], v[t])
+            outs.append(torch.einsum("hn,hnp->hp", q[t], S))
+    return torch.stack(outs, dim=0)
+
+
+def main(seq_lens=(192, 320), H: int = 2, N_state: int = 128, P: int = 64) -> None:
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    device = "cuda"
+    total, num_seqs = sum(seq_lens), len(seq_lens)
+
+    q = (torch.randn(total, H, N_state, device=device) * 0.1).bfloat16()
+    k = torch.nn.functional.normalize(torch.randn(total, H, N_state, device=device), dim=-1).bfloat16()
+    v = torch.randn(total, H, P, device=device).bfloat16()
+    A = -(torch.rand(H, device=device) * 7.0 + 1.0)
+    dt_bias = torch.rand(H, device=device) * 0.5
+    dt_raw = (torch.rand(total, H, device=device) * 4.0 - 4.0).contiguous()
+    do = torch.randn(total, H, P, device=device).bfloat16()
+    cu = torch.tensor([0, *torch.tensor(seq_lens).cumsum(0).tolist()], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+
+    g = cudnn.pygraph()
+    q_t = g.tensor([total, H, N_state], data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, name="q")
+    k_t = g.tensor([total, H, N_state], data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, name="k")
+    v_t = g.tensor([total, H, P], data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, name="v")
+    g_t = g.tensor([total, H], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, name="g")
+    a_t = g.tensor([H], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, name="a")
+    dt_bias_t = g.tensor([H], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, name="dt_bias")
+    cu_t = g.tensor([num_seqs + 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32, name="cu_seqlens")
+    do_t = g.tensor([total, H, P], data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, name="dO")
+    dQ_t, dK_t, dV_t, dG_t, dA_t, _dS0_t, dDt_t, _dD_t, _dZ_t = g.mamba2_bwd(
+        q=q_t,
+        k=k_t,
+        v=v_t,
+        g=g_t,
+        a=a_t,
+        cu_seqlens=cu_t,
+        dO=do_t,
+        dt_bias=dt_bias_t,
+        name="mamba2_bwd",
+    )
+    for t_, dt in (
+        (dQ_t, cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16),
+        (dK_t, cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16),
+        (dV_t, cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16),
+        (dG_t, cudnn.data_type.FLOAT),
+        (dA_t, cudnn.data_type.FLOAT),
+        (dDt_t, cudnn.data_type.FLOAT),
+    ):
+        t_.set_output(True).set_data_type(dt)
+    _build_plans(g)
+
+    dq = torch.empty(total, H, N_state, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+    dk = torch.empty(total, H, N_state, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+    dv = torch.empty(total, H, P, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+    dg = torch.empty(total, H, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    dA = torch.empty(H, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    d_dt_bias = torch.empty(H, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    pack = {
+        q_t: q,
+        k_t: k,
+        v_t: v,
+        g_t: dt_raw,
+        a_t: A,
+        dt_bias_t: dt_bias,
+        cu_t: cu,
+        do_t: do,
+        dQ_t: dq,
+        dK_t: dk,
+        dV_t: dv,
+        dG_t: dg,
+        dA_t: dA,
+        dDt_t: d_dt_bias,
+    }
+    g.execute(pack, torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device))
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+    leaves = [x.double().requires_grad_(True) for x in (q, k, v, dt_raw, A, dt_bias)]
+    o_ref = _reference_o(*leaves, cu)
+    grads = torch.autograd.grad((o_ref * do.double()).sum(), leaves)
+    for name, out, ref, tol in (
+        ("dQ", dq, grads[0], 5e-2),
+        ("dK", dk, grads[1], 5e-2),
+        ("dV", dv, grads[2], 5e-2),
+        ("dG", dg, grads[3], 5e-2),
+    ):
+        r = _rms_ratio(out, ref)
+        assert r < tol, f"{name} rms ratio {r:.4g}"
+    ident = dg.double().sum(0)
+    assert (d_dt_bias.double() - ident).abs().max().item() / max(ident.abs().max().item(), 1e-6) < 1e-3, "d_dt_bias identity"
+    r_a = (dA.double() - grads[4]).abs().max().item() / max(grads[4].abs().max().item(), 1e-6)
+    print(f"[18] PASS  mamba2 backward (recompute) seq_lens={list(seq_lens)} H={H} N={N_state} P={P} (dA max-rel {r_a:.2e})")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""Example 19: Mamba-2 SSD forward summary (pure cuDNN frontend API).
+
+The MAMBA2_SUMMARY node is the state-only pass behind context parallelism: the
+Mamba-2 state recurrence over every packed sequence without the output GEMMs.
+In the graph API's delta-rule vocabulary ``k`` = B, ``v`` = x and ``g`` = the
+raw ``dt`` (and ``a`` = A), exactly as the MAMBA2 node of example 17. For
+every packed sequence it returns ``final_state`` ``[N, H, P, N_state]``, the
+state after the span from a zero seed (or from the optional
+``initial_state``), and with ``output_transition=True`` the span
+``transition`` ``[N, H]``: Mamba-2's transition is a scalar per head, the log2
+of the span's decay product ``exp(A sum_t dt_t)``, so that consecutive spans
+compose with one multiply::
+
+    X_{j+1} = exp2(transition_j) X_j + final_state_j
+
+Here one logical sequence is cut into two spans that are packed as two
+sequences. Each span's ``final_state`` is checked against the fp64 recurrence,
+its ``transition`` against the fp64 log2 decay sum, and the host-side
+composition against the fp64 final state of the uncut sequence. Decays near
+one keep the transition well away from zero, so the cross-span term of the
+composition is exercised.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import cudnn
+import torch
+
+
+def _build_plans(g) -> None:
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+    g.select_plan(names.index("mamba2_summary_frost"))
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+
+
+def _rms_ratio(out, ref):
+    out, ref = out.detach().double(), ref.detach().double()
+    return ((out - ref).pow(2).mean().sqrt() / ref.pow(2).mean().sqrt().clamp_min(1e-12)).item()
+
+
+def _reference_state(k, v, dt_raw, A, dt_bias, cu, s0):
+    """fp64 per-token recurrence over the packed batch from the V-major seed ``s0``.
+    Returns (final_state V-major, log2 decay sum per span and head)."""
+    H, P = v.shape[1], v.shape[2]
+    N_state = k.shape[2]
+    k, v, dt_raw, A, dt_bias = (x.double() for x in (k, v, dt_raw, A, dt_bias))
+    dt = torch.nn.functional.softplus(dt_raw + dt_bias)
+    log_alpha = A * dt
+    fs = torch.zeros(cu.numel() - 1, H, P, N_state, dtype=torch.float64, device=k.device)
+    transition = torch.zeros(cu.numel() - 1, H, dtype=torch.float64, device=k.device)
+    for i in range(cu.numel() - 1):
+        S = s0[i].double().transpose(-2, -1)
+        for t in range(int(cu[i]), int(cu[i + 1])):
+            S = log_alpha[t].exp()[:, None, None] * S + dt[t][:, None, None] * torch.einsum("hn,hp->hnp", k[t], v[t])
+        fs[i] = S.transpose(-2, -1)
+        transition[i] = log_alpha[int(cu[i]) : int(cu[i + 1])].sum(0) / torch.log(torch.tensor(2.0, dtype=torch.float64))
+    return fs, transition
+
+
+def main(spans=(192, 320), H: int = 2, N_state: int = 128, P: int = 64) -> None:
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    device = "cuda"
+    total, num_spans = sum(spans), len(spans)
+
+    k = torch.nn.functional.normalize(torch.randn(total, H, N_state, device=device), dim=-1).bfloat16()  # B
+    v = torch.randn(total, H, P, device=device).bfloat16()  # x
+    A = -(torch.rand(H, device=device) * 0.02 + 0.01)
+    dt_bias = torch.rand(H, device=device) * 0.5
+    dt_raw = (torch.rand(total, H, device=device) * 4.0 - 4.0).contiguous()
+    cu = torch.tensor([0, *torch.tensor(spans).cumsum(0).tolist()], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+
+    g = cudnn.pygraph()
+    k_t = g.tensor([total, H, N_state], data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, name="k")
+    v_t = g.tensor([total, H, P], data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, name="v")
+    g_t = g.tensor([total, H], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, name="g")
+    a_t = g.tensor([H], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, name="a")
+    dt_bias_t = g.tensor([H], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, name="dt_bias")
+    cu_t = g.tensor([num_spans + 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32, name="cu_seqlens")
+    fs_t, transition_t = g.mamba2_summary(
+        k=k_t,
+        v=v_t,
+        g=g_t,
+        a=a_t,
+        cu_seqlens=cu_t,
+        dt_bias=dt_bias_t,
+        output_transition=True,
+        name="mamba2_summary",
+    )
+    fs_t.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    transition_t.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    _build_plans(g)
+
+    final_state = torch.empty(num_spans, H, P, N_state, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    transition = torch.empty(num_spans, H, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    pack = {k_t: k, v_t: v, g_t: dt_raw, a_t: A, dt_bias_t: dt_bias, cu_t: cu, fs_t: final_state, transition_t: transition}
+    g.execute(pack, torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device))
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+    zero = torch.zeros(num_spans, H, P, N_state, dtype=torch.float64, device=device)
+    fs_ref, transition_ref = _reference_state(k, v, dt_raw, A, dt_bias, cu, zero)
+    cu_uncut = torch.tensor([0, total], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    composed_ref = _reference_state(k, v, dt_raw, A, dt_bias, cu_uncut, zero[:1])[0][0]
+    composed = torch.exp2(transition[1].double())[:, None, None] * final_state[0].double() + final_state[1].double()
+    r_h, r_m, r_x = _rms_ratio(final_state, fs_ref), _rms_ratio(transition, transition_ref), _rms_ratio(composed, composed_ref)

+    assert r_m < 1e-3, f"transition rms ratio {r_m:.4g}"
+    assert r_x < 2e-2, f"composed final state rms ratio {r_x:.4g}"
+    print(
+        f"[19] PASS  mamba2 summary              spans={list(spans)} H={H} N={N_state} P={P} (fs rms {r_h:.2e}, transition rms {r_m:.2e}, composed rms {r_x:.2e})"
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Example 20: Mamba-2 SSD backward summary (pure cuDNN frontend API).
+
+The MAMBA2_SUMMARY_BWD node is the reverse state-gradient pass behind context
+parallelism: the Mamba-2 state-gradient recurrence over every packed sequence
+without the input gradients. It reads ``q`` = C, ``g`` = the raw ``dt``
+(``a`` = A) and ``dO``; B and x play no part in the recurrence, and
+the node's ``k`` port is bound to C like the ``mamba2_summary_bwd`` op does.
+For every packed sequence it returns ``d_initial_state`` ``[N, H, P, N_state]``,
+the gradient of ``sum(o * dO)`` with respect to the span's incoming state from
+a zero outgoing state gradient (the optional ``d_final_state`` seeds it
+instead), and with ``output_transition=True`` the span ``transition``
+``[N, H]``, the log2 of the span's decay product, so that state gradients
+compose in reverse with one multiply::
+
+    dX_j = exp2(transition_j) dX_{j+1} + d_initial_state_j
+
+Here one logical sequence is cut into two spans that are packed as two
+sequences. Each span's ``d_initial_state`` is checked against fp64 autograd
+through the recurrence, its ``transition`` against the fp64 log2 decay sum,
+and the reverse host-side composition against the fp64 gradient of the uncut
+sequence with respect to its initial state.

+
+import cudnn
+import torch
+
+

+    g.validate()

+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])

+    g.select_plan(names.index("mamba2_summary_frost"))
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+
+
+def _rms_ratio(out, ref):
+    out, ref = out.detach().double(), ref.detach().double()
+    return ((out - ref).pow(2).mean().sqrt() / ref.pow(2).mean().sqrt().clamp_min(1e-12)).item()
+

+    """Differentiable fp64 per-token recurrence over the packed batch from the V-major seed ``s0``.
+    Returns (o, log2 decay sum per span and head)."""

+    log_alpha = A * dt
+    outs, transition = [], []
+    for i in range(cu.numel() - 1):
+        S = s0[i].transpose(-2, -1)
+        for t in range(int(cu[i]), int(cu[i + 1])):
+            S = log_alpha[t].exp()[:, None, None] * S + dt[t][:, None, None] * torch.einsum("hn,hp->hnp", k[t], v[t])
+            outs.append(torch.einsum("hn,hnp->hp", q[t], S))
+        transition.append(log_alpha[int(cu[i]) : int(cu[i + 1])].sum(0) / torch.log(torch.tensor(2.0, dtype=torch.float64)))
+    return torch.stack(outs, dim=0), torch.stack(transition, dim=0)
+

+def main(spans=(192, 320), H: int = 2, N_state: int = 128, P: int = 64) -> None:

+    v = torch.randn(total, H, P, device=device).bfloat16()  # x

+    dt_bias = torch.rand(H, device=device) * 0.5
+    dt_raw = (torch.rand(total, H, device=device) * 4.0 - 4.0).contiguous()
+    do = torch.randn(total, H, P, device=device).bfloat16()
+    cu = torch.tensor([0, *torch.tensor(spans).cumsum(0).tolist()], dtype=torch.int32, device=device)

+    q_t = g.tensor([total, H, N_state], data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, name="q")
+    k_t = g.tensor([total, H, N_state], data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, name="k")
+    g_t = g.tensor([total, H], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, name="g")
+    a_t = g.tensor([H], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, name="a")
+    dt_bias_t = g.tensor([H], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, name="dt_bias")
+    cu_t = g.tensor([num_spans + 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32, name="cu_seqlens")
+    do_t = g.tensor([total, H, P], data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, name="dO")
+    dS0_t, transition_t = g.mamba2_summary_bwd(
+        q=q_t,
+        k=k_t,
+        g=g_t,
+        a=a_t,
+        cu_seqlens=cu_t,
+        dO=do_t,
+        dt_bias=dt_bias_t,
+        output_transition=True,
+        name="mamba2_summary_bwd",
+    )
+    dS0_t.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    transition_t.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    _build_plans(g)
+
+    d_initial_state = torch.empty(num_spans, H, P, N_state, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    transition = torch.empty(num_spans, H, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    pack = {q_t: q, k_t: q, g_t: dt_raw, a_t: A, dt_bias_t: dt_bias, cu_t: cu, do_t: do, dS0_t: d_initial_state, transition_t: transition}
+    g.execute(pack, torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device))

+### fp32 operands and TF32 references
+
+Blackwell MMAs have no IEEE fp32 mode: fp32 operands run as TF32. Compute their
+torch reference with `torch.backends.cuda.matmul.fp32_precision = "tf32"` set
+explicitly in the test. Torch's default depends on the environment: NGC
+containers (CI) set `TORCH_ALLOW_TF32_CUBLAS_OVERRIDE=1`, while pip torch uses
+IEEE fp32. A test that relies on the default passes in CI and fails locally,
+where `test_gemm_swiglu.py` had 64 such failures.

+### Clamp gradients at the boundary
+
+torch 2.14 changed `clamp`'s backward on the boundary itself: `x.clamp(-7, 7)`
+at `x = [-7, 0, 7]` gives `[0, 1, 0]`, while 2.11 / 2.13 give `[1, 1, 1]`. An
+autograd oracle that puts inputs exactly on a clamp limit therefore changes with
+the image's torch. State the kernel's convention with an explicit
+`torch.where(inside, x, x.detach().clamp(lo, hi))` instead
+(`test_grouped_dgeglu_autograd.py::clamp_closed`, #1522).

+valid-memory control with and without that option before diagnosing a kernel

+detector, and retain a normal run of the real capture test without launch dumps.

+        origins.extend([offset] * length)

+        base += len(starts)

+    keys = torch.arange(total, device=q.device)
+    blocks = inputs["blk_base"][:, None] + (keys[None] - inputs["tok_base"][:, None]) // 4
+    in_bounds = (blocks >= 0) & (blocks < inputs["sel_blocks"].shape[1])
+    selected = torch.gather(inputs["sel_blocks"], 1, blocks.clamp(0, inputs["sel_blocks"].shape[1] - 1).long()) != 0
+    valid = in_bounds & selected & (keys[None] >= inputs["lo"][:, None]) & (keys[None] <= inputs["hi"][:, None])
+    out, lse = torch.empty_like(q), torch.empty((hq, total), dtype=torch.float64, device=q.device)
+    dq, dk, dv = torch.zeros_like(q), torch.zeros_like(k), torch.zeros_like(v)
+    for head in range(hq):
+        kv_head = head // (hq // hkv)
+        scores = (q[:, head] @ k[:, kv_head].T) * inputs["scale"]
+        scores.masked_fill_(~valid, -torch.inf)
+        normalizer = torch.logsumexp(scores, dim=-1)
+        safe_lse = torch.where(normalizer.isfinite(), normalizer, 0)
+        p = torch.exp(scores - safe_lse[:, None])
+        out[:, head] = p @ v[:, kv_head]
+        lse[head] = normalizer
+        if grad_out is not None:
+            do = grad_out[:, head].double()
+            stats = saved_lse[head].double()
+            p = torch.exp(scores - torch.where(stats.isfinite(), stats, 0)[:, None])
+            p = torch.where(valid & stats.isfinite()[:, None], p, 0)
+            delta = (do * saved_out[:, head].double()).sum(-1)
+            ds = p * (do @ v[:, kv_head].T - delta[:, None])
+            dq[:, head] = (ds @ k[:, kv_head]) * inputs["scale"]
+            dk[:, kv_head] += (ds.T @ q[:, head]) * inputs["scale"]
+            dv[:, kv_head] += p.T @ do
+    if grad_out is not None:
+        return dq, dk, dv
+    return out.to(inputs["q"].dtype), out, lse
+
+
+def assert_close(actual, expected):
+    assert torch.equal(torch.isneginf(actual), torch.isneginf(expected))
+    finite = expected.isfinite()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual[finite].double(), expected[finite].double(), atol=0.04, rtol=0.04)
+    diff = (actual[finite].double() - expected[finite].double()).norm()
+    # Absolute error governs analytically zero gradients.
+    bound = max(0.025 * expected[finite].double().norm().item(), 1e-3)
+    assert diff.item() <= bound

+def group_compaction_reference(inputs, nq):
+    """Compact IDs of the batched backward: per group of nq consecutive queries, the sorted union of their valid blocks,
+    each tagged with one owner bit per member above BLK_BITS (bit 31 for the fourth member of a quad). nq = 1 is the
+    single-query compaction: plain block indices."""
+    from cudnn.QSA._contract import BLK_BITS
+
+    sel, lo, hi = (inputs[name].cpu() for name in ("sel_blocks", "lo", "hi"))
+    first, last = inputs["block_first"].cpu(), inputs["block_last"].cpu()
+    total, blocks = sel.shape
+    valid = (sel != 0) & (last[None] >= lo[:, None]) & (first[None] <= hi[:, None]) & (lo[:, None] <= hi[:, None])
+    groups = (total + nq - 1) // nq
+    ids = torch.full((groups, blocks), -1, dtype=torch.int64)
+    counts = torch.zeros(groups, dtype=torch.int32)
+    for group in range(groups):
+        members = valid[group * nq : (group + 1) * nq]
+        owners = (members.long() << torch.arange(members.shape[0])[:, None]).sum(0)
+        chosen = torch.nonzero(owners).flatten()
+        ids[group, : chosen.numel()] = chosen | (owners[chosen] << BLK_BITS) if nq > 1 else chosen
+        counts[group] = chosen.numel()
+    return ids, counts
+

+    from cuda.bindings import driver as cuda
+    from cudnn.QSA import _metadata
+    from cudnn.QSA._contract import BLK_BITS
+
+    inputs = make_inputs(lengths, 12, 1, empty=True)
+    major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability()
+    compiled = _metadata.compile_group_kernel(major * 10 + minor, nq, BLK_BITS)
+    total, blocks = inputs["sel_blocks"].shape
+    groups = (total + nq - 1) // nq
+    ids = torch.full((groups, blocks), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    counts = torch.full((groups,), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    metadata = tuple(inputs[name] for name in ("sel_blocks", "lo", "hi", "block_first", "block_last"))
+
+    def launch():
+        compiled(*metadata, ids, counts, total, cuda.CUstream(torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream))
+
+    launch()

+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    try:
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+            launch()
+        for state in ("random", "last-member-only", "all"):
+            if state == "last-member-only":
+                inputs["sel_blocks"].zero_()
+                inputs["sel_blocks"][nq - 1 :: nq] = 1
+            elif state == "all":

+                assert (expected_ids >= 1 << 31).any(), "the case must exercise owner bit 31"
+            for run in (launch, graph.replay):
+                ids.fill_(-1)
+                counts.fill_(-1)
+                run()
+                torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                torch.testing.assert_close(counts.cpu(), expected_counts, atol=0, rtol=0)

+        last.extend(min(start + 3, origin + length - 1) for start in starts)
