+def _check_half_unpacked_control(g, bufs, tensors, check):
+    """The same HALF plan and input bindings must produce identical packed/unpacked results."""
+    selected_index = g._plan_index
+    selected = g.plans[selected_index]
+    control = {name: _clone_with_slack(value, float("nan") if value.is_floating_point() else 0) for name, value in bufs.items()}
+    # Retain the physical output canary and bind its logical view.
+    if "o_storage" in control:
+        control["o"] = control["o_storage"][..., : bufs["o"].shape[-1]].transpose(1, 2)
+    try:
+        g.create_execution_plan(selected.engine_id, replace(selected.knobs, pack_gqa=False, sched_policy=0))
+        g.select_plan(len(g.plans) - 1)
+        g.check_support()
+        g.build_plans()
+        workspace = torch.empty(max(1, g.get_workspace_size()), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+        for name in ("o", "lse", "amax_o"):
+            control[name].fill_(float("nan"))
+        g.execute({tensor: control[name] for name, tensor in tensors.items()}, workspace)
+        _check(control, **check)
+        for name in ("o", "lse", "amax_o"):
+            assert torch.equal(bufs[name].view(torch.uint8), control[name].view(torch.uint8)), name
+        if "o_storage" in control:
+            assert torch.all(control["o_storage"][..., bufs["o"].shape[-1] :] == 12)
+    finally:
+        g.select_plan(selected_index)
+
+
+def _run_packed(case, dtype, output, monkeypatch, half=False, adapter=False, split=1, pack=True):
+    d, dv, group, sq, skv, causal, bottom_right, window, sink, sched = case
+    heads = 2 * group
+    seen = _record_route(monkeypatch)
+    kwargs = dict(softmax_precision=cudnn.data_type.HALF) if half else {}
+    if causal:
+        kwargs.update(right_bound=0, diagonal_alignment=cudnn.diagonal_alignment.BOTTOM_RIGHT if bottom_right else cudnn.diagonal_alignment.TOP_LEFT)
+    if window is not None:
+        kwargs["left_bound"] = window
+    sinks = torch.linspace(-5, 8, heads, device="cuda").view(1, heads, 1, 1) if sink else None
+    qlens, klens = [sq, max(sq - 3, 0)], [skv, max(skv - 37, 0)]
+    g, vp, ws, bufs, tensors = dense._case(
+        arch="sm107",
+        d=d,
+        dv=dv,
+        b=2,
+        sq=sq,
+        skv=skv,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        output_dtype=output,
+        sink=sinks,
+        padded=True,
+        output_padding=16,
+        heads=(heads, 2),
+        seq_lens=(qlens, klens),
+        sdpa_kwargs=kwargs,
+    )
+    selected = g.plans[g._plan_index]
+    g.create_execution_plan(selected.engine_id, replace(selected.knobs, pack_gqa=pack, split_kv=split, sched_policy=sched, cga=1))
+    g.select_plan(len(g.plans) - 1)
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    ws = torch.empty(max(1, g.get_workspace_size()), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    assert seen and set(seen) == {"sm107/prefill_d256_fp8.py"}, seen
+    assert g.plans[g._plan_index].knobs.pack_gqa == pack
+    for name in ("q", "k", "v"):
+        value = bufs[name]
+        value._base[..., value.shape[-1] :].fill_(float("nan"))
+        value.copy_((value.float() * 2.5).to(dtype))
+    # Split chunks use independent maxima before FP8 P quantization. Compare
+    # them to a partitioned FP64 reference, not one unsplit rounding trajectory.
+    # HALF uses its independent per-partition P-rounding allowance; FLOAT and
+    # Stats/Amax keep their existing bounds.
+    check = dict(causal=causal, bottom_right=bottom_right, window=window, split=split, pack=pack, softmax_f16=half)
+    g.execute(vp, ws)
+    _check(bufs, **check)
+    if half and split == 1:
+        _check_half_unpacked_control(g, bufs, tensors, check)
+    if adapter:
+        plan = g._compiled_plans[g._plan_index]
+        prepared = plan._prepared
+        assert prepared is not None
+        frames = []
+        original = prepared.spec.fn
+
+        def record(*args):
+            frames.append(args)
+            return original(*args)
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr(prepared.spec, "fn", record)
+        if prepared.spec.native is not None:
+            monkeypatch.setattr(prepared.spec, "native", type(prepared.spec.native)(prepared.spec))
+        g.execute(vp, ws)
+        _check(bufs, **check)
+        takes_variant_pack = plan.takes_variant_pack
+        plan._prepared, plan.takes_variant_pack = None, False
+        try:
+            g.execute(vp, ws)
+            _check(bufs, **check)
+        finally:

+def _record_route(monkeypatch):
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd import api_dsl
+
+    seen = []
+    load = api_dsl._load_kernel_template
+
+    def record(filename, params, tag):
+        seen.append(filename)
+        return load(filename, params, tag)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(api_dsl, "_load_kernel_template", record)

+def _clone_with_slack(value, fill):
+    span = 1 + sum((n - 1) * stride for n, stride in zip(value.shape, value.stride()))
+    raw = torch.full((span,), fill, dtype=value.dtype, device=value.device)
+    clone = raw.as_strided(value.shape, value.stride())
+    clone.copy_(value)
+    return clone
+

+def _split_reference(q, k, v, *, split, pack, q_tile_rows=128, **kwargs):
+    """FP64 blocked reference with FP8 P rounded at each split's own maximum.
+
+    Partition logical score columns with a PyTorch bias mask; do not call the
+    kernel's scheduler, index helpers or combine. Full-attention Stats provide
+    an independent check that the partitions cover the same mathematical op.
+    """
+    from sdpa.fp8_ref import compute_ref
+
+    if split == 1:
+        return compute_ref(q, k, v, **kwargs)
+    b, sq, heads, _ = q.shape
+    skv = k.shape[1]
+    qlens, klens = kwargs["padding"] or (torch.full((b,), sq, device=q.device), torch.full((b,), skv, device=q.device))
+    rows = torch.arange(sq, device=q.device).view(1, sq)
+    tile_q = q_tile_rows // (heads // k.shape[2] if pack else 1)
+    first_q = rows // tile_q * tile_q
+    diagonal = (klens - qlens).view(b, 1) if kwargs["diag_align"] == cudnn.diagonal_alignment.BOTTOM_RIGHT else 0
+    first_key = torch.zeros((b, sq), device=q.device, dtype=torch.int64)
+    if kwargs["left_bound"] is not None:
+        first_key = (first_q + diagonal - kwargs["left_bound"]).clamp(min=0) // 128
+    last_key = ((klens.view(b, 1) + 127) // 128).expand(b, sq)
+    if kwargs["right_bound"] is not None:
+        last_key = torch.minimum(last_key, (first_q + tile_q + diagonal + kwargs["right_bound"] + 127) // 128)
+    count = (last_key - first_key).clamp(min=0)
+    count = torch.where(first_q < qlens.view(b, 1), count, 0)
+    columns = torch.arange(skv, device=q.device).view(1, 1, 1, skv)
+    outputs, logs, bounds = [], [], []
+    with_bound = kwargs.get("return_intermediates", False)
+    for index in range(split):
+        start = first_key + index * (count // split) + (count % split).clamp(max=index)
+        end = start + count // split + (index < count % split)
+        included = (columns >= start[:, None, :, None] * 128) & (columns < end[:, None, :, None] * 128)
+        bias = torch.where(included, 0.0, -torch.inf)
+        result = compute_ref(q, k, v, **dict(kwargs, bias=bias, sink_token=None))
+        partial, stats, _ = result[:3]
+        if with_bound:
+            bounds.append(_half_p_output_bound(result[3], v.transpose(1, 2), q.dtype, kwargs["v_descale"]))
+        outputs.append(partial.transpose(1, 2).double())
+        logs.append(stats.double())
+    terms = logs
+    sink = kwargs["sink_token"]
+    if sink is not None:
+        terms = logs + [sink.double().expand(b, heads, sq, 1)]
+    combined_stats = torch.logsumexp(torch.stack(terms), dim=0)
+    output = sum(partial * torch.exp(log - combined_stats).nan_to_num() for partial, log in zip(outputs, logs))
+    dead = rows[:, None, :, None] >= qlens.view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    combined_stats = combined_stats.masked_fill(dead, -torch.inf)
+    output = output.masked_fill(dead, 0)
+    _, full_stats, _ = compute_ref(q, k, v, **dict(kwargs, torch_itype=torch.float64, return_intermediates=False))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(combined_stats.float(), full_stats, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-6)
+    result = (output.transpose(1, 2).float(), full_stats, output.abs().max().item())
+    if with_bound:
+        # Each partition has its own P rounding and online-softmax gains.
+        # The combine is a nonnegative weighted sum, so propagate the bounds
+        # with independent FP64 partition weights, including the sink mass.
+        bound = sum(partial * torch.exp(log - combined_stats).nan_to_num() for partial, log in zip(bounds, logs))
+        return result + (bound.masked_fill(dead, 0),)
+    return result
+

+def _half_p_output_bound(parts, v, input_dtype, descale_v):
+    """Bound HALF + Stats output error from the independent FP64 reference.
+
+    The f16 input conversion and approximate exp2 can cross FP8 P midpoints.
+    PTX specifies relative error <= 2**-9.9 for ex2.approx.f16(x2):
+    https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution/#half-precision-floating-point-instructions-ex2
+    Propagate the possible P-code changes through |V| and the online-softmax
+    gains. This is an input-dependent bound, not a fitted tensor coordinate or
+    tolerance; packed/unpacked bitwise checks independently protect row mapping.
+    This helper covers one D256/D512 register-sum, Stats-present partition;
+    the split reference combines these bounds using independent FP64 weights.
+    """
+    from sdpa.fp16_ref import _pv
+
+    p = parts["p_scaled"]
+    shifted = torch.log2(p).to(torch.float16)
+    # Adjacent f16 arguments cover rounding of the f32 QK scale/shift.
+    lo = torch.nextafter(shifted, torch.full_like(shifted, -torch.inf)).double()
+    hi = torch.nextafter(shifted, torch.full_like(shifted, torch.inf)).double()
+    relative = 2.0**-9.9  # PTX ISA, ex2.approx.f16(x2) maximum relative error
+    lower = (torch.exp2(lo) * (1 - relative)).to(input_dtype).double()
+    upper = (torch.exp2(hi) * (1 + relative)).to(input_dtype).double()
+    nominal = p.to(input_dtype).double()
+    delta = torch.maximum((lower - nominal).abs(), (upper - nominal).abs())
+    delta = delta.masked_fill(~parts["valid"], 0)
+    return _pv(delta * parts["gain"] / 16.0, v.double().abs(), v.shape[1]) * descale_v
+
+
+def _check_half_fp8_o(output, reference, output_dtype, input_key, bound):
+    """Retain the ordinary residual bound after accounting for HALF P rounding."""
+    atol = 0.04
+    if output_dtype in (torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e5m2):
+        floor = (reference - reference.to(output_dtype).float()).abs().max().item()
+        atol = max(atol, 3.0 * floor)
+    error = (output.float() - reference).abs()
+    assert torch.all(error <= bound + atol), f"HALF P-bound exceeded: max excess={(error - bound).max().item():.6f} > {atol} ({input_key})"
+

+    d, dv, group, sq, skv, causal, bottom_right, window, sink, sched = case

+    seen = _record_route(monkeypatch)
+    kwargs = dict(softmax_precision=cudnn.data_type.HALF) if half else {}
+    if causal:

+    if window is not None:
+        kwargs["left_bound"] = window
+    sinks = torch.linspace(-5, 8, heads, device="cuda").view(1, heads, 1, 1) if sink else None
+    g, vp, _, bufs, tensors = dense._case(
+        arch="sm107",
+        d=d,
+        dv=dv,
+        b=2,
+        sq=sq,
+        skv=skv,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        output_dtype=output,
+        sink=sinks,
+        padded=True,
+        output_padding=16,
+        heads=(heads, 2),
+        seq_lens=([sq, max(sq - 3, 0)], [skv, max(skv - 37, 0)]),
+        sdpa_kwargs=kwargs,
+    )
+    selected = g.plans[g._plan_index]
+    g.create_execution_plan(selected.engine_id, replace(selected.knobs, pack_gqa=pack, split_kv=split, sched_policy=sched, cga=2))
+    g.select_plan(len(g.plans) - 1)

+    ws = torch.empty(max(1, g.get_workspace_size()), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    assert seen and set(seen) == {"sm107/prefill_d512_fp8.py"}, seen
+    assert g.plans[g._plan_index].knobs.pack_gqa == pack
+    for name in ("q", "k", "v"):
+        value = bufs[name]
+        value._base[..., value.shape[-1] :].fill_(float("nan"))

+    check = dict(causal=causal, bottom_right=bottom_right, window=window, softmax_f16=half, split=split, pack=pack, q_tile_rows=256)
+    g.execute(vp, ws)
+    _check(bufs, **check)
+    if half and split == 1:
+        _check_half_unpacked_control(g, bufs, tensors, check)
+    if adapter:
+        plan = g._compiled_plans[g._plan_index]
+        prepared, takes_variant_pack = plan._prepared, plan.takes_variant_pack
+        assert prepared is not None
+        plan._prepared, plan.takes_variant_pack = None, False
+        try:
+            g.execute(vp, ws)
+            _check(bufs, **check)
+        finally:
+            plan._prepared, plan.takes_variant_pack = prepared, takes_variant_pack

+            g.execute(vp, ws)
+        fresh = {n: _clone_with_slack(v, 0 if v.dtype == torch.int32 else float("nan")) for n, v in bufs.items() if n != "o_storage"}
+        fresh["descale_q"].fill_(1.1)
+        fresh["scale_o"].fill_(0.6)
+        if sink:
+            fresh["sinks"].copy_(sinks.flip(1))
+        g.execute({t: fresh[n] for n, t in tensors.items()}, torch.empty_like(ws))
+        _check(fresh, **check)
+        if half and split == 1:
+            _check_half_unpacked_control(g, fresh, tensors, check)
+        bufs["seq_q"].copy_(torch.tensor([min(sq, 7), 0], device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).view(2, 1, 1, 1))
+        bufs["seq_kv"].copy_(torch.tensor([min(skv, 129), 0], device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).view(2, 1, 1, 1))
+        bufs["descale_v"].fill_(0.3)
+        if sink:

+        for name in ("o", "lse", "amax_o"):
+            bufs[name].fill_(float("nan"))
+        capture.replay()
+        _check(bufs, **check)

+        assert torch.all(bufs["o_storage"][..., dv:] == 12)

+"""Shared SM107 half-precision inputs and references, independent of test entries."""
+
+import pytest
+
+
+def _rubin_only():
+    import torch
+
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.get_device_capability() != (10, 7):
+        pytest.skip("the fused epilogue gate is served by the sm107 d256 kernels (cc10.7) only")
+
+
+def _half_prefold_tensors(b, hq, hkv, s_q, s_kv, d_qk, d_v, dtype, prefold_scale, *, seed):
+    """Half Q / K / V in BSHD storage (BHSD views) the way the engine consumes them.  ``prefold_scale`` multiplies the f32 Q
+    BEFORE the half cast (the softmax_scale_prefolded contract; 1.0 on the unfolded leg)."""
+    import torch
+
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+
+    def rnd(*shape):
+        return torch.randn(*shape, device="cuda", generator=g) * 0.5
+
+    q = (rnd(b, s_q, hq, d_qk) * prefold_scale).to(dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    k = rnd(b, s_kv, hkv, d_qk).to(dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    v = rnd(b, s_kv, hkv, d_v).to(dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    return q, k, v
+
+
+def _dense_mask(s_q, s_kv, *, causal=False, bottom_right=False, window_left=None):
+    """The (s_q, s_kv) bool mask of the dense band the adapter kwargs describe, or None for no mask."""
+    import torch
+
+    if not causal and window_left is None:
+        return None
+    i = torch.arange(s_q, device="cuda")[:, None] + ((s_kv - s_q) if bottom_right else 0)
+    j = torch.arange(s_kv, device="cuda")[None, :]
+    masked = torch.zeros(s_q, s_kv, dtype=torch.bool, device="cuda")
+    if causal:
+        masked |= j > i
+    if window_left is not None:
+        masked |= j < i - window_left
+    return masked
+
+
+def _half_oracle(q, k, v, *, logit_scale, masked=None, sinks=None):
+    """float64 softmax(logit_scale * Q K^T) V on the half inputs the kernel saw (BHSD, GQA expanded) -> (O, LSE natural).
+    ``masked`` broadcasts over (..., s_q, s_kv).  A keyless row gives O = 0 and LSE = -inf, or LSE = the head's sink logit
+    when a sink joins the row as one extra column (the sink's mass is the row's whole denominator then)."""
+    import torch
+
+    rep = q.shape[1] // k.shape[1]
+    logits = (q.double() @ k.double().repeat_interleave(rep, 1).transpose(-1, -2)) * logit_scale
+    if masked is not None:
+        logits = logits.masked_fill(masked, float("-inf"))
+    full = logits if sinks is None else torch.cat([logits, sinks.double().view(1, -1, 1, 1).expand(*logits.shape[:3], 1)], dim=-1)
+    probs = torch.softmax(full, dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0)[..., : logits.shape[-1]]
+    return probs @ v.double().repeat_interleave(rep, 1), torch.logsumexp(full, dim=-1)
+
+
+def _half_prefold_api(
+    d_qk,
+    d_v,
+    dtype,
+    *,
+    prefolded,
+    with_stats,
+    split_kv,
+    b,
+    hq,
+    hkv,
+    s_q,
+    s_kv,
+    causal=False,
+    bottom_right=False,
+    window_left=None,
+    sink=False,
+    seed=0,
+    attn_scale=None,
+    pack_gqa=False,
+    tile_n=None,
+):
+    """The adapter of one leg (folded or unfolded) of a dense problem on the cc 10.7 half twin, plus its tensors.
+    ``attn_scale`` defaults to d_qk ** -0.5; the leading-dead-tile cells pass 1.0 (scale_log2 > 1)."""
+    import math
+
+    import torch
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.api_dsl import SdpaFwdDslSm100
+
+    attn_scale = d_qk**-0.5 if attn_scale is None else attn_scale
+    q, k, v = _half_prefold_tensors(b, hq, hkv, s_q, s_kv, d_qk, d_v, dtype, attn_scale * math.log2(math.e) if prefolded else 1.0, seed=seed)
+    out = torch.full((b, s_q, hq, d_v), float("nan"), device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)  # sentinel: an unclaimed tile stays visible
+    lse = torch.full((b, hq, s_q), float("nan"), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32) if with_stats else None
+    sinks = torch.linspace(-2.0, 6.0, hq, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32) if sink else None
+    api = SdpaFwdDslSm100(
+        sample_q=q,
+        sample_k=k,
+        sample_v=v,
+        sample_o=out,
+        sample_lse=lse,
+        scale_softmax=None if prefolded else attn_scale,
+        is_causal=causal,
+        causal_bottom_right=bottom_right,
+        window_size_left=window_left,
+        has_sink=sink,
+        cga=2,
+        split_kv=split_kv,
+        pack_gqa=pack_gqa,
+        softmax_scale_prefolded=prefolded,
+        tile_n=tile_n,
+    )
+    return api, dict(q=q, k=k, v=v, out=out, lse=lse, sinks=sinks, attn_scale=attn_scale)

+"""Frozen Python frame oracle; never imported by production execution."""
+
+import math
+from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.prepared_sm80 import ROLES
+
+
+def _same_geometry(actual, expected):
+    # Graph Stats and vector operands may carry extra singleton dimensions.
+    return tuple((n, st) for n, st in zip(*actual) if n != 1) == tuple((n, st) for n, st in zip(*expected) if n != 1)
+
+
+def bind(spec, facts, stream_int, *, scale=None, overridden=None, raw_storage=False):
+    frame = []
+    for name, op in zip(ROLES, spec.operands):
+        f = facts.get(name)
+        if op is None:
+            if f is not None:
+                raise ValueError(f"sdpa_fwd_sm80: {name} was not compiled into this specialization")
+            frame.append(None)
+            continue
+        if f is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"sdpa_fwd_sm80: {name} is required by this specialization")
+        if f.device not in ((2, spec.device_index), (-1, -1)):
+            raise ValueError(f"sdpa_fwd_sm80: {name} must be on CUDA device {spec.device_index}")
+        if f.dtype and f.dtype != op.dtype:
+            raise ValueError(f"sdpa_fwd_sm80: {name} must be {op.dtype}; got {f.dtype}")
+        if not f.ptr or f.ptr % op.alignment:
+            raise ValueError(f"sdpa_fwd_sm80: {name} base address must be {op.alignment}-byte aligned")
+        if f.span >= 0 and f.span < op.span:
+            raise ValueError(f"sdpa_fwd_sm80: {name} backing storage is too small for the declared strides")
+        if not raw_storage and name in ("seq_q", "seq_kv", "sink") and f.shape:
+            if not f.contiguous or f.numel != math.prod(op.shape):
+                raise ValueError(f"sdpa_fwd_sm80: {name} must be contiguous with {math.prod(op.shape)} elements")
+        elif not raw_storage and name == "stats" and f.shape:
+            # Preserve the standalone Stats storage contract: compact plans may
+            # bind a flat contiguous buffer; strided plans use declared strides.
+            if f.numel != math.prod(op.shape) or (op.contiguous and not f.contiguous):
+                raise ValueError("sdpa_fwd_sm80: Stats must match the declared element count and storage layout")
+        elif not raw_storage and name == "bias" and f.shape:
+            # The standalone ABI broadcasts the first contiguous [H,SQ,SKV]
+            # bias plane; retain that view semantics without constructing it.
+            if len(f.shape) != 4 or f.shape[0] < 1 or not _same_geometry((f.shape[1:], f.strides[1:]), (op.shape[1:], op.strides[1:])):
+                raise ValueError("sdpa_fwd_sm80: bias must have a contiguous [H,SQ,SKV] first plane")
+        elif (not raw_storage or (overridden is not None and name in overridden)) and f.shape:
+            if not _same_geometry((f.shape, f.strides), (op.shape, op.strides)):
+                raise ValueError(f"sdpa_fwd_sm80: {name} runtime geometry must match this fixed forward plan")
+        frame.append(f.ptr)
+    scale = spec.scale if scale is None else float(scale)
+    if (scale > 0) != (spec.scale > 0) or (scale < 0) != (spec.scale < 0):
+        raise ValueError("sdpa_fwd_sm80: attn_scale sign must match the compiled plan's")
+    scale = abs(scale) if scale else 1.0
+    frame.extend((scale * math.log2(math.e), 1.0 / scale, stream_int))
+    return frame

+"""The degenerate-input matrix of the f16/bf16 d128-FILE small tiles, the fp64 oracle of the whole forward contract and the pinned
+graph run -- ONE helper for every arch's small-tile module (the Rubin head-dim module carries the original copy; the SM100 module
+imports this one).  ``run_graph`` takes the engine ROW to pin, the only arch-specific input.
+
+Every cell asserts on the OUTPUT directly where the contract is degenerate (keyless rows EXACTLY 0 / -inf, never a residue), launches
+TWICE on sentinel-filled buffers (the two-launch delta) and compares the live rows against the fp64 oracle at the row's tolerances.
+"""
+
+import math
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from frost_test_utils import make_dense_stats
+
+# the existing f16 row tolerances: O against the fp64 oracle (an fp32 accumulation, one 16-bit rounding at the store), the LSE pair
+TOL_O = dict(atol=5e-2, rtol=3e-2)
+TOL_LSE = dict(atol=1e-4, rtol=1e-4)
+
+CASES = {
+    # the degenerate-input matrix (sdpa-invariants.md s9): the KV ring sweep n_kv = 1 (the P14 phase-drift shape), 2, 3, 4 (the ring
+    # depth), 5 (depth + 1), 8 -- every one with B*H > 1; tail tiles (S not a multiple of 128; the row's synthesized KV padding on the
+    # dense one, whose Q tail also exercises the OOB-row store guard); GQA; a zero-length KV batch; keyless bottom-right rows with a
+    # sink and padded-Q trim; keyless rows past a left window; a right band; ONE CTA / one tile in the whole launch (B*H = 1, n_kv = 1)
+    "dense_one_tile_bh1": dict(b=1, h=1, h_kv=1, s_q=128, s_kv=128),
+    "dense_nkv1": dict(b=2, h=2, h_kv=2, s_q=128, s_kv=128),
+    "dense_nkv2": dict(b=2, h=4, h_kv=4, s_q=256, s_kv=256),
+    "dense_nkv3_tail_300": dict(b=2, h=2, h_kv=2, s_q=300, s_kv=300),
+    "dense_nkv4_512": dict(b=2, h=2, h_kv=2, s_q=512, s_kv=512),
+    "dense_nkv5_640": dict(b=2, h=2, h_kv=2, s_q=640, s_kv=640),
+    "dense_nkv8_1024": dict(b=2, h=2, h_kv=2, s_q=1024, s_kv=1024),
+    "causal_tail_385": dict(b=1, h=4, h_kv=4, s_q=385, s_kv=385, causal=True),
+    "right_band_64_tail_300": dict(b=2, h=2, h_kv=2, s_q=300, s_kv=300, right_bound=64),
+    "causal_swa128_padded_385": dict(b=2, h=2, h_kv=2, s_q=385, s_kv=385, causal=True, window_left=128, kv_lens=[385, 200]),
+    "causal_gqa_8_2": dict(b=2, h=8, h_kv=2, s_q=256, s_kv=256, causal=True),
+    "padded_kv_zero_batch": dict(b=3, h=4, h_kv=4, s_q=256, s_kv=256, kv_lens=[256, 0, 100]),
+    "bottom_right_keyless_sink": dict(b=3, h=8, h_kv=4, s_q=256, s_kv=256, bottom_right=True, q_lens=[256, 129, 0], kv_lens=[200, 256, 128], sink=True),
+}
+
+
+def bhsd(b, h, s, d, dtype):
+    return torch.randn(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+def ref(q, k, v, *, scale, causal=False, bottom_right=False, seq_q_lens=None, seq_kv_lens=None, sinks=None, window_left=None, right_bound=None):
+    """fp64 oracle of the whole contract: O and the natural-log LSE per row class (keyless rows -inf / 0)."""
+    b, h_q, s_q, _ = q.shape
+    _, h_kv, s_kv, _ = v.shape
+    dev = q.device
+    g = h_q // h_kv
+    k_ref = k.repeat_interleave(g, dim=1).double()
+    v_ref = v.repeat_interleave(g, dim=1).double()
+    scores = torch.matmul(q.double(), k_ref.transpose(-1, -2)) * scale
+    q_lens = seq_q_lens.flatten().to(device=dev, dtype=torch.int64) if seq_q_lens is not None else torch.full((b,), s_q, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
+    kv_lens = seq_kv_lens.flatten().to(device=dev, dtype=torch.int64) if seq_kv_lens is not None else torch.full((b,), s_kv, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
+    i = torch.arange(s_q, device=dev).view(1, 1, s_q, 1)
+    j = torch.arange(s_kv, device=dev).view(1, 1, 1, s_kv)
+    diag = i + (kv_lens - q_lens).view(b, 1, 1, 1) if bottom_right else i
+    dead_q = i >= q_lens.view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    masked = dead_q | (j >= kv_lens.view(b, 1, 1, 1))
+    if causal:
+        masked = masked | (j > diag)
+    if right_bound is not None:
+        masked = masked | (j > diag + right_bound)
+    if window_left is not None:
+        masked = masked | (j < diag - window_left)
+    scores = scores.masked_fill(masked, float("-inf"))
+    full = scores if sinks is None else torch.cat([scores, sinks.view(1, h_q, 1, 1).double().expand(b, h_q, s_q, 1)], dim=-1)
+    smax = full.max(dim=-1).values
+    ssum = torch.exp(full - smax.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0)
+    lse = smax + torch.log(ssum)
+    o = torch.matmul(torch.softmax(full, dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0)[..., :s_kv], v_ref)
+    dead = dead_q.squeeze(-1)
+    return dict(o=o, lse=lse.masked_fill(dead, float("-inf")), smax=smax.masked_fill(dead, float("-inf")), empty=torch.isneginf(lse) | dead)
+
+
+def case_inputs(case, d, dtype, *, seed=0):
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    c = CASES[case]
+    q = bhsd(c["b"], c["h"], c["s_q"], d, dtype)
+    k = bhsd(c["b"], c["h_kv"], c["s_kv"], d, dtype)
+    v = bhsd(c["b"], c["h_kv"], c["s_kv"], d, dtype)
+    kv_lens = torch.tensor(c["kv_lens"], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").view(c["b"], 1, 1, 1) if "kv_lens" in c else None
+    q_lens = torch.tensor(c["q_lens"], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").view(c["b"], 1, 1, 1) if "q_lens" in c else None
+    sink = torch.randn(1, c["h"], 1, 1, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda") if c.get("sink") else None
+    causal = bool(c.get("causal") or c.get("bottom_right"))
+    sdpa_kwargs = dict(use_causal_mask_bottom_right=True) if c.get("bottom_right") else (dict(use_causal_mask=True) if causal else {})
+    window_left = c.get("window_left")
+    if window_left is not None:
+        sdpa_kwargs["sliding_window_length"] = window_left + 1  # the graph's length L keeps L keys up to the diagonal: W = L - 1
+    right_bound = c.get("right_bound")
+    if right_bound is not None:
+        sdpa_kwargs["diagonal_band_right_bound"] = right_bound  # alone: with use_causal_mask the bound is forced back to 0
+    scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(d) if not c.get("bottom_right") else 0.75
+    oracle = ref(
+        q, k, v, scale=scale, causal=causal, bottom_right=bool(c.get("bottom_right")), seq_q_lens=q_lens, seq_kv_lens=kv_lens,
+        sinks=sink.flatten() if sink is not None else None, window_left=window_left, right_bound=right_bound,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    return q, k, v, dict(scale=scale, sdpa_kwargs=sdpa_kwargs, seq_len_kv=kv_lens, seq_len_q=q_lens, sink=sink), oracle
+
+
+def run_graph(
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    *,
+    row,
+    scale,
+    sdpa_kwargs=None,
+    seq_len_kv=None,
+    seq_len_q=None,
+    sink=None,
+    stats=True,
+    stats_log2=False,

+    dev = wl.q.device

+    ref_lse = torch.full((B, H, S), float("-inf"), device=dev, dtype=torch.float32)
+    for b in range(B):
+        L = int(wl.kv_lens[b])
+        allowed = oracle.qsa_visible_mask(wl.block_ids[b], wl.block_lens[b], torch.arange(S, device=dev), L, SKV, BLOCK_SIZE, top_k=wl.top_k)
+        for h in range(H):
+            kk, vv = wl.k[b, :, h // G].float(), wl.v[b, :, h // G].float()
+            sc = (wl.q[b, :, h].float() @ kk.t()) * scale
+            sc = sc.masked_fill(~allowed, float("-inf"))
+            rmax = sc.amax(dim=-1)
+            dead = torch.isinf(rmax) & (rmax < 0)
+            safe = torch.where(dead, torch.zeros_like(rmax), rmax)
+            p = torch.where(allowed, torch.exp(sc - safe[:, None]), torch.zeros_like(sc))
+            den = p.sum(dim=-1)
+            oc = (p @ vv) / torch.where(dead, torch.ones_like(den), den)[:, None]
+            ref_o[b, :, h] = torch.where(dead[:, None], torch.zeros_like(oc), oc)
+            ref_lse[b, h] = torch.where(dead, torch.full_like(den, float("-inf")), safe + torch.log(den))
+    return ref_o, ref_lse
+
+
+def checked_digest(wl: ItemSequenceWorkList, o: torch.Tensor, lse: torch.Tensor) -> str:
+    """sha256 of the rows the comparison covers (every row whose query is finite, plus the dead rows): the cross-process
+    bitwise pin.  NaN-query live rows are left out -- their values are not part of the contract."""
+    B, S, H, _, _ = wl.shape
+    nan_rows = wl.nan_tokens[None, :, None].expand(B, S, H) & ~wl.expected_dead[:, :, None].expand(B, S, H)
+    keep = ~nan_rows
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    h.update(o[keep].contiguous().view(torch.int16).cpu().numpy().tobytes())
+    h.update(lse.permute(0, 2, 1)[keep].contiguous().view(torch.int32).cpu().numpy().tobytes())
+    return h.hexdigest()
+
+
+def evaluate(wl: ItemSequenceWorkList, o: torch.Tensor, lse: torch.Tensor, ref_o: torch.Tensor, ref_lse: torch.Tensor, atol: float) -> Dict[str, object]:
+    """The cell's verdicts: sentinel survivors (never written), NaN on a finite-query row, dead rows exact, the oracle distance
+    on the live finite-query rows.  Returns metrics + ``failures`` (empty = PASS); the caller asserts or maps to an exit code."""
+    B, S, H, _, _ = wl.shape
+    sent = sentinel_for(wl.q.dtype)
+    of = o.float()
+    dead = wl.expected_dead[:, :, None].expand(B, S, H)  # [B, S, H]
+    ref_dead = torch.isinf(ref_lse).permute(0, 2, 1)  # the oracle's own dead rows, [B, S, H]
+    nan_q = wl.nan_tokens[None, :, None].expand(B, S, H)
+    lse_bsh = lse.permute(0, 2, 1)
+    ref_lse_bsh = ref_lse.permute(0, 2, 1)
+    failures: List[str] = []
+
+    # the sentinel AS THE OUTPUT DTYPE STORES IT: 1.5e30 is not a bf16 value (it lands at 1.4954e30), so a detector that compared
+    # the widened output against the Python float would never fire on bf16 -- the kernel module's `_stored_sentinel` rule
+    sent_o = float(torch.full((), sent, dtype=o.dtype).float())
+    sent_o_rows = int((of == sent_o).any(dim=-1).sum())
+    sent_lse = int((lse == sent).sum())
+    if sent_o_rows or sent_lse:
+        failures.append(f"sentinel survived on {sent_o_rows} O rows / {sent_lse} LSE cells (never written)")
+
+    # The host's dead set and the oracle's must agree (a construction check, not a kernel check).
+    if not torch.equal(dead, ref_dead):
+        failures.append(f"host dead set ({int(dead.sum())}) != oracle dead set ({int(ref_dead.sum())})")
+
+    live_finite = ~dead & ~nan_q
+    nan_o_rows = int((~torch.isfinite(of)).any(dim=-1)[live_finite].sum())
+    nan_lse = int((~torch.isfinite(lse_bsh))[live_finite].sum())
+    if nan_o_rows or nan_lse:
+        failures.append(f"non-finite output on {nan_o_rows} O rows / {nan_lse} LSE cells whose query is finite (residue travelled)")
+
+    dead_o_ok = bool((of[dead] == 0).all()) if dead.any() else True
+    dead_lse_ok = bool((torch.isinf(lse_bsh[dead]) & (lse_bsh[dead] < 0)).all()) if dead.any() else True
+    if not (dead_o_ok and dead_lse_ok):
+        failures.append(f"dead rows not exact: O == 0 {dead_o_ok}, LSE == -inf {dead_lse_ok}")
+
+    d_o = (of - ref_o).abs()
+    d_o = torch.where(live_finite[..., None], d_o, torch.zeros_like(d_o))
+    d_lse = torch.where(live_finite, (lse_bsh - ref_lse_bsh).abs(), torch.zeros_like(lse_bsh))
+    max_o = float(d_o.max()) if live_finite.any() else 0.0
+    max_lse = float(d_lse.max()) if live_finite.any() else 0.0
+    if not (max_o <= atol and max_lse <= atol):
+        failures.append(f"outside the budget: max|dO| {max_o:.5f} max|dLSE| {max_lse:.6f} > {atol}")
+
+    return dict(
+        failures=failures,
+        max_abs_o=max_o,
+        max_abs_lse=max_lse,
+        sentinel_o_rows=sent_o_rows,
+        sentinel_lse=sent_lse,
+        nonfinite_o_rows=nan_o_rows,
+        nonfinite_lse=nan_lse,
+        dead_rows=int(dead.sum()),
+        dead_o_is_zero=dead_o_ok,
+        dead_lse_is_neg_inf=dead_lse_ok,
+        live_rows_checked=int(live_finite.sum()),
+        nan_query_rows=int((nan_q & ~dead).sum()),
+        digest=checked_digest(wl, o, lse),
+    )
+
+
+def default_scale() -> float:
+    return 1.0 / math.sqrt(D)

+        b=8,
+        h_q=64,
+        h_kv=1,
+        s_q=1,
+        s_kv=8192,
+        d_qk=576,
+        d_v=512,
+        dtype=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16,

+@pytest.mark.L0
+def test_entries_are_well_formed_and_name_known_rows():
+    from cudnn.sdpa.bwd.engines import ENGINE_SPECS as BWD
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.engines import ENGINE_SPECS as FWD
+
+    rows = {s.name for s in FWD} | {s.name for s in BWD}
+    for key, entry in pt.TABLE.items():
+        row, cc, dtype, heads, phase, layout, mask, sink, group, kv_off_tile = key
+        assert row in rows, key
+        assert isinstance(cc, tuple) and len(cc) == 2 and dtype in ("bf16", "f16") and len(heads) == 2
+        assert phase in ("q1", "mtp", "prefill") and layout in ("dense", "paged", "thd", "thd_ragged")
+        assert mask in ("none", "window", "causal_br", "causal_tl") and isinstance(sink, bool) and group in ("mha", "gqa", "gqa_unpacked")
+        assert isinstance(kv_off_tile, bool)
+        assert entry.direction in ("always", "never", "ge", "le") and entry.study
+        assert (entry.log2_work is None) == (entry.direction in ("always", "never"))
+        assert entry.feature in pt.FEATURES
+
+
+@pytest.mark.L0
+def test_class_key_ignores_bottom_right_causal_for_one_query_row():
+    """A single bottom-right row sees every key (no mask); a single top-left row sees only key 0 -- a different graph."""
+    assert pt.class_key("r", _facts(causal=True, bottom_right=True)) == pt.class_key("r", _facts(causal=False))
+    assert pt.class_key("r", _facts(causal=True, bottom_right=False))[6] == "causal_tl"
+    assert pt.class_key("r", _facts(s_q=2, causal=True, bottom_right=True))[6] == "causal_br"

+@pytest.mark.L0

+)
+def test_unmeasured_features_never_reach_the_table(feature):

+    assert pt.lookup(row, _facts()) is not None, "the D576 decode entry should answer the plain graph"
+    assert pt.lookup(row, _facts(**feature)) is None

+@pytest.mark.L0
+def test_threshold_entries_split_on_log2_work():

+    low, high = _facts(h_q=16, b=1, s_kv=2048), _facts(h_q=128, b=128, s_kv=131072)
+    assert pt.log2_work(low) < entry.log2_work < pt.log2_work(high)

+@pytest.mark.L0
+def test_cost_proxy_is_byte_bound_for_decode_and_flop_bound_for_prefill():

+@pytest.mark.L0
+def test_kv_off_the_tile_is_its_own_class_with_its_own_entry():

+    FROST; off-tile paged d256 decode wins at lower cost than on-tile), and every measured on-tile class has a measured
+    off-tile twin, so an off-tile graph is never answered by an on-tile study nor dropped to the backend (review on #1957: an
+    off-tile paged D576 decode, B1 H_q16 S_kv 49151, lost its FROST split route)."""

+    for kw in (dict(), dict(has_paged_kv=False, d_qk=256, d_v=256, h_q=16)):
+        assert pt.class_key(row, _facts(s_kv=8191, **kw))[-1] is True
+        assert pt.class_key(row, _facts(s_kv=8192, **kw))[-1] is False
+    for key in pt.TABLE:
+        assert key[:-1] + (not key[-1],) in pt.TABLE, key
+    assert pt.lookup(row, _facts(s_kv=49151, h_q=16, b=1)) is True

+@pytest.mark.L0
+def test_off_tile_dense_d256_decode_reads_parallel_tiles():
+    """Off the KV tile FROST cannot split, so dense d256 decode follows the parallel tiles (b * h_kv), not the cost: the
+    generated entry thresholds on "tiles" and is indifferent to S_kv."""
+    row = "sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100"
+    d256 = dict(d_qk=256, d_v=256, has_paged_kv=False, h_q=16, h_kv=1)
+    entry = pt.TABLE[pt.class_key(row, _facts(s_kv=8191, b=1, **d256))]
+    assert entry.feature == "tiles"
+    for s_kv in (2049, 32769, 131071):
+        assert pt.lookup(row, _facts(s_kv=s_kv, b=16, **d256)) is False
+        assert pt.lookup(row, _facts(s_kv=s_kv, b=64, **d256)) is True
+        assert pt.lookup(row, _facts(s_kv=s_kv, b=40, **d256)) is True  # 33-63 tiles measured on 9.28 and 9.26 (review on #1957)

+def test_off_tile_dense_d576_decode_reads_query_rows():

+    not the cost: 256 rows lose (1.13-1.25 on the training grid) and 384 win (0.86-0.90), for any b / h_q split."""
+    row = "sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100"
+    dense = dict(has_paged_kv=False, d_qk=576, d_v=512, h_kv=1, s_kv=32765)
+    assert pt.TABLE[pt.class_key(row, _facts(b=1, h_q=8, **dense))].feature == "rows"
+    for b, h_q in ((8, 32), (2, 128), (32, 8)):

+    for b, h_q in ((4, 96), (3, 128), (48, 8)):
+        assert pt.lookup(row, _facts(b=b, h_q=h_q, **dense)) is True

+@pytest.mark.L0
+def test_decode_the_row_cannot_pack_is_its_own_group():
+    """A decode-shaped GQA graph the FROST row cannot pack re-reads K/V per query head -- another kernel regime (paged d512
+    at G = 12-96: 5-21x slower than packed neighbours). The row's own pack decision splits the class, so the packed study
+    never answers for it; a flavor that packs a partial group (D576 at G = 96 packs 32) keeps the packed class."""
+    row = "sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100"
+    d512 = dict(d_qk=512, d_v=512, h_kv=1, b=8, s_kv=65536, page_size=64, padded=True)
+    assert pt.class_key(row, _facts(h_q=96, **d512))[8] == "gqa_unpacked"

+    assert pt.class_key(row, _facts(h_q=64, **d512))[8] == "gqa"
+    assert pt.lookup(row, _facts(h_q=64, **d512)) is True
+    assert pt.class_key(row, _facts(h_q=96, page_size=64, padded=True))[8] == "gqa"  # D576 packs 32 of 96
+    assert pt.class_key(row, _facts(h_q=96, s_q=1024, **d512))[8] == "gqa"  # prefill: s_q fills the tile, no packing regime
+

+@pytest.mark.L0
+def test_cc103_borrows_only_the_studies_its_transfer_check_named(monkeypatch):
+    """cc 10.3 has no studies of its own; it answers with a cc 10.0 entry only when that entry's study is in
+    PART_TRANSFERS[(10, 3)] (study sm103_transfer_20261031) -- never a later cc 10.0 study by default."""
+    row = "sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100"
+    base, studies = pt.PART_TRANSFERS[(10, 3)]
+    assert base == (10, 0)
+    cases = (

+        dict(d_qk=576, d_v=512, has_paged_kv=False, b=1, h_q=96, s_kv=131072),  # dense D576 decode
+        dict(d_qk=256, d_v=256, h_q=32, h_kv=2, s_q=2048, s_kv=65536, causal=True, bottom_right=True),  # paged d256 context

+    for kw in cases:

+

+

+from cudnn._pygraph import cudnn_graph_not_supported, pygraph

+    than the login box (9.26), so every test of the ARMED guard pins the version instead of inheriting the installed
+    library's: the day a fix version is recorded these tests keep describing the armed regime (test_version_bound covers the

+def _mxfp8_graph(b=4, hq=8, hk=2, sq=1, skv=2048, d=128, dv=128, bshd=True, stats=False, sink=False, unaligned_k=False):
+    """A dense graph.sdpa_mxfp8 forward declared as test/python/sdpa/mxfp8.py declares it (BSHD or BHSD strides)."""
+    ceil_div = lambda a, m: -(-a // m)  # noqa: E731
+    itype = cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3
+    g = pygraph(io_data_type=itype, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    d_scale_pad = ceil_div(ceil_div(d, 32), 4) * 4
+    dv_pad = ceil_div(dv, 128) * 128
+    s_q_pad, s_kv_pad, s_kv_scale_pad = ceil_div(sq, 128) * 128, ceil_div(skv, 128) * 128, ceil_div(ceil_div(skv, 32), 4) * 4
+
+    def sf(dims, name):
+        return g.tensor(
+            dim=dims,
+            stride=(dims[1] * dims[2] * dims[3], dims[2] * dims[3], dims[3], 1),
+            data_type=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E8M0,
+            reordering_type=cudnn.tensor_reordering.F8_128x4,
+            name=name,
+        )
+
+    q_stride = (sq * hq * d, d, hq * d, 1) if bshd else (hq * sq * d, sq * d, d, 1)
+    o_stride = (sq * hq * dv, dv, hq * dv, 1) if bshd else (hq * sq * dv, sq * dv, dv, 1)
+    k_stride = (skv * hk * d, d, hk * d, 1) if bshd else (hk * skv * d, skv * d, d, 1)
+    if unaligned_k:
+        k_stride = (hk * skv * (d + 1), skv * (d + 1), d + 1, 1)
+    v_stride = (skv * hk * dv, dv, hk * dv, 1) if bshd else (hk * skv * dv, skv * dv, dv, 1)
+    q = g.tensor(dim=(b, hq, sq, d), stride=q_stride, data_type=itype, name="q")
+    k = g.tensor(dim=(b, hk, skv, d), stride=k_stride, data_type=itype, name="k")
+    v = g.tensor(dim=(b, hk, skv, dv), stride=v_stride, data_type=itype, name="v")
+    kw = dict(
+        q=q,
+        k=k,
+        v=v,
+        descale_q=sf((b, hq, s_q_pad, d_scale_pad), "sf_q"),
+        descale_k=sf((b, hk, s_kv_pad, d_scale_pad), "sf_k"),
+        descale_v=sf((b, hk, s_kv_scale_pad, dv_pad), "sf_v"),
+        attn_scale=1.0 / math.sqrt(d),
+        generate_stats=stats,
+    )

+# The hardware form against the software form: both are the same function up to the fp32 rounding of the exp2 arguments (a different m
+# per step), so O agrees within atol = rtol = 1.6e-2 -- 2 bf16 ulps at UNIT magnitude (the bf16 quantum at 1.0 is 2^-7 = 7.8e-3), which for an
+# O element of magnitude 0.05 admits ~60 ulps of that element -- and the LSE within atol = rtol = 2e-5 (a few fp32 ulps of a value ~ 6..10):
+# pinned HERE, tighter than the oracle tolerances of the sibling module (`_TOL_O`: atol 5e-2 / rtol 3e-2).
+_TOL_O_VS_SW = dict(atol=1.6e-2, rtol=1.6e-2)  # bf16: 8 mantissa bits; 2 ulps at unit scale
+_TOL_LSE_VS_SW = dict(atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-5)
+
+# the option's oracle cells: dense, and the masked band (where the hardware bound meets -inf columns)
+_SWEEP = ["dense_nkv3_384", "causal_swa128_padded_384"]

+def _run_both(q, k, v, kw, monkeypatch):
+    """The software and the hardware form on the SAME inputs (the seam flipped between the two builds)."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd import config_sm107 as c
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "_BIAS_MAX_FORM_OVERRIDE_FOR_SWEEPS", 0)
+    sw = _s13._run(q, k, v, **kw)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "_BIAS_MAX_FORM_OVERRIDE_FOR_SWEEPS", 1)
+    hw = _s13._run(q, k, v, **kw)
+    return sw, hw
+
+
+def _check_hw(sw, hw, ref):
+    _s13._check(hw, ref)
+    live = ~ref["empty"]
+    torch.testing.assert_close(hw["o"][live].double(), sw["o"][live].double(), **_TOL_O_VS_SW)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(hw["stats"].squeeze(-1)[live].double(), sw["stats"].squeeze(-1)[live].double(), **_TOL_LSE_VS_SW)
+    assert torch.equal(hw["o"][ref["empty"]], sw["o"][ref["empty"]]) and torch.equal(
+        hw["stats"].squeeze(-1)[ref["empty"]], sw["stats"].squeeze(-1)[ref["empty"]]
+    )
+
+
+def _slack(q, k, bias, scale, kv_mask=None, tile_n=128):
+    """Host model of the bound: per (row, kv tile) ``m_upper - m_true`` in log2 units -- the hardware raw max + the per-row bias-tile max
+    against the true max of the biased (and masked) scores.  Returns (max slack, the raw range it is bounded by)."""
+    k_ref = k.repeat_interleave(q.shape[1] // k.shape[1], dim=1) if k.shape[1] != q.shape[1] else k  # GQA: the shared KV head per Q head
+    s = torch.matmul(q.double(), k_ref.double().transpose(-1, -2))  # (b, h, s_q, s_kv) raw
+    b_ = (bias.double() if bias is not None else torch.zeros_like(s)).expand_as(s)
+    worst, worst_range = 0.0, 0.0
+    for t0 in range(0, s.shape[-1], tile_n):
+        sr, br = s[..., t0 : t0 + tile_n], b_[..., t0 : t0 + tile_n]
+        m_upper = sr.max(-1).values * scale + br.max(-1).values
+        true = sr * scale + br
+        if kv_mask is not None:
+            true = true.masked_fill(~kv_mask.view(kv_mask.shape[0], 1, 1, -1)[..., t0 : t0 + tile_n], float("-inf"))
+        m_true = true.max(-1).values
+        live = torch.isfinite(m_true)
+        if live.any():
+            worst = max(worst, float(((m_upper - m_true)[live] * math.log2(math.e)).max()))
+            worst_range = max(worst_range, float(((sr.max(-1).values - sr.min(-1).values) * scale)[live].max() * math.log2(math.e)))
+    return worst, worst_range
+

+    mask, so when the masked-out columns of a row's kv tile carry a bias ABOVE the kept columns' by more than the fp32 exp2 range (~126 log2
+    units = ~87 natural units, less the row's raw-score slack), every kept P of that tile underflows to 0; a row whose EVERY tile does so ends
+    with total_sum == 0 and the epilogue's empty-row SELECT reads O = 0 / Stats = -inf -- finite, silent, wrong.  No trained model's additive
+    bias has that structure (a masked-fold bias puts the LOW values on the masked columns, so the kept columns define the max), but the
+    numerics protocol's 10 000-scale random bias with an independent random kv_mask does, and the protocol's 1e4 case ran WITHOUT a mask.
+    Pinned here so the limit is visible: form 0 passes the oracle; the rows form 1 kills are EXACTLY the rows the host model of the bound
+    predicts (every tile's bound more than 126 log2 units above the kept columns' true max; the band the running max's lag leaves
+    ambiguous is not asserted), the killed rows read O = 0, and every surviving row stays within the oracle.  A DEFAULT must not route a
+    bias + kv_mask plan onto the hardware bound without a mask-aware bound -- ``sm107_bias_max_form_default`` keeps the software tree with a
+    bias (pinned above) -- and the kv_mask-only default is unaffected (its slack is the raw-score range, the 60-log2-unit assertion above)."""
+    torch.manual_seed(5)

+    dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    q, k, v = (_s13._bhsd(b, h, s, d, dtype) for _ in range(3))

+    scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(d)
+    kw = dict(scale=scale, bias=bias, kv_mask=kv_mask, sdpa_kwargs={}, seq_len_kv=None, seq_len_q=None, sink=None, cga=None, tile_n=tile_n)
+    ref = _s13._ref(q, k, v, scale=scale, bias=bias, kv_mask=kv_mask)
+    outs = _run_forms_on_the_pair_item(q, k, v, kw, monkeypatch)
+    (sw, seen0), (hw, seen1) = outs[0], outs[1]
+    assert seen0 == {0} and seen1 == {1}, (seen0, seen1)
+    _s13._check(sw, ref)  # the software tree: the true row max, no cliff
+    live = ~ref["empty"]
+    # The host model of the bound, per ROW: gap = (the largest per-tile bound of the row) - (the row's true kept max), in log2 units.  The
+    # kernel's online softmax flushes a P below 2^-126 (ex2.approx.ftz) and rescales a partial sum by exp2(m_t - m_final), so a row whose
+    # every kept column sits more than 126 log2 units under the final running max ends with total_sum == 0.  The running max may lag the
+    # largest bound by up to RESCALE_THRESHOLD (an update only beyond the threshold), which can only HELP a row survive -> the two
+    # unambiguous bands: gap > 126 + threshold is CERTAINLY killed, gap < 126 - 1 CERTAINLY survives; rows in between are not asserted.
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.config_sm107 import rescale_threshold as _rescale_threshold
+
+    thr = float(_rescale_threshold(2))  # the bf16 record's threshold (dtype_qkv 2)
+    s_raw = torch.matmul(q.double(), k.double().transpose(-1, -2))

+"""The (n, n+1) PAIR work item of the resident-bias arm on the Rubin (SM107) f16/bf16 small head-dim tiles --
+``TemplateParams.n_chunk >= 1`` on ``sm107/prefill_d128_f16.py``.
+
+A work item is (a 128-row q tile, a head, a CHUNK of up to ``n_chunk`` consecutive entries of the flattened batch axis); the two
+softmax sub-tiles are rows nb / nb + 1 of the SAME q tile, so the bias row-block shrinks to the q tile's 128 rows (twice the kv
+columns fit: S_kv <= 768 at the 32-wide tile, <= 384 at the 64-wide one, from 384 / 128) and is loaded ONCE per item for every
+row of the chunk -- the per-item fixed cost and the bias feed divided by ``n_chunk``.  The form needs a batch-BROADCAST bias
+(``[1, 1|H, S_q, S_kv]``: two rows share one block), at least two rows and cga1; a per-batch bias, a single row or a cga2 plan keeps
+the one-batch-entry item (``n_chunk = 0``, every one-batch-entry cell and cubin record unchanged).  Nothing numerically changes: every row's
+kv loop runs the same tiles in the same order, so O / Stats are BITWISE identical across ``n_chunk`` values, against the
+one-batch-entry item and (bias = 0) against the plain kernel.
+
+Three tiers: (1) CPU contract -- the derived pair budget and the form predicate, the chunk-length rule, the engine row's
+accept / decline table (the widened cells and the cells that keep the one-batch-entry budget), the config factory's couplings,
+the adapter twin; (2) host rendering pins -- every pair rendering keeps the register split, no cluster drain, no spills above
+the one-batch-entry bias rendering, the packed bias add and the bit-word mask where a mask is on; (3) GPU cells on a Rubin
+device -- the fp64 oracle over the degenerate rows (one tile, a chunk of one, the tail chunk with a dead sub-tile, S_kv not a multiple
+of the tile, a zero-length row inside a chunk, mixed lengths, the padded-Q trim, the band + padding, the budget edges of both tiles, the
+sink, the rule's own pick; the magnitude / head-broadcast forms are pinned on the one-batch-entry arm), the bitwise pins across n_chunk in
+{1, 2, 8, N} and against the one-batch-entry item, the identity against the plain kernel, the typed declines on real graphs.

+def test_kernel_module_constants_and_the_not_yet_wired_backstops(_sm100_device_for_the_adapter):
+    """The SM100 file's bias arms fold on the record (the module constants), the seams the file does not render yet raise at
+    module load with a message naming them (the config validators accept the records; the kernel states its own envelope), and the
+    d64 decode tile refuses either operand (the fix pin at the end)."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.api_dsl import _load_sm100_kernel_module
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.config_sm100 import TemplateParams
+
+    def _mod(**kw):
+        return _load_sm100_kernel_module(
+            (kw.get("d_flavor", 32),) * 2, TemplateParams(dtype_qkv=2, cta_mma=1, d_flavor=32, **{k: v for k, v in kw.items() if k != "d_flavor"}), rubin=False
+        )
+
+    plain = _mod()
+    assert not plain._BIAS_ARM and not plain._KV_MASK_ARM and not plain._INF_MASK_ARM and plain._BIAS_GG is None
+    res = _mod(bias_mode=1)
+    assert res._BIAS_ARM and res._BIAS_RESIDENT and res._INF_MASK_ARM and not res._HW_UPPER_MAX
+    assert res._BIAS_GG.n_tiles == res.CFG.BIAS_RESIDENT_TILES == 2 and res._BIAS_GG.block_rows == 256 and res._BIAS_GG.boxes_per_tile == 2
+    assert res.BIAS_PRELOAD_CHUNKS == 0 and res.CFG.BIAS_EMPTY_ARRIVERS == 8
+    mask = _mod(kv_mask_form=1, bias_max_form=1)
+    assert mask._KV_MASK_BOOL and mask._HW_UPPER_MAX and not mask._BIAS_ARM and mask._INF_MASK_ARM
+    ring = _mod(bias_mode=2, bias_stages=2)
+    assert ring._BIAS_STREAMED and not ring._BIAS_RESIDENT and ring.CFG.STAGES_BIAS == 2 and ring._BIAS_GG.n_tiles == 2
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="multicast bias ring"):
+        _mod(bias_mode=3, bias_stages=2, n_chunk=2)
+    tail = _mod(seq_kv_lens_present=True, padded_tail_form=1)
+    assert tail._PADDED_TAIL_PREMASK and not tail._INF_MASK_ARM and tail._INF_BODY_MASK_FLAGS == 0
+    # the pre-masked tail on the BIAS body (the Rubin twin's arm): the -inf body renders its band mask at MASK_NONE (the padding arm's words fold out
+    # of every kv tile; the tail tile is pre-masked in TMEM); a kv_mask is refused with either body (its keep words fold the length in already)
+    btail = _mod(seq_kv_lens_present=True, padded_tail_form=1, bias_mode=2, bias_stages=2)
+    assert btail._PADDED_TAIL_PREMASK and btail._BIAS_STREAMED and btail._INF_MASK_ARM and btail._INF_BODY_MASK_FLAGS == 0 and btail.CFG.MASK_FLAGS != 0
+    bword = _mod(seq_kv_lens_present=True, bias_mode=2, bias_stages=2)
+    assert not bword._PADDED_TAIL_PREMASK and bword._INF_BODY_MASK_FLAGS == bword.CFG.MASK_FLAGS != 0
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="kv_mask"):
+        _mod(seq_kv_lens_present=True, padded_tail_form=1, kv_mask_form=1)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="kv_mask"):
+        _mod(seq_kv_lens_present=True, padded_tail_form=1, bias_mode=2, bias_stages=2, kv_mask_form=1)
+    # the small tiles' ring-wait form: the BIAS body spins (MEASURED on GB200 2026-10-14: +5..+10 % on the bias cells, +8..+18 % with the kv_mask word);
+    # the plain small tile and the kv_mask-only body keep the d64 flavor's sleeping form (unmeasured); never a literal at a call site
+    assert res.SPIN_RING_WAITS is True and btail.SPIN_RING_WAITS is True and bword.SPIN_RING_WAITS is True
+    assert plain.SPIN_RING_WAITS is False and mask.SPIN_RING_WAITS is False and tail.SPIN_RING_WAITS is False
+    # the dead-sub-tile quiet body: wired on the -inf arms (a bias / a kv_mask), refused on the plain body of this file (the factory's admission)
+    quiet = _mod(bias_mode=2, bias_stages=2, dead_subtile_quiet=1)
+    assert quiet._DEAD_SUBTILE_QUIET and quiet._BIAS_STREAMED and not res._DEAD_SUBTILE_QUIET
+    assert _mod(kv_mask_form=1, dead_subtile_quiet=1)._DEAD_SUBTILE_QUIET
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="-inf body"):
+        _mod(dead_subtile_quiet=1)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="pair item"):
+        _mod(bias_mode=1, n_chunk=2)
+    t64 = _mod(bias_mode=1, tile_n=64)
+    assert t64.CFG.TILE_N == 64 and t64.CFG.N_BMM2_CHUNKS == 1 and t64._BIAS_GG.boxes_per_tile == 1 and t64.BIAS_PRELOAD_CHUNKS == 1
+    assert t64.CFG.BIAS_RESIDENT_TILES == 5  # the 32-wide tile holds 5 x 64 = 320 kv columns resident at the 64-wide KV tile
+    # The fix pin: ``_d64_decode_tile`` refuses the 128-row decode tile with a bias / kv_mask bound (the tile carries neither arm; a kv_mask-only
+    # d64 graph at S_q 128 used to lower onto it and fail at build on cc 10.0): the adapter at d64, S_q 128 takes the decode tile plain and stays
+    # on the prefill tile with either operand.
+    for operands, decode in ((dict(), True), (dict(kv_mask=(2, 1, 1, 128)), False), (dict(bias=(1, 4, 128, 128)), False)):
+        api = _api(d=64, s_q=128, s_kv=128, **operands)
+        assert api.check_support() is True and api._d64_decode_tile() is decode, (operands, api.template_params())

+# wraps, 5, 8 with a tail; the causal band; a padded zero-length batch on the ring: an empty item touches no ring row).  One (form x ring class)

+def _expected_cga(case):
+    c = _t7._CASES[case]
+    return 2 if c.get("d", 32) == 64 else 1  # the 64-wide tile's bias block lives at cga2 on this line; the 32-wide tile at its cga1

+def _run(
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    *,
+    scale,
+    bias=None,
+    kv_mask=None,
+    sdpa_kwargs=None,
+    seq_len_kv=None,
+    seq_len_q=None,
+    sink=None,
+    stats=True,
+    cga=None,
+    tile_n=None,
+    two_launch_assert=True,
+):
+    """The Rubin module's ``_run`` against the SM100 row: build the graph, pin the row's unsplit plan (the heuristics' pick; a cga / tile_n
+    request through the public autotune record), launch TWICE on sentinel-filled outputs (the two-launch delta) and return O, Stats and
+    the plan's knobs.  ``two_launch_assert=False`` leaves the two-launch identity to the caller (the first launch rides along as
+    ``o_first`` / ``stats_first``), so a cell can report a NaN residue as what it is before the identity check."""
+    import cudnn
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    g, vp, o, o_gpu, stats_gpu = _t7._build(
+        q, k, v, scale=scale, bias=bias, kv_mask=kv_mask, sdpa_kwargs=sdpa_kwargs, seq_len_kv=seq_len_kv, seq_len_q=seq_len_q, sink=sink, stats=stats
+    )
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+    ours = [i for i, n in enumerate(names) if n == _ROW or n.startswith(_ROW + "[")]
+    idx = next((i for i in ours if g.plans[i].knobs.split_kv in (None, 1)), None)
+    assert idx is not None, f"no unsplit {_ROW} plan in {names}"
+    picked = g.plans[idx].knobs
+    picked_cga, picked_tile_n = picked.cga, picked.tile_n
+    want_cga = picked_cga if cga is None else cga
+    want_tile_n = picked_tile_n if tile_n is None else tile_n
+    if (want_cga, want_tile_n) != (picked_cga, picked_tile_n):
+        engine_id, record = g.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(idx)
+        record = dict(record)
+        if want_cga != picked_cga:
+            record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_CGA_M] = want_cga
+        if want_tile_n != picked_tile_n:
+            record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_N] = want_tile_n
+        g.create_execution_plan(engine_id, record)
+        idx = g.get_execution_plan_count() - 1
+        picked_cga, picked_tile_n = want_cga, want_tile_n
+    g.select_plan(idx)
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    vp[o] = o_gpu
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+    def launch():
+        o_gpu.fill_(float("nan"))  # sentinel: an unwritten live row stays NaN
+        if stats_gpu is not None:
+            stats_gpu.fill_(float("nan"))
+        g.execute(vp, ws)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        return o_gpu.clone(), (stats_gpu.clone() if stats_gpu is not None else None)
+
+    o1, st1 = launch()
+    o2, st2 = launch()
+    if two_launch_assert:
+        assert torch.equal(o1, o2) and (st1 is None or torch.equal(st1, st2)), "two-launch delta on O / Stats"
+    return dict(o=o_gpu, stats=stats_gpu, knobs=SimpleNamespace(cga=picked_cga, tile_n=picked_tile_n), names=names, o_first=o1, stats_first=st1)
+

+def _frost_plan_names(q, k, v, kw):
+    import cudnn
+
+    g, *_ = _t7._build(
+        q,
+        k,
+        v,
+        scale=kw["scale"],
+        bias=kw["bias"],
+        kv_mask=kw["kv_mask"],
+        sdpa_kwargs=kw["sdpa_kwargs"],
+        seq_len_kv=kw["seq_len_kv"],
+        seq_len_q=kw["seq_len_q"],
+        sink=kw["sink"],

+    try:
+        g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])

+            # no engine at all proposed a plan (a kv_mask graph has no backend lowering): the row's decline IS the whole answer
+            return []

+SMEM ONCE (the TMA-LDG warp, after the item's Q / K / V prologue loads; one ``expect_tx`` for the FULL boxes of every tile), and
+the softmax warps read their row slice with 128-byte-swizzled lane loads -- the first 64-column chunk BEFORE the ``bmm1_done``

+tile) in ONE bit-word pass with the true -inf, so a row whose every key is masked ends the item with ``total_sum == 0`` exactly
+and the correction epilogue SELECTs O = 0 / Stats = -inf.  The block's budget is what the carveout leaves beside the Q / O slabs

+def _desc(shape, dtype, name, stride=None):
+    """A standalone-adapter descriptor.  The ACTIVATIONS (``q`` / ``k`` / ``v`` / ``o``, shape (B, H, S, D)) default to the row's
+    envelope, BSHD-physical (stride order 3, 1, 2, 0) -- the layout the prepared launch binds zero-copy, so the adapter cells are the
+    row's twin; a (B, H, S, D)-contiguous activation would take the adapter's staging-copy path, which carries neither the bias nor the
+    kv_mask and is therefore a typed decline in ``check_support`` with a resident-arm operand bound.  Every other tensor (the bias, the
+    kv_mask, the lengths) defaults to its contiguous strides."""
+    from cudnn.api_base import TensorDesc
+
+    if stride is None and name in ("q", "k", "v", "o") and len(shape) == 4:
+        b, h, s, d = (int(x) for x in shape)
+        stride = (s * h * d, d, h * d, 1)
+    stride = tuple(int(x) for x in torch.empty(shape).stride()) if stride is None else tuple(stride)
+    return TensorDesc(
+        dtype=dtype, shape=tuple(shape), stride=stride, stride_order=TensorDesc._compute_stride_order(tuple(shape), stride), device="cuda", name=name
+    )

+def test_kernel_module_constants_and_mask_sites(monkeypatch):
+    """The per-kernel constant ``BIAS_PRELOAD_CHUNKS`` is in its domain, the bias barriers ride ``make_classic_bars(bias_resident=,
+    bias_ring_stages=)`` (the two bias FORMS fold on CFG.BIAS_MODE), every mask site of the file calls ``apply_mask_chunk`` directly

+    below)."""

+        "BIAS_PRELOAD_CHUNKS: int = sm107_bias_preload_chunks(CFG.TILE_N)" in src
+    ), "BIAS_PRELOAD_CHUNKS is the per-rendering constant (one arithmetic, rule 8b')"
+    assert src.count("BIAS_PRELOAD_CHUNKS: int =") == 1

+
+    # the table: nothing ahead of the wait on the 128-wide tile (+1.8..+3.2 % on the resident bias forms at S_kv >= 384, +0.0..+0.6 % on the
+    # streamed ring; the confirm of the applied constant +2.1 % resident / +0.3..+0.5 % ring), one chunk on the 64-wide one (the resident
+    # bias + kv_mask body -- the chooser's pick for a masked bias graph -- loses 2.5..2.7 % without it; the other 64-wide forms are mixed);
+    # every value in the kernel's domain; an unrelated width keeps the one-chunk default
+    assert cfg107.SM107_BIAS_PRELOAD_CHUNKS_BY_TILE_N == {128: 0, 64: 1}
+    assert [cfg107.sm107_bias_preload_chunks(w) for w in (128, 64, 256)] == [0, 1, 1]
+    assert all(cfg107.sm107_bias_preload_chunks(w) in (0, 1, 2) for w in (32, 64, 128, 256))
+    # the bias barriers ride the factory's appended keywords; the multi-line call carries the S / P slot ring and the multicast ring's release count
+    assert (
+        "s_stages=CFG.TILES_Q * CFG.S_SLOTS,\n        bias_resident=_BIAS_RESIDENT,\n        bias_ring_stages=CFG.STAGES_BIAS if _BIAS_STREAMED else 0," in src
+    )
+    assert "form=" not in "".join(ln for ln in src.splitlines() if "apply_mask_chunk(" in ln)
+    assert 'mask_value=float("-inf")' in src and "row_max_for_exp2(total_max)" in src
+    assert "_kv_empty | (total_sum == cutlass.Float32(0.0))" in src, "the fully masked row's SELECT"
+    assert "issue_bias_block_load(" in src and "load_bias_row_chunk(" in src and "kv_mask_keep_words(" in src
+    # The exp2 MUFU / FMA split PROBE: a module constant that is OFF (the split loses on cc 10.7 at every head dim measured), folded at

+    assert len(sites) == 4 and all("exp2_mixed(" in ln and "if _E2E_ENABLED else" in ln for ln in sites), sites

+    "USETMAXREG": ("USETMAXREG",),
+    "STL": (" STL",),
+    "LDL": (" LDL",),
+    "FMNMX3": ("FMNMX3",),
+    "R2P": (" R2P ",),

+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- tier 3: GPU cells (a Rubin device)
+
+_DTYPES = [torch.float16, torch.bfloat16]
+_DTYPE_IDS = ["fp16", "bf16"]
+# The existing f16 row tolerances (test_sdpa_fwd_dsl_sm107.py / test_sdpa_fwd_head_dim_sm107.py): O against the fp64 oracle (an
+# fp32 accumulation, one 16-bit rounding at the store), the LSE pair at 1e-4 / 1e-4 (the bias enters the fp32 score by ONE
+# FFMA of bias * (1 / scale), then the scale multiply: one more fp32 rounding than the eager s * scale + bias -- pinned by the
+# bias-magnitude cells, not widened for them).
+_TOL_O = dict(atol=5e-2, rtol=3e-2)
+_TOL_LSE = dict(atol=1e-4, rtol=1e-4)
+
+
+def _bhsd(b, h, s, d, dtype):
+    return torch.randn(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+def _ref(
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    *,
+    scale,
+    bias=None,
+    kv_mask=None,
+    causal=False,
+    bottom_right=False,
+    seq_q_lens=None,
+    seq_kv_lens=None,
+    sinks=None,
+    window_left=None,
+    right_bound=None,
+):
+    """fp64 oracle of the whole contract: softmax_k(scale * q.k + bias + maskbias) with the key mask, the padding and the band;
+    a row without a live key reads O = 0 / LSE = -inf (the empty-row contract); the bias enters in its 16-bit value."""
+    b, h_q, s_q, _ = q.shape
+    _, h_kv, s_kv, _ = v.shape
+    dev = q.device
+    g = h_q // h_kv
+    k_ref = k.repeat_interleave(g, dim=1).double()
+    v_ref = v.repeat_interleave(g, dim=1).double()
+    scores = torch.matmul(q.double(), k_ref.transpose(-1, -2)) * scale
+    if bias is not None:
+        scores = scores + bias.double()  # broadcast over the dims declared 1
+    q_lens = seq_q_lens.flatten().to(device=dev, dtype=torch.int64) if seq_q_lens is not None else torch.full((b,), s_q, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
+    kv_lens = seq_kv_lens.flatten().to(device=dev, dtype=torch.int64) if seq_kv_lens is not None else torch.full((b,), s_kv, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
+    i = torch.arange(s_q, device=dev).view(1, 1, s_q, 1)
+    j = torch.arange(s_kv, device=dev).view(1, 1, 1, s_kv)
+    diag = i + (kv_lens - q_lens).view(b, 1, 1, 1) if bottom_right else i
+    dead_q = i >= q_lens.view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    masked = dead_q | (j >= kv_lens.view(b, 1, 1, 1))
+    if kv_mask is not None:
+        masked = masked | (~kv_mask.view(kv_mask.shape[0], 1, 1, s_kv))
+    if causal:
+        masked = masked | (j > diag)
+    if right_bound is not None:
+        masked = masked | (j > diag + right_bound)
+    if window_left is not None:
+        masked = masked | (j < diag - window_left)
+    scores = scores.masked_fill(masked, float("-inf"))
+    full = scores if sinks is None else torch.cat([scores, sinks.view(1, h_q, 1, 1).double().expand(b, h_q, s_q, 1)], dim=-1)
+    smax = full.max(dim=-1).values
+    ssum = torch.exp(full - smax.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0)
+    lse = smax + torch.log(ssum)
+    o = torch.matmul(torch.softmax(full, dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0)[..., :s_kv], v_ref)
+    dead = dead_q.squeeze(-1)
+    return dict(o=o, lse=lse.masked_fill(dead, float("-inf")), empty=torch.isneginf(lse) | dead)
+
+
+def _build(q, k, v, *, scale, bias=None, kv_mask=None, sdpa_kwargs=None, seq_len_kv=None, seq_len_q=None, sink=None, stats=True):
+    """The graph with its variant pack (bias / kv_mask bound through ``tensor_like``: the bias as the classic ``bias`` operand,
+    the mask as the python-only ``kv_mask`` input)."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    b, h_q, s_q, _ = q.shape
+    d_v = v.shape[-1]
+    dtype = q.dtype
+    o_gpu = torch.empty(b, s_q, h_q, d_v, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    io = cudnn.data_type.HALF if dtype == torch.float16 else cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=io, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    tq, tk, tv = g.tensor_like(q), g.tensor_like(k), g.tensor_like(v)
+    kw = dict(name="sdpa", q=tq, k=tk, v=tv, generate_stats=stats, attn_scale=scale)
+    vp = {tq: q, tk: k, tv: v}
+    if bias is not None:
+        tb = g.tensor_like(bias)
+        kw["bias"] = tb
+        vp[tb] = bias
+    if kv_mask is not None:
+        tm = g.tensor_like(kv_mask)
+        kw["kv_mask"] = tm
+        vp[tm] = kv_mask
+    if seq_len_kv is not None:
+        slk = g.tensor_like(seq_len_kv)
+        kw.update(seq_len_kv=slk, use_padding_mask=True)
+        vp[slk] = seq_len_kv
+        slq_t = seq_len_q if seq_len_q is not None else torch.full((b, 1, 1, 1), s_q, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+        slq = g.tensor_like(slq_t)
+        kw["seq_len_q"] = slq
+        vp[slq] = slq_t
+    if sink is not None:
+        st = g.tensor_like(sink)
+        kw["sink_token"] = st
+        vp[st] = sink
+    kw.update(sdpa_kwargs or {})
+    o, stats_t = g.sdpa(**kw)
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim(o_gpu.shape).set_stride(o_gpu.stride())
+    stats_gpu = None
+    if stats:
+        stats_gpu = make_dense_stats(b, h_q, s_q, "contiguous")
+        stats_t.set_output(True).set_dim(stats_gpu.shape).set_stride(stats_gpu.stride()).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+        vp[stats_t] = stats_gpu
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    return g, vp, o, o_gpu, stats_gpu
+
+
+def _frost_plans(g):
+    names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+    return names, [i for i, n in enumerate(names) if n == _ROW or n.startswith(_ROW + "[")]
+
+
+def _run(q, k, v, *, scale, bias=None, kv_mask=None, sdpa_kwargs=None, seq_len_kv=None, seq_len_q=None, sink=None, stats=True, cga=None, tile_n=None):
+    """Build the graph, pin the Rubin f16 row (optionally a cga and / or a KV tile width through the public autotune record;
+    ``tile_n=None`` keeps the heuristics' pick), launch TWICE on sentinel-filled outputs (the two-launch delta) and return O,
+    Stats and the plan's knobs (``knobs.tile_n`` = the width the executed plan carries)."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    g, vp, o, o_gpu, stats_gpu = _build(
+        q, k, v, scale=scale, bias=bias, kv_mask=kv_mask, sdpa_kwargs=sdpa_kwargs, seq_len_kv=seq_len_kv, seq_len_q=seq_len_q, sink=sink, stats=stats
+    )
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    names, ours = _frost_plans(g)
+    idx = next((i for i in ours if g.plans[i].knobs.split_kv in (None, 1)), None)
+    assert idx is not None, f"no unsplit {_ROW} plan in {names}"
+    picked = g.plans[idx].knobs
+    picked_cga, picked_tile_n = picked.cga, picked.tile_n
+    want_cga = picked_cga if cga is None else cga
+    want_tile_n = picked_tile_n if tile_n is None else tile_n
+    if (want_cga, want_tile_n) != (picked_cga, picked_tile_n):
+        engine_id, record = g.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(idx)
+        record = dict(record)
+        if want_cga != picked_cga:
+            record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_CGA_M] = want_cga
+        if want_tile_n != picked_tile_n:
+            record[cudnn.knob_type.TILE_N] = want_tile_n
+        g.create_execution_plan(engine_id, record)
+        idx = g.get_execution_plan_count() - 1
+        picked_cga, picked_tile_n = want_cga, want_tile_n
+    g.select_plan(idx)
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    assert (g.plans[idx].knobs.cga, g.plans[idx].knobs.tile_n) == (picked_cga, picked_tile_n), (g.plans[idx].knobs, picked_cga, picked_tile_n)
+    vp[o] = o_gpu
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+    def launch():
+        o_gpu.fill_(float("nan"))  # sentinel: an unwritten live row stays NaN
+        if stats_gpu is not None:
+            stats_gpu.fill_(float("nan"))
+        g.execute(vp, ws)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        return o_gpu.clone(), (stats_gpu.clone() if stats_gpu is not None else None)
+
+    o1, st1 = launch()
+    o2, st2 = launch()
+    assert torch.equal(o1, o2) and (st1 is None or torch.equal(st1, st2)), "two-launch delta on O / Stats"
+    return dict(o=o_gpu, stats=stats_gpu, knobs=SimpleNamespace(cga=picked_cga, tile_n=picked_tile_n), names=names)
+

+def _check(out, ref, *, has_stats=True):
+    """Keyless rows EXACTLY 0 / -inf (never NaN, never a residue); live rows against the fp64 oracle."""
+    empty = ref["empty"]
+    o = out["o"]
+    assert torch.isfinite(o).all(), "O has a non-finite (an unwritten sentinel or a NaN residue)"
+    assert (o[empty] == 0).all(), "a keyless row's O must be exactly 0 (a SELECT, never a multiply by zero)"
+    torch.testing.assert_close(o[~empty].double(), ref["o"][~empty], **_TOL_O)
+    if has_stats:
+        lse = out["stats"].squeeze(-1)
+        assert torch.isneginf(lse[empty]).all(), "a keyless row's Stats must be exactly -inf"
+        torch.testing.assert_close(lse[~empty].double(), ref["lse"][~empty], **_TOL_LSE)

+def _case_inputs(case, dtype, *, seed=0, kv_mask_p=None, table=None):
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    c = (_CASES if table is None else table)[case]
+    d = c.get("d", 32)
+    q = _bhsd(c["b"], c["h"], c["s_q"], d, dtype)
+    k = _bhsd(c["b"], c["h_kv"], c["s_kv"], d, dtype)
+    v = _bhsd(c["b"], c["h_kv"], c["s_kv"], d, dtype)
+    form = c.get("bias", "h")
+    bb = c["b"] if form in ("b", "b1") else 1

+    # A padded row stride (`bias_row_stride`: the TMA 16-byte rule at an S_kv % 8 != 0) makes the bias a strided VIEW; compact otherwise.
+    row = c.get("bias_row_stride", c["s_kv"])

+# The SIGN of attn_scale against the additive arms: a plan with a NEGATIVE attn_scale runs with
+# negate_scores (#1435) -- BMM1 negates S and the kernel runs at |scale| -- and the pre-scale additive FMA of the bias / kv_mask arms
+# (``S_raw + bias * inv_scale``, then the exp2 scale) must take the SAME effective positive magnitude.  The prepared dense template used to
+# bind the SIGNED 1 / scale in that slot, so on such a plan the bias entered with its sign flipped (scale * Q.K - bias) on the graph route
+# (the standalone adapter re-derives the slot per call from |scale| and was right).  The inputs make the whole answer one number: Q = K = 0
+# (the scale multiplies nothing but the additive term), +2 on the first half of the keys and -2 on the other half -- per key, in the io
+# dtype, as the resident [1, H, S, S] block or as the ADDITIVE kv_mask vector [1, 1, 1, S] -- and V = +1 / -1 on the same halves, so
+# softmax_k(bias) . V = tanh(2) on every row and lane at EITHER sign of the scale; the flipped binding reads -tanh(2).  The signed fp64
+# oracle is the detector, and the NEGATED oracle (what the flipped binding computes) is pinned to be what the plan does NOT compute.  Both
+# arch modules run the cells on their row; the HOST pin below reads the template itself off ``build_dense_spec`` without a device.
+_SIGNED_SCALE_S, _SIGNED_SCALE_D, _SIGNED_SCALE_MAG = 128, 32, 0.125
+_SIGNED_SCALE_FORMS = ("bias", "additive_kv_mask")
+
+
+def _signed_scale_inputs(sign, form, dtype):
+    """``(q, k, v, run_kw, ref)`` of the signed-scale cell: ``form`` = "bias" (the resident block) or "additive_kv_mask" (the per-key additive
+    vector through the python-only kv_mask input); ``sign`` = +1 / -1 picks attn_scale = sign * 0.125."""
+    assert form in _SIGNED_SCALE_FORMS, form
+    b, h, s, d = 1, 2, _SIGNED_SCALE_S, _SIGNED_SCALE_D
+    q = torch.zeros(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    k = torch.zeros(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    v = torch.empty(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)

+def test_ring_depth_and_mode_pick_are_derived():
+    """One arithmetic for the row, the heuristics, the adapter and the factory: the ring depth is what the carveout leaves beside the
+    operands in whole tiles of the item form, capped at 3 and 0 below 2; the pick is resident inside the resident budget, streamed above
+    it where a ring fits, 0 where neither form fits."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd import config_sm107 as c
+
+    assert c.BIAS_MODES == {0, 1, 2, 3} and c.BIAS_RING_STAGES == (2, 3)  # 3 = the ring's cluster-multicast form (test_sdpa_bias_multicast_sm107.py)
+    for (d, cga, pair), stages in _RING.items():
+        assert c.sm107_bias_ring_stages(d, cga, pair=pair) == stages, (d, cga, pair)
+        tiles = c.sm107_bias_resident_tiles(d, cga, pair=pair)
+        assert stages == (min(3, tiles) if tiles >= 2 else 0), (d, cga, pair, tiles)
+        s_res = _RESIDENT[(d, cga, pair)]
+        # the knob-less pick: resident inside the budget -- except the one-batch-entry item at the 32-wide tile, which streams wherever
+        # its ring fits (the measured pick, +6..+13 % over its resident block at 2-3 kv tiles); a RESIDENT request still gets the block
+        streams_inside = (not pair) and cga == 1 and d in c.SM107_ONE_BATCH_ENTRY_STREAMING_D_FLAVORS and stages and s_res > 128
+        assert c.sm107_bias_mode_pick(d, cga, s_res, pair=pair) == (c.BIAS_MODE_STREAMED if streams_inside else c.BIAS_MODE_RESIDENT), (d, cga, pair)
+        assert c.sm107_bias_mode_pick(d, cga, s_res, pair=pair, request=1) == c.BIAS_MODE_RESIDENT
+        above = c.sm107_bias_mode_pick(d, cga, s_res + 128, pair=pair)
+        assert above == (c.BIAS_MODE_STREAMED if stages else c.BIAS_MODE_NONE), (d, cga, pair, above)
+        assert c.sm107_bias_mode_pick(d, cga, 4096, pair=pair) == above
+        # a REQUEST is honoured where that form fits and 0 elsewhere -- never degraded to the other form
+        assert c.sm107_bias_mode_pick(d, cga, s_res, pair=pair, request=2) == (c.BIAS_MODE_STREAMED if stages else c.BIAS_MODE_NONE)
+        assert c.sm107_bias_mode_pick(d, cga, s_res + 128, pair=pair, request=1) == c.BIAS_MODE_NONE
+        # the multicast form (3) is the PAIR item's cga1 ring on request; nowhere else
+        assert c.sm107_bias_mode_pick(d, cga, s_res, pair=pair, request=3) == (
+            c.BIAS_MODE_STREAMED_MULTICAST if (pair and cga == 1 and stages) else c.BIAS_MODE_NONE
+        )
+        # the depth pick: the request in the domain and fitting, else the derived deepest for the pair item and 2 for the one-batch-entry
+        # item (the measured pick: its 3-stage ring is +1.5..+3.6 % slower); a request that does not fit is 0
+        assert c.sm107_bias_stages_pick(d, cga, pair=pair) == (stages if pair else min(stages, c.SM107_ONE_BATCH_ENTRY_RING_STAGES))
+        for req in (2, 3):
+            assert c.sm107_bias_stages_pick(d, cga, pair=pair, request=req) == (req if req <= stages else 0)
+        assert c.sm107_bias_stages_pick(d, cga, pair=pair, request=4) == 0
+    # TILE_N 64 halves every stage: the one-batch-entry item at the 64-wide tile's cga1 gets a ring there
+    assert c.sm107_bias_ring_stages(64, 1, tile_n=64) == 3
+    # the SMEM extent by form
+    assert c.bias_smem_tiles(c._CfgSm107()) == 0

+def _executed_tile_n(g, idx):
+    """The KV tile width the EXECUTED plan was compiled with -- never the record the test asked for, so a 64-wide cell is evidenced by
+    the rendering that ran, not inferred from the adapter tier.  Read from the compiled kernel module's own ``CFG.TILE_N`` through the
+    prepared launch spec (``prepared.DenseLaunchSpec.tile_n``); a plan the lowering built WITHOUT a prepared launch (one KV tile, S_kv
+    64) exposes the adapter it compiled through the executor closure, whose ``template_params().tile_n`` is the width the kernel
+    module was loaded with (``_load_sm100_kernel_module((d, d), params)``)."""
+    plan = g._compiled_plans[idx]
+    spec = getattr(getattr(plan, "_prepared", None), "spec", None)
+    if spec is not None and hasattr(spec, "tile_n"):
+        return int(spec.tile_n)
+    cells = getattr(plan._compiled, "__closure__", None) or ()
+    api = next((c.cell_contents for c in cells if type(c.cell_contents).__name__.startswith("SdpaFwdDsl")), None)
+    assert api is not None, f"the compiled plan carries neither a prepared launch spec nor the adapter it compiled: {type(plan).__name__}"
+    return int(api.template_params().tile_n)
