+"""FROST SDPA forward past 65535 heads or batch (#1573).
+
+The NATURAL scheduler launches heads and batch on gridDim.y/z, which CUDA caps
+at 65535, so a pinned NATURAL plan is declined when it is built and the
+recommended plans ride the flat LPT grid.
+"""
+
+import math
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+import cudnn
+from cudnn.engines import is_python_engine
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.L1
+
+
+def _frost_shape():
+    """(S, D) a FROST forward row serves on this device; the SM90 row serves d512 only."""
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        return None
+    major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(0)
+    if (major, minor) == (9, 0):
+        return 64, 512
+    if (major, minor) == (8, 0) or (major == 10 and minor <= 6):
+        return 128, 64
+    return None
+
+
+if _frost_shape() is None:
+    pytest.skip("needs an A100, H100 or SM100 device for the FROST forward rows", allow_module_level=True)
+S, D = _frost_shape()
+SCALE = 1.0 / math.sqrt(D)
+
+
+def _graph(b, h):
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=cudnn.data_type.HALF, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    stride = [S * h * D, D, h * D, 1]
+    q, k, v = (g.tensor(name=n, dim=[b, h, S, D], stride=stride, data_type=cudnn.data_type.HALF) for n in "qkv")
+    o, _ = g.sdpa(q, k, v, is_inference=True, attn_scale=SCALE)
+    o.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.HALF).set_dim([b, h, S, D]).set_stride(stride)
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A, cudnn.heur_mode.FALLBACK])
+    return g, (q, k, v, o)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("b,h", [(65536, 1), (1, 65536)], ids=["batch", "heads"])
+def test_frost_forward_past_65535_runs_on_the_flat_grid(monkeypatch, b, h):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES", "1")
+    g, ports = _graph(b, h)
+    frost = [i for i, plan in enumerate(g.plans) if is_python_engine(plan.engine_id)]
+    if not frost:
+        pytest.skip("no FROST forward row claims this graph here")
+    engine_id, knobs = g.get_engine_and_knobs_at_index(frost[0])
+    assert knobs[cudnn.knob_type.SCHED_POLICY] != 0
+
+    natural = {**knobs, cudnn.knob_type.SCHED_POLICY: 0}
+    g.create_execution_plan(engine_id, natural)
+    g.select_plan(g.get_execution_plan_count() - 1)
+    with pytest.raises(Exception, match="65535"):
+        g.check_support()
+        g.build_plans()
+
+    g.select_plan(frost[0])
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    q, k, v = (torch.randn(b, S, h, D, dtype=torch.float16, device="cuda").transpose(1, 2) for _ in range(3))
+    o = torch.full_like(q, float("nan"))
+    workspace = torch.empty(max(int(g.get_workspace_size()), 1), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    g.execute(dict(zip(ports, (q, k, v, o))), workspace)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    for bi, hi in ((0, 0), (b - 1, h - 1), (b // 2, h // 2)):
+        p = torch.softmax((q[bi, hi].double() @ k[bi, hi].double().T) * SCALE, dim=-1)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(o[bi, hi].float(), (p @ v[bi, hi].double()).float(), atol=2e-3, rtol=1e-2)

+"""The small head-dim tiles of the Rubin (SM107) f16/bf16 forward row: ``TILE_K = TILE_O`` in {32, 64} as Cfg flavors of the d128 file.
+
+``sm107/prefill_d128_f16.py`` is one body with three head-dim geometries (``TemplateParams.d_flavor`` 32 / 64 / 128 ->
+``config_sm107.make_cfg_d32`` / ``make_cfg_d64`` / ``make_cfg_d128``).  A graph's head dim lands on the SMALLEST width covering
+max(d_qk, d_v) -- 8 / 16 / 24 -> 32, 40 / 48 / 56 -> 64, the natives on themselves -- and the TMA load zero-fills the columns
+past D (exact zero terms in QK^T and in P.V's padded V columns; the ``expect_tx`` count is the FULL box; the O store clips at
+d_v).  D % 8 != 0 is a typed decline (the TMA 16-byte global-stride rule at 2 B/elem).  Everything coupled to the tile -- the
+swizzle atoms, the TMA iteration counts, the TMEM O slot width, the BMM1 k-step count -- is derived from ``CFG.*`` and pinned by
+``_validate_head_dim_tile``; the d128 rendering is byte-identical to the one-geometry file (``test_sdpa_fwd_score_stats.py``
+holds the cubin md5 records).
+
+D32 carries dense plans. D64 also carries nonpaged, unsplit THD and PackGQA.
+Split-KV and score side outputs use a larger flavor; a cga2 request at D <= 32
+uses the 64-wide tile. THD requires exact native dimensions, and paged D64 THD
+remains declined.
+
+Three tiers: (1) CPU contract -- the row's accept / decline table per D, the ROUTE table per (D, leg) with the three pick
+implementations agreeing on every cell (the row's envelope walk, the adapter's flavor pool, ``sm107_f16_tile_width(leg=, cga=)``),
+the one constant feeding the row's cga domain, the adapter's cga twin and the config factory, the factories' derived facts and
+raising couplings, the loader binding ``d_flavor`` to the flavor, the static expect_tx pin; (2) host rendering pins -- an sm_107a
+trace-compile of each new rendering keeps the register split (``USETMAXREG`` > 0) and spills no more than the d128 rendering of
+the same mask arm; (3) GPU cells on a Rubin device -- the fp64 oracle over the degenerate-input matrix (the shared ``small_tile_cells``,
+one matrix for both arch lines) on the 32- and 64-wide tiles in bf16 with the fp16 member on the degenerate trio, one accept cell at
+D = 16 and at D = 56, the bitwise pin D = 8 / 24 vs an explicitly zero-padded D = 32 (40 / 48 vs 64: the zero-fill contract, one
+TMA mechanism), the d64 tile at cga2, the routed legs (split-KV and the score outputs at D = 24 / 64 on the d128 flavor, cga2 at
+D = 24 / 32 on the 64-wide tile -- bitwise the zero-padded D = 64 cga2 run), optional and base-2 Stats.  A D = 24 cell that
+completes under the runner's timeout IS the expect_tx pin: a byte count short of the full box would hang the consumer on the
+first tile.  The d128 geometry of the same file is byte-pinned to its one-geometry past (``test_sdpa_fwd_score_stats.py``), so
+it is not re-oracled here.

+def test_expect_tx_is_the_full_box_and_every_box_is_the_tile():
+    """Static pin of the zero-fill contract (frost-tile-dsl.md s5: an overshooting TMA box delivers the FULL box's bytes): the aggregate boxes cover each tile, every
+    per-tile element count is a TILE product, every transaction byte count is that count x BPE x CTA_MMA, and no head-dim
+    EXTENT (d_qk / d_v) reaches a byte count or a box -- the extents live in the descriptors only."""
+    code = "\n".join(ln for ln in _KERNEL.read_text().splitlines() if not ln.lstrip().startswith("#"))
+    for line in (
+        "qBufferElems = CFG.TILE_M * CFG.TILE_K",
+        "kBufferElems = CFG.TILE_N * CFG.TILE_K // CFG.CTA_MMA",
+        "vBufferElems = CFG.TILE_O * CFG.TILE_N // CFG.CTA_MMA",
+        "qTmaTransactionBytes = qBufferElems * CFG.BPE * CFG.CTA_MMA",
+        "kTmaTransactionBytes = kBufferElems * CFG.BPE * CFG.CTA_MMA",
+        "vTmaTransactionBytes = vBufferElems * CFG.BPE * CFG.CTA_MMA",
+        "HEADS_PER_TILE = CFG.PACK_G if CFG.PACK_GQA else 1",
+        "TOKENS_PER_TILE = CFG.TILE_M // HEADS_PER_TILE",
+        "qk_box_q = (1, TOKENS_PER_TILE, HEADS_PER_TILE, TMA_QK_GRANU_ELEMS)",
+        "qk_box_k = (1, K_BOX_ROWS, 1, TMA_QK_GRANU_ELEMS)",
+        "vo_box_v = (1, V_BOX_ROWS, 1, TMA_VO_GRANU_ELEMS)",
+        "vo_box_o = (1, TOKENS_PER_TILE, HEADS_PER_TILE, _O_GRANU_ELEMS)",
+    ):
+        assert line in code, line
+    # Evaluate the kernel's box expressions: packing trades token rows for
+    # heads without changing the transfer volume or the unpacked geometry.
+    names = ("HEADS_PER_TILE", "TOKENS_PER_TILE", "qk_box_q", "vo_box_o")
+    expressions = {
+        target.id: node.value
+        for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(code))
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
+        for target in node.targets
+        if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id in names
+    }
+    for packed, pack_g in ((False, 1), (True, 1), (True, 2), (True, 4), (True, 8), (True, 16)):
+        for granularity in (16, 32, 64):
+            env = dict(CFG=SimpleNamespace(TILE_M=128, PACK_GQA=packed, PACK_G=pack_g), TMA_QK_GRANU_ELEMS=granularity, _O_GRANU_ELEMS=granularity)
+            for name in names:
+                env[name] = eval(compile(ast.Expression(expressions[name]), str(_KERNEL), "eval"), {"__builtins__": {}}, env)
+            for name in ("qk_box_q", "vo_box_o"):
+                assert math.prod(env[name]) == 128 * granularity, (packed, pack_g, name, env[name])
+                if not packed or pack_g == 1:
+                    assert env[name] == (1, 128, 1, granularity)
+    # Evaluate the source's page subdivision and byte-count expressions together.
+    # Per-page boxes must still deliver the full expect_tx volume, including
+    # zero-filled head-dim tails; nonpaged boxes retain the original geometry.
+    names = (
+        "_K_TILE_ROWS",
+        "K_BOX_ROWS",
+        "V_BOX_ROWS",
+        "K_BOXES",
+        "V_BOXES",
+        "qk_box_k",
+        "vo_box_v",
+        "kBufferElems",
+        "vBufferElems",
+        "kTmaTransactionBytes",
+        "vTmaTransactionBytes",
+    )
+    expressions = {
+        target.id: node.value
+        for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(code))
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
+        for target in node.targets
+        if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id in names
+    }
+    for cga in (1, 2):
+        for tile_n in (64, 128):
+            for width in (32, 64, 128):
+                for page in (0, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256):
+                    cfg = SimpleNamespace(TILE_N=tile_n, TILE_K=width, TILE_O=width, CTA_MMA=cga, BPE=2)
+                    env = dict(CFG=cfg, PAGED_KV=bool(page), PAGE_SIZE=page, TMA_QK_GRANU_ELEMS=32, TMA_VO_GRANU_ELEMS=16)
+                    for name in names:
+                        env[name] = eval(compile(ast.Expression(expressions[name]), str(_KERNEL), "eval"), {"__builtins__": {"min": min}}, env)
+                    assert math.prod(env["qk_box_k"]) * (width // 32) * env["K_BOXES"] * 2 * cga == env["kTmaTransactionBytes"]
+                    assert math.prod(env["vo_box_v"]) * (width // cga // 16) * env["V_BOXES"] * 2 * cga == env["vTmaTransactionBytes"]
+                    assert env["K_BOX_ROWS"] * env["K_BOXES"] == tile_n // cga
+                    assert env["V_BOX_ROWS"] * env["V_BOXES"] == tile_n
+                    if page:
+                        assert env["K_BOX_ROWS"] <= page and env["V_BOX_ROWS"] <= page
+                    else:
+                        assert env["qk_box_k"] == (1, tile_n // cga, 1, 32)
+                        assert env["vo_box_v"] == (1, tile_n, 1, 16)
+                        assert env["K_BOXES"] == env["V_BOXES"] == 1
+    for bad in (r"TransactionBytes\s*=.*\bd_(qk|v)\b", r"box_[qkvo]\s*=.*\bd_(qk|v)\b", r"BufferElems\s*=.*\bd_(qk|v)\b"):
+        assert not re.search(bad, code), bad
+    assert "_MAKE_CFG = {32: make_cfg_d32, 64: make_cfg_d64, 128: make_cfg_d128}" in code
+    assert "d128_family_tmem_layout(CFG)" in code and not re.search(r"^\s*(S1|O0|O1|STATS)_OFF: int = \d+\s*$", code, re.M), "no TMEM literal survives"
+    assert re.search(r"CHUNK = CFG\.BMM2_CHUNK_SIZE", code) and not re.search(r"^\s*CHUNK = 64\s*$", code, re.M)

+def _desc(shape, dtype, name):
+    from cudnn.api_base import TensorDesc
+
+    b, h, s, d = shape
+    stride = (s * h * d, d, h * d, 1)
+    return TensorDesc(
+        dtype=dtype, shape=tuple(shape), stride=stride, stride_order=TensorDesc._compute_stride_order(tuple(shape), stride), device="cuda", name=name
+    )
+

+def _api(d, *, s=256, h=4, h_kv=None, dtype=torch.bfloat16, score=False, **kw):
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.api_dsl import SdpaFwdDslSm100
+
+    h_kv = h if h_kv is None else h_kv
+    q, o = (_desc((1, h, s, d), dtype, n) for n in ("q", "o"))
+    k, v = (_desc((1, h_kv, s, d), dtype, n) for n in ("k", "v"))
+    if score:  # the two score side outputs, declared like Stats (b, h, s, 1) fp32
+        kw["sample_score_max"] = _desc((1, h, s, 1), torch.float32, "score_max")
+        kw["sample_score_sum_exp"] = _desc((1, h, s, 1), torch.float32, "score_sum_exp")
+    return SdpaFwdDslSm100(q, k, v, o, None, **kw)

+    kw = dict(q=q, k=k, v=v, descale_q=dq, descale_k=dk, descale_v=dv, attn_scale=scale, generate_stats=with_stats)
+    vp = {q: Qb, k: Kb, v: Vb, dq: sfq, dk: sfk, dv: sfv}
+    if sinks is not None:
+        st = g.tensor_like(sinks)
+        kw["sink_token"] = st
+        vp[st] = sinks
+    if seq_lens_q is not None and seq_lens_kv is None:
+        seq_lens_kv = [S_kv] * B
+    if seq_lens_kv is not None:
+        slq = torch.tensor(seq_lens_q if seq_lens_q is not None else [S_q] * B, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).reshape(B, 1, 1, 1)
+        slk = torch.tensor(seq_lens_kv, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).reshape(B, 1, 1, 1)
+        sq_h = g.tensor(dim=[B, 1, 1, 1], stride=[1, 1, 1, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32)
+        skv_h = g.tensor(dim=[B, 1, 1, 1], stride=[1, 1, 1, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32)
+        kw.update(use_padding_mask=True, seq_len_q=sq_h, seq_len_kv=skv_h)
+        vp.update({sq_h: slq, skv_h: slk})
+    if sf_o_layout is not None:
+        from sdpa.block_scale_o_ref import round_up
+
+        # SF_O pre-filled with 0xAA (scale bytes never written stay visible); token-major rows past B*S_q are caller-owned.
+        C = max(4, round_up(d_v // _BLOCK, 4))
+        if sf_o_layout == "planes":
+            R = round_up(S_q, 128)
+            sf_o_buf = torch.full((B, H_q, R, C), 0xAA, device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+            sf_o_stride = [H_q * R * C, R * C, C, 1]
+        else:
+            R = S_q
+            sf_o_buf = torch.full((round_up(B * S_q, 128), H_q * C), 0xAA, device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+            sf_o_buf[B * S_q :] = 0
+            sf_o_stride = [R * H_q * C, C, H_q * C, 1]
+        kw["sf_o"] = g.tensor(dim=[B, H_q, R, C], stride=sf_o_stride, data_type=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E8M0)
+        vp[kw["sf_o"]] = sf_o_buf
+        if scale_o is not None:
+            kw["scale_o"] = g.tensor(dim=[1, 1, 1, 1], stride=[1, 1, 1, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+            vp[kw["scale_o"]] = torch.full((1,), scale_o, device=dev)
+    kw.update(sdpa_kwargs)
+    o, stats_t, amax_o = g.sdpa_mxfp8(**kw)
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim(list(Ob.shape)).set_stride(list(Ob.stride())).set_data_type(getattr(cudnn.data_type, _CUDNN_OTYPE[out_dt]))
+    if with_stats:
+        stats_t.set_output(True).set_dim([B, H_q, S_q, 1]).set_stride(list(lse.stride())).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+        vp[stats_t] = lse
+    amax_o.set_output(True).set_dim([1, 1, 1, 1]).set_stride([1, 1, 1, 1]).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    vp[amax_o] = amax_buf
+
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    chosen = _select_engine(g, _ENGINE, tiles=tiles, pack_gqa=pack_gqa, sched_policy=sched_policy)
+    if split_kv is not None and (chosen.knobs.split_kv or 1) != split_kv:
+        # The ranked plans need not carry this split count: re-plan the engine's own knob set with it.
+        g.create_execution_plan(chosen.engine_id, replace(chosen.knobs, split_kv=split_kv, sched_policy=0))
+        g.select_plan(len(g.plans) - 1)
+    assert split_kv is None or (g.plans[g._plan_index].knobs.split_kv or 1) == split_kv
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    vp[o] = Ob
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    if sync_debug:
+        g.execute(vp, ws)  # warm the plan's lazy state outside the probe
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        prev = torch.cuda.get_sync_debug_mode()
+        torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("error")
+    try:
+        g.execute(vp, ws)
+    finally:
+        if sync_debug:
+            torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode(prev)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+    o_ref, lse_ref = _ref(
+        q_op.dequant, k_op.dequant, v_op.dequant, scale=scale, sinks=sinks, seq_lens_q=seq_lens_q, seq_lens_kv=seq_lens_kv, **_ref_kwargs(sdpa_kwargs)
+    )
+    stats = lse.squeeze(-1) if with_stats else None
+    if sf_o_layout is not None:
+        from sdpa.block_scale_o_ref import dequant_block_scaled_o
+
+        o_deq, pad_ok = dequant_block_scaled_o(Ob, sf_o_buf, _BLOCK, sf_o_layout, B, H_q, S_q, d_v, C)
+        return _RunResult(o_deq / (1.0 if scale_o is None else scale_o), o_ref, fp8, amax_buf, stats, lse_ref if with_stats else None, pad_ok)
+    return _RunResult(Ob, o_ref, fp8, amax_buf, stats, lse_ref if with_stats else None)

+def _o_tol(res: _RunResult, d_qk=128):
+    """Half-output tolerance relative to the reference's magnitude; FP8 outputs add three times the
+    output dtype's own quantization floor of the reference."""
+    e5m2 = res.input_dtype == torch.float8_e5m2
+    base = 8e-2 if e5m2 and d_qk > 128 else 7e-2 if e5m2 else 5e-2
+    tol = base * max(1.0, res.reference.abs().max().item())
+    if res.output.dtype in (torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e5m2):
+        floor = (res.reference - res.reference.to(res.output.dtype).float()).abs().max().item()
+        tol = max(tol, 3.0 * floor)
+    return tol
+
+
+def _check(res: _RunResult, d_qk=128):
+    out = res.output.float()
+    assert torch.isfinite(out).all(), "non-finite O (NaN = an element never written)"
+    diff = (out - res.reference).abs().max().item()
+    tol = _o_tol(res, d_qk)
+    assert diff <= tol, f"max|O-ref|={diff:.4f} > {tol:.4f}"
+    assert_amax_o(res.amax_o, res.reference.abs().max().item(), torch_itype=res.input_dtype, torch_otype=res.output.dtype, o_gpu=res.output)
+    if res.stats is not None:
+        finite = torch.isfinite(res.reference_stats)
+        assert torch.equal(torch.isfinite(res.stats), finite), "Stats -inf pattern differs from the reference"
+        d = (res.stats[finite] - res.reference_stats[finite]).abs().max().item() if finite.any() else 0.0
+        assert d <= 3e-2, f"max|LSE-ref|={d:.4f} > 0.03"

+def _graph_offers(d_qk=128, d_v=128):
+    """Build an sdpa_mxfp8 graph declaration only (no buffers) and report whether the engine is ranked."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    B, H, S = 2, 2, 256
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    q = g.tensor(dim=[B, H, S, d_qk], stride=[S * H * d_qk, d_qk, H * d_qk, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3)
+    k = g.tensor(dim=[B, H, S, d_qk], stride=[S * H * d_qk, d_qk, H * d_qk, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3)
+    v = g.tensor(dim=[B, H, S, d_v], stride=[S * H * d_v, d_v, H * d_v, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3)
+
+    qk_sf = (B, H, S, _qk_sf_cols(d_qk))
+    kw = dict(
+        q=q, k=k, v=v, descale_q=_sf_tensor(g, qk_sf), descale_k=_sf_tensor(g, qk_sf), descale_v=_sf_tensor(g, (B, H, S // _BLOCK, _cdiv(d_v, 128) * 128))
+    )
+    kw.update(attn_scale=d_qk**-0.5, generate_stats=False)
+    o, _, _ = g.sdpa_mxfp8(**kw)

+# --- THD (ragged) ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class _SeqQuantized(NamedTuple):
+    """One sequence's MXFP8-quantized operand for the THD packing."""
+
+    data: torch.Tensor  # fp8 [1, h, s, d]
+    dequant: torch.Tensor  # fp32 [1, h, s, d]
+    sf_tiles: torch.Tensor  # [h, ceil(s / 128), tile_bytes], every tile's planes contiguous
+
+
+class _SeqOperands(NamedTuple):
+    q: _SeqQuantized
+    k: _SeqQuantized
+    v: _SeqQuantized
+
+
+def _poison_sf_tail(sf_tiles, s, *, columnwise):
+    """Write the NaN encoding 0xFF into the scales of a sequence's last tile that lie past its length ``s``:
+    rowwise (Q/K) rows ``s .. tiles * 128``, columnwise (V) 32-key blocks wholly past ``s``."""
+    _, tiles, size = sf_tiles.shape
+    dev = sf_tiles.device
+    plane = (torch.arange(size // 512, device=dev) * 512).view(1, -1, 1)
+    if columnwise:
+        blocks = torch.arange(_cdiv(s, _BLOCK), tiles * 4, device=dev)
+        n = torch.arange(128, device=dev)
+        tile = (blocks // 4).view(-1, 1, 1)
+        byte = plane + ((n % 32) * 16 + ((n // 32) % 4) * 4).view(1, 1, -1) + (blocks % 4).view(-1, 1, 1)
+    else:
+        rows = torch.arange(s, tiles * 128, device=dev)
+        rr = rows % 128
+        tile = (rows // 128).view(-1, 1, 1)
+        byte = plane + ((rr % 32) * 16 + ((rr // 32) % 4) * 4).view(-1, 1, 1) + torch.arange(4, device=dev).view(1, 1, -1)
+    sf_tiles[:, tile.expand_as(byte), byte] = 0xFF
+
+
+def _quantize_seq(t, fp8, *, columnwise, poison_tail=False) -> _SeqQuantized:
+    """Per-sequence quantization for the THD packing. Columnwise F8_128x4 is plane-major across a tensor,
+    so its [planes, h, tiles, 512] atoms are regrouped to keep every tile's planes contiguous.
+    ``poison_tail`` writes 0xFF scales past the sequence's length (``_poison_sf_tail``)."""
+    _, h, s, d = t.shape
+    if s == 0:
+        planes = _cdiv(d, 128)
+        return _SeqQuantized(
+            t.new_zeros((1, h, 0, d)).to(fp8), t.new_zeros((1, h, 0, d)), torch.zeros((h, 0, 512 * planes), dtype=torch.uint8, device=t.device)
+        )
+    op = _quantize(t, fp8, columnwise=columnwise)
+    tiles, planes = _cdiv(s, 128), _cdiv(d, 128)
+    sf = op.sf.reshape(planes, h, tiles, 512).permute(1, 2, 0, 3) if columnwise else op.sf
+    sf = sf.contiguous().reshape(h, tiles, -1)
+    if poison_tail:
+        _poison_sf_tail(sf, s, columnwise=columnwise)
+    return _SeqQuantized(op.data, op.dequant, sf)

+    None, "token_major" ((T, H)) or "head_major" ((H, T_capacity)) ragged Stats. ``poison_pad`` writes
+    0xFF scales past every sequence's Q and KV length inside its last scale tile."""

+    cu_k = [0] + list(torch.tensor(seq_lens_kv).cumsum(0).tolist())
+    gen = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(torch.initial_seed() % (2**31))
+    seqs = []

+        qf = torch.randn(1, H_q, s_q, d_qk, device=dev, generator=gen) * 0.5
+        kf = torch.randn(1, H_kv, s_kv, d_qk, device=dev, generator=gen) * 0.5
+        vf = torch.randn(1, H_kv, s_kv, d_v, device=dev, generator=gen) * 0.5

+            assert credits and all(len(n.args) >= 2 and isinstance(n.args[1], ast.Constant) and n.args[1].value == 1 for n in credits), str(path)
+            assert all(len(n.args) >= 4 and isinstance(n.args[3], ast.Constant) and n.args[3].value == 1 for n in clc), str(path)
+            scanned.append(path)
+            continue
+        assert len(aliases) == len(clc) == 1, str(path)
+        assert layouts(aliases[0], parents) == layouts(clc[0], parents), f"{path}: scheduler/credit layout mismatch"
+        # The default import must still supply broadcasts on the other arm.
+        if layouts(aliases[0], parents) != {False, True}:
+            broadcasts = [
+                n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom) and any(a.name == "read_tile_id_arrive" and a.asname is None for a in n.names)
+            ]
+            assert any(layouts(n, parents) == {False, True} for n in broadcasts), f"{path}: missing default broadcast credits"
+        scanned.append(path)
+    assert scanned, "no common CLC callers were checked"

+"""Paged MXFP8 pools on the cc 10.7 MXFP8 row (``sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm107_mxfp8``): the SM100 pool contract (#1214 --

+the ``PAGED_KV`` loader of ``sm107/prefill_d128_mxfp8.py`` / ``sm107/prefill_d256_mxfp8.py`` with dense queries.
+
+What ``test_mhas_v2.py``'s cc 10.7 paged MXFP8 sweeps and the native-binder replay test do not cover: the Rule 3
+sync-debug gate around ``execute`` on this row over pools, the sched-policy bit-identity under paging (d128: NATURAL /
+LPT / LPT_L2 reorder whole work items, each tile's page walk is unchanged), e5m2-in / e4m3-out with Stats, pages of three
+and four tiles, and the plan-time declines on the real device.  Builders, reference and O check are the SM100 suite's
+(``test_sdpa_fwd_paged_sm100``, imported as helpers; its own cells stay pre-Rubin-gated).  The cc 10.7 CI lane runs an
+explicit file list that does not include this module (its ``test_mhas_v2.py`` twins -- the plan-pin cells per scheduler
+policy and the e4m3-O pins -- do run there); adding it to that list is a maintainers' follow-up."""

+from test_sdpa_fwd_paged_sm100 import _build_mxfp8, _check_o, _ref_mxfp8

+def _run(B, H, KH, P, max_pages, lens, hnd, *, sched=None, **build_kw):
+    """Build, pin the cc 10.7 MXFP8 row (optionally one scheduler policy), execute under Rule 3 and check O / LSE / Amax_O
+    against the pool reference; -> (plan, O, LSE or None).  Empty sequences write O := 0 and LSE := sink (-inf without one)."""
+    import cudnn
+    import cudnn.sdpa  # noqa: F401 -- registers the FROST engines
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.engines import engine_name
+
+    g, vp, Ob, stats_gpu, amax, ref_in = _build_mxfp8(B, H, KH, P, max_pages, lens, hnd, **build_kw)
+    name = engine_name(arch="sm107", mxfp8=True)
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    plan = select_engine(g, name)
+    if sched is not None:  # pin one scheduler policy of the row's plans explicitly
+        names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+        idx = next((i for i, n in enumerate(names) if n.startswith(name) and g.plans[i].knobs.sched_policy == sched), None)
+        assert idx is not None, f"no {name} plan with sched_policy={sched}; knobs={[p.knobs for p in g.plans]}"
+        g.select_plan(idx)
+        plan = g.plans[idx]
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    ws = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("error")  # Rule 3: any blocking D2H in the FROST execute path is a bug
+    try:
+        g.execute(vp, ws)
+    finally:
+        torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("default")
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+    ref_o, ref_lse = _ref_mxfp8(**ref_in)
+    out = Ob.float()
+    assert not torch.isnan(out).any(), "NaN in O"
+    atol = _check_o(out, ref_o, build_kw.get("out_dt", torch.bfloat16), build_kw.get("in_key", "e4m3"))
+    assert abs(amax.item() - ref_o.abs().max().item()) <= atol, f"amax {amax.item()} vs ref {ref_o.abs().max().item()}"
+    live = ref_in["seq_lens"] > 0
+    if (~live).any():
+        assert out[~live].abs().max().item() == 0.0, "empty sequence must write O := 0"
+        if ref_in["sinks"] is not None:  # a keyless row with a sink: the sink is the whole softmax, LSE := sink
+            ref_lse[~live] = ref_in["sinks"].view(1, H, 1).expand(B, H, ref_lse.shape[-1])[~live]
+    lse = None
+    if stats_gpu is not None:
+        lse = stats_gpu.view(B, H, -1)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(lse[live], ref_lse[live], atol=atol, rtol=3e-2)
+        if (~live).any():
+            torch.testing.assert_close(lse[~live], ref_lse[~live], atol=atol, rtol=3e-2)
+    return plan, out.clone(), None if lse is None else lse.clone()
+

+    so O and LSE are BIT-identical across the three policies over pools (the dense pin's paged twin)."""

+        for p in (SCHED_NATURAL, SCHED_LPT, SCHED_LPT_L2)

+        assert torch.equal(runs[p][2], runs[SCHED_NATURAL][2]), f"LSE differs between NATURAL and policy {p}"

+
+import math
+
+import pytest
+
+from frost_test_utils import requires_dsl
+
+pytestmark = [requires_dsl]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "dim,dtype_name,out_name,pool_layout,stats_layout,page",
+    [
+        pytest.param(128, "float8_e4m3fn", "bfloat16", "hnd", "token", 16, marks=pytest.mark.L0),
+        pytest.param(256, "float8_e4m3fn", "float8_e4m3fn", "nhd", "head", 128, marks=pytest.mark.L0),
+        pytest.param(128, "float8_e5m2", "float8_e4m3fn", "mixed", "head", 8, marks=pytest.mark.L1),
+        pytest.param(256, "float8_e5m2", "bfloat16", "mixed", "token", 256, marks=pytest.mark.L1),
+        pytest.param(128, "float8_e4m3fn", "float8_e4m3fn", "hnd", "padded", 16, marks=pytest.mark.L0),
+        pytest.param(256, "float8_e5m2", "float16", "nhd", "padded", 8, marks=pytest.mark.L1),
+        pytest.param(128, "float8_e5m2", "float8_e5m2", "nhd", "token", 256, marks=pytest.mark.L1),
+        pytest.param(256, "float8_e4m3fn", "bfloat16", "hnd", "token", 16, marks=pytest.mark.L1),
+    ],
+)
+def test_paged_thd_fp8_origins_rebind_and_capture(
+    dim, dtype_name, out_name, pool_layout, stats_layout, page, heads=8, has_amax=False, mask="bottom_right", sink=False
+):
+    import cudnn
+    import torch
+    from cudnn.engines.manifest import family_for
+
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.get_device_capability() not in ((10, 0), (10, 3)):
+        pytest.skip("SM100/SM103 physical THD origin path")
+    torch.manual_seed(261026737)
+    batch, kv_heads, maximum, kv_max = 2, 2, 320, 512
+    pages_per_sequence, page_count = kv_max // page, batch * kv_max // page
+    dtype = getattr(torch, dtype_name)
+    io_type = cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3 if dtype_name == "float8_e4m3fn" else cudnn.data_type.FP8_E5M2
+    out_dtype = getattr(torch, out_name)
+    out_type = {
+        "bfloat16": cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16,
+        "float16": cudnn.data_type.HALF,
+        "float8_e4m3fn": cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3,
+        "float8_e5m2": cudnn.data_type.FP8_E5M2,
+    }[out_name]
+    scalar_names = ("descale_q", "descale_k", "descale_v", "descale_s", "scale_s", "scale_o")
+    widths = {"q": torch.int64, "o": torch.int32, "stats": torch.int64}
+    if stats_layout == "padded":
+        del widths["stats"]
+    multipliers = {"q": heads * dim, "o": dim, "stats": 1}
+    graph_ports = ("q", "k", "v", "o", "stats", "ql", "kl", "kt", "vt", "ro_q", "ro_o", "ro_stats") + scalar_names
+
+    if stats_layout == "padded":
+        graph_ports = tuple(name for name in graph_ports if name != "ro_stats")
+    if has_amax:
+        graph_ports += ("amax_o",)
+    if sink:
+        graph_ports += ("sinks",)
+
+    def buffers(wide=False):
+        q_capacity, o_capacity, stats_capacity = (640 if wide else 512), 640, 672
+        pitch = dim + (16 if wide else 0)
+        result = {
+            "q": torch.empty(q_capacity, heads, pitch, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)[..., :dim],
+            "backing_o": torch.empty(o_capacity, heads, pitch, device="cuda", dtype=out_dtype),
+            "stats": torch.empty((stats_capacity, heads) if stats_layout == "token" else (heads, stats_capacity), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32),
+            "ql": torch.empty(batch, 1, 1, 1, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32),
+            "kl": torch.empty(batch, 1, 1, 1, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32),
+        }
+        result["o"] = result["backing_o"][..., :dim]
+        if stats_layout == "padded":
+            result["stats"] = torch.empty(batch, heads, maximum, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+        if has_amax:
+            result["amax_o"] = torch.empty((1, 1, 1, 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+        if pool_layout != "mixed":
+            shape = (page_count + 1, kv_heads, page, 2 * dim) if pool_layout == "hnd" else (page_count + 1, page, kv_heads, 2 * dim)
+            interleaved = torch.empty(shape, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+            if pool_layout == "nhd":
+                interleaved = interleaved.transpose(1, 2)
+            result["k"], result["v"] = interleaved.split(dim, dim=-1)
+        else:
+            result["k"] = torch.empty(page_count + 1, kv_heads, page, dim, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+            result["v"] = torch.empty(page_count + 1, page, kv_heads, dim, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+        for name in ("kt", "vt"):
+            backing = torch.empty(batch, 1, pages_per_sequence * (2 if name == "vt" else 1), 1, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+            result[name] = backing[:, :, ::2] if name == "vt" else backing
+        for name, width in widths.items():
+            result["ro_" + name] = torch.empty(batch + 1, 1, 1, 1, device="cuda", dtype=width)
+        if sink:
+            result["sinks"] = torch.empty(1, heads, 1, 1, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+        for name in scalar_names:
+            result[name] = torch.empty((1, 1, 1, 1), device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
+        return result
+
+    def fill(values, shift, replay=False, keyless=False, empty=False):
+        ql = ([257, 49] if replay else [300, 177]) if not empty else [0, 0]
+        kl = [kv_max - 31, 263] if replay else [kv_max, kv_max]
+        if keyless:
+            kl[1] = 0
+        # shift=0 is the integration reproducer's shared [0,320,512] Q slots.
+        # Subsequent bindings/replays also separate the three physical origins.
+        starts = {
+            "q": [shift, 320 + shift],
+            "o": [shift + (16 if shift else 0), 320 + shift + (32 if shift else 0)],
+            "stats": [shift + (32 if shift else 0), 320 + shift + (64 if shift else 0)],
+        }
+        for name, lengths in (("ql", ql), ("kl", kl)):
+            values[name].copy_(torch.tensor(lengths, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).view(batch, 1, 1, 1))
+        for name in widths:
+            tensor = values[name]
+            token_stride = tensor.stride(0) if name != "stats" or stats_layout == "token" else 1
+            capacity = tensor.shape[0] if name != "stats" or stats_layout == "token" else tensor.shape[1]
+            offsets = [(x * token_stride) // multipliers[name] for x in starts[name] + [capacity]]
+            values["ro_" + name].copy_(torch.tensor(offsets, device="cuda", dtype=widths[name]).view(batch + 1, 1, 1, 1))
+        values["q"].fill_(float("nan"))
+        for start, length in zip(starts["q"], ql):
+            values["q"][start : start + length].copy_(torch.randn(length, heads, dim, device="cuda").to(dtype))
+        for name in ("k", "v"):
+            values[name].copy_(torch.randn(values[name].shape, device="cuda").to(dtype))
+            values[name][-1].fill_(float("nan"))
+        for name in ("kt", "vt"):
+            values[name].copy_(torch.randperm(page_count, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).view(batch, 1, pages_per_sequence, 1))
+        for name, value in zip(scalar_names, (0.8, 0.9, 0.4 if replay else 0.7, 1.0, 1.0, 1.9 if replay else 1.3)):
+            values[name].fill_(value)
+        if sink:
+            values["sinks"].fill_(-120.0 if replay else 0.3)
+        return ql, kl, starts
+
+    first = buffers()
+    graph = cudnn.pygraph(
+        io_data_type=io_type,
+        intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+        compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT,
+        is_override_shape_enabled=True,

+The graph's two optional ports are fp32 ``(B, H_q, S_q, 1)`` row statistics in NATURAL units: ``score_max`` is the

+``exp(s - max)`` -- the two operands the LSE is built from, so ``Stats == score_max + ln(score_sum_exp)`` to fp32 rounding

+same SELECT and the same OOB-row store guard as the LSE.  Served by the d128 f16/bf16 prefill kernels on dense, unsplit,
+unpaged plans of the 2-CTA tile; every other selection is a typed decline (the engine row's ``mismatch`` and the standalone
+adapter's ``check_support`` read ONE shape constant per arch line).

+degenerate contract (the keyless row -inf / 0, the sink sink_logit / 1), the base-2 Stats interaction, each output alone,

+def _desc(shape, dtype, name, stride=None):
+    """A BSHD-physical (BHSD-logical) TensorDesc with no storage behind it."""
+    from cudnn.api_base import TensorDesc
+
+    b, h, s, d = shape
+    stride = tuple(stride) if stride is not None else (s * h * d, d, h * d, 1)
+    return TensorDesc(
+        dtype=dtype, shape=tuple(shape), stride=stride, stride_order=TensorDesc._compute_stride_order(tuple(shape), stride), device="cuda", name=name

+def _fake_cc(monkeypatch, cc):
+    """check_support reads the LIVE device; pin it so both arch arms run on any host."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.cuda, "is_available", lambda: True)

+def _api(
+    *,
+    b=1,
+    h=8,
+    h_kv=None,
+    s=512,
+    d=128,
+    d_v=None,
+    dtype=torch.float16,
+    fp8=False,
+    score_max=True,
+    score_sum_exp=True,
+    score_stride=None,
+    score_dtype=torch.float32,
+    **kw,
+):
+    """A d128-shaped SdpaFwdDslSm100 built from descriptors only, the score samples declared like Stats."""
+    from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.api_dsl import SdpaFwdDslSm100
+
+    h_kv = h if h_kv is None else h_kv
+    d_v = d if d_v is None else d_v
+    qkv_dtype = torch.float8_e4m3fn if fp8 else dtype
+    o_dtype = torch.bfloat16 if fp8 else dtype
+    q = _desc((b, h, s, d), qkv_dtype, "q")
+    k = _desc((b, h_kv, s, d), qkv_dtype, "k")
+    v = _desc((b, h_kv, s, d_v), qkv_dtype, "v")
+    o = _desc((b, h, s, d_v), o_dtype, "o")
+    # The Stats geometry: compact (b, h, s, 1) unless a declared (padded / permuted) stride is given.
+    score_stride = score_stride if score_stride is not None else (h * s, s, 1, 1)
+    if score_max:
+        kw["sample_score_max"] = _desc((b, h, s, 1), score_dtype, "score_max", stride=score_stride)
+    if score_sum_exp:
+        kw["sample_score_sum_exp"] = _desc((b, h, s, 1), score_dtype, "score_sum_exp", stride=score_stride)
+    if fp8:

+
+# The probe body: TemplateParams from the arm's kwargs (the compile() keys travel as `__has_*` and are popped), the d128
+# module of the arch, compile(...) with only the keys the module accepts -- so the SAME body renders the pre-edit tree
+# (whose compile() had no score keys) and this tree.  Keep byte-identical to the renderer that produced the records.
+_PROBE_BODY = """
+import inspect
+from cudnn.frost.buffers import cutedsl_state
+_installed, _version = cutedsl_state()
+print("DSL", " ".join(_version) if _version else "unknown")
+has_lse = params_kw.pop("__has_lse", True)
+score_kw = {k[2:]: params_kw.pop(k) for k in ("__has_score_max", "__has_score_sum_exp") if k in params_kw}
+params = TemplateParams(**params_kw)
+mod = _load_sm100_kernel_module((128, 128), params, rubin=(arch == "sm_107a"))
+accepted = inspect.signature(mod.compile).parameters
+compile_kw = dict(has_lse=has_lse, lse_kind="dense")
+compile_kw.update({k: v for k, v in score_kw.items() if k in accepted})
+print("COMPILE_KW", sorted(compile_kw.items()))
+mod.compile(**compile_kw)
+"""
+_COUNTS = {
+    "STG": (" STG",),
+    "LDTM": ("LDTM",),
+    "FSEL": (" FSEL",),
+    "STL": (" STL",),
+    "LDL": (" LDL",),
+    "USETMAXREG": ("USETMAXREG",),
+}
+_RECORDS = {"dense_bf16": {"dtype_qkv": 2}, "causal_f16": {"dtype_qkv": 3, "window_right": 0}, "dense_bf16_nolse": {"dtype_qkv": 2, "__has_lse": False}}
+_SCORE_ARM = {"dtype_qkv": 2, "__has_score_max": True, "__has_score_sum_exp": True}
+_RENDERINGS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "renderings"
+
+
+def _record(arch):
+    """(dsl line, {record: md5}) of the committed pre-edit record ``renderings/md5_fwd_d128_f16_score_stats_off_<arch>.txt``."""
+    f = _RENDERINGS / f"md5_fwd_d128_f16_score_stats_off_{arch}.txt"
+    assert f.is_file(), f
+    dsl, want = None, {}
+    for ln in f.read_text().splitlines():
+        if ln.startswith("dsl="):
+            dsl = ln[len("dsl=") :].strip()
+        m = re.match(rf"fwd_d128_f16 {arch} (\S+) rc=0 cubin_md5=([0-9a-f]{{32}})", ln)
+        if m:
+            want[m.group(1)] = m.group(2)
+    return dsl, want

+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- tier 3: GPU cells (the row of the device present)
+
+# Tolerances DERIVED from the kernel's arithmetic, not from the first passing run:
+#   score_max: S is the fp32 tcgen05 accumulation of exact bf16/f16 products over d = 128 (|err| <= 128 * 2^-24 * sum|q k|,
+#              ~2e-4 at these magnitudes), then one FMUL by scale*log2(e) and one by ln 2 (2 roundings, ~1e-7 relative):
+#              atol 1e-3 is >= 5x that bound; rtol 1e-5 covers the two roundings.
+#   score_sum_exp: a sum of up to S_kv ex2.approx terms (2^-22 relative each) plus the per-KV-tile rescales (one more
+#              ex2.approx each) and the fp32 accumulation (S_kv * 2^-24): < 2e-4 relative at S_kv <= 512, < 4e-4 at the
+#              n_kv = 8 cell's S_kv = 1024 (1024 * 2^-22 + 1024 * 2^-24 + 8 rescales, every term one-sided); rtol 1e-3.
+#   Stats == score_max + ln(score_sum_exp): the kernel evaluates exactly that with lg2.approx (2 ulp): 2e-5 absolute.
+_TOL_MAX = dict(atol=1e-3, rtol=1e-5)
+_TOL_SUM = dict(atol=0.0, rtol=1e-3)
+_TOL_LSE_CONSISTENCY = dict(atol=2e-5, rtol=2e-6)
+_TOL_O = dict(atol=5e-2, rtol=3e-2)  # the suite's half-precision O bound

+
+def _bhsd(b, h, s, d, dtype):
+    return torch.randn(b, s, h, d, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+def _ref(q, k, v, *, scale, causal=False, bottom_right=False, seq_q_lens=None, seq_kv_lens=None, sinks=None, window_left=None):
+    """fp64 oracle of the whole contract: O, the natural-log LSE, score_max and score_sum_exp per row class."""
+    b, h_q, s_q, _ = q.shape
+    _, h_kv, s_kv, _ = v.shape
+    dev = q.device
+    g = h_q // h_kv
+    k_ref = k.repeat_interleave(g, dim=1).double()
+    v_ref = v.repeat_interleave(g, dim=1).double()
+    scores = torch.matmul(q.double(), k_ref.transpose(-1, -2)) * scale
+    q_lens = seq_q_lens.flatten().to(device=dev, dtype=torch.int64) if seq_q_lens is not None else torch.full((b,), s_q, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
+    kv_lens = seq_kv_lens.flatten().to(device=dev, dtype=torch.int64) if seq_kv_lens is not None else torch.full((b,), s_kv, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
+    i = torch.arange(s_q, device=dev).view(1, 1, s_q, 1)
+    j = torch.arange(s_kv, device=dev).view(1, 1, 1, s_kv)
+    diag = i + (kv_lens - q_lens).view(b, 1, 1, 1) if bottom_right else i
+    dead_q = i >= q_lens.view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    masked = dead_q | (j >= kv_lens.view(b, 1, 1, 1))
+    if causal:
+        masked = masked | (j > diag)
+    if window_left is not None:
+        # The left window rides the diagonal: keys j < diag - W are masked, W keys below the diagonal stay (the kernel's
+        # WINDOW_LEFT = W = the graph's sliding_window_length - 1; the same convention as the sm107 suite's references).
+        masked = masked | (j < diag - window_left)
+    scores = scores.masked_fill(masked, float("-inf"))
+    full = scores if sinks is None else torch.cat([scores, sinks.view(1, h_q, 1, 1).double().expand(b, h_q, s_q, 1)], dim=-1)
+    smax = full.max(dim=-1).values  # -inf on a row with no finite column
+    ssum = torch.exp(full - smax.unsqueeze(-1)).sum(dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0)  # exp(-inf - -inf) = NaN on an empty row -> 0
+    lse = smax + torch.log(ssum)  # -inf + -inf on an empty row
+    o = torch.matmul(torch.softmax(full, dim=-1).nan_to_num(0.0)[..., :s_kv], v_ref)
+    dead = dead_q.squeeze(-1)
+    return dict(o=o, lse=lse.masked_fill(dead, float("-inf")), smax=smax.masked_fill(dead, float("-inf")), ssum=ssum.masked_fill(dead, 0.0))

+def _run(
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    *,
+    scale,
+    sdpa_kwargs=None,
+    seq_len_kv=None,
+    seq_len_q=None,
+    sink=None,
+    stats=True,
+    outputs=("score_max", "score_sum_exp"),
+    layout="contiguous",
+    stats_log2=False,
+):
+    """Build the graph with the requested side outputs, pin the arch's f16 row, launch TWICE (sentinel-filled outputs, the
+    two-launch delta) and return the buffers."""
+    import cudnn
+
+    b, h_q, s_q, _ = q.shape
+    d_v = v.shape[-1]
+    dtype = q.dtype
+    o_gpu = torch.empty(b, s_q, h_q, d_v, device="cuda", dtype=dtype).transpose(1, 2)
+    io = cudnn.data_type.HALF if dtype == torch.float16 else cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=io, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    tq, tk, tv = g.tensor_like(q), g.tensor_like(k), g.tensor_like(v)
+    kw = dict(name="sdpa", q=tq, k=tk, v=tv, generate_stats=stats, attn_scale=scale, stats_use_log2=stats_log2)
+    vp = {tq: q, tk: k, tv: v}
+    side = {}
+    for name in outputs:
+        buf = make_dense_stats(b, h_q, s_q, layout)
+        t = g.tensor(dim=list(buf.shape), stride=list(buf.stride()), data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, name=name)
+        kw[name] = t
+        vp[t] = buf
+        side[name] = buf
+    if seq_len_kv is not None:
+        slk = g.tensor_like(seq_len_kv)
+        kw.update(seq_len_kv=slk, use_padding_mask=True)
+        vp[slk] = seq_len_kv
+        slq_t = seq_len_q if seq_len_q is not None else torch.full((b, 1, 1, 1), s_q, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+        slq = g.tensor_like(slq_t)
+        kw["seq_len_q"] = slq
+        vp[slq] = slq_t
+    if sink is not None:
+        st = g.tensor_like(sink)
+        kw["sink_token"] = st
+        vp[st] = sink
+    kw.update(sdpa_kwargs or {})
+    o, stats_t = g.sdpa(**kw)
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim(o_gpu.shape).set_stride(o_gpu.stride())
+    stats_gpu = None
+    if stats:
+        stats_gpu = make_dense_stats(b, h_q, s_q, "contiguous")
+        stats_t.set_output(True).set_dim(stats_gpu.shape).set_stride(stats_gpu.stride()).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)

+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    # The plan: the row's unsplit, unpacked 2-CTA prefill tile -- the tile the score arm is wired on -- PINNED, never inferred from the
+    # ranking: with the ports off the heuristics may rank another tile of the row first (the PackGQA cga1 plan on a 148 / 152-SM part for
+    # the GQA shapes), and the bitwise comparisons below must be like for like.  A cga2 plan not in the ranked list is replayed through the
+    # public autotune record (the way an autotuner replays it).
+    names = [g.get_plan_name_at_index(i) for i in range(len(g.plans))]
+    ours = [i for i, n in enumerate(names) if n == _ROW or n.startswith(_ROW + "[")]
+    assert ours, f"no {_ROW} plan in {names}"
+
+    def _prefill_tile(i):
+        kn = g.plans[i].knobs
+        return (kn.split_kv or 1) == 1 and not kn.pack_gqa and kn.cga in (None, 2)
+
+    idx = next((i for i in ours if _prefill_tile(i)), None)

+        record = dict(record)

+        g.create_execution_plan(engine_id, record)
+        idx = g.get_execution_plan_count() - 1
+    g.select_plan(idx)

+def _check(out, ref, *, has_stats=True):
+    """The contract on every row: keyless rows EXACTLY -inf / 0 (never NaN), live rows against the fp64 oracle, and the
+    LSE identity Stats == score_max + ln(score_sum_exp) evaluated from the kernel's own fp32 outputs."""
+    smax = out["score_max"].squeeze(-1)
+    ssum = out["score_sum_exp"].squeeze(-1)
+    empty = torch.isneginf(ref["smax"])
+    assert torch.isneginf(smax[empty]).all(), "an empty row's score_max must be exactly -inf"
+    assert (ssum[empty] == 0).all(), "an empty row's score_sum_exp must be exactly 0"
+    assert torch.isfinite(smax[~empty]).all() and torch.isfinite(ssum[~empty]).all(), "a live row was left unwritten (sentinel NaN) or non-finite"
+    torch.testing.assert_close(smax[~empty].double(), ref["smax"][~empty], **_TOL_MAX)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(ssum[~empty].double(), ref["ssum"][~empty], **_TOL_SUM)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out["o"].double(), ref["o"], **_TOL_O)
+    if has_stats:
+        lse = out["stats"].squeeze(-1)
+        assert torch.isneginf(lse[empty]).all()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(lse[~empty], (smax + torch.log(ssum))[~empty], **_TOL_LSE_CONSISTENCY)

+"""The Rubin index-list sparse d256 forward (``kernels/sm107/sparse_d256_f16.py``) over PRESCRIBED per-CTA item sequences:
+every ring barrier's slot and parity must come from a pipeline state carried across the work items a persistent CTA runs.
+
+A per-item restart of the parity arithmetic passes every one-item-per-CTA cell and fails on an odd / even MIX of tile counts
+between consecutive items: ``1, 1, 1`` leaves the ``s_empty`` ring a phase behind (a hang), ``3, 1, 2`` reads a stale score
+slot, mixes whose tile counts do not sum to a multiple of the K/V ring depth desynchronise that ring.  ``sparse_item_sequences``
+builds work lists on which those sequences are the typical per-CTA order (waves of the device's SM count along the token
+axis, the tile count set through ``block_lens``), holds the open-tail phase constant through the per-batch KV length, poisons
+the outputs with a sentinel (a surviving one = a row never written), poisons the tensor-memory residue through NaN query rows
+on the item before the sequence, and appends batches of KV length 0 (dead items in a run) next to the dead waves.
+
+Host tier (any box): the builder's arithmetic -- the count that yields a tile count round-trips through the kernel's clamp,
+every designed wave lands its target, a ``0`` wave is dead with no open block and tail-only with one, the natural form
+interleaves the four residues, the filler region costs one tile per item.
+
+Rubin tier (``requires_rubin``): the six sequences x the five tail phases, each with two launches.  Pins: no sentinel on any
+row (every item ran and stored), no non-finite output on a row whose query is finite (NaN residue did not travel), dead rows
+``O = 0`` / ``LSE = -inf`` exactly, the live rows within the sparse module's budget (atol 2e-2 on O and LSE, tighter than the dense sm107 suite's 5e-2 on O -- nothing widened),
+and the two launches bitwise.  A 12-fresh-process census of the same cells is a results-tree driver, not a test.

+def _sm120_reference(q, k, v, *, causal=False, bottom_right=False, stats_log2=False, sinks=None):

+    with no visible key has O = 0 and Stats = its sink.
+    """
+    b, h_q, s_q, d = q.shape
+    h_kv, s_kv = k.shape[1:3]

+    stats = torch.empty((b, h_q, s_q), device=q.device, dtype=torch.float32)

+def _make_graph(
+    lens_q,
+    lens_kv,
+    *,
+    h=2,
+    hkv=None,
+    d=128,
+    dv=None,
+    dtype=torch.float16,
+    causal=False,
+    bottom_right=False,
+    cu_lens=False,
+    stats_layout="head_major",
+    cap_extra=0,
+    stats_output=True,
+    stats_log2=False,
+    sdpa_kwargs=None,
+    declare_total=True,
+    skv_max=None,
+    sq_max=None,
+):
+    b = len(lens_q)
+    assert b == len(lens_kv)
+    hkv = h if hkv is None else hkv
+    dv = d if dv is None else dv
+    dev = "cuda"
+    sq, skv = max(lens_q), max(lens_kv)
+    sq = sq if sq_max is None else sq_max
+    skv = skv if skv_max is None else skv_max
+    tq, tkv = sum(lens_q), sum(lens_kv)
+    io = cudnn.data_type.HALF if dtype == torch.float16 else cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16
+    graph = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=io, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    vp = {}
+    cu_q = [0]
+    cu_kv = [0]
+    for nq, nkv in zip(lens_q, lens_kv, strict=True):
+        cu_q.append(cu_q[-1] + nq)
+        cu_kv.append(cu_kv[-1] + nkv)
+
+    def port(name, smax, total, cu, nh, dd):
+        stride = (smax * nh * dd, dd, nh * dd, 1)
+        node = graph.tensor(name=name, dim=(b, nh, smax, dd), stride=stride, data_type=io)
+        offset = graph.tensor(name=f"{name}_ro", dim=(b + 1, 1, 1, 1), stride=(1, 1, 1, 1), data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT64)
+        node.set_ragged_offset(offset)
+        vp[offset] = (torch.tensor(cu, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev) * nh * dd).view(b + 1, 1, 1, 1)
+        vp[node] = torch.randn(1, total + cap_extra, nh, dd, dtype=dtype, device=dev)
+        if cap_extra:
+            vp[node][0, total:] = float("nan")
+        return node
+
+    q = port("q", sq, tq, cu_q, h, d)
+    k = port("k", skv, tkv, cu_kv, hkv, d)
+    v = port("v", skv, tkv, cu_kv, hkv, dv)
+    q_is_cu, kv_is_cu = (cu_lens, cu_lens) if isinstance(cu_lens, bool) else cu_lens
+    nq_lens, nkv_lens = b + int(q_is_cu), b + int(kv_is_cu)
+    q_len = graph.tensor(name="cu_seq_len_q" if q_is_cu else "seq_len_q", dim=(nq_lens, 1, 1, 1), stride=(1, 1, 1, 1), data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32)
+    kv_len = graph.tensor(name="cu_seq_len_kv" if kv_is_cu else "seq_len_kv", dim=(nkv_lens, 1, 1, 1), stride=(1, 1, 1, 1), data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32)
+    vp[q_len] = torch.tensor(cu_q if q_is_cu else lens_q, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).view(nq_lens, 1, 1, 1)
+    vp[kv_len] = torch.tensor(cu_kv if kv_is_cu else lens_kv, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).view(nkv_lens, 1, 1, 1)
+    kw = dict(
+        name="sdpa",
+        q=q,
+        k=k,
+        v=v,
+        attn_scale=1 / math.sqrt(d),
+        generate_stats=stats_output,
+        use_padding_mask=True,
+        use_causal_mask=causal,
+        use_causal_mask_bottom_right=bottom_right,
+        stats_use_log2=stats_log2,
+    )
+    if declare_total:
+        kw.update(max_total_seq_len_q=tq, max_total_seq_len_kv=tkv)
+    kw.update({("cu_seq_len_q" if q_is_cu else "seq_len_q"): q_len, ("cu_seq_len_kv" if kv_is_cu else "seq_len_kv"): kv_len})
+    kw.update(sdpa_kwargs or {})
+    o, stats = graph.sdpa(**kw)
+    o.set_output(True).set_data_type(io).set_dim((b, h, sq, dv)).set_stride((sq * h * dv, dv, h * dv, 1))
+    o_ro = graph.tensor(name="o_ro", dim=(b + 1, 1, 1, 1), stride=(1, 1, 1, 1), data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT64)
+    o.set_ragged_offset(o_ro)
+    vp[o_ro] = (torch.tensor(cu_q, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev) * h * dv).view(b + 1, 1, 1, 1)
+    vp[o] = torch.full((1, tq + cap_extra, h, dv), float("nan"), dtype=dtype, device=dev)
+
+    if stats_output:
+        stats.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+        if stats_layout in ("head_major", "head_major_padded"):
+            head_stride = tq if stats_layout == "head_major" else ((tq + 63) // 64) * 64
+            stats.set_dim((b, h, sq, 1)).set_stride((h * head_stride, head_stride, 1, 1))
+        else:
+            assert stats_layout == "token_major"
+            stats.set_dim((b, h, sq, 1)).set_stride((sq * h, 1, h, 1))
+        stats_ro = graph.tensor(name="stats_ro", dim=(b + 1, 1, 1, 1), stride=(1, 1, 1, 1), data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT64)
+        stats.set_ragged_offset(stats_ro)
+        vp[stats_ro] = (torch.tensor(cu_q, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev) * (h if stats_layout == "token_major" else 1)).view(b + 1, 1, 1, 1)
+        vp[stats] = torch.full((tq, h) if stats_layout == "token_major" else (1, h, head_stride), float("nan"), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
+    return graph, vp, (q, k, v, o, stats), (cu_q, cu_kv)
+
+
+def _plan(graph):
+    _build_plan(graph)
+    return torch.empty(max(graph.get_workspace_size(), 1), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+
+
+def _build_plan(graph):
+    graph.validate()
+    graph.build_operation_graph()
+    graph.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    select_engine(graph, _ENGINE)
+    graph.check_support()
+    graph.build_plans()

+    from test_sdpa_bwd_staged_sm80 import _assert_kernel_count

+    q, k, v, o, stats = nodes
+    stats_view = vp[stats]
+
+    def bind_stats():
+        # Graph producers also expose packed Stats as (T, H, 1), including
+        # head-major storage with an independent, padded head pitch.
+        vp[stats] = stats_view
+        if stats_carrier == "th1":
+            vp[stats] = stats_view.unsqueeze(-1) if stats_layout == "token_major" else stats_view[0, :, : sum(lens_q)].T.unsqueeze(-1)
+
+    bind_stats()
+    storage = {}
+    for index, node in enumerate((q, k, v, o)):
+        _, heads, _, width = node.get_dim()
+        total = sum(lens_q if node in (q, o) else lens_kv)
+        head_stride = width + 8 * (index + 1)
+        token_stride = heads * head_stride + 8 * (index + 2)
+        span = (total + 4) * token_stride + (heads - 1) * head_stride + width
+        backing = torch.full((span + 24,), 77.0 if node is o else float("nan"), dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
+        view = backing.as_strided((1, total + 5, heads, width), (0, token_stride, head_stride, 1), 8)
+        if node is not o:
+            view[:, :total].normal_()
+        node.set_stride((7, head_stride, token_stride, 1))
+        for offset in vp:
+            if offset.get_name() == node.get_name() + "_ro":
+                # The graph still describes adjacent sequences; physical token pitches differ by port.
+                vp[offset].div_(node.get_dim()[1] * width, rounding_mode="floor").mul_(token_stride)
+        vp[node] = view
+        storage[node] = backing
+    output_padding = torch.ones_like(storage[o], dtype=torch.bool)
+    output_padding.as_strided(vp[o][:, : sum(lens_q)].shape, vp[o].stride(), 8).fill_(False)
+    workspace = _plan(graph)
+
+    def poison():
+        vp[o][:, : sum(lens_q)].fill_(float("nan"))
+        vp[stats].fill_(float("nan"))
+        workspace.fill_(0xA5)

+    def check(q_lengths, kv_lengths):

+        for nq, nk in zip(q_lengths, kv_lengths, strict=True):

+                kd = vp[k][0, ok : ok + nk].transpose(0, 1).double().repeat_interleave(2, dim=0)
+                vd = vp[v][0, ok : ok + nk].transpose(0, 1).double().repeat_interleave(2, dim=0)
+                if nk:
+                    scores = qd @ kd.transpose(-1, -2) / math.sqrt(d)
+                    ref_o, ref_lse = scores.softmax(-1) @ vd, scores.logsumexp(-1)
+                else:
+                    ref_o = torch.zeros((4, nq, dv), dtype=torch.float64, device="cuda")
+                    ref_lse = torch.full((4, nq), -float("inf"), dtype=torch.float64, device="cuda")
+                torch.testing.assert_close(vp[o][0, oq : oq + nq].transpose(0, 1).float(), ref_o.float(), rtol=1e-2, atol=4e-3)
+                got_lse = stats_view[oq : oq + nq].T if stats_layout == "token_major" else stats_view[0, :, oq : oq + nq]
+                torch.testing.assert_close(got_lse, ref_lse.float(), rtol=1e-3, atol=2e-3)
+            oq += nq
+            ok += nk
+        assert torch.all(storage[o][output_padding] == 77)
+        if stats_layout != "token_major":
+            assert torch.isnan(stats_view[0, :, oq:]).all()
+
+    poison()
+    graph.execute(vp, workspace)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    check(lens_q, lens_kv)
+    if stats_carrier == "th1":
+        good = vp[stats]
+        token_stride, head_stride, _ = good.stride()
+        for bad in (
+            good[:-1],
+            torch.empty_strided(good.shape, (token_stride + 1, head_stride, 1), dtype=good.dtype, device=good.device),
+            torch.empty_strided(good.shape, (token_stride, head_stride + 1, 1), dtype=good.dtype, device=good.device),
+        ):

+            vp[stats] = good
+    # Fresh allocations with the same pitches must not retain any previous pointer.
+    for node in (q, k, v, o):
+        storage[node] = storage[node].clone()
+        vp[node] = storage[node].as_strided(vp[node].shape, vp[node].stride(), 8)
+    stats_view = stats_view.clone()
+    bind_stats()
+    vp[v][:, : sum(lens_kv)].mul_(0.7)
+    poison()
+    stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    captured = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph(keep_graph=True)
+    try:
+        handle = cudnn_handle
+        previous_stream = cudnn.get_stream(handle)
+        try:
+            cudnn.set_stream(handle, stream.cuda_stream)
+            with torch.cuda.graph(captured, stream=stream):
+                graph.execute(vp, workspace, handle=handle)
+            _assert_kernel_count(captured, 2)  # device lengths metadata + attention, no layout copies
+        finally:
+            cudnn.set_stream(handle, previous_stream)
+        new_q, new_kv = (0, 25, 25), (26, 0, 41)
+        for node in vp:
+            name = node.get_name()
+            if name in ("seq_len_q", "seq_len_kv"):
+                vp[node].copy_(torch.tensor(new_q if name == "seq_len_q" else new_kv, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").view_as(vp[node]))
+            elif name.endswith("_ro"):
+                lengths = new_kv if name in ("k_ro", "v_ro") else new_q
+                prefix = [0, lengths[0], lengths[0] + lengths[1], sum(lengths)]
+                data_node = next((n for n in (q, k, v, o) if n.get_name() + "_ro" == name), None)
+                pitch = data_node.get_stride()[2] if data_node is not None else (4 if stats_layout == "token_major" else 1)
+                vp[node].copy_(torch.tensor(prefix, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda").view_as(vp[node]) * pitch)
+        captured.replay()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        check(new_q, new_kv)
+    finally:
+        captured.reset()
+
+
+def test_graph_thd_rejects_undersized_workspace():
+    graph, vp, _, _ = _make_graph((144, 96), (160, 128))
+    workspace = _plan(graph)
+    assert workspace.numel() > 1
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="workspace"):
+        graph.execute(vp, torch.empty(1, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda"))

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""``sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm90`` reads the bound ragged offsets of a THD graph.
+
+A ragged graph binds one ragged-offset tensor per port, and a padded THD layout -- TE's
+``cu_seqlens_padded`` -- puts a sequence's rows somewhere other than ``prefix(lengths)``.
+Q/K/V must be read, and O written, where the caller put them, and the O gaps are never written
+(they hold a sentinel). Every port may be padded differently (TE pads the Q side and the KV side
+independently), and the offsets may be element counts or token counts with a multiplier. The
+addressing cases fill the gaps with finite values; a separate case fills them with NaN, which a
+K/V tile that runs past its sequence end into the gap would turn into a NaN output (a masked
+probability of exactly 0 times NaN is NaN), so the gaps must not reach the PV product either.
+The packed case (offsets == prefix(lengths) * token stride) is the existing suite's. Stats rows
+follow their own offsets too, in both packed Stats layouts, and an offset past its buffer stays
+inside it (the setup launch clamps every origin and clips every map).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+import cudnn
+from cudnn.sdpa.fwd.engines import engine_name
+from frost_test_utils import _SM, requires_dsl
+from frost_test_utils import select_engine as _select_engine
+
+from test_sdpa_fwd_dsl_sm100 import _mask_graph_kwargs, _mask_ref_kwargs, _ref_sdpa_full
+
+pytestmark = [
+    pytest.mark.L0,
+    pytest.mark.skipif(_SM != 90, reason="needs an SM90 Hopper GPU, have " + ("none" if _SM is None else f"sm_{_SM}")),
+    requires_dsl,
+]
+
+_D = 512
+_SENTINEL = 2048.0
+
+
+def _starts(lens, pads, lead=0):
+    """Padded start rows: ``lead`` empty rows, then sequence ``b`` occupies ``[start[b], start[b] + lens[b])``,
+    then ``pads[b]`` empty rows."""
+    starts, t = [], lead
+    for n, p in zip(lens, pads, strict=True):
+        starts.append(t)
+        t += n + p
+    return starts, t
+
+
+def _run_padded_full(
+    lens_q,
+    lens_kv,
+    pads,
+    *,
+    h_q=2,
+    h_kv=2,
+    mask="none",
+    units="elements",
+    dtype=torch.float16,
+    seed=0,
+    gap="nan",
+    offset_dtype=torch.int64,
+    stats=None,
+    edit_offsets=None,
+    lead=None,
+    slack=0,
+    handles=False,
+):
+    """Build and execute a padded THD forward graph on the SM90 row; returns the packed Q/K/V,
+    the O (and Stats) storage and the per-port geometry. ``stats`` is None, ``"token_major"``
+    (packed (T, H)) or ``"head_major"`` (packed (H, T)); ``edit_offsets(port, values)`` may
+    rewrite a port's offset values after the geometry is laid out; ``lead`` gives a port empty
+    rows before its first sequence; ``slack`` adds spare rows to every buffer. The fourth value
+    is None, or with ``handles`` the graph, its variant pack, workspace, offset and length tensors
+    and token strides, for a caller that re-executes or captures the plan."""
+    dev = "cuda"
+    gen = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(seed)
+    b = len(lens_q)
+    d = _D
+    io = cudnn.data_type.HALF if dtype == torch.float16 else cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16
+    lead = lead or {}
+    geom = {
+        port: _starts(lens_q if port in ("q", "o", "stats") else lens_kv, pads.get(port, [0] * b), lead.get(port, 0)) for port in ("q", "k", "v", "o", "stats")
+    }
+    # One declared extent per side: the widest port's padded total bounds the views.
+    tot = {port: max(geom[p][1] for p in (("q", "o") if port in ("q", "o", "stats") else ("k", "v"))) for port in geom}
+    heads = {"q": h_q, "o": h_q, "k": h_kv, "v": h_kv}
+    s_max_q, s_max_kv = max(lens_q), max(lens_kv)
+
+    packed, stor = {}, {}
+    for port in ("q", "k", "v"):
+        lens = lens_q if port == "q" else lens_kv
+        packed[port] = torch.randn(sum(lens), heads[port], d, generator=gen, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+        rows = tot[port] + max(s_max_q, s_max_kv) + slack
+        if gap == "nan":
+            buf = torch.full((rows, heads[port], d), float("nan"), device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+        else:
+            buf = torch.randn(rows, heads[port], d, generator=gen, device=dev, dtype=dtype) * 4
+        cu = 0
+        for i, n in enumerate(lens):
+            buf[geom[port][0][i] : geom[port][0][i] + n] = packed[port][cu : cu + n]
+            cu += n
+        stor[port] = buf
+    stor["o"] = torch.full((tot["o"] + s_max_q + slack, h_q, d), _SENTINEL, device=dev, dtype=dtype)
+
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=io, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    vp, t = {}, {}
+
+    ro_type = {torch.int32: cudnn.data_type.INT32, torch.int64: cudnn.data_type.INT64}[offset_dtype]
+    ro_by_port, ts_by_port = {}, {}
+
+    def ragged(port, x, ts):
+        vals = geom[port][0] + [geom[port][1]]
+        if edit_offsets is not None:
+            vals = edit_offsets(port, vals)
+        vals = torch.tensor(vals, dtype=torch.int64, device=dev)
+        ro_t = (vals if units == "tokens" else vals * ts).to(offset_dtype).view(b + 1, 1, 1, 1)
+        ro = g.tensor(name=f"{port}_ro", dim=[b + 1, 1, 1, 1], stride=[1, 1, 1, 1], data_type=ro_type)
+        x.set_ragged_offset(ro)
+        if units == "tokens":
+            x.set_ragged_offset_multiplier(ts)
+        vp[ro] = ro_t
+        ro_by_port[port], ts_by_port[port] = ro_t, ts
+
+    for port, s_max in (("q", s_max_q), ("k", s_max_kv), ("v", s_max_kv)):
+        ts = heads[port] * d
+        t[port] = g.tensor(name=port, dim=[b, heads[port], s_max, d], stride=[s_max * ts, d, ts, 1], data_type=io)
+        ragged(port, t[port], ts)
+        vp[t[port]] = stor[port]
+    slq = torch.tensor(lens_q, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    slk = torch.tensor(lens_kv, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev).view(b, 1, 1, 1)
+    sq, skv = g.tensor_like(slq), g.tensor_like(slk)
+    vp[sq], vp[skv] = slq, slk
+    o, st = g.sdpa(
+        name="sdpa",
+        q=t["q"],
+        k=t["k"],
+        v=t["v"],
+        generate_stats=stats is not None,
+        attn_scale=1.0 / math.sqrt(d),
+        use_padding_mask=True,
+        seq_len_q=sq,
+        seq_len_kv=skv,
+        **_mask_graph_kwargs(mask),
+    )
+    ts_o = h_q * d
+    o.set_output(True).set_dim([b, h_q, s_max_q, d]).set_stride([s_max_q * ts_o, d, ts_o, 1])
+    ragged("o", o, ts_o)
+    vp[o] = stor["o"]
+    if stats is not None:
+        rows = tot["stats"] + s_max_q + slack
+        if stats == "token_major":
+            stor["stats"] = torch.full((rows, h_q), _SENTINEL, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32)
+            st.set_output(True).set_dim([b, h_q, s_max_q, 1]).set_stride([s_max_q * h_q, 1, h_q, 1]).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+            ragged("stats", st, h_q)
+        else:
+            stor["stats"] = torch.full((h_q, rows), _SENTINEL, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32)
+            st.set_output(True).set_dim([b, h_q, s_max_q, 1]).set_stride([h_q * rows, rows, 1, 1]).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+            ragged("stats", st, 1)
+        vp[st] = stor["stats"]
+
+    g.validate()
+    g.build_operation_graph()
+    g.create_execution_plans([cudnn.heur_mode.A])
+    _select_engine(g, engine_name(arch="sm90"))
+    g.check_support()
+    g.build_plans()
+    workspace = torch.empty(max(g.get_workspace_size(), 1), device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    g.execute(vp, workspace)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    if handles:
+        return packed, stor, geom, SimpleNamespace(g=g, vp=vp, workspace=workspace, ro=ro_by_port, ts=ts_by_port, slq=slq, slk=slk)
+    return packed, stor, geom, None
+
+
+def _run_padded(*args, **kwargs):
+    """``_run_padded_full`` without the handles: the packed Q/K/V, the O (and Stats) storage and the geometry."""
+    return _run_padded_full(*args, **kwargs)[:3]
+
+
+def _check(lens_q, lens_kv, packed, stor, geom, mask, stats=None, skip=()):
+    """Every sequence's O (and Stats) rows at its origin; nothing written outside them.
+    Sequences in ``skip`` (deliberately bad offsets) are not compared, but their rows still
+    count as live."""
+    o_starts = geom["o"][0]
+    cu_q, cu_k = 0, 0
+    live = torch.zeros(stor["o"].shape[0], dtype=torch.bool, device=stor["o"].device)
+    st_rows = 0 if stats is None else stor["stats"].shape[0 if stats == "token_major" else 1]
+    st_live = torch.zeros(st_rows, dtype=torch.bool, device=stor["o"].device)
+    for i, (nq, nkv) in enumerate(zip(lens_q, lens_kv)):
+        live[o_starts[i] : o_starts[i] + nq] = True
+        st0 = geom["stats"][0][i]
+        st_live[st0 : st0 + nq] = True
+        if i not in skip and nq:
+            qb = packed["q"][cu_q : cu_q + nq].permute(1, 0, 2).unsqueeze(0)
+            kb = packed["k"][cu_k : cu_k + nkv].permute(1, 0, 2).unsqueeze(0)
+            vb = packed["v"][cu_k : cu_k + nkv].permute(1, 0, 2).unsqueeze(0)
+            ref, lse_ref = _ref_sdpa_full(qb, kb, vb, scale=1.0 / math.sqrt(_D), return_stats=True, **_mask_ref_kwargs(mask))
+            got = stor["o"][o_starts[i] : o_starts[i] + nq].permute(1, 0, 2).unsqueeze(0)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(got, ref, atol=5e-2, rtol=3e-2, msg=f"sequence {i}")
+            if stats is not None:
+                rows = stor["stats"][st0 : st0 + nq].transpose(0, 1) if stats == "token_major" else stor["stats"][:, st0 : st0 + nq]
+                torch.testing.assert_close(rows, lse_ref[0], atol=2e-2, rtol=2e-2, msg=f"Stats of sequence {i}")
+        cu_q += nq
+        cu_k += nkv
+    assert (stor["o"][~live] == _SENTINEL).all(), "a gap or tail row of O was written"
+    if stats is not None:
+        dead = stor["stats"][~st_live] if stats == "token_major" else stor["stats"][:, ~st_live]
+        assert (dead == _SENTINEL).all(), "a gap or tail row of Stats was written"
+
+
+_LENS_Q = [130, 64, 7]
+_LENS_KV = [130, 200, 7]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "pads",
+    [
+        pytest.param({"q": [5, 0, 9], "o": [5, 0, 9], "k": [3, 11, 0], "v": [3, 11, 0]}, id="te-padded"),
+        pytest.param({"q": [0, 17, 1], "o": [4, 4, 4], "k": [0, 0, 0], "v": [8, 0, 2]}, id="per-port"),
+        pytest.param({"k": [64, 1, 64], "v": [64, 1, 64]}, id="kv-only"),
+    ],
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("units", ["elements", "tokens"])
+def test_sm90_thd_reads_ragged_offsets(pads, units):
+    packed, stor, geom = _run_padded(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, pads, units=units, gap="finite")
+    _check(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, packed, stor, geom, "none")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mask", ["causal", "causal_br"])
+def test_sm90_thd_ragged_offsets_masked(mask):
+    pads = {"q": [5, 0, 9], "o": [5, 0, 9], "k": [3, 11, 0], "v": [3, 11, 0]}
+    packed, stor, geom = _run_padded(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, pads, h_q=4, h_kv=2, mask=mask, dtype=torch.bfloat16, seed=1, gap="finite")
+    _check(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, packed, stor, geom, mask)
+
+
+def test_sm90_thd_gap_rows_never_reach_the_output():
+    """NaN in the gaps: a K/V tile that reads past a sequence end into its gap poisons that sequence."""
+    pads = {"q": [5, 0, 9], "o": [5, 0, 9], "k": [3, 11, 0], "v": [3, 11, 0]}
+    packed, stor, geom = _run_padded(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, pads, gap="nan")
+    _check(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, packed, stor, geom, "none")
+
+
+def test_sm90_thd_packed_offsets_unchanged():
+    """Offsets equal to prefix(lengths): the packed layout every existing caller binds."""
+    packed, stor, geom = _run_padded(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, {})
+    _check(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, packed, stor, geom, "none")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("stats", ["token_major", "head_major"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("units", ["elements", "tokens"])
+def test_sm90_thd_stats_read_their_own_offsets(stats, units):
+    """Stats rows land at the Stats port's own origins, which may differ from O's."""
+    pads = {"q": [5, 0, 9], "o": [5, 0, 9], "k": [3, 11, 0], "v": [3, 11, 0], "stats": [2, 7, 0]}
+    packed, stor, geom = _run_padded(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, pads, units=units, gap="nan", stats=stats)
+    _check(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, packed, stor, geom, "none", stats=stats)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("units", ["elements", "tokens"])
+def test_sm90_thd_int32_offsets(units):
+    pads = {"q": [0, 17, 1], "o": [4, 4, 4], "k": [0, 0, 0], "v": [8, 0, 2]}
+    packed, stor, geom = _run_padded(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, pads, units=units, offset_dtype=torch.int32, gap="nan")
+    _check(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, packed, stor, geom, "none")
+
+
+def test_sm90_thd_single_padded_sequence():
+    """B = 1 takes the setup's single-writer path; a leading gap still moves every port."""
+    lead = {"q": 3, "o": 6, "k": 9, "v": 1, "stats": 4}
+    packed, stor, geom = _run_padded([77], [150], {}, gap="nan", stats="token_major", lead=lead)
+    _check([77], [150], packed, stor, geom, "none", stats="token_major")
+
+
+def test_sm90_thd_many_padded_sequences():
+    """B = 40 (more sequences than the setup's map-writing warps and a prefix warp's lanes),
+    random gaps on every port, empty Q sequences, GQA, causal, NaN gaps."""
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(7)
+    b = 40
+    lens_q = torch.randint(0, 70, (b,), generator=gen).tolist()
+    lens_kv = [max(n, 1) + int(x) for n, x in zip(lens_q, torch.randint(0, 30, (b,), generator=gen))]
+    pads = {port: torch.randint(0, 10, (b,), generator=gen).tolist() for port in ("q", "k", "v", "o")}
+    packed, stor, geom = _run_padded(lens_q, lens_kv, pads, h_q=4, h_kv=2, mask="causal_br", dtype=torch.bfloat16, gap="nan")
+    _check(lens_q, lens_kv, packed, stor, geom, "causal_br")
+
+
+def test_sm90_thd_offset_past_the_buffer_stays_inside_it():
+    """A K/V offset past its buffer is clamped into it: the launch completes, the other
+    sequences are exact, and nothing outside O's sequences is written."""
+    pads = {"q": [5, 0, 9], "o": [5, 0, 9], "k": [3, 11, 0], "v": [3, 11, 0]}
+
+    def far(port, vals):
+        return vals[:2] + [10**7] + vals[3:] if port in ("k", "v") else vals
+
+    packed, stor, geom = _run_padded(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, pads, gap="nan", edit_offsets=far)
+    _check(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, packed, stor, geom, "none", skip=(2,))
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+
+def test_sm90_thd_cuda_graph_replay_reads_new_offsets():
+    """TE replays one captured graph while ``cu_seqlens_padded`` changes every step: a replay
+    reads the offsets and lengths bound at replay time, not the capture's."""
+    pads_a = {"q": [5, 0, 9], "o": [5, 0, 9], "k": [3, 11, 0], "v": [3, 11, 0], "stats": [2, 7, 0]}
+    packed, stor, geom, h = _run_padded_full(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, pads_a, gap="nan", stats="token_major", slack=96, handles=True)
+    _check(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, packed, stor, geom, "none", stats="token_major")
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    try:
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+            h.g.execute(h.vp, h.workspace)
+
+        def replay():
+            stor["o"].fill_(_SENTINEL)
+            stor["stats"].fill_(_SENTINEL)
+            graph.replay()
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+        replay()
+        _check(_LENS_Q, _LENS_KV, packed, stor, geom, "none", stats="token_major")
+
+        # A new step: other lengths, other gaps, the same buffers rewritten in place.

+# The forward bias and the per-key kv_mask: what the ANALYZER accepts as facts and rejects as malformed (``invalid``), and the typed

+def _mk_small_d_graph(d: int = 32, *, s_q: int = 256, s_kv: int = 256, dtype=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, bias=None, kv_mask=None, **sdpa_kwargs):
+    """A dense (B, H, S, d) forward graph at a small head dim with an optional ``bias`` / ``kv_mask`` tensor spec
+    (``(dims, strides, data_type)``); the O geometry is set directly (``_finish_output``)."""
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=dtype, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    dims_q, dims_kv = (B, H, s_q, d), (B, H, s_kv, d)
+    q = g.tensor(dim=dims_q, stride=(s_q * H * d, d, H * d, 1), data_type=dtype, name="q")
+    k = g.tensor(dim=dims_kv, stride=(s_kv * H * d, d, H * d, 1), data_type=dtype, name="k")
+    v = g.tensor(dim=dims_kv, stride=(s_kv * H * d, d, H * d, 1), data_type=dtype, name="v")
+    kw = dict(name="s", q=q, k=k, v=v, attn_scale=0.1, is_inference=True, **sdpa_kwargs)
+    if bias is not None:
+        kw["bias"] = g.tensor(dim=bias[0], stride=bias[1], data_type=bias[2], name="bias")
+    if kv_mask is not None:
+        kw["kv_mask"] = g.tensor(dim=kv_mask[0], stride=kv_mask[1], data_type=kv_mask[2], name="kv_mask")
+    o, _ = g.sdpa(**kw)
+    _finish_output(o, dims_q, (s_q * H * d, d, H * d, 1), dtype=dtype)
+    return g
+

+def _compact(dims):
+    """Compact (row-major) strides of ``dims``."""
+    st, acc = [], 1
+    for n in reversed(dims):
+        st.append(acc)
+        acc *= n
+    return tuple(reversed(st))
+

+_BIAS_ACCEPT = {
+    "per_head [1, H, S, S]": ((1, H, S, S), _compact((1, H, S, S))),
+    "per_batch_head [B, H, S, S]": ((B, H, S, S), _compact((B, H, S, S))),
+    "head_broadcast [1, 1, S, S]": ((1, 1, S, S), _compact((1, 1, S, S))),
+    "batch_head_broadcast [B, 1, S, S]": ((B, 1, S, S), _compact((B, 1, S, S))),
+    # the strided OUTER axes: a [B, S_q, H, S_kv]-physical bias (the head stride below the row stride) and a padded row stride
+    "outer_permuted [B, S_q, H, S_kv]-physical": ((B, H, S, S), (S * H * S, S, H * S, 1)),
+    "padded_row_stride": ((1, H, S, S), (H * S * (S + 64), S * (S + 64), S + 64, 1)),
+}
